strings.talk.10015.text: I'm sorry, you need to be level #R#B20/#R/#B or more to create your own Guild.
strings.talk.10016.text: You need to pay #R#B10,000 Gold/#R/#B to create your own Guild.
strings.talk.11012.text: Come here to have a look at the weapons and customs in my shop.
strings.talk.11013.text: Welcome! We have everything you could want in our store.
strings.talk.11014.text: You need to pay 10 gold for one night stay. Do you want to have a rest?
strings.talk.11029.text: I'm not willing to do it.
strings.talk.11030.text: Please trust me and give it to me.
strings.talk.11031.text: Sorry, I have something else to do.
strings.talk.11032.text: It doesn't matter, you can entrust it to me.
strings.talk.11034.text: It doesn't matter, I will ask others to help me.
strings.talk.11038.text: Without your help, I can not figure out how to do it.
strings.talk.11039.text: You won't even help with this small favor?
strings.talk.11040.text: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
strings.talk.11041.text: Why is there a hot spring?
strings.talk.11044.text: The weather is so nice today, isn't it?
strings.talk.11048.text: This is the Reception Desk. Please select relevant matter.
strings.talk.11049.text: This is the Pet NPC Claim, what can I do for you?
strings.talk.11050.text: This is the Props Keeper. Please select the service.
strings.talk.11051.text: This is the arena, please select the item you need.
strings.talk.11067.text: What can I do for you?
strings.talk.11075.text: I will come again after I have prepared myself.
strings.talk.11076.text: I'm really grateful for what you have done for me. Please accept this gift.
strings.talk.11078.text: Sorry, you don't have enough Stars.
strings.talk.11085.text: Turn a blind eye to it.
strings.talk.11086.text: Damn it! I won't let you get away with this!
strings.talk.11087.text: Not enough room for the items, so nothing happens.
strings.talk.11088.text: Not enough free pet slots to trigger the event.
strings.talk.19001.text: Er, are you the warrior who pulled out the hair of lion? What's wrong?
strings.talk.19002.text: I still have no hair, but I have heard a #RWitch Doctor/#R is selling a #RMagic Potion/#R nearby. It can help my hair grow again. But, I cannot find him.
strings.talk.19003.text: Can you help me look for him? I will pay you.
strings.talk.19004.text: (He is so persistent! Is there really a way to cure his baldness?)
strings.talk.19005.text: I have a date with #RMabel/#R in the #RAfrica Plain/#R. you can go first, I will come soon.
strings.talk.19006.text: Please help me buy the #RMagic Potion/#R from the #RWitch Doctor/#R.
strings.talk.19008.text: All right, I will do it by myself.
strings.talk.19009.text: Hi, do you see a #RWitch Doctor/#R who is selling #RMagic Potion/#R?
strings.talk.19011.text: I want to buy a bottle of Magic Potion. (He is also bald. Does he sell such potion?)
strings.talk.19013.text: Sorry, My sheep have used up all the Magic Potions. Please come early next year.
strings.talk.19014.text: Next year? I can't wait that long.
strings.talk.19015.text: Er, if you find the ingredients I will make it for you.
strings.talk.19017.text: #R3 Ginseng, 1 bottle of rice wine, 2 Yaro Safflowers/#R. Combine these with my secret recipe and you'll have your Magic Potion.
strings.talk.19018.text: I have prepared all materials. Here you go.
strings.talk.19019.text: Hmm~ First like this... then like this... and then... Done! Here you go!
strings.talk.19022.text: Lost it?  Luckily, there are still some materials left, I will make another one for you. Don't lose it again.
strings.talk.19023.text: I have found the Magic Potion for you. Try it and see its effect.
strings.talk.19024.text: Great, I will use it now.
strings.talk.19025.text: Ha-ha, something is coming out of my head.
strings.talk.19027.text: Wow, I have hair! It's finally grown back after all these years.
strings.talk.19028.text: Thank you very much. I can show off my hair now.
strings.talk.19029.text: (This Magic Potion is really very potent!)
strings.talk.19033.text: Why, why am I so handsome?
strings.talk.19034.text: Oh, nothing. I will go first, see you!
strings.talk.19035.text: Wait! Even though I am handsome, I'm still too scared to face my sweetheart.
strings.talk.19036.text: Can you go with me to propose to Mabel?
strings.talk.19038.text: I have other things to do.
strings.talk.19039.text: Ok, I will ask other people.
strings.talk.19041.text: Is that Mabel? Why is there a group of lions around her?
strings.talk.19043.text: These lions look too hungry. I cannot fight so many lions! What should I do?
strings.talk.19044.text: Darling, I am fine. I know you will save me. You are so great!
strings.talk.19046.text: Of course, I've been waiting for this for so long.
strings.talk.19047.text: They seem to be ignoring me.
strings.talk.19048.text: Thank you for your help. Please take this gift and have a good journey.
strings.talk.19049.text: Thanks for helping me grow my hair back!
strings.talk.19050.text: Sir, I'll go find these materials right away.
strings.talk.19051.text: Materials for Magic Potion are #R3 Ginseng, 1 bottle of rice wine, 2 Yaro Safflowers/#R, have you found them?
strings.talk.19052.text: Magic Potion is really effective! Feel free to use it.
strings.talk.19054.text: Hah, Mabel, are you injured? Do you need a doctor? Take it easy, I promise I will never let you be endangered again.
strings.talk.19055.text: Whenever you are ready, please come with me when I propose.
strings.talk.19056.text: Sorry, you should have one empty slot at least.
strings.talk.19057.text: If I can help you propose successfully, I am willing to give you a hand.
strings.talk.19058.text: Disgusting! I can defeat these lions after full preparation.
strings.talk.19059.text: Mabel, I will rescue you this time!
strings.talk.19061.text: Wait for me in the north of #RAfrican Plain/#R, I will come soon.
strings.talk.19064.text: Alas, I forgot to take one important thing.
strings.talk.19066.text: Mabel, don't be afraid! I'll save you!
strings.talk.19067.text: What are you looking for? Did you ask her to marry you?
strings.talk.19068.text: I am looking for the love token.
strings.talk.19070.text: What is he looking for? I'd better follow him.
strings.talk.19072.text: How long is their intimacy going to last? I'd better leave.
strings.talk.19073.text: Someone's on the floor! Are you okay?! (Is he dead?)
strings.talk.19074.text: Hello? Can you hear me? Hello?!
strings.talk.19076.text: Are you sure you're okay? I can help you into the bed.
strings.talk.19077.text: It's okay, I just feel tired when I first get up. I'll be fine after I drink some of Bick's Black Medicine.
strings.talk.19079.text: It's a really great potion, but it's really expensive... Now that I think of it, I don't even have any money! What will I do, I already owe him so much!
strings.talk.19080.text: I think I can help you to buy it, I just wonder why it's so powerful.
strings.talk.19081.text: I wonder how you make this stuff...
strings.talk.19082.text: (Maybe I can find out something about the #Rblack Medicine/#R from these bottles!)
strings.talk.19083.text: Really? Thank you so much! You can find #Rblack Medicine/#R in #RBick/#R's house near the shop easily!
strings.talk.19085.text: Yes, what can I do for you?
strings.talk.19086.text: I came here to buy some #RBlack Medicine/#R.
strings.talk.19087.text: I've never seen you here before, how do you know about my #RBlack Medicine/#R?
strings.talk.19088.text: Hubert asked me to buy it for him. Can you sell it to me?
strings.talk.19089.text: Oh, the poor guy? He owed me a lot of money and now he wants more without paying?! No way! I'm not selling it to that guy!
strings.talk.19090.text: I'm sure he'll return the money... Just one more bottle?
strings.talk.19091.text: Get out right NOW! No more handouts for the poor!
strings.talk.19092.text: (Poor Herbert won't be able to work without the medicine... I'd better go break the bad news...)
strings.talk.19093.text: I recognize this... It's the bottle that was in Hubert's house! Maybe this is the bottle of the #RBlack Medicine/#R.
strings.talk.19094.text: Is this... coffee? It is! I should tell Hubert!
strings.talk.19095.text: You... You ruined me!!! I want to kill you!
strings.talk.19096.text: Great, I can give this coffee to the villagers, they'll be happy about it!
strings.talk.19097.text: Please don't! I spent so much time and money on this, and can't get anything back!
strings.talk.19098.text: So you know you were wrong?
strings.talk.19099.text: Yes, I realize it now. I'll be a good business man, have this bottle on me!
strings.talk.19100.text: Hubert! Hubert! I got the Black Medicine!
strings.talk.19101.text: Wow, thanks! I'll drink some right now!
strings.talk.19102.text: Wait, Hubert, you should really see a doctor! This is just coffee, it won't cure your disease.
strings.talk.19103.text: It couldn't hurt... I'll go see the doctor. Take this for your troubles!
strings.talk.19105.text: I don't know what to do.
strings.talk.19106.text: Do you want to help him?
strings.talk.19107.text: I can't stand up and now I have a severe headache, can you get #RBlack Medicine/#R from #RBick/#R near the shop?
strings.talk.19108.text: (Maybe I can find out something about the #RBlack Medicine/#R from these bottles!)
strings.talk.19110.text: Curse Bick! I want to expose him!
strings.talk.19112.text: This coffee will be sold for a low price!
strings.talk.19113.text: You lost it? Ugh, here's another. Don't lose this one.
strings.talk.19115.text: I want to be the best coffee salesman!
strings.talk.19116.text: Are you in trouble? If not, then leave me alone!
strings.talk.19118.text: The Persian bottle is really pretty.
strings.talk.19119.text: It's terrible! My husband was eaten by a Huge Sandworm! He spoke in my dream last night, hoping someone could avenge him!
strings.talk.19120.text: But... But I can't... I can't...
strings.talk.19121.text: Don't cry, I can help. Where is it?
strings.talk.19122.text: It's always wandering along the #RDeath Dune/#R. Please be careful!
strings.talk.19123.text: Oh, another meal walks my way! Prepare to be devoured!!
strings.talk.19124.text: I'll kill you before that happens!
strings.talk.19126.text: If I don't kill you, you'll eat others...
strings.talk.19127.text: Is that a ring? Something's carved into it: For my love-Lia
strings.talk.19128.text: Lia, I have slain the Huge Sandworm. I found this ring near it, I think it was left for you by Claud.
strings.talk.19129.text: This ring... I gave it to Claud... but... he's dead now... no...
strings.talk.19130.text: I'm sure Claud would have wanted you to live a happy life, try not to cry.
strings.talk.19131.text: Right... I'll keep this ring, and Claud's blessings with it.
strings.talk.19132.text: The #RHuge Sandworm/#R lives in #RDeath Dune/#R, you must be careful.
strings.talk.19133.text: Help her, she's a poor woman.
strings.talk.19134.text: Sorry, I'm too busy right now.
strings.talk.19136.text: I can't beat this yet, I should train some more.
strings.talk.19137.text: I'll kill you this time hideous beast!
strings.talk.19138.text: You escaped last time, this time you won't be lucky. I'm going to eat you!!!
strings.talk.19139.text: This ring must've been left by Claud... I'll give it to Lia.
strings.talk.19140.text: Thank you for helping... Take this.
strings.talk.19141.text: Claud will protect me like always, even if he's in heaven.
strings.talk.19143.text: This ring must've been left by Claude... I'll give it to Lia.
strings.talk.19144.text: Oh no! What can I do now?
strings.talk.19146.text: I forgot my purple box, and it has something important in it! If my wife Luchia opens it.... oh dear!
strings.talk.19147.text: Can you get me that box?
strings.talk.19149.text: It's next to the senate, can you get my #Rpurple box/#R?
strings.talk.19150.text: Who are you? Why are you here?
strings.talk.19151.text: Hello Luchia, your husband asked me to get a Purple Box for him.
strings.talk.19152.text: You mean this box? He always brings it with him. It's weird he forgot it today.
strings.talk.19154.text: You could... but what's in it? I could hide it and just watch my husbands reactions...
strings.talk.19155.text: ...but, if you could get #R3/#R #RRoses/#R for me, I suppose you could have this box...
strings.talk.19156.text: Here Luchia, here's the roses you wanted.
strings.talk.19161.text: I'm... not even beautiful with the roses? Now I'll damage this box!
strings.talk.19162.text: Thanks... take this to my husband now.
strings.talk.19165.text: You finally know what's in it.
strings.talk.19166.text: You always bring this toy, why?
strings.talk.19167.text: It's a birthday gift from my mother when I was a child... It's very important to me.
strings.talk.19168.text: Oh, I thought it was from your ex-girlfriend...
strings.talk.19169.text: So, darling, do you think I'm pretty with the roses?
strings.talk.19170.text: You're the most beautiful girl I've ever seen.
strings.talk.19171.text: #n/#n gave me those roses. #n/#n is a very kind person.
strings.talk.19172.text: Thanks for helping us... Take this for your trouble.
strings.talk.19173.text: What can I do for you?
strings.talk.19174.text: Rome is my home, I'm here to protect it!
strings.talk.19177.text: Oh, I love roses! Thanks so much!
strings.talk.19178.text: I think the potato stewed with beef is a good choice. My darling loves it so much!
strings.talk.19179.text: I should go back, but I need to patrol.
strings.talk.19180.text: My house is next to the senate, can you help me get my #Rpurple box/#R?
strings.talk.19186.text: Child, I'm too young to be your aunty... Don't cry, what happened?
strings.talk.19188.text: Yes, you can call me sister...
strings.talk.19189.text: Aunty, I forgot where I put my Homework Sheet. Can you help me find it?
strings.talk.19190.text: Help the little boy find his Homework Sheet?
strings.talk.19191.text: Okay, I'll help you, but don't call me Aunty. I'm Sister, okay?
strings.talk.19192.text: Thank you so much! I'm sure you'll find the #RHomework Sheet/#R soon.
strings.talk.19195.text: Is that cow... chewing the Homework Sheet?!
strings.talk.19196.text: Hey, what are you chewing on there?
strings.talk.19197.text: This is my lunch, is there a problem?
strings.talk.19199.text: You want to steal my lunch? I'm strong, and not afraid of you!
strings.talk.19200.text: Here's the sheet, here you go...
strings.talk.19201.text: I found this sheet, is it the right one?
strings.talk.19203.text: I found it... why are you still crying?
strings.talk.19204.text: I have to hand it in tomorrow, but it's way too late to finish it!
strings.talk.19206.text: I'll help you this time, but next time remember to put it somewhere safe.
strings.talk.19208.text: It's not too difficult, I can finish it quickly!
strings.talk.19210.text: Thanks for helping me! Take this!
strings.talk.19211.text: 1. Greece is located on which peninsula?
strings.talk.19216.text: 2. Which is the pioneer of the Greek culture?
strings.talk.19221.text: Which of these is a philosopher?
strings.talk.19226.text: 4. Who built the first empire cross Europe and Asia?
strings.talk.19231.text: 5. Greece was finally conquered by which group?
strings.talk.19237.text: Child, I'm too young to be your uncle... Don't cry, what happened?
strings.talk.19239.text: Yes, you can call me brother...
strings.talk.19240.text: I can't find my Homework Sheet brother, can you help me find it?
strings.talk.19241.text: Help the little boy find his Homework Sheet?
strings.talk.19242.text: Ok, I'll help you find it, but stop calling me Uncle. I'm brother, okay?
strings.talk.19243.text: Yes... you found it, but it's too late to finish! I have to turn it in tomorrow!
strings.talk.19245.text: Thanks for helping me! Take this!
strings.talk.19249.text: Mom, do you know where my homework sheet is?
strings.talk.19250.text: I haven't seen it... Is it on the desk?
strings.talk.19251.text: No, I can't find it anywhere in the house!
strings.talk.19252.text: I'm busy, you should ask someone else to help you.
strings.talk.19253.text: Sister, have you found the homework sheet yet?
strings.talk.19254.text: Brother, have you found the homework sheet yet?
strings.talk.19255.text: Go back and train more, you won't beat me!
strings.talk.19256.text: I'll get that cow this time!
strings.talk.19257.text: I'll eat this sheet if I get it again.
strings.talk.19261.text: Yay, I finished my homework, I can play with my friend now!
strings.talk.19262.text: First, the pencil box and now the homework sheet! It's annoying finding his things. How does he lose this stuff?
strings.talk.19263.text: I know my child is naughty, but he always gives me special things.
strings.talk.19264.text: Thanks so much, he won't lose it again I think.
strings.talk.19265.text: Mom, can I go play with my friends now?
strings.talk.19266.text: Not until you finish your homework!
strings.talk.19268.text: Hey boy, what's your name? I'll find your mother.
strings.talk.19272.text: Jam is worried about you. He wondered why you were gone so long, you should go back home to him.
strings.talk.19273.text: But I can't go back right now!
strings.talk.19275.text: Today is Jam's birthday, and he likes platinum beetles! It's why I was gone!
strings.talk.19276.text: I wanted to catch one as a birthday gift, but I don't know how!
strings.talk.19277.text: I can help you catch one, just go back home and I'll get one as soon as possible.
strings.talk.19280.text: Shh, I haven't told Jam yet... It's a surprise!
strings.talk.19281.text: Jam, me and sister got you a gift for your birthday!
strings.talk.19283.text: Thank you so much, Jam enjoyed his birthday!
strings.talk.19284.text: I'm happy that Jam liked the beetle so much.
strings.talk.19285.text: I just bought this bouquet from the market, but you can have it. Thanks!
strings.talk.19286.text: Come back and see us again if you ever have time!
strings.talk.19287.text: I'm going to show my beetle to everyone tomorrow!
strings.talk.19288.text: Jam, me and brother got you a gift for your birthday!
strings.talk.19290.text: Mom's home now, but she seems to be worried about something. Can you help her?
strings.talk.19291.text: You got a Platinum Beetle for me?
strings.talk.19292.text: Xao Li, Xao Yung,  Xao Ree, where are you? I want to leave now, where are you!
strings.talk.19293.text: What are you looking for? Need help?
strings.talk.19294.text: Me and my children came here to get grapes, but I can't find them now!
strings.talk.19295.text: We should go home, where are they?
strings.talk.19299.text: Your mom is looking for you. She's waiting in front of the grape garden. You should go see her.
strings.talk.19300.text: Oh, it's really late! I forgot!
strings.talk.19301.text: It's okay, just go find her as soon as possible.
strings.talk.19305.text: Your mom is looking for you. She's waiting in front of the grape garden. You should go see her.
strings.talk.19306.text: I thought I could get some coconuts...
strings.talk.19307.text: It's okay, just go find her as soon as possible.
strings.talk.19309.text: Your mom is looking for you. She's waiting in front of the grape garden. You should go see her.
strings.talk.19310.text: I just wanted to get her some flowers... They're so pretty!
strings.talk.19311.text: It's okay, just go find her as soon as possible.
strings.talk.19312.text: Okay, I'll go find mom right now!
strings.talk.19313.text: I'm so happy you're back, I was so worried!
strings.talk.19314.text: Don't run off so far next time!
strings.talk.19320.text: I want to get the coconut, shall I go back later?
strings.talk.19321.text: I want to get the flowers, shall I go back later?
strings.talk.19322.text: I want to get the great grape, shall I go back later?
strings.talk.19323.text: Have you found #RXao Li, Xao Yung and Xao Ree/#R?
strings.talk.19324.text: If you find #RXao Li, Xao Yung and Xao Ree/#R, please tell them I'll be waiting in front of the grape garden.
strings.talk.19325.text: Can you help me find my children?
strings.talk.19328.text: Did you go back to find your mom?
strings.talk.19329.text: Jam, do you know where your mom went?
strings.talk.19330.text: My mom said she went to buy some medicine in #Rvillage/#R, but it's been a long time since she left.
strings.talk.19331.text: Don't worry, I'll go find her.
strings.talk.19333.text: Wahhhh... who can help me find my mom?
strings.talk.19335.text: Wow, so this time we get a great harvest! We have grapes, coconuts and flowers!
strings.talk.19336.text: There is so much fruit here!
strings.talk.19337.text: These flowers are pretty, I want to give them all to mom!
strings.talk.19338.text: I love the coconut milk, can I have some?
strings.talk.19339.text: Do you like the Platinum Beetle?
strings.talk.19340.text: Mom, I want to name my Platinum Beetle Xao Ba, is that okay?
strings.talk.19341.text: Of course! You should take good care of Xao Ba.
strings.talk.19342.text: Ok, I will. It will be the strongest beetle in Yamataikoku.
strings.talk.19343.text: Don't worry child, I'm sure your mom will be back soon.
strings.talk.19344.text: Don't you want to find her?
strings.talk.19345.text: She asked me to stay home and wait for her.
strings.talk.19346.text: He's really worried about his mom... Help him?
strings.talk.19347.text: Xao Li and Xao Ree still haven't returned.
strings.talk.19348.text: Xao Li and Xao Yung still haven't returned.
strings.talk.19350.text: Xao Yung and Xao Ree still haven't returned.
strings.talk.19354.text: I sent it out to play, it comes back when I whistle!
strings.talk.19356.text: What's up? What's up?! Everyone knows that the Roman King's gold fortune is here, that's what's up!
strings.talk.19357.text: I want to give up though, because it's in this maze with monsters...
strings.talk.19358.text: Fortune? I think I'll have a go.
strings.talk.19359.text: So a gold fortune is hidden here?
strings.talk.19360.text: Cool, I can bring the treasure home now!
strings.talk.19361.text: You shouldn't touch the fortune of others.
strings.talk.19362.text: This monster is incredibly strong. I need to train.
strings.talk.19363.text: The paper reads: The Lucky Dog will go the right way.
strings.talk.19365.text: My master taught me this. I do it quite well, but feel sorry for using it.
strings.talk.19366.text: If it's so good, what are you sorry about?
strings.talk.19367.text: I have a talented twin brother, but he has a bad temper. My master taught me this Kung-Fu and not him.
strings.talk.19368.text: My brother got really angry and left. We haven't heard from him since.
strings.talk.19369.text: Maybe I can help you. What is his name?
strings.talk.19371.text: What?! Don't call me that, you're a stranger to me!!!
strings.talk.19372.text: Calm down buddy, your brother wanted me to tell you he misses you and wants you back home.
strings.talk.19373.text: I don't want to go back.
strings.talk.19374.text: I don't even care about what master did, I just want to finish a task.
strings.talk.19376.text: I want to make the most powerful sword in the world, but need some materials.
strings.talk.19377.text: I could help you find the materials...
strings.talk.19378.text: I still need #R5 Black Jade, 3 Copper Ore and 2 Northern Tiger Skin/#R. I want to make the most powerful sword in the world!
strings.talk.19380.text: Hello Sword, I have the materials.
strings.talk.19381.text: Wonderful! I can make the sword now!
strings.talk.19383.text: I'll go back when I finish this sword, tell brother not to worry about me.
strings.talk.19389.text: I experienced many things when I left home, but I think master was right to teach you Kung Fu.
strings.talk.19390.text: If I had learned Kung-Fu, I could've done horrible things knowing my temper. It's a good thing I didn't learn it.
strings.talk.19391.text: When I figured that out, I decided to make a sword instead... So I forged this to give to you! You'll be incredibly powerful now!
strings.talk.19392.text: Thanks! With this sword, I'll be one of the best swordsman!
strings.talk.19394.text: #n/#n, thanks for helping me gather those materials, take this!
strings.talk.19395.text: My brother is #RWino/#R #RCai/#R, but he hates that name. Maybe he changed this name? I don't know?
strings.talk.19397.text: You called me Wino Cai again!
strings.talk.19400.text: He misses his brother a lot, help him find his brother?
strings.talk.19402.text: Have you collected #R5 Black Jade, 3 Copper Ore and 2 Northern Tiger Skin/#R for me?
strings.talk.19404.text: I'll try my best to finish the sword and then meet you.
strings.talk.19405.text: I'm so happy my brother finally came back. ?
strings.talk.19406.text: My younger brother is honest, I think it'll help him be great at Kung-Fu.
strings.talk.19407.text: My brother went to get some wine to celebrate! We can train for a while!
strings.talk.19409.text: (These two brothers are very good people!)
strings.talk.19411.text: Let's go back and have dinner together.
strings.talk.19414.text: The Persian Army kidnapped my son! I want to rescue him...
strings.talk.19415.text: Why did they kidnap your son?
strings.talk.19416.text: Well, I'm both a mathematician and a military strategist. The Persians wanted me to help them, but I can't betray my country!
strings.talk.19417.text: So they took my son and said they'd kill him if I don't help...
strings.talk.19418.text: That's horrible, why didn't you ask the senate for help?
strings.talk.19419.text: If I did that, it might start a war, so I waited here hoping someone could help me.
strings.talk.19420.text: I think I can help. Where's your son at now?
strings.talk.19421.text: They take prisoners to the #RDungeon of Palace/#R. The guards are not easy to get past. I hope you can return with my son #RLeo/#R...
strings.talk.19422.text: My father and I are not afraid of the Persian Army, we'll escape from here.
strings.talk.19423.text: Who are you, are you here to kill me?
strings.talk.19424.text: Your father asked me to rescue you Leo.
strings.talk.19425.text: Wonderful! How can we get past the Persian General?
strings.talk.19428.text: We'd better leave as soon as we can, or they'll find us!
strings.talk.19429.text: We should leave separate ways or they'll easily find us.
strings.talk.19431.text: I'll pretend that I'm a Persian Solider and leave easily.
strings.talk.19434.text: Leo, you got out without being found, great!
strings.talk.19435.text: It was because I wore the Persian Soldier's suit!
strings.talk.19437.text: Even though we're safe, I'm afraid of what Persia will do to Rome.
strings.talk.19438.text: Don't worry about it, I'll talk to the senate and get them to send an army to protect Rome.
strings.talk.19439.text: Thank you for rescuing my son... Please, take this.
strings.talk.19440.text: Do you want to help me?
strings.talk.19441.text: I thought you could do this, but I was wrong...
strings.talk.19442.text: Hah! You want to challenge me! You're too weak!
strings.talk.19443.text: I want to defeat General Charlie and rescue Leo.
strings.talk.19444.text: General Charlie is incredibly strong, I should get prepared.
strings.talk.19445.text: I need the Key of the Dungeon.
strings.talk.19446.text: I'm very busy right now, I don't think I can help.
strings.talk.19449.text: We'd better rescue him before they wake up!
strings.talk.19450.text: Leave as fast as you can!
strings.talk.19451.text: I'm going inside, I should defeat the guard first, right?
strings.talk.19452.text: Nobody can go in the dungeon without the King's Orders!
strings.talk.19454.text: Do you think I'll let you escape? We'll tear you to pieces!!!
strings.talk.19458.text: I will try my best to defend my country!
strings.talk.19459.text: We'd better leave here before they wake up.
strings.talk.19460.text: They take prisoners to the #RDungeon of Palace/#R. The guards are not easy to get past. I hope you can return with my son #Rleo/#R...
strings.talk.19461.text: General Charlie is unconscious, let's escape before he wakes up!
strings.talk.19462.text: General Charlie is unconscious, let's escape before he wakes up!
strings.talk.19463.text: You there, come work in the stable!
strings.talk.19464.text: Why? I don't even know you!
strings.talk.19465.text: Oh, I just need someone to look after the horses.
strings.talk.19466.text: Oh... You should hire someone to look after them for you.
strings.talk.19467.text: I know, but I need to be quick or the horses will get sick.
strings.talk.19469.text: My wallet is missing, that guy stole it! Help!
strings.talk.19471.text: I thought you were following me...
strings.talk.19472.text: Just give me the wallet you stole.
strings.talk.19473.text: If I don't give it back, what will you do?
strings.talk.19474.text: I'll get it back the hard way!
strings.talk.19479.text: Why did you adopt so many kids if you're poor?
strings.talk.19480.text: I'm an orphan, I think I can be a father for them and give them a stable family.
strings.talk.19481.text: Last month, the shop I worked for closed down, so I don't have enough money pay for the rent. I need 20,000 Gold.
strings.talk.19482.text: I don't mind living on the street, but these kids can't be wandering on the cold streets at night!
strings.talk.19483.text: That's why I stole the wallet.
strings.talk.19484.text: Want to give Cool King #R20,000 Gold/#R?
strings.talk.19485.text: I know someone in need of a horse-keeper... You can go to Inchon and visit Wheel Ben, he'll hire you.
strings.talk.19486.text: I'll help you pay the rent, but return the wallet first.
strings.talk.19488.text: No problem, but go see Wheel Ben fast so you get the job.
strings.talk.19489.text: Thanks, he's good at this job!
strings.talk.19492.text: Yes, but where is the thief?
strings.talk.19493.text: He promised he wouldn't do it again, and apologized.
strings.talk.19494.text: That's great. Thanks for helping me!
strings.talk.19495.text: I bought this bouquet this morning, but you can have it as a thank-you!
strings.talk.19496.text: Wallet? What? I don't know what you're talking about.
strings.talk.19497.text: I want to get the wallet back!
strings.talk.19498.text: Want to help Wheel Ben hire someone?
strings.talk.19499.text: Have you found someone to help me?
strings.talk.19500.text: What to buy... I can't remember!
strings.talk.19501.text: Did you get my wallet back yet?
strings.talk.19503.text: I want to leave for a while, stay here and wait for me, okay?
strings.talk.19505.text: I hope daddy gets good news!
strings.talk.19506.text: First, you should give me the wallet you stole.
strings.talk.19508.text: Thanks for helping me, I have a good job!
strings.talk.19511.text: Yeah, I found someone named Cool King, he should be here soon.
strings.talk.19512.text: I hope he gets here quickly.
strings.talk.19513.text: (I think I'd better go to visit #RWheel Ben/#R, I should see if Cool King got the job.)
strings.talk.19515.text: I bought this thing this morning. You can have it as a thank-you.
strings.talk.19516.text: Thanks for helping me get my wallet back!
strings.talk.19517.text: If you want a good sturdy horse, you can buy one from me!
strings.talk.19518.text: (I think I forgot the wallet in Cool King's house, I'd better go back and get it.
strings.talk.19519.text: Is this the thief's house? I think I'll have a look...
strings.talk.19520.text: Grandma asked me to buy something other than dinner!
strings.talk.19522.text: Guardian! I ran into a huge monster in the Wish Forest, what if it attacks the villagers?!
strings.talk.19524.text: Yes, a huge and horrible monster!
strings.talk.19525.text: Okay, I'll report it to our leader, then we'll patrol here.
strings.talk.19527.text: (Why is there a huge monster in #RWish Forest/#R? I think I should go and have a look.)
strings.talk.19528.text: Xao Mo, Xao Mo, where are you? Why don't you come and find me?
strings.talk.19530.text: Hey, you scared the villagers around here! You should leave now.
strings.talk.19531.text: Sorry, but I want to find Xao Mo.
strings.talk.19533.text: She's a very kind friend of mine. She always sings songs for us, and she gave me my name, Mao!
strings.talk.19534.text: ...but now she's missing, and I'm worried about her!
strings.talk.19535.text: I think I can help you to see Xao Mo, but you can't, ok?
strings.talk.19537.text: Xao Mo, my sweetie, don't leave me alone.
strings.talk.19539.text: Xao Mo is weak. She has a bad cough and is faint. Even the best doctor I know told me she's in danger!
strings.talk.19540.text: Who can help my sweet daughter?! I'll give anything to save her!
strings.talk.19541.text: (Xao Mo is very sick, I should tell them)
strings.talk.19543.text: Wait, Mao is a good monster! He's not here to hurt you!
strings.talk.19544.text: Look at the sharp claws that he has! We should stop him before he attacks us!
strings.talk.19545.text: It'd be brutal to do so!
strings.talk.19546.text: Oh, helping the monster? We'll just kill them all!
strings.talk.19549.text: I'm ok. Just tell me, how's Xiaomo?
strings.talk.19552.text: Xao Mo has a strange illness, you should come have a look...
strings.talk.19553.text: Can you get the gem that's socketed on my head? It cures many diseases, I found it in the forest...
strings.talk.19554.text: But what about you? You are also badly hurt.
strings.talk.19555.text: This gem let's me live long, but I also am so lonely...
strings.talk.19556.text: Then I met Xao Mo. She wants to be my friend, and play with me. I want her to grow up and  have a happy life.
strings.talk.19557.text: So? You want to give it to her?
strings.talk.19558.text: I can help you give this gem to her.
strings.talk.19559.text: I think Xao Mo will be ok if she put this gem on. It can cure different diseases.
strings.talk.19561.text: Xao Mo how are you feeling?
strings.talk.19562.text: I'm okay mom, I want to play with Mao.
strings.talk.19563.text: Xao Mo, Mao went back home.
strings.talk.19565.text: Mom, do you want to go with me? I want to the place where I met Mao. There are many trees, flowers and animals. It's a great place.
strings.talk.19566.text: He went back home? Why didn't he tell me!
strings.talk.19567.text: Because he gave a gem hoping you would get better.
strings.talk.19568.text: Oh, ok, I'll be healthy and then when I grow up, I'll protect my mom and Mao.
strings.talk.19569.text: Xao Mo, you really are a good little girl.
strings.talk.19570.text: Thanks for saving Mao and Xao Mo, take this as my thanks.
strings.talk.19571.text: Mao can't hold on any longer, we have to help.
strings.talk.19572.text: She even gave me a nice name Mao. And we had a lot of fun together!
strings.talk.19573.text: Don't stand in the way! Help! Guards!
strings.talk.19574.text: We won't let you harass Mao!
strings.talk.19575.text: Mao told me to give the gem to Xao Mo and urged her to be careful. I can't fail this time.
strings.talk.19578.text: We'll take a look after dinner.
strings.talk.19579.text: Thank you, and you too Mao.
strings.talk.19580.text: I hope some day Mao will come back and see me doing well.
strings.talk.19582.text: Assemble your men to fight the monster!
strings.talk.19583.text: In what part of #RWish Forest/#R did you see the monster?
strings.talk.19584.text: In the grasslands! He caught me completely off guard and scared me!
strings.talk.19585.text: (Mao is not around any more, but I guess Xao Mo will always miss him.
strings.talk.19587.text: Mao told me to give the gem to Xao Mo and urged her to be careful.
strings.talk.19589.text: Brother, you broke my favorite doll!
strings.talk.19590.text: Oh my! What should I do now?
strings.talk.19591.text: Little brothers, how are you doing?
strings.talk.19592.text: I messed up Xao Mee's doll by accident and now she's mad at me! What do I do?
strings.talk.19593.text: Hmmm. I'll help you figure something out...
strings.talk.19594.text: Do you know what Xao Mee likes?
strings.talk.19595.text: She likes Small Daisy a lot. I often give her #R 5 Small Daisy/#R as gifts.
strings.talk.19596.text: Maybe I know how to calm down Xao Mee. Hang on a minute.
strings.talk.19598.text: Little sister, I got you some small daisies... Please don't be upset at me!
strings.talk.19601.text: I know, Xao Mee is curious what a Fire Lizard looks like. Maybe a Fire Lizard would get her mind off of the doll.
strings.talk.19603.text: Yeah, I think so. By the way, I don't know what they look like either.
strings.talk.19604.text: Good, I'll try to find some #RFire Lizards/#R.
strings.talk.19609.text: It's a Fire Lizard! Don't you like it? You've always wanted to see one!
strings.talk.19611.text: Uh oh, did we add insult to injury?
strings.talk.19612.text: Maybe... Perhaps food is a good idea?
strings.talk.19613.text: Oh yes! I know her favorite is #RFruit Cake/#R. It will cheer her up for sure.
strings.talk.19614.text: Good idea! I'll try to find some!
strings.talk.19615.text: Here is some fruit cake for you to give her.
strings.talk.19616.text: Little Sister, I got your favorite fruit cake, please don't be mad at me anymore!
strings.talk.19617.text: Brother, I need to talk to you
strings.talk.19619.text: You have to promise not to be mad first.
strings.talk.19620.text: Why? I'm hoping you won't be mad at me!
strings.talk.19621.text: Uh... I... broke your wooden sword...
strings.talk.19622.text: What? You broke my wooden sword?!
strings.talk.19623.text: You promised not to be mad! Grandpa said he would help!
strings.talk.19625.text: Grandpa, brother messed up my doll.
strings.talk.19626.text: Grandpa, sister broke my wooden sword!
strings.talk.19627.text: That's enough! Stop bickering and get ready to eat.
strings.talk.19630.text: Sorry my grandchildren were such trouble. I have something for you.
strings.talk.19631.text: Grandpa said grandma can clean up my doll, and is giving me a pair of shoes. I've forgiven brother.
strings.talk.19632.text: Grandpa made a new wooden sword for me, so I've forgiven sister.
strings.talk.19633.text: Do you have any ideas how to mend Xao Mee's broken heart?
strings.talk.19634.text: (Go collect #R5 Small Daisy/#R for Xao Mee.
strings.talk.19636.text: Do you have #RFruit Cake/#R with you?
strings.talk.19637.text: Xao Mee seems worried. Xao Tee, can you figure it out?
strings.talk.19639.text: Xao Mee is still in a bad mood.
strings.talk.19640.text: I want some BBQ Pork Buns.
strings.talk.19641.text: Little brother, would you like some BBQ Pork Buns?
strings.talk.19642.text: I'd love to, but I can't afford any, so I'm settling for Pazychyrus.
strings.talk.19643.text: I think I can cook some BBQ Pork Buns. How many do you want me to cook?
strings.talk.19644.text: I want to have #R10 BBQ Pork Buns/#R.
strings.talk.19645.text: My goodness, can you eat that many?
strings.talk.19646.text: Yeah, looks can be deceiving, I can eat a lot!
strings.talk.19647.text: Okay, then be a little patient.
strings.talk.19648.text: Hey little brother, here you are, 10 BBQ Pork Buns!
strings.talk.19649.text: Wow! I have never seen so many BBQ Pork Buns. Awesome!
strings.talk.19650.text: Get some while they're warm then!
strings.talk.19651.text: Ugh... I can't finish them... there's 5 left...
strings.talk.19652.text: I thought so, what do we do with the remaining 5?
strings.talk.19653.text: I have an idea! Let's give them to Xao Fen next to Longai Hotel! She loves them!
strings.talk.19655.text: Xao Fen is mad at me these days. I am hoping these BBQ Pork Buns will cheer her up. When she cheers up a little I'll try to talk to her.
strings.talk.19656.text: All right! I am going to deliver the remaining #R5 BBQ Pork Buns/#R to #RXao Fen/#R.
strings.talk.19657.text: Excuse me, is Xao Fen here?
strings.talk.19658.text: You're talking to her. Can I help you?
strings.talk.19659.text: (I thought Xao Fen was a little girl...)
strings.talk.19660.text: Xao Sun asked me to deliver some BBQ Pork Buns.
strings.talk.19663.text: Impossible, Xao sun died long ago!
strings.talk.19664.text: But I just talked to him, he wanted me to deliver these to you!
strings.talk.19665.text: Well, it sounds like the same Xao Sun... We were good childhood friends, and he always shared BBQ Pork Buns with me.
strings.talk.19666.text: Thank you for the delivery, I have something in return.
strings.talk.19667.text: Are you done with making #R10 BBQ Pork Buns/#R?
strings.talk.19668.text: Have you finished delivering #R5 BBQ Pork Buns/#R?
strings.talk.19670.text: Right next to the Longlai Hotel. Get going with 5 BBQ Pork Buns for her. Quickly, or they'll be cold!
strings.talk.19672.text: Oh, I think Xao Sun missed me so much that he showed up as a ghost and asked you to send me some BBQ Pork Buns.
strings.talk.19673.text: #n/#n, look! The sakura is falling down like gentle rain.
strings.talk.19675.text: It's a blessing if someone watches this in their last moments...
strings.talk.19677.text: #n/#n, I have a really good time being with you these days that I forget my mission sometimes!
strings.talk.19679.text: I like travelling with you. I'd like to stick around after this mission to go adventuring some more!
strings.talk.19680.text: Exactly! We can go hiking, take a dip in the hot spring, even get some good food, just don't leave Angela!
strings.talk.19681.text: Ha-ha~ Okay! I promise you, little fool.
strings.talk.19683.text: Why did Angela come to a sudden stop?
strings.talk.19684.text: #n/#n, it seems an angel just paid a visit. The scent rings a bell to me.
strings.talk.19685.text: Really? Is it an angel you know? Let's find out!
strings.talk.19688.text: Good to have you here, Angela, Savior! You finally made it!
strings.talk.19689.text: Oh! It's you sister, I never thought I'd see you again!
strings.talk.19690.text: I just want to finish what's left sister.
strings.talk.19691.text: Don't be silly, you're just a common angel.
strings.talk.19694.text: If the Messiah descended in the final battle one hundred years ago, King Howert's dark power would not be so great.
strings.talk.19695.text: We wouldn't have lost so many angels.
strings.talk.19696.text: #n/#n! Is there a chance you'll be enchanted by King Howert and then betray Angela?
strings.talk.19697.text: Absolutely not! I want to protect Angela and see her beautiful smile!
strings.talk.19698.text: I don't know what difficulties face me down the road, but I'll protect my friends no matter where they go!
strings.talk.19700.text: Hmmm... I think you'll keep your promise. Very well. This is my Light Armband. It will guide you to King Howert.
strings.talk.19701.text: Their destinies lie in your hands. Do not fail them.
strings.talk.19702.text: I have much more to discuss with you...
strings.talk.19703.text: Angela, Misia took us under his wing. The road to defeating King Howert is still long, but we'll do anything to reach the end!
strings.talk.19704.text: The cave can't be accessed, a mysterious force prevents it.
strings.talk.19705.text: It might be a trap. Let's think twice before moving on.
strings.talk.19706.text: How dare you enter the forbidden kingdom of King Howert! ! ! Prepare to pay with your lives!
strings.talk.19707.text: Angela, how are you an heir of the Bright Shield too?
strings.talk.19708.text: Whose armlet is this? We have to stay under the radar to the men of King Howert. Perhaps #RAngela/#R can shed a light on all this.
strings.talk.19711.text: #swav1538/#sHey! Get out of here, you intruders!
strings.talk.19713.text: I purchased this antique mirror from a merchant two days ago. I bid 1 million to win it. It's supposed to be a tribute to the king!
strings.talk.19714.text: Damn, I might die for  this!
strings.talk.19715.text: Go over every nook and cranny!
strings.talk.19716.text: It's not like I live in a palace. I didn't miss it, someone must have stolen it! I just brought it back two days ago, I have no idea how the thief could've gotten it.
strings.talk.19717.text: Stolen eh, do you know who would take it?
strings.talk.19718.text: Only the merchant Aston and Ulysses who bid against me in the auction.
strings.talk.19719.text: I'll investigate. Do you know where they are?
strings.talk.19720.text: #RUlysses/#R hangs around the market near the port, and #RAston/#R is just next door.
strings.talk.19721.text: I think Ulysses probably stole it because he wanted it badly.
strings.talk.19725.text: I heard you like antique mirrors.
strings.talk.19728.text: Excuse me. I need to leave.
strings.talk.19729.text: He's in a hurry, I need to find out why!
strings.talk.19730.text: Ulysses is about to enter the #Rcave/#R. I am going to follow him inside the cave.
strings.talk.19732.text: Did you get this fortune from selling the stolen mirror?!
strings.talk.19733.text: Are you listening to yourself? I'm an antique nut! It took years to build up this fortune!
strings.talk.19734.text: Then why did you show no interest in the mirror just now?
strings.talk.19735.text: Since you followed me such a long way, I'll be honest. Aston said he got a new mirror.
strings.talk.19736.text: I was afraid that Asura would outbid me again, but Aston told me it would be okay.
strings.talk.19737.text: (What the hell is going on? Just go ask #RAston/#R.)
strings.talk.19738.text: Aston, how did you get another mirror? Did you steal it from Asura or sell it to Ulysses?!
strings.talk.19739.text: Obviously, you came a long way to find the truth.
strings.talk.19741.text: You'd better not, my men will take you down in seconds...
strings.talk.19742.text: Why would you do all of this?
strings.talk.19743.text: In actuality, this mirror is a fake. Only an expert virtuoso can tell if they are extremely close.
strings.talk.19744.text: I wasn't expecting it to be a present to the king. I can't take the blame if the truth was revealed. I had no choice but to get it back.
strings.talk.19745.text: How could you! I'll report it to the king!
strings.talk.19746.text: Please don't, I can compensate for the losses that were caused.
strings.talk.19747.text: Thanks for investigating! Take this for your time.
strings.talk.19751.text: I am a friend of Asura.
strings.talk.19753.text: The mirror Asura bought from you is missing. Would you know anything about it?
strings.talk.19755.text: Do you have any other mirros like that one?
strings.talk.19756.text: No, the mirror is unique. If I get any information, I'll let Asura know immediately.
strings.talk.19758.text: It's in my dough-case. Please keep this a secret.
strings.talk.19759.text: (Ulysses was being honest.  I need to go back to have a talk with #RAston/#R.)
strings.talk.19760.text: I have to pack up the mirror and sell it to Ulysses.
strings.talk.19763.text: I know I was wrong, I'll be more honest down the road.
strings.talk.19764.text: My husband is out. Can I help you?
strings.talk.19766.text: (Is it possible that Aston stole the mirror? I need to find out.)
strings.talk.19767.text: You said Asura's mirror was stolen?
strings.talk.19768.text: That's why I don't want the antique mirror now.
strings.talk.19769.text: We have to teach you a lesson.
strings.talk.19772.text: I asked him not to touch the Pork that was sitting out for a month, but he didn't listen!
strings.talk.19773.text: #n/#n! He'll be safe if we can get a Recovery Potion...
strings.talk.19774.text: We have to get a #RRecovery Potion/#R for him.
strings.talk.19775.text: (We have to find #RRecovery Potion/#R for Tatasi.)
strings.talk.19776.text: The Recovery Potion will work on Tatasi.
strings.talk.19778.text: He's still asleep... Maybe it didn't work...
strings.talk.19779.text: I would like to have some #RRoasted Pork/#R.
strings.talk.19781.text: Give him #R10 Roasted Pork/#R. He should be fine in a little while.
strings.talk.19784.text: Stay away from rotten food next time, okay?
strings.talk.19785.text: ...but we don't know how to store food. It goes bad very often.
strings.talk.19786.text: Okay, I'll show you an easy way to store food.
strings.talk.19787.text: Gather up some spices like garlic, cinnamon and salt. Those spices can prevent food from going bad.
strings.talk.19788.text: That's based off of many experiences of storing food at sea!
strings.talk.19789.text: It's an easy way to preserve food.
strings.talk.19790.text: Here is a Cebu Stone for you. It represents our friendship.
strings.talk.19791.text: Find us if you need help in the future. We have to get going!
strings.talk.19792.text: He passed out halfway from a sharp pain in his belly.
strings.talk.19793.text: Thanks so much for Roast Pork...
strings.talk.19794.text: He looks terrible. Can Recovery Potion really help? You'd better come with #RMagellan/#R for more information.
strings.talk.19795.text: 10 Roasted Pork are not good enough, for I still don't know how to communicate with them without Magellan's presence.
strings.talk.19796.text: 10 Roasted Pork didn't recover Tatasi's energy. You'd better come with #RMagellan/#R for more information.
strings.talk.19797.text: I owe you guys a lot for the information you gave us. Thanks!
strings.talk.19798.text: Is this the Cebu Stone that Tatasi gave me? I should put it in a safe place!
strings.talk.19799.text: They remind me of my sailors. The sea was relentless, so we had to band together to ride out tough times. I wonder how they fare now...
strings.talk.19800.text: Your sailors must be good at what they do. Don't worry about them.
strings.talk.19802.text: My goodness, I want Roasted Pork so badly!
strings.talk.19804.text: It's been a long time since I boarded my ship.
strings.talk.19805.text: #n/#n, later on I'll introduce you to Henry, my first mate.
strings.talk.19809.text: The ship is very close to the Philippines, would you like to search the island? Maybe they left for food.
strings.talk.19810.text: Henry, stop goofing off and get out here!
strings.talk.19812.text: Henry's scarf... how did it get here?
strings.talk.19814.text: The sheet says: show your ID to get through!
strings.talk.19816.text: Henry? What the hell happened to you guys?
strings.talk.19817.text: We got caught in a trap while searching for food, and the villagers took us captive.
strings.talk.19818.text: The priest said we were pagans that would draw disaster in, so they locked us up.
strings.talk.19819.text: The priest was sinister, he judged us with no evidence.
strings.talk.19820.text: I see. Well, let's get out of here!
strings.talk.19821.text: New Pagans in the dungeon! Don't let them leave alive!
strings.talk.19825.text: Don't worry! I've got #n/#n with me. Get on the ship quickly and prepare to sail out!
strings.talk.19826.text: This only proves what I said! The pagans only bring death and disaster!
strings.talk.19827.text: How dare you talk back, pagan! I sense the Gods want us to rid the island of you! Your death will bring us bountiful harvests for years after!
strings.talk.19829.text: Argh, we have to play hardball!
strings.talk.19830.text: Rats, it seems we can't change this fate...
strings.talk.19831.text: I can't believe the pagans escaped alive.
strings.talk.19832.text: Aren't those the people that brought us to the dungeon?
strings.talk.19834.text: Wasn't that Tatasi and his friends?
strings.talk.19839.text: Sorry, Henry. I can't go back to Spain with you.
strings.talk.19840.text: ...but I believe you will fulfill my wish.
strings.talk.19843.text: He-he... #n/#n, adventuring with you is so exciting!
strings.talk.19844.text: ...but I am old, and not up for it.
strings.talk.19845.text: Ferdinend Magellan wasn't an old washed up alcoholic in my heart, but a great stalwart navigator.
strings.talk.19846.text: #n/#n, we must fulfill the captain's wish to sail the ship around the globe and to go back to Spain!
strings.talk.19848.text: We have to hurry up before they get us!
strings.talk.19849.text: Don't mess it up, we only stunned the guards. They will return!
strings.talk.19850.text: The priest went insane and tried to take advantage of fear.
strings.talk.19855.text: The entrance to the cellar is blocked!
strings.talk.19857.text: Maybe the #RCebu Stone/#R given by Tatasi?
strings.talk.19858.text: Should we give the Cebu Stone a try?
strings.talk.19859.text: Henry isn't on board! Let's check out Philippines Islands nearby.
strings.talk.19860.text: It seems like foreigners can't access it.
strings.talk.19861.text: There seems to be some mysterious power preventing us from entering.
strings.talk.19862.text: What ID should we use? Let's check with Magellan.
strings.talk.19863.text: I have to go back home and rest. Don't forget me.
strings.talk.19864.text: We need to unlock the gate. Maybe we can find something nearby to help.
strings.talk.19865.text: We should have come with #RMagellen/#R to get help.
strings.talk.19866.text: They are strong! We have to get #RMagellen /#R for help.
strings.talk.19867.text: We have to get out of here along with #RMagellen/#R.
strings.talk.19868.text: They are still here. We have to get #RMagellen /#R for help.
strings.talk.19869.text: #RMagellan/#R is going to leave the party. Is that okay?
strings.talk.19870.text: #RMagellen/#R is going to leave the party. Please unequip any items to avoid losing them.
strings.talk.19871.text: We all obey the words of the Priest.
strings.talk.19873.text: There is a cave in front, maybe #RMagellan/#R and #Rhis crew/#R will be there.
strings.talk.19874.text: We will ask our fellow tribesmen to not harm the pagan or his friends. Hopefully this will never happen again.
strings.talk.19879.text: The Casino Boss! He said he wanted to teach you a lesson, but he couldn't find you and #n/#n, so they took Miyuki and Yuta away.
strings.talk.19880.text: I'm too old to stop them...
strings.talk.19881.text: Where were they taken? Do you know?
strings.talk.19882.text: The Casino boss wanted me to tell you that they were waiting for you in #REastern Forest/#R, if you don't go to save them, I think they will never come back.
strings.talk.19883.text: Kanako, I want to save Miyuki and Yuta with you.
strings.talk.19884.text: But grandma, your body won't allow it.
strings.talk.19885.text: For Miyuki and Yuta, I would do anything.
strings.talk.19890.text: You finally came! I've been waiting far too long for this. Kill the hostages!
strings.talk.19893.text: An old lady stop me? Hahaha!
strings.talk.19894.text: #f2/#f I'll fight against all of you!
strings.talk.19900.text: Don't worry about me, Kanako, save Miyuki
