strings.talk.20256.text: I think this pig is the one I am looking for.
strings.talk.20257.text: Come on, little pig, you need to return to your home.
strings.talk.20259.text: I think it is on its way home.
strings.talk.20260.text: Youth, thank you for bringing my pig back.
strings.talk.20262.text: Oh, thanks, I ll keep it.
strings.talk.20263.text: I promise you I'll like it.
strings.talk.20264.text: Although our village is quite small, we still have a mine, a hoggery, and a forest.
strings.talk.20266.text: What was that? It almost hit my head.
strings.talk.20270.text: I found my son laying on the ground when I came back, and there was a white fox near him...I think it wanted to eat him...
strings.talk.20271.text: The loathsome fox fleed when it saw you, can you help me find it?
strings.talk.20273.text: I think it must be nearby the village...
strings.talk.20275.text: #F2/#F Oh no, you are so strong...
strings.talk.20276.text: I'd better kill you, because people usually say fox is too cunning.
strings.talk.20278.text: Wow, you have turned into a human! ! !
strings.talk.20279.text: You are so beautiful, I can't believe you were the fox.
strings.talk.20280.text: Yes, but please listen to me.
strings.talk.20281.text: What? You know the human language!
strings.talk.20282.text: I originally resided in a very big mountain, one day I saw a youth chopping firewood on the mountain and I fell in love at first sight.
strings.talk.20283.text: I turned into a human and came back to the village with him in order to stay with him forever, unfortunately he saw my tail by accident, and then he passed out right away.
strings.talk.20284.text: I was not willing to let that happen... believe me.
strings.talk.20285.text: I think there are too many differences between you and him... You'd better leave here , and leave him!
strings.talk.20286.text: Yes I have no choice, but please tell him I love him so much and will miss him forever!
strings.talk.20287.text: It's ok now, the fox was driven away.
strings.talk.20288.text: Ahh... thank you so much , my hero.
strings.talk.20289.text: You are welcome, the fox wanted to tell your son something.
strings.talk.20291.text: She really loves you , don't you know that?
strings.talk.20293.text: (from the distance)~~The god arranged that we met each other, but he didn't arrange that we stay together.
strings.talk.20295.text: Ahh, that fox is that girl who came back with my son!!! I can't believe it.
strings.talk.20296.text: Why did this happen to me?
strings.talk.20297.text: I wish I could be your husband forever, but I can't.
strings.talk.20298.text: I almost drool when I smell that fragrance.
strings.talk.20299.text: Doll's cooking skills are highly spoken of by native villagers.
strings.talk.20303.text: Maka Hotspring #e/#e(The hotspring can heal your injured body and enhance your health.)
strings.talk.20304.text: Cough cough... Huh? Where am I?
strings.talk.20305.text: This is such a desolate place. Why did you come here?
strings.talk.20306.text: I was on a ship, but suddenly a violent shaking made me fall unconscious.
strings.talk.20307.text: I think you must have drifted to this island after shipwreck. It's lucky that you survived.
strings.talk.20308.text: It has been 28 years since I drifted to this island.
strings.talk.20309.text: Oh, dear! 28 years ago? Didn't you look for ways to go back?
strings.talk.20310.text: Yes, I did. But I've only been to the islands nearby. I was always sent back by a violent wave every time I had almost reached the open sea.Several years of failure have caused me to give up. By the way, what's your name?
strings.talk.20312.text: #N/#N, you look fine. Walk around if you are free. You can ask me if you have any questions.
strings.talk.20313.text: What would you like to know?
strings.talk.20317.text: If you are injured, you can eat some blood-supplementing food or press ALT+1 or have a rest in the hotel of the village.
strings.talk.20318.text: Many articles such as Treasure Box, barrel etc may be found anywhere. Choose and Click any one of them and then take contents in them. For instance, you can break the wooden box beside me and take the items in it.
strings.talk.20319.text: There are many kinds of resources around here to be used. For example, you can pick coconuts from the tree beside me.
strings.talk.20320.text: To leave for other place, you can take raft or flying vehicles. You can get vehicles by completing missions or by synthesizing designs.
strings.talk.20321.text: There are instruction in the system at the bottom right. You can read game contents from it. For instance, if you are forced to stay overseas for other reasons, you can return to beach of Northern Island by pressing the button for regeneration.
strings.talk.20322.text: The drawing at left top shows the condition of you and your pet, including blood, magic, experience and money.
strings.talk.20323.text: Chat menu is at left bottom. There are six channels to choose from and 3 buttons for switching to Windows Screen Mode.
strings.talk.20324.text: There are 6 buttons for PK,Join combat,Watch combat,Join the team,Make friends,Commerce Money at the right top.
strings.talk.20325.text: There are 6 buttons for item, skill, compound, group, socail and system.
strings.talk.20326.text: I made a raft recently. I put it into the box beside me. If you want to leave, you can take it from the box.
strings.talk.20328.text: No, although it's desolate here, it's free from the hustle and bustle of the city. Besides, Wilson is here with me!
strings.talk.20330.text: #n/#n, hurry up and leave! It will be much more difficult to leave when the tide comes in later.
strings.talk.20331.text: Thank you. Will we meet again?
strings.talk.20334.text: Yes, just like this, you'll find these boxes of items if you pay more attention!
strings.talk.20336.text: There are 3 children, including me, in my family. The age gap is 2 and the total age 69. I'm the second child. Can you guess how old I am?
strings.talk.20339.text: Sorry, your answer is wrong. So you can't get that Hill Pepper by yourself.
strings.talk.20340.text: Your answer is right. You are so clever. These Hill Peppers are for you.
strings.talk.20341.text: Oh no, it isn't here either.
strings.talk.20342.text: You are in panic. What's up?
strings.talk.20343.text: Ah! You come here at the right time. I took a nap just now. But when I woke up, I found my sword had gone. I have no time to buy another one. Can you help me buy a #r iron sword /#r from Weaponry?
strings.talk.20344.text: I beg you. I will be punished by the church if they find that I've lost my sword on duty.
strings.talk.20345.text: This is a 100 gold note. Thank you for all your trouble.
strings.talk.20346.text: Curses! If I know who stole my sword, I will surely beat him up.
strings.talk.20347.text: They seel some strong Iron Swords at Weaponry. Can you buy one for me?.
strings.talk.20348.text: Ha-ha! I finally find a treasure worthy of collecting.
strings.talk.20349.text: Ah! How did you know that I had hidden the treasure there? Gulp, quickly sneak away??
strings.talk.20350.text: This is the iron sword you want.
strings.talk.20351.text: Thank you. Now I'm relieved. Oh! It's time for my duty. I must go first.
strings.talk.20353.text: I believe we can meet each other again. Quickly start off! Be careful on the way.
strings.talk.20354.text: By the way, I picked up some useful articles on the sea and hid them in the forest. You can take them with you if you should find them.
strings.talk.20355.text: This is the raft I made. It's very simple, but you can take it to the islands nearby. Be careful when you use it.
strings.talk.20356.text: You are so cute. There are many kinds of fruits can be picked. You can get them by clicking them.
strings.talk.20357.text: Our captain is good at navigation. He is a good example to all of us.
strings.talk.20358.text: By staying with our captain, you can learn much new knowledge from him.
strings.talk.20359.text: It's said that the end will appear when sailing halfway across the Earth. I will certainly overthrow this notion.
strings.talk.20360.text: It contains a fierce rabbit. Don't flap and feed it.
strings.talk.20361.text: Do you want to compete with me in reaction?
strings.talk.20362.text: Stay away from me. Don't disturb my eating.
strings.talk.20363.text: The supper today is very fresh. I will give you some!
strings.talk.20364.text: You are too useless. I've shown you too much leniency.
strings.talk.20365.text: Ah! Why is a sword here?
strings.talk.20367.text: What shall I do? It's too dangerous for Houyi to chase them alone.
strings.talk.20368.text: Why do so many suns in the sky run down to make trouble?
strings.talk.20369.text: Child! Wake up! You fainted from the heat, who else can help Houyi deal with those suns?
strings.talk.20370.text: Darling! Wake up! What shall I do? Is my husband all right?
strings.talk.20371.text: Too bad, Aniu fainted from the heat as soon as he was close to the suns. How can Houyi deal with those suns alone?
strings.talk.20372.text: The trees are withered and dry. I'm afraid the forest will soon be on fire.
strings.talk.20373.text: Will you assist me to drive these suns away?
strings.talk.20375.text: I won't force you. Quickly leave here!
strings.talk.20378.text: #F2/#F Aahh, you were only playing a trick.  Let me teach you  a lesson.
strings.talk.20379.text: Oh! Don't kill me! Don't kill me!
strings.talk.20380.text: #F2/#F Hum! Won't you continue to hurt people if I let you off?
strings.talk.20381.text: Don't kill me. I will rise and sink continually and bring warmth and light to the world.
strings.talk.20382.text: Hero, wait a minute. Their words seem reasonable. If you shoot all of them down it will be difficult to survive.
strings.talk.20383.text: Er! You are right. Ok! I let him off as you say.
strings.talk.20384.text: Thank you for your forgiveness. I will go back to sky to work.(sneak away quickly)
strings.talk.20385.text: Hero, thank you for your assistance. I must tell villagers the good news. I will go first.
strings.talk.20387.text: I didn't expect that you could help Houyi shoot down these suns. I do admire you.
strings.talk.20391.text: Houyi told me just now that you helped him a lot. Thank you.
strings.talk.20392.text: #F2/#F Aaahhh, I really can not stand the heat. It's so hard to deal with.
strings.talk.20393.text: Hu! I can shoot them down here. There are several suns in the west sky. Let me wipe them out in one strike.
strings.talk.20394.text: So boring. Go away! Don't disturb my play if you have no strength to stop me.
strings.talk.20395.text: Hero, I shot down 4 suns hardly just now.
strings.talk.20396.text: You are so lucky this time. If you dare make trouble again, I will certainly shoot you down with my bow.
strings.talk.20397.text: #F2/#F Naughty sun, I will defeat you.
strings.talk.20398.text: Who are you! Do you want to play with me?
strings.talk.20401.text: Hi! Are you all right? Wake up??
strings.talk.20402.text: There is a forest in the southeast of the village. It's strange that the forest often emits white smoke recently. One feels extremely hot near it.
strings.talk.20403.text: That's terrible, I have nothing for supper, Woo!
strings.talk.20404.text: Who can you blame since it is you who were too slow!
strings.talk.20405.text: It is you who were too slow!
strings.talk.20406.text: What are you doing here, old man?
strings.talk.20409.text: How wonderful you are! Could you teach me this skill?
strings.talk.20410.text: Youth, it took me 50 years of cultivating to reach this level,but considering your sincerity, I will teach you, if you can bring me the Snake's Biliary in the Snake Cave at the back of the mountian.
strings.talk.20411.text: OK, I will have a try.
strings.talk.20412.text: Thank you. I will have a further consideration.
strings.talk.20413.text: Is it the cave occupied by the Snake Lord? The snake looks so terrifying! But since I have promised the old man, I have to force myself to go in.
strings.talk.20414.text: Are these the Snake Lords? They look very different from what I imagined.
strings.talk.20415.text: It is an exaggeration to call these things Snake Lords.
strings.talk.20416.text: This is the real Snake Lord, be careful!
strings.talk.20417.text: This may be the Snake's Biliary. What reward will I get from the old man?
strings.talk.20418.text: Old man, is it the Snake's Biliary you wanted?
strings.talk.20419.text: Yes, it is right. It is young men who make heroes! OK, I will initiate you into this skill.
strings.talk.20420.text: Outside the gate beside me is the way to the #R#B Snake Cave /#R/#B and don't forget to bring me the #R#B Snake's Biliary /#R/#B.
strings.talk.20421.text: Is this uncle making a show of himself here?
strings.talk.20422.text: Hi, I'm Earl Basirona. I'm also an antique dealer who travels all over the world and collects precious and curious things.
strings.talk.20423.text: Oh, may I ask what you are doing here?
strings.talk.20424.text: I have been trying to find a treasure named #R#B Elf's tear /#R/#B but failed.
strings.talk.20426.text: Would you bother to search it for me. If you find it, please bring it to me and I will reward you.
strings.talk.20427.text: Remember its name, #R#B Elf's tear /#R/#B. I will be here waiting for your news.
strings.talk.20428.text: Is this the Elf's tear  that you wanted?
strings.talk.20429.text: Ah! So terrific you've found this rare treasure! I'll reward you with this #R#B Vacuum Cleaner /#R/#B.
strings.talk.20430.text: Remember to inform me if you find any precious treasure!
strings.talk.20431.text: The two women seem to be arguing over something.
strings.talk.20432.text: It is obvious that chicken came first!
strings.talk.20435.text: You are right here to make a judgement for us. Which on earth came first, chicken or eggs?
strings.talk.20439.text: (Which on earth came first, chicken or eggs?)
strings.talk.20440.text: What a disturbance you are making stranger! You deserve to learn a lesson from us!
strings.talk.20442.text: It surprises me that you turn out to be so excellent!
strings.talk.20443.text: Let us show up our true shape to deal with you!
strings.talk.20446.text: OK, I admit you excel me!
strings.talk.20448.text: Such a strange pair of sisters!
strings.talk.20449.text: My son is sleeping late again and I can't wake him up. I have something else to do, and I'll leave this business to you.
strings.talk.20460.text: Why am I discovered when I have hid myself so secretly?
strings.talk.20461.text: I hid here to blow up the whole village, but since I have been discovered by you, I must also kill you too!
strings.talk.20462.text: Good, my son has been woken by you! This is a reward for you!
strings.talk.20463.text: (He doesn't believe what I said just now.)
strings.talk.20465.text: Please don't kill me. It is my fault!
strings.talk.20466.text: Well, let's do it this way. Do you have the #R#B Broken UFO Design /#R/#B?
strings.talk.20467.text: If you do, I can patch it for you, on the condition that I am not to be killed.
strings.talk.20468.text: Thank you for not killing me, bye! I'm going to find another corner to hide myself.
strings.talk.20469.text: That's it! A piece of trash.
strings.talk.20473.text: She would faint if she saw what happened just now.
strings.talk.20474.text: It seems that you don't take the design with you.
strings.talk.20475.text: I remember I took #R#BBroken UFO Design /#R/#B. Where is it now?
strings.talk.20476.text: You are overrating yourself! Stop shouting for nothing!
strings.talk.20477.text: How did you wake him up, you nice guy!
strings.talk.20479.text: It is merely a piece of waste paper?
strings.talk.20480.text: It is strange. How can a boat lying here?
strings.talk.20481.text: Where is the #R#B Owner /#R/#B of the boat?
strings.talk.20483.text: Oh no! That guy is in danger!
strings.talk.20485.text: How did you come alone to such an icy and freezing place?
strings.talk.20486.text: Youth, could you chase away the beasts around me?
strings.talk.20488.text: 2. I'm not able to beat those beasts either!
strings.talk.20489.text: I'm not going to leave here alive!
strings.talk.20490.text: I'm saved. I was sailing at sea and then came here to look for water after I had run out of it. Surprisingly I met the beasts as soon as I arrived here. Had you not chased away them for me, I would have died here!
strings.talk.20493.text: Aren't you leaving? Why are you still here, old man?
strings.talk.20494.text: The boat broke down. Maybe some parts were broken.
strings.talk.20495.text: Could you help me? I need #R#B Large Assembly Tool /#R/#B and #R#B Steam Engine /#R/#B.
strings.talk.20497.text: 2. Sorry, I have some other business.
strings.talk.20498.text: Youth, you helped me a lot today. These are rewards for you. Take them!
strings.talk.20499.text: I will take it to you when I find it!
strings.talk.20500.text: So sorry that I am not able to help you!
strings.talk.20501.text: Ooohhh, am I going to die here?
strings.talk.20502.text: Let me try to help myself out! Maybe a miracle will occur from the mercy of the heaven.
strings.talk.20503.text: You forgot to find me the #R#BLarge Assembly Tool/#R/#B.
strings.talk.20504.text: You forgot to find the #R#BSteam Engine/#R/#B to me!
strings.talk.20505.text: Thank you. I'll repair my boat first.
strings.talk.20506.text: How can there be a hot spring in such freezing place?
strings.talk.20508.text: Leave it alone. I'm freezing. Let me soak in the hot spring first.
strings.talk.20509.text: So comfortable! It is wonderful to have hot spring in such cold place.
strings.talk.20510.text: This is the tool I need.
strings.talk.20511.text: There is a mountain nearby. Let me go and have a look.
strings.talk.20513.text: There is an injured rabbit. It will die if the bleeding is not stopped.
strings.talk.20514.text: That is OK. It will recover soon.
strings.talk.20515.text: Never be injured by an arrow again! Bye!
strings.talk.20516.text: It is strange. It should be right here!
strings.talk.20517.text: What are you looking for? What can I do for you?
strings.talk.20518.text: We shot a rabbit when hunting, but it disappeared when we arrived. Strange!
strings.talk.20520.text: What? That is to be supper for the hungry people.  Didn't you think?
strings.talk.20521.text: I'm really sorry. I'm going to find some #R#B Nigiri Sushi /#R/#B to make up for the loss, is it OK?
strings.talk.20522.text: OK,for your sincerity, I'll give you a chance to make a compensation.
strings.talk.20525.text: The hungry people are waiting for my food!
strings.talk.20526.text: This is the #R#B Nigiri Sushi /#R/#B I promised to give you.
strings.talk.20527.text: You didn't break your promise. I'll thank you for the hungry people!
strings.talk.20528.text: My name is #n/#n. What is your name?
strings.talk.20531.text: I have to arrive in the Kyoto before dark. I'll leave now.
strings.talk.20532.text: There is a comb on the ground.
strings.talk.20533.text: Oh! How can I find her in such a large place?
strings.talk.20534.text: There is Kanako carved on the comb. It must be hers.
strings.talk.20535.text: This can only be opened by #R#B Key of Red Box /#R/#B.
strings.talk.20536.text: This can only be opened by #R#B Key of Blue Box /#R/#B.
strings.talk.20537.text: This can only be opened by #R#B Key of Green Box /#R/#B.
strings.talk.20541.text: Are you the Mars from last time? How can you still be here?
strings.talk.20542.text: I would rather I had gone home, but I found out  my fuel had run out on the way, so I am to be stuck here.
strings.talk.20543.text: If I could have #R#B 3 Magnet and 1 Magnet Stone /#R/#B, I could have enough energy to go back to my planet.
strings.talk.20546.text: Where are the #R#B 3 Magnet and 1 Magnet Stone /#R/#B you promised to find for me?
strings.talk.20548.text: Where is the #R#B 1 Magnet Stone /#R/#B you promised to find for me?
strings.talk.20549.text: Where are the #R#B 3 Magnet /#R/#B you promised to find for me?
strings.talk.20550.text: Youth, if you can help me get #R#B The Egg of the Fire Phoenix /#R/#B, I will give you a reward. Will you have a try.
strings.talk.20551.text: OK, but it seems that that kind of eggs are not sold in the super market.
strings.talk.20552.text: Of course that kind of eggs can only be found in #R#B Flaming Place of Mountain /#R/#B.
strings.talk.20553.text: OK, then I will go to the #R#B Flaming Place of Mountain /#R/#B and flame to seek #R#B the Egg of the Fire Phoenix /#R/#B.
strings.talk.20554.text: Is that the Egg of the Fire Phoenix? But it is too far to reach it. It could be better if I set up a #R#B set up a Wooden Bridge /#R/#B.
strings.talk.20555.text: Can't the egg be boiled when it lies here? Forget it, I will take the feather beside it as well since the mysterious old man need it.
strings.talk.20556.text: I'm back! Here is the egg you wanted!
strings.talk.20557.text: Very good! That is it! I don't need the feather. You take it for it can be useful when you are in danger.
strings.talk.20558.text: #R#B The Egg of the Fire Phoenix /#R/#B I want is in #R#B Flaming Place of Mountain /#R/#B.
strings.talk.20559.text: You can come to me if you change your mind. I am here at any time.
strings.talk.20560.text: What can I do for you?
strings.talk.20561.text: I had a nautical chart for fishing once, but the pirate stole it, it is said that their den is in the #R#B South Island/#R/#B, the map should be there. How can I take it back by myself?
strings.talk.20564.text: I still have things to do.
strings.talk.20565.text: The treasure box has been put in the high place, maybe the #R#B nautical chart/#R/#B is in there.
strings.talk.20566.text: It seems that I need a #R#B ladder /#R/#B.
strings.talk.20567.text: The nautical chart is in the box, I must take it to the fisherman.
strings.talk.20568.text: Fishman, is this your nautical chart?
strings.talk.20569.text: Thank you very much! I can fish again, this gift is for you.
strings.talk.20570.text: It is said that their den is in the #R#B South Island /#R/#B, the map should be there.
strings.talk.20571.text: My husband was hired as a sailor by Captain Cook. We had made an appointment to meet here, but I have lost his message, I have no idea whether he has had an accident or not!
strings.talk.20572.text: Could you inquire about it for me please?
strings.talk.20574.text: When will I meet my husband again?
strings.talk.20575.text: Your wife has been waiting in Holy Village for a long time, why didn't you go to meet her?
strings.talk.20576.text: To insure that the military affairs are kept secret, the regulations do not admit us to go on shore unless absolutely necessary, please tell her that I miss her so much.
strings.talk.20578.text: Your husband has some important things to do, so he can't come back for now. He asked me to tell you that he misses you very much!
strings.talk.20579.text: That is so! Thank you very much, this gift is for you.
strings.talk.20580.text: There is a Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva here, do you want to worship him?
strings.talk.20583.text: May the god bless us all!
strings.talk.20584.text: It has been such a long time since I have seen someone as faithful as you. If you can pass the test, I will give you a present.
strings.talk.20586.text: I will leave all that to you, my husband #R#B Elvis/#R/#B is on the ship of Captain Cook.
strings.talk.20587.text: You didn't pass the test. I can't give the gift to you.
strings.talk.20588.text: You have passed the test. The present is for you.
strings.talk.20589.text: Please tell my wife that I miss her very much!
strings.talk.20590.text: Sorry! I have some things to do.
strings.talk.20592.text: Yes, what can I help you?
strings.talk.20594.text: Recently a Giant Snake has been eating people near here.  It has devoured many people.  The King has asked the minister to find a warrior who can kill the Giant Snake, but all of our people are too afraid of it.
strings.talk.20596.text: It's in the #R#Bforest/#R/#B not far from here, do you want to kill the Giant Snake for us and be the hero.
strings.talk.20598.text: I think it is out of my ability.
strings.talk.20599.text: Who can kill the Giant Snake? We are really worried about it!
strings.talk.20600.text: Oh! Very good! It is in the #R#Bforest/#R/#B behind me?I will be waiting for your good news.
strings.talk.20601.text: The Giant Snake is eating people, I must kill it!
strings.talk.20604.text: Hmm! I am fine. It seems that I am not good enough to be a guard. I will go back home to be a farmer. Thank you for saving me.
strings.talk.20605.text: I have beaten the Giant Snake, it is severly hurt.
strings.talk.20606.text: That's good! Thank you for solving this problem for us, I will take you to our King, he will reward you.
strings.talk.20607.text: Your Majesty, the Giant Snake has been beaten by the hero; it was severly hurt, now the other villagers have gone to the forest to finish the job.
strings.talk.20608.text: Good! There is nothing to do; you all can go back except for the hero.
strings.talk.20609.text: Come to me, I will reward you.
strings.talk.20610.text: You dare to give me a surprise attack and wound me so heavily!  I will eat you!
strings.talk.20611.text: The Giant Snake pretend to be the queen!
strings.talk.20613.text: Your Majesty, you were being controlled by this snake, luckily I killed it or the consequences would be too ghastly to contemplate.
strings.talk.20614.text: Is that so? I cannot find the words to thank you enough for saving me and awakening me from the control of this snake.  Here, please accept this reward.
strings.talk.20615.text: What's the matter, Your Majesty, are you good?
strings.talk.20616.text: The Palace is on ground alert...let me take you out!
strings.talk.20618.text: I will return to my hometown.
strings.talk.20619.text: Thank you for defeating the snake.
strings.talk.20621.text: You are the hero who defeated the snake.
strings.talk.20622.text: Thank you for saving the king.
strings.talk.20623.text: You are the strongest warrior in our country.
strings.talk.20624.text: Here, is the palace, the King is waiting for you to go in and see him! I must return to my post.
strings.talk.20625.text: I can't do it; there is too little firewood to burn.
strings.talk.20627.text: The Axeman does not sell firewood today, I have some firewood that is left over from yesterday but it is not enough.  So how can I make fire with such little firewood, what can I do?..
strings.talk.20628.text: How much firewood do you need?
strings.talk.20630.text: Let me find some for you!

strings.talk.21055.text: Ah! Thank you very much indeed. I must look after Laifu more cautiously in the future.

strings.talk.21058.text: Alas! The special Chinese carbon ink I need in my drawing is running low. What shall I do?
strings.talk.21059.text: Really? Then how can you continue your business?
strings.talk.21060.text: I must keep an eye on my calligraphy. I can't leave. . .Ah! Would you please prepare a bottle of the #R#B Prepared Chinese Ink /#R/#B? Please!
strings.talk.21061.text: This is the special Prepared Chinese Ink you wanted. Bring more with your later on.
strings.talk.21062.text: Ah! Thank you very much. This is a humble gift. I hope you can accept it. I can go on with my business again.
strings.talk.21063.text: I need a bottle of the  #R#B Prepared Chinese Ink /#R/#B to continue my calligraphy.
strings.talk.21065.text: Awww! My companion has fallen into the water jar. If I get a #R#B common stone /#R/#B,I can save him.
strings.talk.21066.text: I've got a common stone here, here you are!
strings.talk.21067.text: Thank you for getting a stone for me in time.The Lucky Grass is for you as a souvenir.
strings.talk.21069.text: Hehehehe! Younger brother Sima, you are really smart.
strings.talk.21070.text: Ok,I will find a #R#B common stone /#R/#B for you.(How can you save a person with a stone?)
strings.talk.21071.text: The board reads: The king has been ill for a long time. The royal doctor needed the blood of Crane as an inducement for the medicine. If anybody finds the Crane, please inform the Kings Sodiers. You will be awarded a lot.
strings.talk.21072.text: Hehehe, are there really heavenly birds in the world? If I meet with them, I will report it immediately.
strings.talk.21073.text: Yeah! Here is a wounded crane!
strings.talk.21074.text: The crane is the sacred source of the king's medicine. Give it to us now.
strings.talk.21075.text: (Should we give the crane to them?)
strings.talk.21076.text: You can leave now. This is your reward.
strings.talk.21077.text: You little brat! How dare you ignore the king's order! Come on, guys, lets beat him.
strings.talk.21078.text: No way! We will not let you go next time. Let's go.
strings.talk.21079.text: Each time you are beaten by me, you will say the same words. "Oooohhh,...ahhhh...please don't kill me!"  Hahaha...
strings.talk.21080.text: It's not the time to make jokes. The crane seems poisonous. We should use an #R#B antidote /#R/#B to save it.
strings.talk.21081.text: Good, I have some antidote with me.
strings.talk.21082.text: Thank you for not delivering me to the bad guys! You also saved me. Thanks.
strings.talk.21084.text: I am leaving for Heaven. These gifts are for you. Thanks.
strings.talk.21085.text: En! Take care on your way back.
strings.talk.21086.text: Yee! Did he say he wanted to go back to Heaven? Is he really a heaven crane?
strings.talk.21087.text: Yee! Why is there a strange light?
strings.talk.21088.text: It seems mysterious. Ok, let it be.
strings.talk.21090.text: Can cranes talk? Is he the heaven crane mentioned on the board?
strings.talk.21092.text: Wounded!? It will be killed if it is captured. Shut up! Give him to me!
strings.talk.21093.text: But. . I have one thing that I can't understand. Since they wanna get your blood to cure the king's disease, why did they shoot you with an arrow?
strings.talk.21094.text: They are disloyal in their heart. And they want to rebell. They want to murder the king with the poinsonous blood, so they shot me.
strings.talk.21095.text: So it is! (I prevented a conspiracy by accident...)
strings.talk.21096.text: There is not enough firewood on our island, I have been searching all day with no luck.  How will I cook tonight?
strings.talk.21097.text: Help her to find some #R#B firewood /#R/#B or not?
strings.talk.21098.text: Do not worry; I will help you to find some firewood! How much do you need?
strings.talk.21099.text: Really? I'm sorry to trouble you. I think #R#B 5 firewood /#R/#B is enough.
strings.talk.21100.text: Please find another #R#B 5 firewood /#R/#B for me.
strings.talk.21103.text: Good! I can cook the dinner now. Thank you very much, please accept this gift.
strings.talk.21104.text: #f1/#f hope you can make a delicious dinner.
strings.talk.21109.text: We need to defeat the lion, but no one dares to go, we don't know what to do.
strings.talk.21112.text: Great! The lion has been beaten.  Now I can pull out his mane.
strings.talk.21113.text: Why do you pull out the lion?s mane?
strings.talk.21114.text: In legend, if you pull out a lion's mane your own hair will soon grow back. You see, my head is so bald . After pulling out the mane of lion; I won't be laughed at by others.
strings.talk.21115.text: You should not believe old wives tales that have no basis in truth!
strings.talk.21117.text: Here are the African Villages, do you have anything to help them?
strings.talk.21118.text: This fiery pile is where we cook.
strings.talk.21119.text: Why is there a locked treasure box? In addition,there are some numbers on the box.It seems there is a code to lock, and unlock it.
strings.talk.21120.text: Hey! Old man! Give us the security money for this month!
strings.talk.21121.text: Please, forgive me, masters! You see, business is down lately, can you give me several more days?
strings.talk.21122.text: No money? Then we will tear down your shop because there's no security to stop us! Haha Oh, yes, I remember you have a pretty grandaughter too, right? What about asking her to serve me? Maybe you can pay your debt this way,hehehehe. . .
strings.talk.21123.text: No...you can't ,she is my only grandaughter. My...only family...
strings.talk.21124.text: #f2/#f Stop! How can you be so rude to an old man! I'll teach you a lesson.
strings.talk.21125.text: Wow! So. . . Sorry. It's our fault. I won't do that ever again. Forgive us,please!
strings.talk.21126.text: If I see you doing bad things again, you'll suffer. Get away!
strings.talk.21127.text: Thank you very much for driving away these Local Ruffians. This humble gifts are for you! I hope you can accept them.
strings.talk.21128.text: These books here seem messy. Put them  back onto the shelves.
strings.talk.21129.text: Maybe these books should be put here while there are four English letters(O,K,B,O) on them. How can I put them onto the shelves?
strings.talk.21134.text: Yee! It seems that something is ringing?
strings.talk.21136.text: Wow! Human beings! It's been a long time since I ate a big dinner. Be ready to die!
strings.talk.21137.text: #f2/#f Huh! You wanna defeat me?! No way! Come on!
strings.talk.21138.text: #f1/#f Hurry here to open my treasure box.
strings.talk.21139.text: The tidied books look much more comfortable.
strings.talk.21140.text: Yee, why are you here,old man?
strings.talk.21141.text: Ah! Great! Somebody like me has been unexpectedly swallowed by the Water Monster.
strings.talk.21142.text: Yes, I was swallowed by accident. But how long have you been here,old man?
strings.talk.21143.text: About a year. I can't find the exit yet. I decided to settle down after a long time.
strings.talk.21144.text: Wow! Great! You can stay here for such a long time. What on earth have you been doing here?
strings.talk.21145.text: I'm a puppet master and I like making puppets. It's been no exception here because I've begun to feel lonelier and lonelier lately.
strings.talk.21147.text: I like puppets, but I like children better. I really hope the puppets I made can become children and talk to me.
strings.talk.21148.text: I have heard that the puppets will be alive so long as you put #R#B two Life Crystals  /#R/#B into their bellies.But I don't know where to find them though. . .
strings.talk.21149.text: (Yee! The Life Crystal can be made in a magic stove! Should I give him a helping hand?)
strings.talk.21150.text: My dear father, you will not feel lonely if I accompany you in future.
strings.talk.21151.text: Ah! I finally have my own kid. I'm so happy! Thanks for your help.
strings.talk.21152.text: You're welcome. Look after him well, please.
strings.talk.21153.text: Don't worry! I will take care of him like he's my own kid.
strings.talk.21154.text: #f1/#f En. Then I have nothing to worry about.
strings.talk.21156.text: Old uncle, I found the Life Crystals . Have a try! Be quick?
strings.talk.21157.text: Ha-ha, it's only you! Wait to die!
strings.talk.21159.text: Pah, coward, you always disturb us.
strings.talk.21160.text: (It's Dracula and Medusa, why did they come here at the same time?)
strings.talk.21161.text: Hum, you come at the right time, today I will kill you!
strings.talk.21163.text: It doesn't matter, Dracula. Let's go to meet Gilbert first.
strings.talk.21164.text: Right, don't delay our business. We should unite Nether General to defeat him later.
strings.talk.21165.text: Hum, don't be arrogant. We will have our revenge soon. Let's go.
strings.talk.21167.text: It was terrible! They kidnapped Apollo. From now on, we won't have sunshine, the crops won't grow up, the land will die.
strings.talk.21168.text: What? How dare they did that!
strings.talk.21169.text: Do you know they seized Apollo?
strings.talk.21170.text: No, they wanted to kill me. I just tried to escape, I wasn't thinking about anything else.
strings.talk.21172.text: (Too bad! People cannot survive without sunshine, I must rescue Apollo!)
strings.talk.21173.text: Take this badge, hopefully it'll bring you good luck!
strings.talk.21174.text: Trust me, I will rescue Apollo!
strings.talk.21175.text: Thank you. I am Apollo's priest, so I cannot leave my job to save him.
strings.talk.21176.text: Kanako... Don't leave me.... I don't want you to die... Kanako!!!
strings.talk.21178.text: #n/#n, is there a way to rescue Kanako?
strings.talk.21179.text: Maybe the #RRecovery Potion/#R will take effect!
strings.talk.21180.text: Thank god, Kanako, are you okay?!
strings.talk.21182.text: The Recovery Potion took effect. I thought we lost you.
strings.talk.21183.text: I think I'm ok now! #n/#n, let's go back to see grandma.
strings.talk.21185.text: The doctor said grandma wasn't hurt too seriously. She just needs to rest.
strings.talk.21189.text: #n/#n, thanks for saving Kanako. I want to give this to you. I hope it helps you during your journey.
strings.talk.21191.text: It's too bad the casino owner died, we'll never know who asked him to do this.
strings.talk.21192.text: I'll go back and tell grandma.
strings.talk.21193.text: I hope this Recovery Potion can help Kanako.
strings.talk.21196.text: I must bring #RKanako/#R back home so they don't worry about her safety.
strings.talk.21197.text: Grandma hurt herself. She is receiving treatment in a #R House/#R. I need to go there to find out if she is seriously hurt.
strings.talk.21199.text: Hey, old man, it looks like you have lots of money. I bet you could pay for our meal! What do you say?
strings.talk.21200.text: Er ... no, sorry, I don't have enough money right now.
strings.talk.21201.text: Ha! Are you kidding me? OK, since you don't have enough money, why don't you give us your clothes as a downpayment!
strings.talk.21202.text: Please don't ... let me go! Please ...
strings.talk.21203.text: Shut up or we'll beat you!
strings.talk.21204.text: What are you doing? Stop! I won't let you beat this old man anymore!
strings.talk.21205.text: What's wrong with you? You want to join us? Ha!
strings.talk.21206.text: Uh oh, run! We'll get revenge on you sooner or later! Let's go!
strings.talk.21208.text: Thanks for your help. I'm OK, but I'd like to know who are you.
strings.talk.21210.text: I'm Stephen and I live outside of the castle.
strings.talk.21211.text: #n/#n, in fact, I need your help. If you want to help me, please meet me at my house.
strings.talk.21212.text: I wonder what Stephen wants me to do. Maybe I'll go meet him at his house.
strings.talk.21213.text: #n/#n, I'm so happy to see you again. I hope you can help me.
strings.talk.21215.text: I just got a letter from Kidd. He said he wants something hidden in my house!
strings.talk.21217.text: Can you help me guard the things in my house?
strings.talk.21218.text: Sure, I'll help you protect everything in your house.
strings.talk.21219.text: OK, here's the key to my treasure. Please take care of it!
strings.talk.21220.text: Oh, my eyes! What's going on? That light really hurts my eyes!
strings.talk.21221.text: Oh God! Oh God! Where's the key? And where's the maidservant?
strings.talk.21222.text: Stephen, look, here's a piece of paper on the floor.
strings.talk.21223.text: It says: I've got the Treasure Key and maidservant suit. Signed, Kidd
strings.talk.21224.text: No! Kidd stole my treasure key! My key!!
strings.talk.21225.text: Stephen needs me to get the key back.
strings.talk.21226.text: Please help me get the #Rkey/#R back!
strings.talk.21229.text: Do you think I'll give the key to you? What a joke!
strings.talk.21230.text: OK, let's fight for the key!
strings.talk.21231.text: OK, I lost, so here's the key! I'll give it to you as long as you stop following me!
strings.talk.21232.text: Where is Stephen? I can't find him. Maybe he went to get help.
strings.talk.21233.text: He asked me to protect the treasure, but where is it? Maybe it's in his house.
strings.talk.21234.text: Er, there are 2 locks on the door? How do I unlock them?
strings.talk.21235.text: Something is written on this paper: Unlock the right lock by using #RStephen's Key/#R and then unlock the other one.
strings.talk.21236.text: Wow! Gold! Diamonds! Um, but ... why am I fainting?
strings.talk.21237.text: Hahaha! Thank you for opening the door. The treasure kept in this red box is mine now!
strings.talk.21238.text: Wake up, #n/#n! What's going on? Why you are lying on the floor?
strings.talk.21239.text: Sorry, Stephen, Kidd stole the treasure in that red box.
strings.talk.21240.text: Are you talking about the red box?
strings.talk.21241.text: Oh, it doesn't matter. There was a useless toy in that box. It's an old gift given to me by my grandpa after a long voyage.
strings.talk.21242.text: Oh, an old toy? Can you tell me what it is?
strings.talk.21243.text: I'll show you. My grandpa brought 2 of them.
strings.talk.21245.text: Thanks for helping me protect my treasure! My gold and diamonds are still here. You seem to be interested in this little ring. I think it is a fitting reward for your help.
strings.talk.21247.text: (Why did Kidd steal that useless ring? Why didn't he steal the gold and diamonds?)
strings.talk.21248.text: (Is this a special ring? If I meet Kidd again, I'll ask him about it.)
strings.talk.21249.text: Hahaha, are you kidding? You want to defeat me? Impossible! You are too weak!
strings.talk.21250.text: He loves me, he loves me not, loves me, loves me ... no, he doesn't love me!
strings.talk.21251.text: I'm using the flower to do augury, but it says he doesn't love me!
strings.talk.21252.text: I think you'd better tell him you love him directly.
strings.talk.21253.text: I know, but ... I'm not so sure. I'm afraid of being refused.
strings.talk.21254.text: If I was a #Rgirl with blond hair and white skin/#R, I'd tell him directly. But I'm not.
strings.talk.21255.text: (Let me see, if Haben has #RHair Dye/#R and #RColor Mask/#R, I think she could be a girl with blond hair and white skin!)
strings.talk.21256.text: Oh, don't worry, I think I can help you! Your dream will come true if you use these 2 magic items!
strings.talk.21257.text: Wow, Haben! You are so pretty!
strings.talk.21258.text: Really? But ... but I'm still not sure.
strings.talk.21259.text: Don't hesitate! Go tell him how you feel!
strings.talk.21260.text: What happened after Haben revealed her true feelings? I'd better go have a look.
strings.talk.21261.text: Haben, what's going on? Why are we here?
strings.talk.21263.text: (Unbelievable! Haben is falling in love with an old man?)
strings.talk.21268.text: Haben, it's impossible. You see, you are too young for me!
strings.talk.21269.text: But I know you like girls with blond hair and white skin! See, now I'm just your type! Don't you love me?
strings.talk.21270.text: Sorry, Haben, but I've met someone I want to marry. So ...
strings.talk.21271.text: Oh, I have an idea. Haben, will you be my mistress?
strings.talk.21273.text: Haben is running away! Please go after her. She needs someone with her now.
strings.talk.21274.text: Oh, the pain! Can anybody help me?
strings.talk.21275.text: Haben, don't be so desperate! You'll meet your destined sweetheart sooner or later!
strings.talk.21277.text: Don't worry about me. I came here to bathe in the sun! I want my black skin back!
strings.talk.21278.text: Oh, sorry, I thought you may have wanted to kill yourself.
strings.talk.21279.text: Thanks so much! I want to give you this gift.
strings.talk.21280.text: If you meet someone you think would be suitable for me, please let me know! Ha ha!
strings.talk.21281.text: Do you want to help her?
strings.talk.21282.text: What happened after Haben revealed her true feelings? I'd better go have a look.
strings.talk.21283.text: Ouch! Why do you beat me?
strings.talk.21284.text: That man is the one I'm in love with, but I heard that he loves someone with blond hair and white skin!
strings.talk.21285.text: Why? Are you not confident in yourself?
strings.talk.21286.text: Don't you see? My hair and my skin are black! He won't love me!
strings.talk.21287.text: He seems to be OK. I'd better go follow Haben.
strings.talk.21288.text: My master is not here right now. How can I help you?
strings.talk.21291.text: I finally got the key back from Kidd! I'd better tell Stephen as soon as possible!
strings.talk.21293.text: Return the key to Stephen as soon as possible.
strings.talk.21294.text: Do you want to use the #Rstephen's Key/#R?
strings.talk.21295.text: It seems we need a special code to open it.
strings.talk.21298.text: Ha ha, I know where the key is.
strings.talk.21299.text: After Vortigern died, I, Merlin, became an advisor to the next 3 kings.
strings.talk.21300.text: Those kings were Aurelius, Uther and the great King Arthur!
strings.talk.21301.text: Hey, young one, would you like to answer some questions? I'll give you some gifts if your answers are correct.
strings.talk.21304.text: Q1: In the late 16th century, _____ruled England.
strings.talk.21309.text: Q 2: Dickens and Thackeray, who are most famous for their novel, lived in the period of ____
strings.talk.21314.text: Q 3: Who's the first Queen in Britain?
strings.talk.21319.text: Q 4: Among the most typical English sports, ____ has been in existence since the 16th century.
strings.talk.21324.text: Q 5: Which of following doesn't belong to Britain?
strings.talk.21329.text: Wow, not bad! Here's one last question.
strings.talk.21330.text: Do you know who created Stonehenge in Britain?
strings.talk.21331.text: Hm ... I think Arthur built it!
strings.talk.21332.text: No, it was made by the Knights of the Round Table!
strings.talk.21334.text: To commemorate the monument, I sang a magic song and summoned some huge stones from Ireland to create my own Stonehenge.
strings.talk.21335.text: Oh, I see. (I thought some ET created it.)
strings.talk.21336.text: Even though you gave me a wrong answer, I still have a gift for you. Here you go.
strings.talk.21337.text: I hope you will have learned more by the time we meet again.
strings.talk.21340.text: Oh, but I saw a #Rgirl who has blond hair and white skin/#R. She was heading toward the cave in the village.
strings.talk.21341.text: Have you seen someone with blond hair and white skin pass by?
strings.talk.21342.text: Yes, she was heading #RSouth/#R to the coast.
strings.talk.21343.text: Return the key to Stephen as soon as possible.
strings.talk.21344.text: Ha ha, I'm quite a knowledgeable person!
strings.talk.21345.text: Young one, can you get me #R10 pieces of Ordinary Wood/#R?
strings.talk.21346.text: OK, I'll find some for you.
strings.talk.21347.text: Hello, sir! I got 10 pieces of Ordinary Wood for you!
strings.talk.21349.text: May I ask what you are going to do with it?
strings.talk.21350.text: I'm so hungry, I need some wood to cook the old hen!
strings.talk.21351.text: Um, you want to cook the old hen? That doesn't sound so good.
strings.talk.21352.text: Yes, I know, but I'm so hungry and my wife Jessi didn't cook me anything.
strings.talk.21353.text: Why didn't she cook for you?
strings.talk.21355.text: I think I'd better kill the old hen.
strings.talk.21356.text: Hey, take it easy! I'll ask Jessi why if you let the old hen go, OK?
strings.talk.21357.text: Hello, Jessi, I'm here to ask why you didn't cook anything for your husband.
strings.talk.21358.text: Today is our anniversary! Our wedding day, you know? But he didn't give me my favorite strawberry cake!
strings.talk.21359.text: Yet I cook everything he loves every day! I don't think he loves me anymore!
strings.talk.21360.text: (Give Jessi #Ra strawberry cake/#R to pacify her.)
strings.talk.21361.text: Today is our anniversary! Our wedding day, you know? But he didn't give me my favorite strawberry cake!
strings.talk.21362.text: No, no, I think there's some misunderstanding between you. This is the strawberry cake he asked me to give you!
strings.talk.21364.text: Oh, really? Oh, I did a terrible thing.
strings.talk.21365.text: Could you help me by telling my sweetheart that I'll prepare a wonderful dinner for us? I'll be waiting for him!
strings.talk.21366.text: You're back! So, do you know why my wife was so angry?
strings.talk.21367.text: She's angry because you forgot your anniversary!
strings.talk.21368.text: But everything is OK now. She asked me to tell you that she's preparing a wonderful dinner for you.
strings.talk.21369.text: Oh God, I forgot our special day!
strings.talk.21370.text: Sorry, old hen, I can't help you.
strings.talk.21372.text: Don't you have #R10 pieces of Ordinary Wood/#R for me?
strings.talk.21373.text: I'm getting it. Just be patient.
strings.talk.21374.text: My home is in the southwestern part of this city.
strings.talk.21375.text: Please help me by asking my wife #RJessi/#R why she was so angry with me.
strings.talk.21376.text: Could you help me by telling my sweetheart that I'll prepare a wonderful dinner for us? I'll be waiting for him!
strings.talk.21377.text: Well, I still want to kill this old hen. It can be one of the entrees for my dinner!
strings.talk.21378.text: Do you want to help her?
strings.talk.21379.text: So for me love is an impossible dream?
strings.talk.21380.text: Oh, what happened? Koliz has disappeared!
strings.talk.21381.text: My wife Koliz said she wanted to go to the Lost Jungle and Avignon Jungle and bring some flowers back, but it's late now, and she still hasn't returned.
strings.talk.21382.text: In fact, I've been to the jungle and couldn't find her anywhere! Why has she disappeared?
strings.talk.21383.text: Don't worry, I can help you find her.
strings.talk.21384.text: Thanks! I hope everything is OK.
strings.talk.21385.text: (Matthew searched the Lost Jungle and Avignon Jungle but didn't find his wife. I think I'd better go to #RBordeaux  Jungle/#R)
strings.talk.21386.text: #f2/#f, oh God, the lady is in danger! I have to rescue her.
strings.talk.21388.text: Oh, thanks so much. I'm fine, thank you! I'm Koliz, who are you?
strings.talk.21390.text: Oh, I finally found you! Your husband is worried about you. Please come back with me right away!
strings.talk.21391.text: No! I won't go back! I don't want to see my husband anymore!
strings.talk.21393.text: Oh, my sweetheart! You are here!
strings.talk.21395.text: Koliz? Why? What are you scared of?
strings.talk.21396.text: Because ... because he's not human! He's a monster!
strings.talk.21397.text: Oh, my dear, I am a monster? No, I'm not, I'm a real human being!
strings.talk.21399.text: No, you lie! That day I came home early after I finished visiting my uncle, I went to your study and heard a horrible scream! What was that?
strings.talk.21400.text: Then I saw a pointy-eared head through the crack between the door and the frame.
strings.talk.21401.text: Only you can enter that study, so you must be a monster!
strings.talk.21402.text: Oh, you really are a monster!
strings.talk.21403.text: Oh, wait! I want to show you something.
strings.talk.21404.text: Meow, meow, where are you? Come here.
strings.talk.21405.text: Wow, this kitty is sooo cute!
strings.talk.21406.text: Haha, this is the birthday gift I wanted to give you!
strings.talk.21407.text: I bought it and kept it in the study. I'm sorry to have scared you. I just wanted it to be a surprise!
strings.talk.21408.text: Oh, honey, you are so sweet! I'm sorry. I love it so much! Thank you!
strings.talk.21409.text: Thanks for helping me find Koliz. Here is your reward.
strings.talk.21410.text: I hope you live happily together.
strings.talk.21411.text: Thank you. We should be going. Bye!
strings.talk.21412.text: Oh, is there a wolf tail on Matthew's back? Maybe I'm hallucinating.
strings.talk.21413.text: Do you want to help Matthew find #RKoliz/#R?
strings.talk.21416.text: Thanks, I hope Koliz is OK now.
strings.talk.21417.text: These wolves are too strong. I need more training.
strings.talk.21419.text: Sure, what can I help you with?
strings.talk.21421.text: The Curse Scroll is a holy item coveted by many powerful countries.
strings.talk.21422.text: In fact, lately many strangers have tried to steal the Curse Scroll.
strings.talk.21423.text: The Curse Scroll is made of 2 parts: sky and earth. I'm guarding the earth Curse Scroll and the sky part is guarded by Official Nanase.
strings.talk.21424.text: I've sent many people to tell Official Nanase about this, but nobody has returned.
strings.talk.21425.text: Can you give this #RSecret  Letter/#R to #ROfficial Nanase/#R?
strings.talk.21426.text: Sure, but where is Official Nanase?
strings.talk.21427.text: I heard he's now in #RShayii Hill/#R with 2 attendants. Be careful!
strings.talk.21430.text: This is Official Nanase's special training place. Nobody else can enter!
strings.talk.21431.text: Oh, I'm a messenger sent by the Lion General. I have important news for him! Here is the letter.
strings.talk.21434.text: Ah! Why there are so many skulls here?
strings.talk.21435.text: Hahahahaha! They are the skulls of the messengers dispatched by the Lion General! Hayate! You dared to betray us!
strings.talk.21436.text: You are going to your doom! We will kill you!
strings.talk.21437.text: So those attendants are the subordinates of Kurokawa!
strings.talk.21438.text: We have to defeat them all!
strings.talk.21439.text: Who are you? Why do you want to rescue her?
strings.talk.21441.text: Haha! Her friend? A betrayer has a friend? You are a fool to trust her!
strings.talk.21442.text: Haha, I may not be able to beat you with my weapon, but I can poison you!
strings.talk.21445.text: Oh, have we arrived? You are wonderful, Hayate! Thanks for saving my life.
strings.talk.21446.text: My pleasure. I'm happy to have you as my friend!
strings.talk.21447.text: We fought each other when we first met, but now you trust me. Why?
strings.talk.21448.text: I don't know, but I believe you are a good person.
strings.talk.21451.text: #n/#n, I don't think this is a safe place. We'd better go back and tell the Lion General about the situation here.
strings.talk.21454.text: We reached Shayii Hill, but we didn't find Official Nanase. I was nearly killed by Kurokawa's subordinates. All the other messengers were dead.
strings.talk.21455.text: I think I would have died if Hayate hadn't rescued me.
strings.talk.21456.text: So, you're saying Kurokawa wants the Curse Scroll?
strings.talk.21457.text: No! Those messengers I dispatched are dead?
strings.talk.21458.text: #n/#n, I'm afraid they may have also killed Official Nanase!
strings.talk.21459.text: Clam down, Lion General. Maybe Official Nanase is still alive. We haven't heard any news about his death.
strings.talk.21461.text: #n/#n, thanks for trying to deliver the message.
strings.talk.21462.text: Don't worry, I'll keep searching. If I hear any news about Official Nanase, I'll tell you as soon as possible.
strings.talk.21463.text: What shall we do? They are too strong! We must find a better way to defeat them!
strings.talk.21464.text: Did you deliver the message to Official Nanase?
strings.talk.21465.text: Sorry, not yet. I'll be going to #RShayii Hill/#R as soon as possible.
strings.talk.21467.text: I don't think I can handle it by myself. I think I need Hayate's help.
strings.talk.21468.text: (If I show them the #RSecret  Letter/#R from the Lion General, maybe I can enter.)
strings.talk.21469.text: (There's a lot that can go wrong here. I'd better come back with Hayate.)
strings.talk.21470.text: (I'd better go back and report to the #RLion General/#R as soon as possible.)
strings.talk.21471.text: (I need to report back to the Lion General with #RHayate/#R.)
strings.talk.21472.text: I heard that he's now in #RShayii Hill/#R with 2 attendants. Be careful!
strings.talk.21473.text: Thanks for saving me. Here is your reward!
strings.talk.21474.text: Welcome to #RFiery Mountain/#R! I'd like to tell you the rules for participating in the #RFiery Challenge/#R event!
strings.talk.21475.text: To defeat the final boss, King Minotaur , players must win at least #R20 rounds of combat/#R. They must also kill the following lesser bosses: #RSpider Spirit, Fox Spirit, Golden Corn and Silver Corn/#R. What's more, players must kill #RKing Minotaur /#R
strings.talk.21476.text: After players defeat the final boss and rescue #RMonk Xuanzang/#R, they can claim their rewards.
strings.talk.21477.text: Congratulations! Go get your rewards from #RMonk Xuanzang/#R.
strings.talk.21478.text: If you want to challenge me, you need to win at least #R15 battles of combat and you must first kill the lesser bosses/#RSpider Spirit, Fox Spirit, Golden Corn and Silver Corn/#R.
strings.talk.21479.text: You haven't won #R20 rounds of combat/#R yet.
strings.talk.21484.text: If I eat Monk Xuanzang, I'll live in this world forever!
strings.talk.21485.text: You want to rescue Monk Xuanzang? Impossible! Hahahahahaha!
strings.talk.21486.text: Hahahahaha! If I eat Monk Xuanzang, my power will grow stronger! Then I could become a human! I'm so happy!
strings.talk.21487.text: We are King Minotaur 's subordinates. You can't see King Minotaur  unless you defeat us!
strings.talk.21488.text: Hahahahaha! If I eat Monk Xuanzang, my power will grow stronger!
strings.talk.21489.text: What am I supposed to do?
strings.talk.21491.text: I'm going to marry Ming, but Wee, a friend I grew up with,  began keeping his distance from me when he found out.
strings.talk.21492.text: Can you give this #RWedding Invitation/#R to Wee? He lives in #RWestern Woodland /#R.
strings.talk.21493.text: Can you help Ling  by giving the Wedding Invitation to Wee?
strings.talk.21494.text: Sorry, no. (She needs to deliver it herself and ask why he's keeping his distance from her.)
strings.talk.21496.text: I will help you deliver this Wedding Invitation to Wee.
strings.talk.21497.text: I think you'd better go invite yourself. I think it's the best way to save your friendship.
strings.talk.21499.text: Ming, can you wait for me for a while? I'll be back soon!
strings.talk.21501.text: I can go to #RWestern Woodland /#R with her.
strings.talk.21502.text: Ling , you can't get married to Ming!
strings.talk.21506.text: I didn't realize it until you told me you wanted to marry Ming! You are the most important person in the world to me!
strings.talk.21507.text: Can you give me a chance?
strings.talk.21508.text: No! Why didn't you tell me before? I'm going to get married!
strings.talk.21511.text: Ling , do you want to run away with him?
strings.talk.21513.text: I just wanted to know if you would abandon me. In fact, it looks like you want to elope with him!
strings.talk.21514.text: I heard everything! How dare you do that to me? You can't do that to me! I will stop you!
strings.talk.21516.text: Ming, I'm sorry,  so sorry, but ... but I love Wee!
strings.talk.21517.text: Ming, I promise you that I'll try my best to make Ling  happy. I love her.
strings.talk.21518.text: I won't wish you a happy life. Both of you betrayed me! I don't want to see you anymore! I hate you!
strings.talk.21520.text: Ling , believe me, you'll be happier living with me!
strings.talk.21521.text: #n/#n, thanks for helping me discover my true feelings. I know I hurt Ming, but I believe Wee will give me a happy life!
strings.talk.21522.text: Congratulations! I hope you two have a happy life!
strings.talk.21525.text: Yes, I am, but who are you?
strings.talk.21526.text: I'm Ling 's friend. She asked me to invite you to her wedding.
strings.talk.21527.text: She really wants to marry Ming?
strings.talk.21528.text: (I think I'd better go back and meet with Ling .)
strings.talk.21529.text: Wee, please don't disturb Ling  anymore. She's going to get married!
strings.talk.21530.text: No! I love her! Shall we fight? I want to defeat you, Ming!
strings.talk.21531.text: Ling , why did you ask someone to stop me?
strings.talk.21532.text: Wee, I'm sorry but it's too late, even though I once loved you very deeply.
strings.talk.21533.text: I've decided to marry Ming. I think we will be happy together.
strings.talk.21534.text: Wee, I love Ling ! I can give her the happiest life she could want.
strings.talk.21536.text: #n/#n, thank you. I choose Ming to be my husband. I believe he will love me forever.
strings.talk.21537.text: Ling  said she decided to marry me! I want to tell everyone about it!
strings.talk.21538.text: No! I want to stop it!
strings.talk.21539.text: Have you sent the #RWedding Invitation/#R to #RWee/#R?
strings.talk.21540.text: Not yet, but I'll go to #RWestern Woodland /#R as soon as I can.
strings.talk.21541.text: (Go back to #RChang'an/#R and visit Ling  again.)
strings.talk.21543.text: You don't have the #RWedding Invitation/#R. You must go get it from Ling .
strings.talk.21544.text: (Wee comes to visit Ling  as expected.)
strings.talk.21545.text: Ling , I didn't realize I loved you until you told me you wanted to get married! You are the most important person in the world to me!
strings.talk.21550.text: (It seems that Ming is worried about Ling . She went to tell Wee she wanted to marry Ming. I think I'd better go to #RWestern Woodland /#R.)
strings.talk.21553.text: Wee! I want to fight you!
strings.talk.21555.text: It's said that there's a beautiful castle at the South Pole. I hope to see it for myself one day.
strings.talk.21556.text: Oh, I've heard of it. It's called Barnya Sky City!
strings.talk.21557.text: You know that? So, do you know what's inside it?
strings.talk.21558.text: All I know is that it's said that a goddess was jailed in the castle because she fell in love with a human, which was intolerable to the other gods.
strings.talk.21559.text: So the gods sealed her in the castle.
strings.talk.21560.text: Oh, I see. I thought many beauties from different countries were gathered there.
strings.talk.21561.text: #n/#n, it's been a long time since I last saw my parents. I miss them very much.
strings.talk.21562.text: OK, let's go to #RBarnya Sky City/#R together.
strings.talk.21563.text: I'm a human and can't enter. Only gods or god-blooded people can enter the city.
strings.talk.21564.text: Look, the seal on the door has disappeared! Let's go!
strings.talk.21566.text: I don't know when we will next meet.
strings.talk.21569.text: Me? I am Karl, one of 6 Nether Generals. I want to open the Heaven Gate!
strings.talk.21571.text: If we destroy the seal for Acina, her soul can then return to heaven.
strings.talk.21572.text: Tell us, where is the Heaven Gate?
strings.talk.21573.text: And then the army of hell can go to heaven and we can reign over all life in this world.
strings.talk.21574.text: Stop! You can't treat my mother like this!
strings.talk.21576.text: Haha, we need people who are god-blooded! You can help us. Hahahahahaha, we are lucky indeed!
strings.talk.21577.text: I can't believe it! I lost!
strings.talk.21578.text: Your majesty, why do you come here by yourself?
strings.talk.21579.text: You are useless! You can do nothing! What a fool!
strings.talk.21580.text: King Howert! Finally you're here. I want to fight you!
strings.talk.21581.text: Hahahahaha! The seal has been destroyed!
strings.talk.21582.text: #n/#n, there's one last way to deal with King Howert!
strings.talk.21586.text: You dare to destroy it? You think you can stop me? Hahahaha! I will find the Heaven Gate sooner or later!
strings.talk.21587.text: Fred, what spell did you just use?
strings.talk.21589.text: I destroyed ... the seal ... by using all of my power. Now ... I think I have to leave you.
strings.talk.21590.text: Go! Get out! You must leave now! It's going to collapse. Leave here ... as soon as possible.
strings.talk.21591.text: #f3/#fNo! I can't leave without you! I won't leave you alone here. You are bleeding. You need a doctor.
strings.talk.21592.text: #n/#n, I'm not alone here. I want to be ... in the company of my parents. I'd like to lie here with my parents.
strings.talk.21593.text: No! Fred! You have to kill King Howert! You need to fight for peace! That is your mission!
strings.talk.21596.text: I also miss my sister, Niss. She's in heaven, too. I'm happy I'll see her again soon.
strings.talk.21597.text: #f3/#fFred! Thanks ... thanks for being my friend for so long. I'll never forget you.
strings.talk.21599.text: Ah, I'm eager to go to #RBarnya Sky City/#R.
strings.talk.21601.text: (Fred said he wanted to visit his parents there.)
strings.talk.21603.text: It's bliss to have a beer after a long day of work. Let's enjoy life!
strings.talk.21606.text: Please, my master, give me another chance!
strings.talk.21610.text: I must destroy this seal, even if it means my life!
strings.talk.21612.text: I'll try my best to stop him!
strings.talk.21613.text: Nobody can stop King Howert! Hahahahahaha!
strings.talk.21614.text: I don't think I can handle it by myself. I think I need #RFred/#R's help.
strings.talk.21615.text: I don't think I can handle it by myself. I think I need #RFred/#R's help.
strings.talk.21616.text: #RFred/#R will leave your team. Are you sure?
strings.talk.21617.text: I hope you find your family in heaven. I'll kill King Howert to avenge your death!
strings.talk.21618.text: Fred, I'll never forget my promise.
strings.talk.21619.text: #RFred/#R will leave your team during this quest. Please remove his equipment or you may lose it.
strings.talk.21620.text: We finally have enough money, Lee. Stay here. I'll be back as soon as possible.
strings.talk.21622.text: What am I supposed to do? Boo hoo!
strings.talk.21624.text: My mom borrowed lots of money to buy the Secret Jade from Heaven Master for me, but ...
strings.talk.21626.text: Heaven Master is a great and famous augur!
strings.talk.21627.text: He told my fortune and said I would have a very short life. If I had the Secret Jade, I could stay alive for a long time.
strings.talk.21628.text: Yes, I'm scared of death, but I don't want my mom to work so hard for me.
strings.talk.21629.text: Don't cry. Tell me your name and where to find Heaven Master.
strings.talk.21630.text: I'm Lee. Heaven Master is now in #Rthe cave of Koyota birds den/#R.
strings.talk.21631.text: Lee, don't worry. I'll catch up to your mom and help her.
strings.talk.21632.text: I think this is the cave Lee told me about. I must enter it.
strings.talk.21634.text: Secret Jade will purify all the dirty in the world! Secret Jade will bless you!
strings.talk.21635.text: Heaven Master, it will keep my daughter alive with me, right?
strings.talk.21636.text: If you don't believe in it, even my incredible power can't help you and your daughter!
strings.talk.21637.text: It seems you don't believe me, so ... Ah, here comes a new friend. I'll prove it to you!
strings.talk.21639.text: Upon the Secret Jade I can see your past and future. I know what he's thinking about!
strings.talk.21640.text: I know that you are #n/#n, a traveler! You are brave and powerful and have saved many lives.
strings.talk.21641.text: You came here because you promised Lee you would help her find her mother.
strings.talk.21644.text: Heaven Master, your power is so great! We won't doubt you any longer!
strings.talk.21645.text: Sorry, but today I have wasted too much of my energy. I need to rest.
strings.talk.21646.text: Before I return, you should pray to the Secret Jade and tell it what you wish for over and over again.
strings.talk.21647.text: (How did he know? Does he really have the ability to see the future? I must ask him about it.)
strings.talk.21648.text: He needs to rest. I bet I'll find him nearby.
strings.talk.21649.text: Hahahaha! I've got tons of money! Hahahaha, they are so stupid! I just need the message that you collected for me! Hahahaha!
strings.talk.21650.text: Then I became a great and powerful augur!
strings.talk.21651.text: But, head, maybe it's time to move to another spot!
strings.talk.21652.text: Yes, but before we do, we can earn some money from those stupid villagers! Hahahaha!
strings.talk.21653.text: #f2/#fYou are disgusting! You cheated them! They worship you as a god! I will reveal your trickery!
strings.talk.21655.text: I don't believe ... I lost my life here. No!
strings.talk.21656.text: I need to return the money to the villagers.
strings.talk.21660.text: (I think I'd better not tell them the truth.)
strings.talk.21661.text: Heaven Master said that he transferred all his power to this Secret Jade! So now you can get your money back with this Secret Jade!
strings.talk.21662.text: Heaven Master has left to go on a trip.
strings.talk.21664.text: But what about Lee? Did he say something about my daughter?
strings.talk.21667.text: I followed you here because I was worried about you and the traveler.
strings.talk.21668.text: I followed you here because I was worried about you and the traveler.
strings.talk.21669.text: Don't worry, Heaven Master said that everything will be fine and Lee will be safe now.
strings.talk.21672.text: Thanks for helping us. This is a gift for you!
strings.talk.21675.text: My mom went to visit Heaven Master. He is now in #Rthe cave of Koyota birds den/#R.
strings.talk.21676.text: OK, I'll go catch your mom and help her.
strings.talk.21677.text: (It seems something has happened to her. I need to ask her what's going on.)
strings.talk.21678.text: My friend, please stand in front of the Secret Jade.
strings.talk.21679.text: If you have a problem, tell it to Heaven Master and he'll help you resolve it.
strings.talk.21680.text: I can't enter because it's closed!
strings.talk.21681.text: Maybe there's a secret trap here.
strings.talk.21683.text: We're worshiping the Secret Jade. Please join us!
strings.talk.21684.text: I need to return #Rthe money to the villagers/#R.
strings.talk.21685.text: Why did she run away when I got close?
strings.talk.21688.text: Are you the one who's stalking me?
strings.talk.21689.text: I just saw you. You looked scared, so I wondered if I could help you.
strings.talk.21690.text: And you think someone followed you?
strings.talk.21691.text: I don't know. I just had a feeling, and so many people have disappeared recently. Sorry.
strings.talk.21693.text: Don't worry about it. I can go with you.
strings.talk.21694.text: Do I need to believe in you?
strings.talk.21695.text: It's very late, Mina. Er, who are you?
strings.talk.21696.text: I don't know who he is! Doctor Mate, can you help me get home?
strings.talk.21698.text: I must look horrible with such a frightened face.
strings.talk.21699.text: Someone is lying on the ground! The girl!
strings.talk.21700.text: She just asked Doctor Mate to go back home with her, so why is she lying here unconscious?
strings.talk.21702.text: What are you doing? Mina is dead! Go tell the village leader!
strings.talk.21704.text: Mina is dead! When I found her, this traveler was there, too.
strings.talk.21705.text: Did you kill Mina? Did you kidnap the other girls?
strings.talk.21706.text: No, I didn't! I just arrived today!
strings.talk.21707.text: You are a stranger here and were found near Mina's body.
strings.talk.21708.text: You have no proof! You can't arrest me!
strings.talk.21709.text: Well, if you can find the murderer, we'll let you go.
strings.talk.21710.text: (I have to catch the real murderer, or they will imprison me! Maybe this #RGolden Pocket Watch/#R can tell me something. I should go ask some villagers for more information.)
strings.talk.21711.text: Do you know anything about this #RGolden Pocket Watch/#R?
strings.talk.21712.text: This pocket watch? Why do you have this pocket watch? This is the one that #RDoctor Mate/#R bought from me.
strings.talk.21713.text: I know it. #RDoctor Mate/#R bought it from me!
strings.talk.21714.text: I found it near Mina's body. Do you know where he lives?
strings.talk.21715.text: He's a teacher in Domremy, but he doesn't live there. I heard that he's now doing some experiment in #RLost Jun/#R.
strings.talk.21716.text: I think you can find him there.
strings.talk.21717.text: I think you can find him in #RLost Jun/#R.
strings.talk.21718.text: Oh, God! There's a dead body and bandages. He's doing some horrible experiment! We need to tell the village leader!
strings.talk.21719.text: Ah, young one, you have arrived at a good time. I need someone to help me test my weapons! Haha!
strings.talk.21720.text: How can you do such experiments with living people?
strings.talk.21721.text: Hahahahaha! Their lives are nothing if I finish my experiment!
strings.talk.21722.text: I'll show you how powerful those Undying Man  are that I created! Hahaha!
strings.talk.21724.text: No! I don't believe it! I lost?
strings.talk.21726.text: Doctor Mate, you have killed many people and will pay for your crimes!
strings.talk.21727.text: I don't believe it! I can't lose!
strings.talk.21728.text: Village leader, why have you come here?
strings.talk.21729.text: I dispatched someone to follow you, then came to see what was happening for myself. The murderer was Doctor Mate!
strings.talk.21730.text: I'm sorry. Thank you for everything. Here is a reward for you.
strings.talk.21731.text: If you aren't the murderer, who is that?
strings.talk.21733.text: We must follow the village leader's orders.
strings.talk.21734.text: We haven't checked this cave. Let's go inside.
strings.talk.21735.text: It's too dark in this cave. We'd better not go inside.
strings.talk.21736.text: I think we need to go back to the village and find out something about it.
strings.talk.21737.text: See, this villager is dead, and his corpse looks the same as Mina.
strings.talk.21738.text: I think I need the #RGolden Pocket Watch/#R.
strings.talk.21740.text: Now we are finding the clues.
strings.talk.21742.text: No! I refuse to accept it. It's unbelievable!
strings.talk.21743.text: I don't know this watch, but if you want to repair it, go find #RKendal/#R, who lives nearby.
strings.talk.21744.text: So many have disappeared and nobody knows who did it. We hope the kidnapper will be caught soon.
strings.talk.21745.text: Aaron is still in the water. Has something happened to him? Boo hoo ... Aaron!
strings.talk.21747.text: Me and my boyfriend, #RAaron/#R, were fishing, but he saw something shiny in the water. He thought it was a pearl and jumped in after it.
strings.talk.21748.text: I've been waiting for him to return for too long, but he's still in the water. I'm worried.
strings.talk.21749.text: I think I can help you.
strings.talk.21750.text: Can you help me find him? I'm #RJosephine /#R. Please return with Aaron soon!
strings.talk.21752.text: Hey! I found him first, so I get to eat his head!
strings.talk.21753.text: OK, OK, so the hands belong to me!
strings.talk.21755.text: (It must be Aaron! Go save him!)
strings.talk.21756.text: No! Run! The attacker is too strong!
strings.talk.21759.text: Oooh, my head aches so badly.
strings.talk.21760.text: Hey, you're Aaron, right? Josephine  is worried about you! I think you've hurt your head. You need to get back to land as soon as possible!
strings.talk.21761.text: No! I won't go back until I find the shiny #Rpearl/#R. I want to give it to Josephine . Go on back and tell her I'm OK.
strings.talk.21762.text: I'd better follow him. Maybe I can help him find that shiny pearl.
strings.talk.21765.text: #f2/#fBack off! You can't eat him! I will kill you first!
strings.talk.21766.text: Hmmph, I don't think you'll be eating human beings anymore!
strings.talk.21767.text: No! Don't kill me! Don't kill me!!
strings.talk.21768.text: I didn't really want to eat him at first, but he kept pulling my beard up! He woke me up! I just wanted to scare him. I don't want to eat him!
strings.talk.21769.text: You liar! The bead on his head is a pearl! Look! I want it anyway!
strings.talk.21770.text: No! Stop! OK, I'll give it to you. Don't pull my beard again!
strings.talk.21771.text: Yeah! I got the pearl! Josephine  will be happy when I give it to her.
strings.talk.21772.text: You are very lucky! Let's go back.
strings.talk.21773.text: Josephine , I got the pearl for you! Look!
strings.talk.21774.text: Aaron! Don't do that again! You are the most important thing in the world to me.
strings.talk.21775.text: #f1/#fJosephine , I think Aaron just wants you to be happy. Will you accept this pearl?
strings.talk.21776.text: Yes, my sweetie! Do you like it? It's brilliant!
strings.talk.21780.text: I hope you will return with Aaron soon.
strings.talk.21781.text: (Go to the pool and find Aaron.)
strings.talk.21786.text: I'd better get back to land and see #RJosephine /#R.
strings.talk.21789.text: Sweetie, this pearl is from a horrible monster!
strings.talk.21790.text: But I defeated it and got the pearl for you!
strings.talk.21791.text: Oh, OK, so can you get me another?
strings.talk.21792.text: Er, well, my head is badly hurt and I need something for the pain. Let's go home.
strings.talk.21795.text: Do you want to dive into the water?
strings.talk.21796.text: This elf is badly hurt. I have to help him.
strings.talk.21797.text: Maybe I can use a #RRecovery Potion/#R.
strings.talk.21798.text: I don't have a #RRecovery Potion/#R right now.
strings.talk.21799.text: Do you want to use the #RRecovery Potion/#R?
strings.talk.21801.text: You human beings! Stop destroying the environment! I want to kill all of you!
strings.talk.21802.text: Don't move. I saw you were lying here in pain, so I saved you.
strings.talk.21804.text: Most of the trees in this forest have been chopped down! You human beings destroyed my home!
strings.talk.21805.text: And now they want to destroy the last trees here! I can't bear it!
strings.talk.21806.text: #f2/#fBelieve me, I will help you if I can. Tell me who they are.
strings.talk.21807.text: I don't know where they came from, but I know their leader. They call him #RKwint/#R!
strings.talk.21809.text: The trees we got from #RSecret Jungle/#R are very good! We can make many strong weapons and sell them to the munitioners.
strings.talk.21810.text: Hahahaha! I'll be a rich man soon!
strings.talk.21811.text: Leader Kwint! We found more trees like these nearby!
strings.talk.21812.text: That's great! We need more people, then we'll go make more money!
strings.talk.21813.text: (I see that it's #RKwint/#R. I must stop them!)
strings.talk.21815.text: Who are you? You think you can stop me? I'll kill you!
strings.talk.21816.text: It's no use driving those cowards away! You can't stop me!
strings.talk.21817.text: #f2/#fWhy does he keep doing such horrible things?
strings.talk.21818.text: Boss, look, these trees are great! We can make more weapons!
strings.talk.21819.text: Kwint, I'm here because I've decided to withdraw my order, I think I need more powerful weapons made of iron and steel. I don't need those wooden weapons any more!
strings.talk.21821.text: What are you talking about? You don't need the wooden weapons anymore? That means I'll lose all my investment!
strings.talk.21823.text: Oh no! I wanted to be rich!
strings.talk.21824.text: It's wrong to destroy so many trees, Kwint.
strings.talk.21825.text: I know, I know. I won't chop another tree from now on. Here are the #RTree Sprout/#R I got from the trees and was going to sell. Please take them.
strings.talk.21826.text: That's great! I think I'd better go tell this good news to the #RElf/#R.
strings.talk.21827.text: I know I was wrong. I won't do it again.
strings.talk.21828.text: Pack these #RTree Sprout/#R up. Maybe one day you will use them.
strings.talk.21829.text: #f1/#fLittle elf, nobody will come to destroy your home again!
strings.talk.21830.text: But isn't it too late? It takes hundreds of years to develop a lush forest like this once was.
strings.talk.21832.text: Kwint said he knew he was wrong, so he gave me these Tree Sprout. I think they will take root and grow again.
strings.talk.21833.text: Yes! I want my green home back!
strings.talk.21834.text: From now on I will be the guardian of this forest!
strings.talk.21835.text: I'm so happy to hear that. With you guarding it, these trees will grow well!
strings.talk.21836.text: Thanks for helping me. This is a gift for you.
strings.talk.21838.text: I need to take the #RTree Sprout/#R to the little elf.
strings.talk.21840.text: Wow, we can't defeat this one. The attacker is too strong! Run!
