strings.talk.21841.text: (Why are there so many trees here?)
strings.talk.21842.text: Leader Joan, we've entered a dangerous area controlled by our enemies.
strings.talk.21843.text: Leader Joan, we don't have enough food. We can't go any farther!
strings.talk.21845.text: Leader Joan, what is the problem?
strings.talk.21846.text: You are #n/#n! The king dispatched me to fight our enemies.
strings.talk.21847.text: If we can seize this place and crown the king, we can have peace again!
strings.talk.21848.text: But we don't have enough food.
strings.talk.21849.text: I think if we had something like #RFrench Bread/#R, which has the same flavor as our  hometown snack, we'd be stronger.
strings.talk.21850.text: But we have nothing now, so all we can do is rest here.
strings.talk.21851.text: (If I have #R50 pieces of French Bread/#R, I can help them.)
strings.talk.21852.text: Joan, I have some French Bread. Here you go!
strings.talk.21853.text: Thanks! We can continue our fight!
strings.talk.21854.text: You evil witch! We will catch you make you face judgment! Everyone will know you are a devil in disguise!
strings.talk.21856.text: Let's fight for glory! Kill them!
strings.talk.21857.text: You need more rest. I can handle them.
strings.talk.21859.text: We lost? No! Even God helps you!
strings.talk.21860.text: I think God wants me to join this war. He has a plan for me.
strings.talk.21861.text: I must follow God's orders and lead them to victory.
strings.talk.21862.text: Humph, I'll defeat you in the end!
strings.talk.21863.text: Thanks for saving us again! Are you ... the envoy of God?
strings.talk.21864.text: #f1/#fI'm not! I'm just a common traveler. I hope you and your team can win this war.
strings.talk.21868.text: Farewell! We have to leave now.
strings.talk.21869.text: (Joan is a real hero. I think we would be friends. Maybe one day we will meet again.)
strings.talk.21870.text: We'll follow our team leader's order!
strings.talk.21871.text: I must protect Joan and defeat all enemies.
strings.talk.21872.text: Where can I collect those ingredients?
strings.talk.21874.text: I need some ingredients to make Slimming Drugs.
strings.talk.21875.text: What? Slimming Drugs, is that a safe recipe?
strings.talk.21876.text: Sure, I got it from a friend. He was fatter than me but after he used this Slimming Drugs, he became a handsome man!
strings.talk.21877.text: I want to be a pretty girl with a hot body, so I asked him for the special recipe!
strings.talk.21878.text: Now I have the recipe, but I can't find the ingredients!
strings.talk.21879.text: I'm #n/#n. I think I can help you collect them.
strings.talk.21880.text: That's great! I'm Kedi. Can you collect #RStrawberry*3, Snake Meat*2, Sea Salt*2 and Brazil Mushroom*1/#R for me?
strings.talk.21881.text: (These ingredients can be used for making #RSlimming Drugs/#R?)
strings.talk.21882.text: Can you collect #RStrawberry*3, Snake Meat*2, Sea Salt*2 and Brazil Mushroom*1/#R for me?
strings.talk.21883.text: Kedi, I found everything you need, but are you sure you can use them to make Slimming Drugs?
strings.talk.21884.text: Yes, the recipe says I just need to combine these ingredients and then read a curse.
strings.talk.21885.text: Kedi, are you sure you want to eat that?
strings.talk.21886.text: Yes! For a nice body, I'd eat anything!
strings.talk.21887.text: Bla bla bla bla bla pa pa pang!
strings.talk.21891.text: (Kedi rushed out. I'm worried about her. I'd better follow her.)
strings.talk.21893.text: Wow, why there's a horribly huge snake! And it looks angry!
strings.talk.21894.text: Ah! You horrible snake! I will kill you and add your corpse to my supply of ingredients!
strings.talk.21897.text: You are Kedi? Hahahahahaha! You used the recipe!
strings.talk.21898.text: You laugh at me! You'll never see me again! Boo hoo ... (She runs away.)
strings.talk.21900.text: Oh, she's really angry with me.
strings.talk.21901.text: But David, why did you give such a horrible recipe to her?
strings.talk.21902.text: Because she teased me when I was fatter than her. I love her so much, but she never paid even a little tiny bit of attention to me! That's why I left and went to learn dark magic.
strings.talk.21903.text: It was so hard before I finally lost the weight.
strings.talk.21904.text: I just made a joke. I didn't know she would take it seriously. Now she's angry.
strings.talk.21905.text: You need to apologize to her and find a way to change her back to the way she was.
strings.talk.21906.text: I know! I have a bottle of #RMedium Elixir /#R. Can you help me get it to #RKedi/#R?
strings.talk.21907.text: Boo hoo! What am I doing? I'm a snake ...
strings.talk.21908.text: Kedi, don't cry. This is the Medium Elixir . David asked me to give it to you. Drink it.
strings.talk.21909.text: Humph, I don't trust him anymore! I just thought I might have a crush on him.
strings.talk.21910.text: David knows he was wrong and hopes you can forgive him. You don't want to be a snake like this forever, do you?
strings.talk.21912.text: Oh! I'm back! Oh, and more pretty!
strings.talk.21915.text: Do you like me even though I'm so fat?
strings.talk.21916.text: Of course! I love you so much!
strings.talk.21917.text: So you don't mind that I'm fat? OK, I don't want to lose weight anymore. It's quite hard for me.
strings.talk.21919.text: #f1/#fI'm so happy to see that you love each other now.
strings.talk.21920.text: Thanks for helping us. Here is a gift for you.
strings.talk.21921.text: Please help me get this Medium Elixir  to Kedi.
strings.talk.21923.text: We have no more food! What shall we do?
strings.talk.21924.text: Only Leader Joan can save us now! I hope you can help her!
strings.talk.21925.text: I must go help Leader Joan!
strings.talk.21927.text: ... too hungry to lift a sword.
strings.talk.21928.text: All the soldiers have lost their morale.
strings.talk.21931.text: OK, let's refresh ourselves and start again!
strings.talk.21935.text: David, let's go have some roasted duck to celebrate!
strings.talk.21936.text: Er, Kedi, I don't think you should eat too much fatty food. I think I can teach you some dark magic to help you keep fit.
strings.talk.21937.text: But I want to eat the roasted duck.
strings.talk.21938.text: Kedi, if you finish learning all the dark magic lessons, I'll go eat it with you, OK?
strings.talk.21941.text: I'm David's brother. Why have you come here?
strings.talk.21943.text: What are you talking about, madam?
strings.talk.21944.text: It's the gallipot. My son always holds it and talks to it! But I don't understand what he says!
strings.talk.21945.text: I don't want my friends and neighbors to think he's crazy.
strings.talk.21946.text: I threw the gallipot many times, but it went back again and again!
strings.talk.21947.text: So I decided to break it, but I failed! When I tried to break it, it flew up and hit me in the head!
strings.talk.21950.text: Can you help me throw the #Rgallipot/#R away? If you succeed, I'll give you a gift.
strings.talk.21951.text: Sure, but where is the gallipot?
strings.talk.21952.text: (I need to throw the #Rgallipot/#R away as soon as possible.)
strings.talk.21953.text: It's in Aden's bedroom! Go up the stairs near the gate.
strings.talk.21955.text: This must be the gallipot the lady spoke of.
strings.talk.21956.text: Where should I take it? I think throwing it into the river nearby is a good idea.
strings.talk.21957.text: Throw it into the river. It should not come back again.
strings.talk.21958.text: Do you want to throw it?
strings.talk.21960.text: #f1/#fThat was quite simple! I'd better go to tell the lady this good news.
strings.talk.21962.text: Really? I want to check it out.
strings.talk.21964.text: That's impossible! I threw it into the river!
strings.talk.21965.text: I think I need to take it farther away, or this lady will be driven crazy.
strings.talk.21966.text: Huh? I can't pick it up!
strings.talk.21967.text: Don't throw me out! I want to stay here!
strings.talk.21969.text: I'm Ella, Aden's lover in his previous life.
strings.talk.21970.text: But why are you trapped in this gallipot?
strings.talk.21971.text: In our previous life, we loved each other deeply, but our parents wouldn't allow it. So I decided to run off with him!
strings.talk.21972.text: But he didn't come to meet me! He got engaged to someone else!
strings.talk.21973.text: So I enchanted myself into this gallipot so I would follow him forever and make sure he never betrays our love again!
strings.talk.21974.text: But that happened in previous life! You'd better leave now.
strings.talk.21975.text: You want to break up my relationship with Aden! I will kill you!
strings.talk.21977.text: No! I won't leave here! I want to stay with Aden!
strings.talk.21980.text: Ella, you are real! I thought it was just a dream, but it was my previous life!
strings.talk.21981.text: Aden, why did you betray me?
strings.talk.21982.text: I'm sorry, Ella. I'm a coward! Your parents said I couldn't give you a rich life, and that you would have a horrible life with me, so I gave up. I'm so sorry.
strings.talk.21983.text: Then I faked the news of my engagement, but I never thought you would commit suicide!
strings.talk.21984.text: So you didn't betray me? You didn't fall in love with someone else?
strings.talk.21985.text: Never. You are the only one I could fall in love with, Ella!
strings.talk.21986.text: I'm so happy to hear that you still love me. Please don't forget me ...
strings.talk.21988.text: Mom? Mom? Wake up. Why are you lying here?
strings.talk.21990.text: The gallipot is broken! From now on, Aden won't need to talk to it anymore!
strings.talk.21991.text: In fact, there was a sprite living in it, but now her dream has come true. She's going to heaven and the gallipot is broken.
strings.talk.21993.text: Never mind that now. I just want you to be happy.
strings.talk.21994.text: Thanks for your help. Here is your reward.
strings.talk.21995.text: Her hatred is too horrible. She might hurt the lady. I have to drive her away.
strings.talk.21996.text: Please don't separate me from Aden!
strings.talk.21998.text: Do you want to go to the 2nd floor?
strings.talk.22000.text: Look! The gallipot is coming back!
strings.talk.22002.text: I hope I will see Ella in my next life, but now I need to take care of my mom.
strings.talk.22004.text: Let's meet in our next life.
strings.talk.22006.text: Stand still! Melody! Where are you going?
strings.talk.22008.text: Don't go after that monster! I'm serious!
strings.talk.22009.text: No! Daddy, #RBaird/#R isn't a monster. You know nothing about him!
strings.talk.22012.text: Please help me stop my daughter! She's going to the #RDrought Spot/#R! We trapped a bloody monster there. We can't give it any water.
strings.talk.22013.text: What can I do? She doesn't listen to me.
strings.talk.22014.text: OK, I'll help you. But where is the #RDrought Spot/#R?
strings.talk.22015.text: It's in the #Rcave/#R outside our village. Be careful.
strings.talk.22017.text: Baird! Baird, don't worry! I'll bring water to you!
strings.talk.22018.text: Melody, we must go back. Your dad is worried about you.
strings.talk.22019.text: No! I want to save Baird. He's not a monster, he's the god of water!
strings.talk.22020.text: There's no more water here, but my daddy and the villagers keep me from bringing any water to Baird. He's going to die! Boo hoo ...
strings.talk.22021.text: (It seems that Baird isn't a monster.)
strings.talk.22022.text: OK, I'll help you get some water.
strings.talk.22024.text: (Baird is the god of water. I think #R10 bottles of Fresh Water/#R should be enough for him.)
strings.talk.22026.text: Thank you. I'll give it to Baird.
strings.talk.22028.text: I ... I feel cold, very cold now ...
strings.talk.22030.text: Melody, come here. I need you.
strings.talk.22033.text: I'm the water monster Baird! This is what I am! Melody, come here! If you love me so much, I must eat you so we will be together forever!
strings.talk.22035.text: Yes. When I saw her the first time, I decided to be with her forever. I want her be a part of me!
strings.talk.22036.text: I don't need the water. What I need is Melody! She's my love!
strings.talk.22039.text: Why do you want to stop me from being with my Melody?
strings.talk.22040.text: Your love is different from hers. She doesn't need that kind of love. You'll hurt her!
strings.talk.22041.text: No I won't, because I love her!
strings.talk.22045.text: He's going to a watery place, but he told me he's sorry he can't bring you with him. He really loved you.
strings.talk.22046.text: Really? But he abandoned me. Even so, I'll always remember him.
strings.talk.22047.text: It's quite late, Melody, and your dad is worried about you. You'd better go back home.
strings.talk.22048.text: Melody, you won't go to see the monster again, will you?
strings.talk.22049.text: Sir, Baird is not a monster. He fell in love with Melody, but now he has left. Melody won't see him again.
strings.talk.22050.text: My sweety, it's your destiny! You will meet someone better than him. Believe me!
strings.talk.22052.text: Thanks for helping me. Here is a reward for you.
strings.talk.22053.text: I hope you can bring my daughter back.
strings.talk.22054.text: (Go find Melody. She's now in the #Rcave/#R outside the village.)
strings.talk.22056.text: (It seems she is worried about something.)
strings.talk.22057.text: (This is the cave I'm looking for.)
strings.talk.22059.text: I want to go back and see Melody's father.
strings.talk.22060.text: Don't cry, my sweety. You'll meet your Mr. Right sooner or later.
strings.talk.22061.text: Yes, I think I need a new relationship. I want to forget him.
strings.talk.22065.text: My wife went to visit her parents and asked me to take care of her pet #RYoyo/#R.
strings.talk.22066.text: But it doesn't get along well with me, and when my wife left, it rolled itself up in the hose!
strings.talk.22067.text: So I beat it, but just once. Then it ran away!
strings.talk.22068.text: If my wife returns and sees it has gone missing, she'll kill me!
strings.talk.22069.text: I'm hoping it will come back on its own when it gets hungry.
strings.talk.22070.text: Ah! I have an idea. Can you help me catch a Yoyo?
strings.talk.22071.text: But it wouldn't be the same one!
strings.talk.22072.text: It doesn't matter. I don't think my wife will figure it out.
strings.talk.22073.text: So what kind of pet is a Yoyo?
strings.talk.22074.text: It's a #RPangolin/#R. I think you can find one in the forest nearby!
strings.talk.22076.text: I told you I need a yellow Pangolin, not this red Pangolin!
strings.talk.22078.text: Oh, really? Sorry! Can you catch me a #RRed Pangolin/#R?
strings.talk.22080.text: I caught a #RRed Pangolin/#R. Is this what you need?
strings.talk.22082.text: Honey, I'm back! Did you take care of my Yoyo?
strings.talk.22085.text: My darling! You lost my Yoyo!
strings.talk.22086.text: (I knew this wasn't a good idea.)
strings.talk.22087.text: No! Look, Yoyo is here! (Thank God it came back in time!)
strings.talk.22090.text: Ah! This is another Pangolin that I found. I thought it could be Yoyo's mate!
strings.talk.22091.text: Oh, splendid! I hope they'll give us some more small Yoyo! Don't you mind?
strings.talk.22092.text: Of course not! I love them! (I'm hoping it's not a male, or I'll have a miserable life ...)
strings.talk.22093.text: Thanks for helping me. Here is your reward.
strings.talk.22094.text: Can you help me catch a #RPangolin/#R?
strings.talk.22096.text: Honey, if Yoyo has lots of babies, maybe this house will be too small for them ...
strings.talk.22097.text: Don't worry. If they have babies, we can move to a new and bigger house!
strings.talk.22098.text: Sounds great, but it will take quite a long time before we can afford one.
strings.talk.22099.text: No it won't. If I work hard, we'll manage.
strings.talk.22101.text: Don't you think our Yoyo's family is really sweet?
strings.talk.22102.text: You told us we were taking a voyage to India. I don't think the earth is really round after all!
strings.talk.22103.text: You cheated all of us! The earth is flat!
strings.talk.22104.text: You told us to head west and said we could reach the east, but now we have nearly finished all our food and we have nothing to show for it! All we found were some unknown and unexplored islands!
strings.talk.22105.text: You're not qualified to be our captain! Step down at once!
strings.talk.22106.text: We want to return to Spain!
strings.talk.22108.text: If you don't relinquish command, we'll throw you into the sea, and you'll be food for the sharks!
strings.talk.22109.text: Feed the sharks! Feed the sharks!
strings.talk.22110.text: What are you doing?! Release Captain Colombo now!
strings.talk.22111.text: Who are you? How did you get here? If you try to stop us, it will cost you your life!
strings.talk.22113.text: Why, you are so strong! I must defeat you!
strings.talk.22115.text: #n/#n, stop! Don't beat my sailors! You shouldn't hurt my crew, even though you saved me.
strings.talk.22117.text: I think this is my fault. I didn't realize it would take so long, and we haven't even reached any eastern lands yet.
strings.talk.22118.text: Colombo is a really great captain.
strings.talk.22119.text: Maybe I'm wrong. I made the wrong decision. There's no route to India or the east this way! If there was, shouldn't we have found it?
strings.talk.22120.text: Captain, I think you need to calm down. At sea, in this ship, all of you must believe in your captain! It's wrong to betray him in this situation!
strings.talk.22121.text: As a matter of fact, Captain Colombo is right! You just need to go though this ocean and then you will reach India, just as Colombo told you. I'm from there!
strings.talk.22122.text: Really? We're sorry, Captain. Please forgive us.
strings.talk.22123.text: Never mind! I think we should go to an island to take a break before we continue on to India!
strings.talk.22125.text: #n/#n, thanks. You would make an excellent explorer, since you dealt with that mutiny so well.
strings.talk.22126.text: Thanks. In fact, I've traveled all around the world, so I've experienced many things.
strings.talk.22129.text: If you run into any danger, please contact me. Here is a gift I want you to have.
strings.talk.22131.text: I want to buy lots of beautiful silk for my wife when we reach India.
strings.talk.22132.text: I heard that the food there is delicious! I can't wait to taste it!
strings.talk.22133.text: Off we go on our journey!
strings.talk.22134.text: I'm in awe of Colombo. He's such a great captain.
strings.talk.22135.text: Off we go on our journey!
strings.talk.22137.text: My friend, if you run into any trouble, just contact me. I'll try my best to help you.
strings.talk.22138.text: I want to be the captain and take us back to Spain!
strings.talk.22139.text: We have to deal with this right away!
strings.talk.22141.text: Captain, you need to give us an appropriate explanation!
strings.talk.22143.text: We won't trust this captain anymore!
strings.talk.22146.text: This is the little boy that will be used as a sacrifice.
strings.talk.22147.text: If we use him to pacify those horrible souls, they won't go out and kill our people.
strings.talk.22149.text: Boo hoo! Help him! He can't be the sacrifice!
strings.talk.22150.text: I'm sorry, but we have no other choice!
strings.talk.22151.text: It's time to begin the sacrifice!
strings.talk.22153.text: #f2/#fHow can you do such horrible things to a little boy? Release him!
strings.talk.22154.text: Who are you? How dare you stop this holy sacrifice?
strings.talk.22155.text: Oh, look, he has Knight's Badge!
strings.talk.22156.text: So, he's the new Knight here? Still, he has no right to stop this sacrifice!
strings.talk.22158.text: Stop! Stop! I just made an augury. It says there's a huge dragon underground! If you continue with this so-called sacrifice, you'll wake the dragon from its slumber!
strings.talk.22160.text: Merlin! This is a traditional sacrifice! Only young boys and girls can pacify the cruel souls. If there's a huge dragon underground, show us some #Revidence/#R.
strings.talk.22162.text: I believe what Merlin said! I will find the evidence.
strings.talk.22163.text: Well, if you can't find the huge dragon, then it must be the souls doing evil here!
strings.talk.22165.text: To pacify them, we need to sacrifice this boy!
strings.talk.22167.text: #n/#n, in my augury the huge dragon was sleeping in the #Rcave#R of the #RMysterious Forest/#R behind Stonehenge.
strings.talk.22168.text: This is the #RGuiding Stone/#R. It contains my power, so maybe it can lead you to the place.
strings.talk.22169.text: Wow, cool! A huge dragon! Merlin was right! Now how do I collect some evidence? Should I pull a scale from its hide?
strings.talk.22174.text: #n/#n, the huge dragon has become even stronger since leaving its cave. We need to trap it.
strings.talk.22175.text: I defeated the dragon, so now will you release the little boy?
strings.talk.22176.text: (They destroyed everything. I'll be back sooner or later.)
strings.talk.22177.text: The soldiers release the little boy.
strings.talk.22178.text: Oh, my child! You are safe now.
strings.talk.22180.text: Everything is done! Merlin, I need to go report this to the king.
strings.talk.22183.text: This is a special gift I want you to have. It may help you one day.
strings.talk.22184.text: (What's going on? Maybe if I have the #RKnight's Badge/#R, I can ask what happened.)
strings.talk.22185.text: I hope everything will be OK soon.
strings.talk.22186.text: This is the only boy that meets the priest's requirements.
strings.talk.22188.text: Boo hoo! Help! Help! I'm scared!
strings.talk.22189.text: (What's going on? Maybe if I have the #RKnight's Badge/#R, I can ask what happened.)
strings.talk.22190.text: Knight, have you found any evidence?
strings.talk.22191.text: Maybe the #Rcave/#R Merlin spoke of is behind this stone gate.
strings.talk.22192.text: Guiding Stone is shining now! This is the right way. Enter.
strings.talk.22193.text: Guiding Stone is shining, and the light disappears when I reach the cave.
strings.talk.22194.text: The stone gate is locked! There's a machine here. Maybe this is the key to open the door.
strings.talk.22195.text: The door is open! Go have a look.
strings.talk.22196.text: It's not so easy to open it. Try again.
strings.talk.22197.text: #f2/#fThis dragon is unbelievably powerful. It would do a huge amount of damage to everything. We have to defeat it!
strings.talk.22200.text: The huge dragon has finally been killed.
strings.talk.22201.text: #n/#n, you are so powerful and smart! With more training, you could be a great hero!
strings.talk.22202.text: Thanks. I'll strive to continue my training.
strings.talk.22203.text: (Fortunately, Merlin doesn't know the dragon awoke because I pulled its scale out.)
strings.talk.22204.text: (Otherwise he would use his magic wand and banish me.)
strings.talk.22206.text: Maybe this is the right way. Go have a look.
strings.talk.22208.text: I'd better go see what will happen.
strings.talk.22210.text: Grandma, the boy's fate is sealed. Those soldiers caught him.
strings.talk.22211.text: They will sacrifice him to pacify the bloody souls.
strings.talk.22787.text: Redeem 1 Jade Rabbit running to the moon (need 10 milk yellow moon cakes)
strings.talk.22788.text: Do I need to exchange 10 yellow moon cakes for 1 Jade Rabbit running to the moon?
strings.talk.25000.text: Excuse me, can you do me a favor?
strings.talk.25001.text: I wanna make some presents for my parents personally. To do this, I need the following materials:#R#B 2 Daphnes, 2 Common Grass,1 Blue Wild Flower,1 Aligote,2 common stones /#R/#B. Can you find them for me?
strings.talk.25002.text: Thank you, these are some humble gifts. Please accept them.
strings.talk.25003.text: Dick, what can I do for you?
strings.talk.25004.text: Dick, you can take these materials to make some gifts for your parents.
strings.talk.25006.text: Never mind!I'll get other people to help me.
strings.talk.25007.text: Have you collected :#R#B 2 Daphnes, 2 Common Grass,1 Blue Wild Flower,1 Aligote,2 common stones /#R/#B?
strings.talk.25008.text: Great,then I have presents to give to my Papa and Mama.
strings.talk.25009.text: Dick is really a good boy who truly cares about his parents.
strings.talk.25017.text: Excuse me, what do you want?
strings.talk.25018.text: I need a snakeskin overcoat. But I still lack #R#B 1 Fire Snake Skin,1 Green Snake Skin,1 White Snake Skin,and 1 Yellow Snake Skin/#R/#B.Are you willing to collect these materials for me?
strings.talk.25019.text: Have you collected these things: #R#B1 fire snake skin,1 green snake skin,1 white snake skin,and 1 yellow snake skin/#R/#B?
strings.talk.25020.text: These are the materials you need!
strings.talk.25021.text: Great~~~~I finally have what I need to make my snakeskin overcoat.
strings.talk.25022.text: Thank you so much. Please accept these humble gifts.
strings.talk.25023.text: Loving beauty is the nature of females.
strings.talk.25025.text: Please...please hurry to save the other people.
strings.talk.25026.text: Where are the other people you mentioned.
strings.talk.25029.text: You silly fools. If you tell us the hiding place of the #R#B Jade Stone/#R/#B,you will survive.
strings.talk.25033.text: Tell us the hiding place of the #R#B Jade Stone/#R/#B,otherwise what you will do next is to go to hell.
strings.talk.25034.text: I don't know even know what the #R#B the Jade Stone /#R/#B is.
strings.talk.25035.text: Nobody will come to help you. Hahaha. . .
strings.talk.25038.text: Somebody is coming to help us! !
strings.talk.25039.text: Stop! Let the innocent villagers go.
strings.talk.25041.text: To be a hero will cost you a lot! Buddies, come on!
strings.talk.25042.text: You! Get out of this place.
strings.talk.25044.text: Finally, I can get away from here.
strings.talk.25046.text: Hahaha! You, the low-class human being! Do you think you can leave here that easily?
strings.talk.25049.text: You were lucky enough to have escaped before, but that won't be the case this time. Whoever tries to stop Master Frederico's from carrying out his plan will die.
strings.talk.25050.text: Where is Frederico? Tell us quickly.
strings.talk.25051.text: You wanna know where Master Frederico is? Ok, show us your power.
strings.talk.25052.text: Hahahah! Don't be so happy! What you knocked down is just me warming up.
strings.talk.25053.text: Come on! The real fighting begins now.
strings.talk.25055.text: Hurry, tell me where Frederico is?!
strings.talk.25056.text: Master Frederico is at...He is at..
strings.talk.25061.text: (Damn! The clue to know the hiding place of Frederico is over)
strings.talk.25062.text: He is just a very humble subordinate of Frederico. But he seemed so powerful. We should strengthen our power so that we can get revenge for Roca.
strings.talk.25063.text: Stupid Frederico! I promise I will find you.
strings.talk.25065.text: What? A human broke into the cave? It's rare.
strings.talk.25067.text: Hah...Since you found us, don't leave in such a hurry. It's your turn to go to hell after I kill her.
strings.talk.25069.text: You are the human beings who recently dectected Frederico's hiding place in the evil circles. It's not strange that you were able to defeat me.
strings.talk.25071.text: I don't know #R#B Frederico's hiding place /#R/#B. Being just a naive little girl, can you get revenge for your father? You underestimate #R#B Frederico's power /#R/#B.
strings.talk.25072.text: If you don't kill me, I can change into evil which may strengthen your #R#B Stars Companions'/#R/#B power. After all, I'm one of the high-class devils.
strings.talk.25074.text: (No matter which angles you look at him, he is not likely to be a high-class evil at all.)
strings.talk.25076.text: Ok! Considering that you want to be good again and fight against Frederico with us, I will accept your request.
strings.talk.25078.text: How's it? You are now aware that I didn't cheat you. Are you feeling a strong stream of power is being emitted?
strings.talk.25080.text: Don't make a fuss. After all I'm a high-class evil. Even if I change into an object, I can't have my self-consciousness.
strings.talk.25081.text: Damn it!! Shut up! Or I will shut you up!
strings.talk.25084.text: Damn!! Why can't I run into such a good thing?
strings.talk.25085.text: Do you want to exchange the key for the underground passage with five stars?
strings.talk.25086.text: The articles are not enough that it can't begin.
strings.talk.25087.text: If you wanna exchange, you can come to see me.
strings.talk.25088.text: The door has been locked. The key to the #R#B underground passage /#R/#B is needed to open the door.
strings.talk.25089.text: The scenery here is very beautiful...Yee? Why can we see the meteor at this time of the day? And why is the meteor becoming larger and larger...?
strings.talk.25090.text: Get away! My plane doesn't listen to me now.
strings.talk.25091.text: My! Why not say it earlier!
strings.talk.25092.text: #f2/#f That was dangerous just now, do you know that?
strings.talk.25093.text: Hahahha! (laughing bitterly) Sorry, I was flying happily because I invented a plane. However, I didn't pay attention to its endurance, so, just now...
strings.talk.25094.text: I flew here from a far place but I can't go back now. If you can help me to make a #R#B propeller /#R/#B and #R#B wings/#R/#B, I will give you the design schematics.
strings.talk.25095.text: Have you made the #R#B propeller /#R/#B and #R#B wings /#R/#B which I desperately need?
strings.talk.25096.text: These are the objects you need.
strings.talk.25097.text: Fantastic! I can go back now.
strings.talk.25098.text: Thank you very much indeed! This is for you as a parting gift.
strings.talk.25101.text: My family was lost, I'm looking for them everywhere!!
strings.talk.25103.text: Last night, he said that he would go to the #R#B fishing village /#R/#B for a walk. However, a day has passed, and he hasn't come back yet. Can you find him for me?
strings.talk.25106.text: #R#B Sanbao /#R/#B?? It seems that I have ever heard it somewhere.
strings.talk.25108.text: Hey! There is a man who is wearing the same garment as a Chinese soldier over there. I don't know whether he is the man who the soldiers mentioned or not.
strings.talk.25109.text: Strange! Where are we now? Why can't I find the way to the fishing village?
strings.talk.25111.text: Yes! Who are you? I don't think I know you.
strings.talk.25112.text: I was asked to take you back by the soldier in the fishing village.
strings.talk.25113.text: Really?! I'm worried, how can I leave this place?
strings.talk.25114.text: I helped you to bring your family back.
strings.talk.25115.text: Thank you very much. I'm worried that he can't come back.
strings.talk.25116.text: Yes! I'm the kind of person who can't find my way home once I leave the sea. This object is for you.
strings.talk.25119.text: Then #n/#n? If you are free, you can come to my ship to meet me. I'll tell you the happiness of sailing.
strings.talk.25120.text: Isn't Master Sanbao the first person to sail to the Atlantic Ocean seven times with ZhengHe in Chinese history? I hadn't expected that I was lucky enough to meet a famous Chinese navigator unexpectedly.
strings.talk.25121.text: Yee! Are you Master Sanbao? Why are you here?
strings.talk.25122.text: #N/#N, do you want to sense the happiness of sailing?
strings.talk.25123.text: Yes! Mr Zheng, I wanna know more about the happiness of sailing.
strings.talk.25124.text: Then I'm imparting to you all the happiness I know about sailing.
strings.talk.25125.text: Hahahah! Hand all the treasure out, or you will be thrown to the sea to feed the sharks.
strings.talk.25127.text: What!! You gave me up?! How can you be worthy of being soldiers of the Ming Dynasty?!
strings.talk.25128.text: Nobody will come to save you. Hand over all the treasures.
strings.talk.25129.text: I have no choice but to break through by myself.
strings.talk.25130.text: Master Zheng, let me help you.
strings.talk.25131.text: Impossible! I never thought that I would fail since I, Chen Zuyi, have travelled so long in the sea.
strings.talk.25132.text: I think your power is not as weak as I thought. Don't be pirates anymore. I think you may be worthy of being my crew.
strings.talk.25133.text: (I didn't think that Master Zheng was blind, while it's not the case in the sea.)
strings.talk.25135.text: Of course it's true. The court really need a powerful person like you to join.
strings.talk.25136.text: ChenZuyi will be sure to serve the court.
strings.talk.25137.text: #n/#n, Thank you for your help. Please accept my humble gifts.
strings.talk.25138.text: You are welcome. This is what I should do.
strings.talk.25140.text: He...He...It's not certain that we will meet somewhere.
strings.talk.25142.text: How shall we deal with it!
strings.talk.25143.text: I was teaching my younger sister a lesson. I did't care what she felt. She has left because she can't stand my bad words. Can you help me to find her around the #R#B village./#R/#B?
strings.talk.25144.text: En! No problem. I've been looking for her all over the village.
strings.talk.25145.text: Have you found #R#B my younger sister/#R/#B? She couldn't have gone far away.
strings.talk.25146.text: Little Sis...Go back to your elder sister. She is worried about you.
strings.talk.25147.text: You are trying to cheat me. My elder sister doesn't care about me at all. How can she be worried about me?
strings.talk.25148.text: It's true!! If she really doesn't care about you, she would not have looked for you at all.
strings.talk.25149.text: Really? If she is really worried about me, I guess I should go back.
strings.talk.25150.text: It's hard to imagine that children nowadays think in such a strange ways.
strings.talk.25151.text: Youth, It seems that you have good abilities. Can you help me to find an object?
strings.talk.25152.text: Sure! What do you want me to find for you?
strings.talk.25153.text: It is said that there was a brilliant ceramist who hid his perfect works in a cave #R#B Outside the Pass./#R/#B in the time of Shengwen. Of course you will be rewarded if you can help me.
strings.talk.25154.text: What! Just find some old pots?! That's seems too easy! Is it dangerous?
strings.talk.25155.text: How can it be dangerous?! This is a very easy task.
strings.talk.25156.text: It seems that a stream of somber wind is drawing near. Could it be a monster is about to appear?!
strings.talk.25157.text: Yee! Is this the perfect work of the genius ceramist, which was mentioned by that old man?
strings.talk.25158.text: He is really a gifted sculptor. His work seems to always be on the verge of coming alive, especially the eyes, which are so lifelike... I want to touch it!
strings.talk.25161.text: OW! My nose! What's wrong with you? You said you would prick my eyes, so why do you poke my nostrils?
strings.talk.25162.text: Terriblely sorry! My hands carelessly slid into your nose!
strings.talk.25163.text: What! The earth puppy can talk? You really scared me!
strings.talk.25164.text: Who is more abhorrent?! You said you would prick my eyes, but instead you pricked my nostrils. Be ready to die!
strings.talk.25165.text: #f2/#f You crazy old man, how dare you try to cheat me. This was a very dangerous task.
strings.talk.25166.text: Don't be angry! You've returned, nothing missing or broken, no harm done. This is your reward.
strings.talk.25169.text: Thank you very much indeed for finding my younger sister. This humble gift is for you.
strings.talk.25170.text: I have a key passed down from my ancestors. I heard from my grandfather that it can open a mysterious box which holds a treasure. I'll sell it to you for the price of #R#B20 thousand gold/#R/#B?Ok?
strings.talk.25171.text: Wow!(exclamation) You trying to hurt my feelings? That's not enough.
strings.talk.25172.text: Come to see me when you really think its worth it.
strings.talk.25173.text: So expensive! In my opinion, give it up!
strings.talk.25175.text: Thank you very much for finding my younger sister.
strings.talk.25176.text: A #R#B golden key /#R/#B is needed to open the treasue.
strings.talk.25177.text: Have you found the object I need? It is hidden in some cave outside the Pass.
strings.talk.25178.text: I finally knocked him down. Take him to the old man and get my reward.
strings.talk.25179.text: Excuse me, do you know who can uderstand the languages of the other areas?
strings.talk.25180.text: I heard from the village that recently a mysterious outlander arrived, who helped us solve many problems. He is in #R#B some room in the village /#R/#B. Maybe he can solve your problem.
strings.talk.25181.text: Hi, I have heard that you can understand the languages of the other areas, is that true?
strings.talk.25182.text: Hehe, I can't completely understand it. But don't worry. I'm ready to help others. If I can I will try my best to help you.
strings.talk.25183.text: Thank you very much indeed. One of my friends said she speaks the language of another area. I wonder whether there is a way which can enable my friend to speak the ordinary language?
strings.talk.25184.text: I wonder whether you can let me hear how your friend speaks?
strings.talk.25188.text: This...This is the language of the divine clan, why...Why are you able to speak the language of the divine clan?
strings.talk.25189.text: Can you come a little closer? I want to see your appearance clearly.
strings.talk.25190.text: Ah! Niss!! You have grown up. You look like your mother Asner. Why are you here? Are your parents alive? Do you remember who I am?
strings.talk.25192.text: Oh, your memory has been sealed. It's not strange because people from the divine and human clans are not allowed to get married.
strings.talk.25193.text: Excuse me, what are you talking about? Why can't I catch you? Do you know Niss's background? Would you please tell me?
strings.talk.25194.text: I don't know much about it. The only thing I know is that Niss's father is the king of Aschyna and her mother is the daughter of the Space King.
strings.talk.25195.text: If you want to know more details, you must find the #R#R 3 Sealed Beads /#R/#B used by Daliers to seal Niss's memory.
strings.talk.25196.text: Ah! Niss is accidentally the descendent of the divine clan. Then where should I find the #R#R 3 Sealed Beads/#R/#B?
strings.talk.25197.text: I can give you some information about this. I have heard that there is a bedroom of Chief Pharoah Kabyph in the mysterious passage of the Pyramid in Egypt, where there are many mysterious treasures. You can go there to have a look.
strings.talk.25199.text: Oh, yes. May I know your name ?
strings.talk.25201.text: What's wrong? Pattis is lost all of a sudden. It seems that I should go to the #R#B bedroom of Chief Pharoah Kabyph in the mysterious passage of the Pyramid in Egypt /#R/#B to have a look.
strings.talk.25202.text: This ought to be the Sealed Bead that Pattis mentioned.
strings.talk.25203.text: How can you, a group of tomb thieves, come here to steal my treasures?! Be ready to die!
strings.talk.25204.text: Why...How can this little girl have a stream of stength as powerful as that guy. Did he cheat me?
strings.talk.25205.text: (Is the person he mentioned Niss? Is there a huge mysteriou stream of power in Niss's body?)
strings.talk.25206.text: Ok! You are not allowed to talk here.
strings.talk.25208.text: Hehehe, youth, see you next time.
strings.talk.25209.text: Youth?? I think he is younger than me!!
strings.talk.25210.text: (Who on earth is Pattis? I wonder whether she is my enemy or my friend?)
strings.talk.25211.text: (What's going on? Why am I feeling uneasy now?)
strings.talk.25212.text: Why did my ancestors leave me a crystal death head?
strings.talk.25213.text: I got this crystal death-head for some reason. Since it was left by your ancestors, I will give it back to you.
strings.talk.25214.text: Thank you. Well, my ancestors left 13 crystal skull heads. Two were lost due to my carelessness. Since you have found one of them, can you help me to find the other one?
strings.talk.25215.text: Ok, I will be responsible for this.
strings.talk.25216.text: However, where can I find it? Do you still remember where it was lost.
strings.talk.25217.text: I remember that I lost it in the #R#B mysterious passage of altar /#R/#B.
strings.talk.25218.text: Have you found the other #R#B crystal skull head /#R/#B yet? I remember that I lost it in the #R#B mysterious passage of altar /#R/#B.
strings.talk.25219.text: This may be the thirteenth crystal death-head the flamen mentioned.
strings.talk.25220.text: Yee! Odd! Why can't I pick it up?
strings.talk.25221.text: Yee! There are words on it. They look like the Mayan Language, Qlaya, can you understand the words on it?
strings.talk.25222.text: It reads: Turn the crystal skull to the right side three times and to the left side once,then you can pick it up.
strings.talk.25226.text: You actually want to steal the crystal skull? You are really terrible.
strings.talk.25227.text: Is this your lost crystal skull?
strings.talk.25228.text: Yes! This is the right crystal skull!
strings.talk.25229.text: Can you tell me what secrets we can know from the crystal skulls?
strings.talk.25230.text: These crystal skulls are called Opas by us Mayan people. They provide information on the origin and death of human.When the civilization reaches its summit, they will appear again and open up the secrets of the past and future things.
strings.talk.25231.text: This is treasured knowledge left by our ancestors. I will never lose them again. Here are some gifts for you.
strings.talk.25232.text: Thank you for helping me to get back the crystal skulls handed down from my ancestors.
strings.talk.25233.text: Here comes a #R#B stranger/#R/#B. This guy can keep working without eating or drinking anything. I doubt that he is a alien, maybe he is an ET...
strings.talk.25234.text: Could you help me to find the truth?
strings.talk.25236.text: I have something to deal with right now. Let's go beyond it later.
strings.talk.25237.text: Have you looked into the background of that #R#B stranger /#R/#B?
strings.talk.25238.text: Excuse me, are you the man who can work without eating or drinking anything?
strings.talk.25239.text: Exactly, but it's not the case when I am in my hometown. I don't know why I can work without eating or drinking anything for several days after I came to this blue planet.
strings.talk.25240.text: Blue planet!! You are an ET as I expected.
strings.talk.25241.text: ET? You are wrong, I'm not an ET. Look!
strings.talk.25242.text: I'm a Martian not a so-called ET.
strings.talk.25243.text: It's too bad! Since you've seen my true appearance, I have to punish you.
strings.talk.25244.text: It's very dangerous here! You'd better hurry back to Mars!
strings.talk.25245.text: Please, I love this blue planet. Don't drive me away, ok?
strings.talk.25246.text: (He seems to really love this place. Forcing him to leave may not be the kind thing to do to him.)
strings.talk.25247.text: Ok, but you should promise me you'll behave well here and don't do anything wrong. OK?
strings.talk.25248.text: Ok, thanks. If possible, I will repay you for your kindness.
strings.talk.25249.text: #f3/#f(If the villagers know he is from Mars,we can't imagine what would happen. We'd better find an excuse to drive him out.)
strings.talk.25250.text: I have checked him out and found that he doesn't have an appetite because of the hot weather.He's not an ET, just a hard working man.
strings.talk.25251.text: Really? I don't know, I have my doubts...
strings.talk.25252.text: Thanks you for telling me the truth, or I would've misunderstood a good person. Please accept this article as my humble object.
strings.talk.25253.text: I think he must be an ET. My intuition is never wrong.
strings.talk.25254.text: He ought to be in the #R#B forests /#R/#B over there.
strings.talk.25255.text: This world is coming to an end! We are doomed to die.
strings.talk.25257.text: Because the envoy of the Apollo Ayatollah has captured Apollo, all living things will die without the sun.
strings.talk.25258.text: Outer traveler, would you save the Helios from the Ayatollah?
strings.talk.25260.text: No way! The world will come to a grisly end. Who can save the Apollo? We're going to die!
strings.talk.25261.text: Then where should I look for the Ayatollah?
strings.talk.25262.text: The Ayatollah doesn't like places with sunshine. You should go to the #R#Bcave/#R/#B before you to have a check. Maybe you can find some clues in there.
strings.talk.25263.text: Haha! I have been waiting for this day for a long time. Finally the day has come. You can surrender now. After killing you, I can destroy this world with Master Frederico and create our own world. By then, nobody can stand in our way!
strings.talk.25264.text: Ayatollah, I expected you would betray me to fulfill your own desires. But your little conspiracy will not work, I'm sure someone will stop you.
strings.talk.25266.text: Aaahhh! Why is there always someone ready to step up and stop me, just when I'm about to get away with it.
strings.talk.25268.text: If you want to save the Apollo, you must defeat me.
strings.talk.25269.text: Great. Finally the Ayatollah has been defeated.
strings.talk.25270.text: Hahah!! How naive you are! I will not lose if you cannot defeat my subordinate.
strings.talk.25272.text: So, can you defeat me now?
strings.talk.25273.text: Master Frederico, please forgive me that I couldn't accomplish the tasks you assigned to me.
strings.talk.25275.text: Thank you very much, outer traveller! In order to express my gratitude, please follow me to the gate of the #R#Bcave/#R/#B, I will treat you well there.
strings.talk.25276.text: Outer traveler. Thank you for saving the Apollo. In order to thank you, Apollo has asked me to give you these gifts.
strings.talk.25277.text: Thank you very much for saving the Apollo. The world is saved and the Apollo can return to his rightful place once more.
strings.talk.25278.text: It seems that the door is sealed with some kind of mysterious power and can't be opened.
strings.talk.25279.text: Strange! How can the sealed bead flash?
strings.talk.25281.text: Who are you? How did you come here? Are you a soldier of King Howert?
strings.talk.25282.text: No,I don't know King Howert. I just came here by accident to find if the bead is the one we are looking for.
strings.talk.25283.text: What do you want the sealed bead to do?
strings.talk.25284.text: We just need this sealed bead to help my friend to restore his memory. Could you give me the sealed bead?
strings.talk.25286.text: Sealed Bead is a holy object being protected by us.
strings.talk.25287.text: Let's discuss it after you defeat the four door gods.
strings.talk.25289.text: Are you willing to accept my challenge?
strings.talk.25291.text: In my opinion,we should give up!
strings.talk.25293.text: Elder brother,don't be so stubborn. Since he could come in, it proved that he is the right person to choose.
strings.talk.25294.text: What? My second elder brother was right. I think he was chosen to be here.
strings.talk.25295.text: Quite right, maybe the elder brother can defeat King Howert.
strings.talk.25296.text: (He could come in. Maybe he is really chosen to be here)
strings.talk.25297.text: Ok! The sealed bead will be given to you. Oh,yes, I have one final question. Is the person who told you about the sealed bead, Pattis, an enchantress?
strings.talk.25298.text: Well,I have one more question. Is the person who told you about the sealed bead, Pattis, an enchantress?
strings.talk.25300.text: Pattis, she was the assisting god of Daris, the king of universe. He disappeared from heaven 1500 years ago. Nobody knows where she has gone.
strings.talk.25301.text: What's more, I feel that the girl beside you has two streams of strong power, one belonging to the power of light, the other belonging to the power of darkness. Human beings can't have two streams of such power.
strings.talk.25302.text: Several thousand years ago,there was a god who had these two streams of power. I named him Twin god, who stands for the reborn and damage.
strings.talk.25303.text: Are you refering to Niss? Niss can't even talk. How can she have two streams of such power? Can you make it clearer?
strings.talk.25304.text: The sealed bead has been given to you. And we four brothers have accomplished the task. We are leaving here. All the questions will have their answers after the three sealed beads' secret is discovered.
strings.talk.25305.text: (What on earth was going on? What's the relationship between the twin god standing for the reborn and damage and Niss?)
strings.talk.25307.text: I can't understand what you are talking about. Lets set out to find the third sealed bead.
strings.talk.25308.text: When I was on sailing , I had heard that a Ghost Ship was wandering on sea around the #R#BIndian Ocean(X:3882,Y:8775)/#R/#B. It was said that there were many treasures on it, but nobody can get close to it because of the dead spirits.
strings.talk.25309.text: The door is open. Is there somebody alive?
strings.talk.25310.text: Please save me. I will go crazy because there are so many dreadful spirits performing wildly here.
strings.talk.25311.text: Ok, but the door has been locked. How can I open it?
strings.talk.25312.text: There is a blue key beside the door gate. It can open the door.
strings.talk.25313.text: Ok,I will open the door. You get away from here.
strings.talk.25314.text: No, I can't leave here. I came here for the secrets treasure of this ship.How can we leave without anything!
strings.talk.25316.text: Yes, it's the place. The red sign is mentioned in the picture of hidden treasures. The treasures are under it while the door can't be opened. What shall we do?
strings.talk.25317.text: It reads: "Use hellfire to draw a black bloody association sign"
strings.talk.25318.text: Are you sure you want to light the hellfire?
strings.talk.25319.text: The door is open. Treasures~~I'm coming!!
strings.talk.25320.text: Aha! After going through thick and thin, we are here.There must be things we need.
strings.talk.25321.text: (Why. . Why are there so many skeletons?)
strings.talk.25322.text: You escaped from prison most unexpectably and then found yourself some help. What's more, you also wanna steal the black magic stone from the ship? We will teach you a good lesson for our captain.
strings.talk.25324.text: Thank you very much for defeating the skeleton guardians. I don't know your name yet.
strings.talk.25325.text: #n/#n, the only thing I want is the black magic stone. The rest of the objects belong to you. I am leaving first. Take care!
strings.talk.25326.text: Is there really a ghost ship? Wandering on the Indian Ocean?
strings.talk.25328.text: The ghosts are wandering on the #R#B Indian Ocean at (X:3882, Y:8775)/#R/#B.
strings.talk.25329.text: It seems that we opened some secret equipment?
strings.talk.25330.text: The treasue box is locked. We can't open it.
strings.talk.25331.text: There is nothing in the treasure box.
strings.talk.25333.text: I am an archaeologist. I'm looking at the words on the pillar from which I can decipher the secrets of the Pyramids.
strings.talk.25335.text: It reads: If you put the #R#B truth stone/#R/#Bat the back of the Androsphinx, you can step on the way of truth.
strings.talk.25336.text: Is this the truth stone metioned by the archaeologist?
strings.talk.25337.text: Yes!? The Androsphinx's eyes are flashing!
strings.talk.25338.text: Why is there an entry? Is this the way of truth?
strings.talk.25339.text: Why are there so many coffins?
strings.talk.25340.text: The image of Anubis looks like it is alive and staring at us with hate. Which sculpter did this?
strings.talk.25341.text: Who are you? How do you know the method to open the way of truth? Are you also a graverobbersent by "that person"?

strings.talk.26834.text: My pet Blunt is in pain from a decayed tooth! I want to help it, but I don't the right tools!
strings.talk.26835.text: (If she had some #RDental Forceps/#R, I think she could pull the decayed tooth out of Blunt's mouth.)
strings.talk.26836.text: #f1/#fCome here! The Dental Forceps are for you. You can help Blunt by pulling out the decayed tooth.
strings.talk.26837.text: Thanks. Here is a gift for you.
strings.talk.26838.text: Thanks. Here is a gift for you.
strings.talk.26839.text: Blunt! Don't worry, you'll be OK soon!
strings.talk.26841.text: Splendid! I pulled out Blunt's decayed tooth!
strings.talk.26842.text: Did you know that a spy from Britain was put in jail in #Rthe cellar behind the Church/#R? They said he's a knight!
strings.talk.26845.text: (Are they talking about Lancelot? I think I'd better go check it out!)
strings.talk.26846.text: This is the cellar they were talking about.
strings.talk.26847.text: Why did you come here! What's your plan?
strings.talk.26848.text: I told you I'm just a common traveler!
strings.talk.26849.text: We got a message saying that someone would come here and help Joan conquer France! Would that be you?
strings.talk.26850.text: Oh, I've told you many times! I don't know who Joan is!
strings.talk.26851.text: Well, I don't think you'll tell the truth until I give you something special.
strings.talk.26853.text: You again! The guy with Joan! You're really dead this time!
strings.talk.26854.text: Lancelot! Are you OK? Why have they put you in prison?
strings.talk.26856.text: Oh, I guess this isn't a good place to tell me what happened. If you need help, just tell me!
strings.talk.26857.text: Savior #n/#n, I will tell you what happened.
strings.talk.26858.text: What makes you think I'm a savior?
strings.talk.26859.text: Goddess Le Yana told King Arthur that Saint could stop the war between Britain and France, so he asked me to help her!
strings.talk.26860.text: But I can't find her anywhere! If you know where she is, please tell me!
strings.talk.26861.text: #f1/#fSure, I'll tell you as soon as I find her.
strings.talk.26862.text: Thanks. I have to go find Saint now. Farewell.
strings.talk.26863.text: Lancelot wants to find Saint? Maybe Saint is Joan?
strings.talk.26867.text: Why? She's protecting us from being attacking by the British!
strings.talk.26868.text: They say she's the one who secretly provoked the war between Britain and France!
strings.talk.26870.text: Yes, they said they want to burn Joan in Dorjas Jungle!
strings.talk.26871.text: (They are talking about Joan? Is she the Saint that Lancelot wants to find?)
strings.talk.26873.text: My dear villagers! This is Joan who cheated us and provoked the war between Britain and France.
strings.talk.26874.text: Now we will burn her to purify her soul!
strings.talk.26875.text: I'm Lancelot, a knight from the Round Table. I won't let you burn St. Joan!
strings.talk.26876.text: (St. Joan) So Joan is the Saint!
strings.talk.26877.text: Ha! I've been waiting for you for a long time! I knew someone would come to save her! Lancelot! #n/#n! I will kill you!
strings.talk.26879.text: Ahhhhhh! A monster is coming! Run! Run!
strings.talk.26880.text: I'm one of the 6 Nether Generals, the Dark Knight Kirk!
strings.talk.26881.text: Ha ha! The war between Britain and France is about to begin! I put Joan in jail here so I could kill you both and finish my mission! Ha!
strings.talk.26882.text: Oh, it was you who provoked the hatred between Britain and France!
strings.talk.26883.text: You're right! I did it so King Howert would conquer the world!
strings.talk.26885.text: #f2/#fI must kill you and stop the war!
strings.talk.26886.text: Yes! I swear I will stop you and your dark king!
strings.talk.26887.text: Ha ha! I'm not the only enemy you have to defeat! Here they come!
strings.talk.26889.text: What's going on? Why didn't they lose HP when we attacked them?
strings.talk.26890.text: Hahahaha! We are invincible! This is the power that King Howert gave us!
strings.talk.26891.text: Run! Get away from here! Leave me!
strings.talk.26892.text: No! I must protect you! It's my mission!
strings.talk.26895.text: Savior #n/#n and Sir Lancelot! I will use my godly powers to help you defeat the dark knight Kirk!
strings.talk.26898.text: Savior #n/#n, even though you ruined King Howert's plan, he will just dispatch more killers to get rid of you. Be careful!
strings.talk.26899.text: I want to kill you all!
strings.talk.26901.text: Thanks for helping me and my country!
strings.talk.26902.text: #f1/#fI'm so happy the war between Britain and France has been stopped.
strings.talk.26903.text: I don't think it has. In fact, the people were merely manipulated into doing what they truly desire. A war will break out sooner or later.
strings.talk.26905.text: No! There is a way to stop the war.
strings.talk.26908.text: Ah! Sorry, I kept it in a secret place.
strings.talk.26909.text: I'll enchant purifying power into the Guiding Stone and then place it in Britain and France. It will remove the hatred and evil desires.
strings.talk.26911.text: #f1/#fOh, Goddess Le Yana disappear again! I have so many questions I want to ask.
strings.talk.26913.text: Sorry, #n/#n. By saving me, you've become hell's enemy.
strings.talk.26915.text: Would you mind if I join your team? I want to help protect you just like you have done for me.
strings.talk.26916.text: That's a good idea. It's safer if you two stay together. Then I can go back.
strings.talk.26917.text: I'm so happy you'll be a part of my team!
strings.talk.26921.text: #f2/#fI didn't know Kirk was so strong.
strings.talk.26922.text: Oh, I'm so happy to see you again! I will capture you and make you a slave for King Howert!
strings.talk.26923.text: Ha ha, I caught the spy!
strings.talk.26924.text: No! I'm not a spy! I'm a common traveler.
strings.talk.26926.text: You're not even afraid of death! Fine, I'll kill you as you wish!
strings.talk.26927.text: #f2/#fSo there's no way to defeat Kirk and save Joan?
strings.talk.26928.text: Savior #n/#n! Equip the #RKnight's Badge/#R from King Arthur. It may help us defeat Kirk.
strings.talk.26930.text: Here's the Guiding Stone, Le Yana.
strings.talk.26931.text: Defeat Kirk and save St. Joan.
strings.talk.26932.text: To save St. Joan, I must first defeat Dark Knight Kirk.
strings.talk.26933.text: Is St. Joan all right? Go have a look.
strings.talk.26934.text: #n/#n, from now on you must protect St. Joan.
strings.talk.26936.text: She's the one who provoked the war between Britain and France.
strings.talk.26937.text: She's so horrible! She cheated us!
strings.talk.26938.text: I never thought she was a traitor.
strings.talk.26939.text: St. Joan has been saved and my mission is finished!
strings.talk.26940.text: #n/#n, please give the #RGuiding Stone/#R to Goddess Le Yana.
strings.talk.26942.text: #n/#n, it seems you are in some trouble. I want to give this #RGuiding Stone/#R to you. I hope it will help you.
strings.talk.26945.text: Oh, you're the Jade Rabbit who accompanies Chang'er! But why are you here?
strings.talk.26946.text: Ha ha, in fact, I'm hoping to have an unusual Mid-Autumn Festival, so I need some Sweet Pomelo Kabob.
strings.talk.26947.text: #f1/#fYou want Sweet Pomelo Kabob? I think Chang'er can make it for you!
strings.talk.26948.text: I'm not good at making it. That's why my Jade Rabbit comes here. She said she needs delicious Sweet Pomelo Kabob!
strings.talk.26950.text: I am going to cook Grilled Steak for the Jade Rabbit. Can you help me collect the ingredients?
strings.talk.26951.text: Sure! So what kind of ingredients do you need?
strings.talk.26952.text: I've already got a barbeque grill. So I need #R#BRaw Sirloin Steak/#R/#B and #R#BBBQ Sauce/#R/#B. After I finish cooking, I will give the #R#BGrilled Steak/#R/#B to the Jade Rabbit for a taste.
strings.talk.26953.text: If the Jade Rabbit likes it, you'll be rewarded.
strings.talk.26954.text: Okay, I'll collect the ingredients for you, but you must wait for me here!
strings.talk.26955.text: No worries. We won't leave until #R#BOctober 14th/#R/#B
strings.talk.26956.text: Oh, so we can't have the Sweet Pomelo Kabob here this year?
strings.talk.26957.text: It turns out I don't have any #R#BRaw Sirloin Steak/#R/#B or #R#BBBQ Sauce/#R/#B.
strings.talk.26958.text: I'm eager to have some Sweet Pomelo Kabob! They're so delicious!
strings.talk.26959.text: #f1/#fCome here, Jade Rabbit! Time to have something delicious!
strings.talk.26961.text: Here is a gift for you.
strings.talk.26962.text: If you have any #R#BGrilled Steak/#R/#B left, remember to let me taste it.
strings.talk.26964.text: The meat is over cooked. It's not very good.
strings.talk.26965.text: The meat is too rare. To be a good chef, you have to be more careful.
strings.talk.26967.text: I have to collect #R#BRaw Sirloin Steak/#R/#B and #R#BBBQ Sauce/#R/#B to cook the Grilled Steak for the Jade Rabbit.
strings.talk.26968.text: #f1/#fFantastic! It'smells good! Jade Rabbit will love it.
strings.talk.26969.text: The fire is very hot. I don't think it's a good idea to get too close to it.
strings.talk.26970.text: Annual Thanksgiving comes again! Haven't you prpared the turkey and pumpkin pie?
strings.talk.26972.text: Oh, Happy Thanksgiving! Can you help me to get the #R#BTurkey and Pumpkin Pie/#R/#B? If you give me them I'll give you a gift as reward.
strings.talk.26974.text: If you can give me the #R#BTurkey and Pumpkin Pie/#R/#B before 11:00pm of December 6th, I'll give you a gift as reward.
strings.talk.26975.text: These are the Turkey and Pumpkin Pie you want!
strings.talk.26976.text: Oh thanks, this is the reward for you. Don't forget to exchange it before 11:00pm of December 6th.
strings.talk.26977.text: I have 3 special bells that mean a lot to me, the 2013 Wish Bell, 2013 Safety Bell and 2013 Christmas Bell. I must have dropped them on my way here. Could you help me find it?
strings.talk.26978.text: Have you found my bells yet? I'll repeat, it's the 2013 Wish Bell, 2013 Safety Bell and 2013 Christmas Bell.
strings.talk.26979.text: Do you want to exchange #R#Bthese 4 Happy Xmas Snowball/#R/#B for Christmas Gift Pack?
strings.talk.26980.text: You can trade #R#B4 Happy Xmas Snowball/#R/#B for a Christmas Gift Pack.

strings.talk.26982.text: Do you much about Chinese literature?

strings.talk.27006.text: Wow, you're pretty good! Here's some rewards!
strings.talk.27007.text: Wow, you're pretty good! Here's some rewards!
strings.talk.27008.text: #f1/#f Ha-ha, thanks a lot! (I might have gotten lucky on one or two...)
strings.talk.27011.text: We human's are pretty clever, huh?
strings.talk.27012.text: I'm now reading Three-Character Scripture. What's up?
strings.talk.27013.text: It's quite late, but my daughter hasn't come home yet! I'm worried about her?
strings.talk.27015.text: My daughter told me she went to pick some herbs in Cherry Forest. But she hasn't returned home yet and it's late! I heard that there are some wolves in that forest? I'm so worried?
strings.talk.27016.text: Can you help me find my daughter?
strings.talk.27017.text: Don't worry, I can help you to find her.
strings.talk.27018.text: Thanks so much. My daughter told me she went to #R#BCherry Forest/#R/#B.
strings.talk.27019.text: Thanks so much. My daughter told me she went to #R#BCherry Forest/#R/#B.
strings.talk.27020.text: Where's my daughter? She said she was going to #R#BCherry Forest/#R/#B.

strings.talk.27023.text: (Do you want to help the girl?)
strings.talk.27029.text: Your father is worried about you. You'd better get home now.
strings.talk.27032.text: What a pity. Some of your answers were wrong. Go back and try it again when you know the right answers.
strings.talk.27033.text: #f2/#fNo! So I have to see the horrible wolf tear the girl into pieces?
strings.talk.27034.text: Ok, I'll go back right now!
strings.talk.27035.text: Ah! ! ! So boring! ! ! Can I have something to do now?
strings.talk.27036.text: Hey! It seems you're pretty powerful, but are you boring?
strings.talk.27037.text: Hey! It seems you're pretty powerful, but are you boring?
strings.talk.27038.text: Do you want to fight me?
strings.talk.27039.text: Oh, nevermind! You can fight with me here when you've got some free time.
strings.talk.27042.text: Oh, I never would have suspected you'd be so weak?
strings.talk.27043.text: Oh, I never would have suspected you'd be so weak?
strings.talk.27044.text: You want to challenge me again?
strings.talk.27045.text: I'm so happy we had such a great fight! This is your reward.
strings.talk.27046.text: I'm so happy we had such a great fight! This is your reward.
strings.talk.27047.text: So, you want to PvP with me?
strings.talk.27048.text: Yes! Standing here and doing nothing is soooooo boring!
strings.talk.27049.text: WOW, I never thought I would see an elf here!
strings.talk.27050.text: I'm not just any common elf! I'm a chocolate elf! ! !
strings.talk.27052.text: Yes! ! ! I'm Cupid's envoy! Cupid asks me to personally deliver this chocolate. He said the world must be full of love!
strings.talk.27053.text: #f1/#f Really? That sounds great! I want some!
strings.talk.27054.text: Oh? But it's not so easy to get the chocolate of love! You have to pay for it!

strings.talk.27056.text: No, of course not. Gold is nothing to the Gods.
strings.talk.27057.text: If you can give me #R#BHonest Chocolate/#R/#B, #R#BFriendship Chocolate/#R/#B and #R#BYummy Chocolate/#R/#B, then you'll have earned Cupid's Fancy Chocolate.
strings.talk.27058.text: Collect #R#BHonest Chocolate/#R/#B, #R#BFriendship Chocolate/#R/#B and #R#BYummy Chocolate/#R/#B for you? That's easy! I'll get right on it!
strings.talk.27059.text: I've got #R#BHonest Chocolate/#R/#B, #R#BFriendship Chocolate/#R/#B and #R#BYummy Chocolate/#R/#B for you!
strings.talk.27060.text: Great, this is the Yummy Chocolate! Happy Valentine's Day!
strings.talk.27061.text: You don't have #R#BHonest Chocolate/#R/#B, #R#BFriendship Chocolate/#R/#B and #R#BYummy Chocolate/#R/#B. Come back when you've get them all.
strings.talk.27062.text: Do you want to exchange them for Yummy Chocolate?
strings.talk.27063.text: Ha, never mind. Come back here to make the exchange before #R#B11:59pm on February 23rd/#R/#B.

strings.talk.27065.text: Welcome to the #RTiger Cave/#R! I'd like to tell you about the rules.
strings.talk.27066.text: You must win at least #R30 battles and defeat 4 tigers/#R to earn a chance to challenge the Bloody Tiger. Also, you need to defeat the Bloody Tiger within #R45 minutes/#R!
strings.talk.27067.text: Want to challenge the Tigers? Haha! It's impossible! You'll be torn to shreds!
strings.talk.27068.text: Congratulations! You've defeated Bloody Tiger! This is your reward.
strings.talk.27069.text: You have to defeat my disciples before attacking me(wining #R30 battles in game/#R)
strings.talk.27070.text: You must think you're pretty amazing after defeating those 4 tigers. But they aren't even in the same league as me!
strings.talk.27071.text: I'm hoping that there's someone who will help me try out my new design!
strings.talk.27073.text: Ha-ha! You want to know what it is? If you can defeat me, you'll know...
strings.talk.27075.text: Q1: The Sky Lantern has another name. What is it?
strings.talk.27080.text: Q2: Who created the Sky Lantern?
strings.talk.27085.text: Q3: What was the original function of the Sky Lantern?
strings.talk.27090.text: Q4: What festival involves the release of the Sky Lantern?
strings.talk.27095.text: Amazing! Your answers are all correct! My new invention is yours!
strings.talk.27096.text: Amazing! Your answers are all correct! My new invention is yours!
strings.talk.27097.text: #f1/#f Oh, yeah! That's great! (This just confirms what I've always suspected ? I'm a genius! )
strings.talk.27098.text: Never mind, come back again when you've got some free time.
strings.talk.27099.text: You new invention is the lantern?
strings.talk.27100.text: Yes. You can send you best wishes to your friends with it.
strings.talk.27102.text: Because it's White Day! When love is in the air, I'll be there!
strings.talk.27103.text: I want to give you a special White Day suit this year!
strings.talk.27105.text: You thought I'd just hand it over? I may be a demigod, but I wasn't born yesterday. Before you get it, you've got to do a little something for me.
strings.talk.27106.text: Oh? You need some money? What does a demigod want money for?
strings.talk.27107.text: No! I don't want any money. Gold is less than nothing to the Gods.
strings.talk.27108.text: To get the suit, you need to give me #R3 White Day Vouchers/#R, which you'll find in the #RWhite Day Pack/#R.
strings.talk.27109.text: Give you #R3 White Day Vouchers/#R? That's it? Sweet!
strings.talk.27110.text: #f1/#f I've got the 3 White Day Vouchers.
strings.talk.27111.text: This is my special White Day Suit! I hope you have a good White Day!
strings.talk.27112.text: You haven't got the #R3 White Day Vouchers/#R yet. When you collect enough vouchers, come back and see me.
strings.talk.27113.text: Ha-ha, never mind. I won't be leaving until #R11:59pm on March 24th/#R.
strings.talk.27114.text: Collect #R3 White Day Vouchers/#R before #R11:59pm on March 24th/#R.
strings.talk.27115.text: You want to exchange #R3 White Day Vouchers/#R for the White Day Suit?
strings.talk.27116.text: Welcome! We have lots of brand new White Day items!
strings.talk.27119.text: Oh! I'm so tired! I'd better have a rest here.
strings.talk.27123.text: Oh, wow! Was it ever difficult to find you.
strings.talk.27124.text: Oh, wow! Was it ever difficult to find you.
strings.talk.27125.text: Do you have Stephen's other ring?
strings.talk.27126.text: Do you have Stephen's other ring?
strings.talk.27127.text: (Stephen's #Rring/#R? I don't have it with me.)
strings.talk.27128.text: (Why did the Kid steal that little ring?)
strings.talk.27129.text: Yes, I have the other ring, but why did you steal the little ring from Stephen?
strings.talk.27131.text: (I must keep the secret about the little ring! )
strings.talk.27133.text: Oh, don't be silly, kid. It's useless!
strings.talk.27134.text: So, how about the sleep bomb?
strings.talk.27136.text: Ha-ha. Put these 2 little rings together and then say the curse! We can open the door to Quatermain's Treasure!
strings.talk.27141.text: Where's the Kid? I heard something about Quatermain's Treasure before I went unconscious! So he might have entered the #RForbidden Place of Quatermain/#R
strings.talk.27142.text: Do you want to enter the Forbidden Place of Quatermain?
strings.talk.27145.text: WOW, the legendary treasure of Quatermain! I want to see it up close!
strings.talk.27146.text: I don't want to. There's probably some horrible monsters hiding there.
strings.talk.27147.text: What? This is the legendary treasure of Quatermain? No wonder its been lost for a thousand years, its just an illusion!
strings.talk.27149.text: Oh? You've come! Amazing! But it's too late, I've already got the treasure!
strings.talk.27150.text: Oh? You've come! Amazing! But it's too late, I've already got the treasure!
strings.talk.27151.text: I'm Eligor, Quatermain's loyal guardian! You must be trying to steal the treasure! You're so dead! ! !
strings.talk.27152.text: Oh, WOW! The army is real! ! !
strings.talk.27153.text: No, NO! I'm not trying to 'steal' your treasure, I found this place by accident!
strings.talk.27154.text: No, NO! I'm not trying to 'steal' your treasure, I found this place by accident!
strings.talk.27155.text: You want the treasure? You can have it all if you defeat me! ! !
strings.talk.27156.text: I don't quibble about details! Just come over here and take your beat down!
strings.talk.27157.text: Ha! You're so weak! You want the treasure? You're dreaming!
strings.talk.27158.text: You... you defeated me! I suppose I underestimated you. You can take the treasure. I've completed my mission?
strings.talk.27159.text: You... you defeated me! I suppose I underestimated you. You can take the treasure. I've completed my mission?
strings.talk.27160.text: Oh! That's great! The demon was defeated and is gone! Quatermain's Treasure is mine!
strings.talk.27161.text: Ok, since you defeated the demon, the treasure should be yours. I have to find another treasure!
strings.talk.27162.text: Ok, since you defeated the demon, the treasure should be yours. I have to find another treasure!
strings.talk.27163.text: #f1/#fHa-ha! It seems it's hard for the Kid to give up on finding mystic treasure.
strings.talk.27167.text: There's some magic power sealed in this box, I can't seem to open it?
strings.talk.27168.text: Hmm, seems there's nothing in it?
strings.talk.27169.text: Priest! Where are you going? I need to pray!
strings.talk.27170.text: You have no right to know where I'm going! ! !
strings.talk.27174.text: Can I ask you a question? What's wrong with the priest?
strings.talk.27176.text: 5 days ago, the Priest went somewhere and when he came back, he was like another person altogether! And boy, did he have a temper when he returned!
strings.talk.27177.text: Can you help me find out why?
strings.talk.27180.text: Don't worry, I'll help you find out what happened!
strings.talk.27182.text: Where is the Priest? I can't find him now!
strings.talk.27183.text: #n/#n, the Priest was heading off to the #RLost Jungle/#R.
strings.talk.27184.text: Eva, how do you know where the Priest is?
strings.talk.27185.text: Because he has a special smell?
strings.talk.27187.text: That's the smell of evil! Only one creature has that smell, demon's!
strings.talk.27189.text: So, the Priest was possessed by a demon?
strings.talk.27190.text: Yes, so we'd better go to the #RLost Jungle/#R right now and save the real Priest!
strings.talk.27192.text: Hahahahaha! A young lady is always the best choice?
strings.talk.27194.text: (Oh no, someone is coming, I'd better drive them away...)
strings.talk.27195.text: Hey, this isn't what it looks like! This girl was possessed by an evil spirit, and I'm helping her to drive it out!
strings.talk.27196.text: Really? Did you think I'd buy that? That's the worst excuse I've ever heard! I know you're the source of the evil! You've possessed the poor Priest's body!
strings.talk.27199.text: So you're a demon too? How else would you have known?
strings.talk.27201.text: Hahaha! You ever heard that saying 'If I tell you, I've got to kill you?' Well, I didn't tell you, but I'm still going to kill you!
strings.talk.27202.text: I don't think you can withstand the power of the strongest demon in Hell!
strings.talk.27204.text: Oh, no! I'm bleeding! ! ! I can't believe this! Defeated by some whipper snapper... I'm so ashamed!
strings.talk.27205.text: I thought I was better than you...
strings.talk.27206.text: Well, this time I'm not going to hold anything back! This time you'll have to contend with the full force of my deadly power! !
strings.talk.27207.text: There's no way you'll survive this! Hahahahaha! ! !
strings.talk.27208.text: Ah, sorry, I'm so sorry, I should never have possessed this Priest's body. Please, forgive me!
strings.talk.27209.text: I'll release you if you leave the Priest's body unharmed.
strings.talk.27210.text: Sure, but I have a small request?
strings.talk.27214.text: Will you go on a date with me! ! ! I think I'm falling for you! Just now, when you hit me with your tough fist... ohhh, it sent shivers down my spine!
strings.talk.27216.text: Er? I don't really like you?I... uh...
strings.talk.27217.text: Please, please give me a chance!
strings.talk.27218.text: Get away from me! ! ! You're one sick demon!
strings.talk.27220.text: Oh? What happened? Where am I?
strings.talk.27222.text: (I'd better not tell him about that perverted demon...)
strings.talk.27223.text: You were angy and rushed out, and the nun was worried about you. She asked me to follow you. When I came here, I found you and this girl had fainted!
strings.talk.27224.text: Oh, I'm not even sure about what happened, but I really want to go back now?
strings.talk.27226.text: Don't worry, I'll send her back home when she wakes up.
strings.talk.27230.text: Well, if I tell you, you promise not to laugh? My dream is to be a famous model, but as you can see, I'm not exactly model material!
strings.talk.27232.text: Yes, a famous model! That's my dream, but as you can see?
strings.talk.27233.text: I heard that the Props Shopkeeper in Kyoto is selling a Magic Slimming Drug, maybe I can use it to lose some weight! Can you help me to buy it?
strings.talk.27235.text: You're such a great person! You can buy it from the #RProps Shopkeeper in Kyoto/#R
strings.talk.27236.text: I'm not willing to do it.

strings.talk.27283.text: Don't be late, we'll only keep the suit for you until #R11:59pm on August 29th/#R! If you want it, you'd better get here before time's up!
strings.talk.27284.text: You haven't collected #RSummer Voucher A/#R, #RSummer Voucher B/#R and #RSummer Voucher C/#R. Come back when you've collected them all.
strings.talk.27285.text: Do you want to exchange vouchers for the Special Summer Suit?
strings.talk.27286.text: Oh, never mind! I won't be leaving until #R11:59pm on August 29th/#R
strings.talk.27287.text: If you still have #RSummer Voucher A/#R, #RSummer Voucher B/#R and #RSummer Voucher C/#R, please remember to exchange them for a suit before #R11:59pm on August 29th/#R.
strings.talk.27288.text: Aren't you Maudgalya? Why are you here?

strings.talk.27292.text: #f3/#fWow, so what can you do about it? Can I help?

strings.talk.27298.text: Before #R11:59pm on August 24th/#R, you can come here to exchange #R2 Magic Fruit/#R for a gift!

strings.talk.27319.text: If you still have #R2 or more Sweet Crystals/#R, don't forget to exchange them for a gift before #R11:59pm on August 29th/#R.

strings.talk.27354.text: I'll be punished if I don't have enough snacks!

strings.talk.27357.text: Okay, I'll collect #R#BBraised Devilfish/#R/#B, #R#BApple Sugar/#R/#B and #R#BSpun Sugar/#R/#B for you. Don't worry.
strings.talk.27359.text: Thanks so much! I can return in time! Here is your reward.
strings.talk.27360.text: If you have #R#BBraised Devilfish/#R/#B, #R#BApple Sugar/#R/#B and #R#BSpun Sugar/#R/#B, can you give them to me? If you have some #R#BJoyous Cards/#R/#B, you can even exchange them with me for a gift!
strings.talk.27361.text: You haven't collected all of these 3 snacks: #R#BBraised Devilfish/#R/#B, #R#BApple Sugar/#R/#B and #R#BSpun Sugar/#R/#B. Come meet me here when you have collected all of them.

strings.talk.27372.text: Congratulations! You've set Chang'er free! Pick up your reward from #RChang'er/#R.
strings.talk.27373.text: Good luck! If you win, you'll receive a reward from Chang'er.
strings.talk.27374.text: Challenge my disciples first before winning #R30 battles/#R.
strings.talk.27378.text: It's amazing you were able to defeat all those disciples! But I'm not as weak as they are.

strings.talk.27381.text: So she asked me to catch another rabbit!
strings.talk.27383.text: But I don't know where I can find a male #Rrabbit/#R on #RNorth Island/#R!
strings.talk.27384.text: Do you want me to help catch a #Rrabbit/#R?
strings.talk.27386.text: So nobody wants to help me?
strings.talk.27389.text: #f1/#f(Wow, this bunny is so so so cute! ! ! )
strings.talk.27390.text: So it's impossible to complete the building before Mid-Autumn day?
strings.talk.27391.text: Thanks so much, but I want to check out the materials!
strings.talk.27392.text: Great, this is a male rabbit!
strings.talk.27395.text: Thanks for helping me get this cute bunny. My jade rabbit won't be lonely any more!
strings.talk.27396.text: If you still have #R2 or more Magic Fruit/#R, don't forget to exchange them for a gift before #R11:59pm on August 24th/#R.
strings.talk.27398.text: Thanks so much, this is your reward.
