strings.talk.27401.text: I'm collecting some materials for Chang'er, because she wants to build a palace! But we don't have a lot of time, so she hopes we'll finish before Mid-Autumn Day.
strings.talk.27402.text: Can you help me to collect some materials?

strings.talk.27407.text: #f1/#fI've collected all the materials you wanted!
strings.talk.27408.text: Good job! Thanks for helping me! This is your reward.

strings.talk.27418.text: I'm going to smash this seal soon!

strings.talk.27420.text: But I'm not nearly as weak and pathetic as they are!
strings.talk.27421.text: No! ! ! ! ! ! I don't want to be sealed inside again!
strings.talk.27422.text: Thanks so much, this is your reward.
strings.talk.27423.text: You must defeat my disciples before you earn the privilege of attacking me!

strings.talk.27426.text: Oh, Happy Thanksgiving! Can you help me to get the #R#BTurkey and Pumpkin Pie/#R/#B? If you give me them I'll give you a gift as reward.
strings.talk.27428.text: Find me some #R#B2013 Big Turkey and 2013 Pumpkin Pie/#R/#B before 7th December and I'll give you something good in return!

strings.talk.27493.text: Do you want to use a #R#B4 2011 Xmas Snowball/#R/#B to exchange for a 2011 Xmas Gift Box?
strings.talk.27494.text: Candied Gourds! Anyone want Candied Gourds? Sweet Candied Gourds! ! !
strings.talk.27496.text: Do you want a Candied Gourd? They're so delicious! Everyone knows that! In fact, I'll let you in on a little secret... my Candied Gourd is the best!
strings.talk.27502.text: Well, you could focus on the price, or you could focus on the high quality, all natural ingredients I use on all my Candied Gourds! There's no doubt in my mind that my gourds are the best!
strings.talk.27503.text: So do you want to buy a Candied Gourd?
strings.talk.27505.text: No way! I'm not spending that much on a gourd!
strings.talk.27506.text: Oh, what a pity. My Candied Gourds are legendary!
strings.talk.27510.text: #f1/#f(Ha-ha, she wants it? but why doesn't she just admit it?)
strings.talk.27512.text: Oh? You don't want it? But I paid so much for it! I guess I'll eat it then! Mmmmmm!
strings.talk.27513.text: Hey! Wait! I'll have a try. Give it to me!
strings.talk.27515.text: Hm? this Candied Gourd is so good, it reminds me of when I was a child. My father always bought Candied Gourds for me? (Crying)
strings.talk.27517.text: No, of course not! Something got in my eyes while I was thinking about my dead pet dog...
strings.talk.27519.text: Why are you staring at me? We'd better get going!
strings.talk.27520.text: (So Victoria remembered the Candied Gourd her father bought for her...)
strings.talk.27523.text: What? You lost the Candied Gourd?
strings.talk.27524.text: Ok, I'll give you another one. Don't lose it!
strings.talk.27525.text: I have 3 special bells that mean a lot to me, the 2013 Wish Bell, 2013 Safety Bell and 2013 Christmas Bell. I must have dropped them on my way here. Could you help me find it?
strings.talk.27526.text: Have you found my bells yet? I'll repeat, it's the 2013 Wish Bell, 2013 Safety Bell and 2013 Christmas Bell.
strings.talk.27528.text: I am not a normal elf, I am the great Chocolate Elf .

strings.talk.27539.text: You don't have #R#BVerity Choco/#R/#B, #R#BBuddy Choco/#R/#B and #R#BMelty Choco/#R/#B. Come back when you've collected all.
strings.talk.27540.text: Do you want to exchange them for Fancy Choco of 2010?
strings.talk.27541.text: Ha-ha! ! It's okay, come back when you do, I will be here till #R#B11: 59pm on March 1st./#R/#B.
strings.talk.27542.text: You've collected #R#BVerity Choco/#R/#B, #R#BBuddy Choco/#R/#B and #R#BMelty Choco/#R/#B. Come here to make the exchange before #R#B11: 59pm on March 1st/#R/#B.
strings.talk.27543.text: Tell the boss, We've finally caught Zhenghe and his men.
strings.talk.27544.text: Great, we will feed them to the sharks once we reach the Ming Dynasty Naval Vault.
strings.talk.27545.text: To think that the Ming Dynasty Navy would hide the gold in the Beast Island.
strings.talk.27546.text: Boss, will Victoria and the man who obstructed us previously try to to hinder us again?
strings.talk.27547.text: No worries, it is not that easy to reach here, you must have #REast King Certification/#R for a guaranteed entry.
strings.talk.27548.text: If they come, I'll have my revenge.

strings.talk.27552.text: Father is captured by the Pirates, I must save him.
strings.talk.27553.text: Victoria, calm down, do you know Ming Dynasty Naval Vault?
strings.talk.27554.text: Even if I don't, I need to save Father.
strings.talk.27555.text: Calm down, the East King Certification that the Pirate talked about, was given to me as a gift when I fought the pirates alongside your Father.
strings.talk.27556.text: That's great! Now I can enter Ming Dynasty Naval Vault to save Father.
strings.talk.27557.text: It'should be us, instead of just you.
strings.talk.27558.text: The person I respect the most is Master Zheng, we must save him at all cost.
strings.talk.27561.text: I've even suspected you were the mastermind behind my Father's disappearance, I am really sorry.
strings.talk.27563.text: Yes, but where is the Beast Island they spoke of?
strings.talk.27566.text: My instinct tells me Beast Island is #RCentaur Island/#R.
strings.talk.27568.text: This is weird, a group of humans entered the house to the #Rleft/#R and never ever came out.
strings.talk.27569.text: That'should be the entrance of Ming Dynasty Naval Vault.
strings.talk.27570.text: It says, "The East King Certification will show you the right path. "
strings.talk.27571.text: Hahaha, we've finally reached, we do not need you anymore.
strings.talk.27572.text: Brothers, feed Zhenghe to the sharks.
strings.talk.27576.text: How did you get in without the East King Certification?
strings.talk.27577.text: The East King Certification you spoke of had been given to me a long time ago by Master Zheng.
strings.talk.27578.text: You runts have hindered me not once but twice.
strings.talk.27579.text: Brothers, drink the potion I gave out at South Ocean.
strings.talk.27581.text: I will not let you off alive this time.
strings.talk.27582.text: Hahaha, you wont be able to stop me this time.
strings.talk.27585.text: I am fine, you have grown stronger and wiser after travelling with #n/#n, but your bad temper hasn't changed after all.
strings.talk.27587.text: #f1/#f Hohoho. (Victoria as gentle as a princess in front of Master Zheng)
strings.talk.27588.text: Darn! I will perish with you.
strings.talk.27590.text: Let this little girl perish with me in the place of you two.
strings.talk.27592.text: #f2/#f Victoria, wake up, open your eyes.
strings.talk.27593.text: Victoria, wake up, talk to Father.
strings.talk.27595.text: G... great, you are all fine.
strings.talk.27596.text: Victoria, hang in there, I will have the doctor tend to you.
strings.talk.27597.text: Father, forgive me... I can't stay by your side anymore...
strings.talk.27598.text: #n/#n, I wish we could travel together again.
strings.talk.27600.text: #f3/#f Victoria! There are still places I want to bring you around! Stay awake! Do not close your eyes...
strings.talk.27601.text: I... I really want to have some Candied Gourds right now...
strings.talk.27603.text: Do not be upset any longer, #n/#n, Victoria wouldn't want to see you this way.
strings.talk.27605.text: #f3/#f(To think I am being comforted by Master Zheng when he should be feeling worse than me.)
strings.talk.27606.text: #f3/#f(Even though Victoria will not be by my side in my future travels, I must stay strong.)
strings.talk.27610.text: These pirates are tough... I must be prepared.
strings.talk.27613.text: I've brought you here as promised. Please keep yours and release my men.

strings.talk.27615.text: Ha! I'm notorious for breaking my promises!
strings.talk.27616.text: Throw Zhenghe and his men to the sharks now!
strings.talk.27617.text: #R Victoria will leave team permanently/#R, are you sure?
strings.talk.27619.text: I'm not willing to do it.
strings.talk.27620.text: These pirates are tough... I must be prepared.
strings.talk.27621.text: Leave here if you have no business.
strings.talk.27622.text: These gold belongs to the Navy, do not touch.
strings.talk.27623.text: Orders have been given. All must die.
strings.talk.27625.text: I know what you are going to say. We will not make any show of sadness... Victoria wouldn't like to see our sad faces.
strings.talk.27626.text: I know what you are going to say. We will not make any show of sadness... Victoria wouldn't like to see our sad faces.
strings.talk.27628.text: The door seemed to be locked.
strings.talk.27632.text: I... I've always suspected you were the mastermind behind my father's disappearance, I am sorry.

strings.talk.28026.text: #f1/#f I feel much better now, thank you Angela.
strings.talk.28027.text: Pay no attention to it. Dispelling barriers are just one of the basic skills of an angel.
strings.talk.28028.text: Let's find Antruz quickly and retrieve the Heaven's Trove.
strings.talk.28029.text: That's right, Antruz must be found immediately.
strings.talk.28030.text: Hand me the Heaven's Trove, Antruz!
strings.talk.28032.text: Quit dreaming of me handing over the Heaven's Trove!
strings.talk.28034.text: Darn, he lives up to his reputation as the 8th Fallen Angel!
strings.talk.28035.text: I'll have to become stronger in order to defeat Antruz.
strings.talk.28036.text: Just hand us the Heaven's Trove!
strings.talk.28037.text: Heaven's Trove is no longer in my possesion!
strings.talk.28038.text: But neither will you get to know about its whereabouts!
strings.talk.28039.text: In that case, we will catch you and you will be imprisoned and judged!
strings.talk.28041.text: This is impossible! How did you attain the powers of imprisoning me! !
strings.talk.28042.text: Angela is the successor of the Bright Shield, no evil shall escape her!
strings.talk.28044.text: (Is this the true power of the Bright Shield as foretold by the Elven Elder?)
strings.talk.28045.text: My heartfelt thanks to Angela and Saviour #n/#n for imprisoning Antruz
strings.talk.28046.text: With regards to the whereabouts of Heaven's Trove, Archangel Michael will look into it. I have to drag that evil Antruz back for his ultimate judgment.
strings.talk.28047.text: Antruz could not have escaped with his own ability out of the sealed prison cell. There must be an insider helping him out.
strings.talk.28048.text: Your observational skills are truly impressive, Angela. Indeed, it is the King Howert who aided me in my escape.
strings.talk.28050.text: With my new found freedom, I must destroy Angelic Realm, that both I and King Howert hates the most.
strings.talk.28051.text: You may have foiled our plans, but one day the King Howert will destroy the entire Angelic Realm! !
strings.talk.28052.text: #f2/#fThis will not happen for as long as I live! I will kill King Howert first!
strings.talk.28053.text: The King Howert has extended his influence up to Angelic Realm, we must eliminate him.
strings.talk.28056.text: #f3/#f If you used the power of the Bright Shield to imprison Antruz, wouldn't that mean you would be leaving me soon?
strings.talk.28057.text: Ha-ha... The power imprisoning Antruz is not the power of the Bright Shield.
strings.talk.28058.text: The power of the Bright Shield is sacred, its purpose must not be abused.
strings.talk.28059.text: We won't leave before the King Howert falls.
strings.talk.28060.text: #f1/#f This is great news to behold!
strings.talk.28061.text: Let's head towards #Rspirit Forbidden Grounds/#R to search for Antruz.
strings.talk.28062.text: This is from Archangel Michael, please accept this.
strings.talk.28064.text: Yes, we have to eliminate King Howert as soon as possible.
strings.talk.28065.text: Let's continue to look for King Howert.
strings.talk.28068.text: This little girl has wings of an angel on her back, could she be from the same tribe as #RAngela/#R?
strings.talk.28070.text: Do you wish to exchange #R#B4 2011 Christmas Snow Balls #R#Bfor a 2011 Christmas gift?
strings.talk.28071.text: Only #R#B4 2011 Christmas Snow Balls #R#Bare needed to exchange for a 2011 Christmas gift.
strings.talk.28072.text: Merry Christmas! Where are the well-behaved kids this year?
strings.talk.28073.text: Hohoho! Have you been naughty or nice?
strings.talk.28074.text: You can bring them for exchange anytime before December 28th of 2011!
strings.talk.28075.text: Hoho! Bring me 10 Christmas socks and you will be able to receive a Christmas present!
strings.talk.28076.text: Thank goodness, you guys made it to #RChristmas Meadows/#R!
strings.talk.28077.text: Becks and his minions have captured Santa Claus. Their devious plan of depriving the children from their Christmas gifts must not succeed. Please defeat Becks and his underlings/#R.
strings.talk.28078.text: Players have to win #R15 battles/#R, then defeat Becks' #R3 minions/#R, before Becks himself will appear. Defeat Becks within 30 minutes to complete the instance.
strings.talk.28079.text: The children will not be able to receive any gifts this Christmas.
strings.talk.28080.text: Muahaha! The disappointment on the kids' faces from not getting Christmas gifts brings me fun and joy!
strings.talk.28081.text: You actually defeated my underlings... I'm impressed.
strings.talk.28082.text: Darn, I cannot believe how easily I was defeated...
strings.talk.28083.text: You have not won #R15 battles/#R. Accumulate more victories first.
strings.talk.28084.text: Please accept this reward as gratitude for defeating Becks and his minions
strings.talk.28085.text: You may have defeated me, but Master Becks will not be this easy.
strings.talk.28086.text: You have yet to defeat my #Runderlings! Challenge and defeat them first.
strings.talk.28087.text: Open the prison gates behind Becks after defeating him. You will be able to rescue Santa Claus and also get to receive some gifts as rewards!
strings.talk.28089.text: The Deity Dragon?King has led his?minions into this world. Will you be able to stand against him?? Fight the #RDeity Dragon King and his minions!/#R
strings.talk.28090.text: In order to complete the instance, the?player must complete #R20 levels/#R and defeat the Deity Dragon King's #RFour Dragon Lords/#R?before defeating the Deity Dragon King within #R30 minutes/#R. ?
strings.talk.28091.text: You dare to challenge his Holiness? Do not disappoint me!
strings.talk.28092.text: His Holiness?has defeated countless foes before you, so make sure you're in top form for the battle!
strings.talk.28093.text: So you have defeated the four Dragon Lords under me. Not bad, not bad at all.
strings.talk.28094.text: You are powerful indeed. I believe his Holiness will be most pleased to meet you.
strings.talk.28095.text: You have not yet completed #R20/#R levels. Please complete more levels first.
strings.talk.28096.text: Your abilities are impressive. Given how you have surmounted my challenge, I hereby reward you with a gift.
strings.talk.28097.text: The challengers have surpassed our expectations, but they'll face a hard battle against His Holiness!
strings.talk.28098.text: You wish to challenge me without getting past my #RFour Dragon Lords/#R? Defeat them first!
strings.talk.28099.text: Thank goodness! We've finally arrived at the #RChang'an Frontier/#R!
strings.talk.28100.text: The Warlord Lu is leading his men to revolt and destroy the empire, please help your Emperor defeat #RLu and his army!/#R
strings.talk.28101.text: We must complete #R20 levels/#R and then defeat??Lu's #RFour Generals/#R in order to attack? Lu himself! We must defeat Lu within #R30 minutes/#R to complete the instance.
strings.talk.28102.text: The Lu are about to fall, and soon?the?Lu?clan?shall rule!
strings.talk.28103.text: Ha ha ha! It won't be long before I behold Lu's despair!
strings.talk.28104.text: You have defeated my Four Generals. Impressive!
strings.talk.28105.text: Darn, I cannot believe how easily I was defeated...
strings.talk.28106.text: You have not completed #R20 levels/#R yet. Come back to me when you have done so.
strings.talk.28107.text: Though you have defeated me, his Lordship Lu?is mightier still.
strings.talk.28108.text: You have yet to defeat my #Runderlings! Challenge and defeat them first.
strings.talk.28109.text: You have quelled the?Lu Rebellion on the 15th day of the New Year. As the Emperor, I welcome this age of joy and peace with my people!
strings.talk.28110.text: (The tradition of celebrating the 15th Day... Is this how it all began?)
strings.talk.28111.text: The Empire thanks you for defeating Lu and his Army. This is your reward.
strings.talk.28112.text: You've finally arrived at the #RRoman Dungeon/#R!
strings.talk.28113.text: Claudius has captured and imprisoned St Valentine, and now all of Rome's lovers are unable to marry! Please defeat #RClaudius and his minions/#R!
strings.talk.28114.text: The player must complete #R20 levels/#R and then defeat Claudius' #RPraetorian Four/#R before taking on Claudius. Claudius must be defeated within #R30 minutes/#R in order to complete the instance.
strings.talk.28115.text: Harumph! A Roman soldier has no need for love!
strings.talk.28116.text: Love is fatal for a soldier! ?It is by?forbidding marriage in Rome that Emperor Claudius has built our might!
strings.talk.28117.text: You have defeated my Praetorian Four. You are strong indeed!
strings.talk.28118.text: Bedamned! I have?been defeated by the likes of you! (Alas, am I no match for the power of love?)
strings.talk.28119.text: You have yet to pass #R20 levels/#R. Complete them before you challenge me!
strings.talk.28120.text: Thanks for defeating Claudius and his underlings. Here is your Valentine's Day present.
strings.talk.28121.text: Though you have defeated me, his Majesty is mightier still!
strings.talk.28122.text: If you have not even defeated my #Rsubordinates/#R, do not think you can defeat me! Challenge them first!
strings.talk.28123.text: Once Claudius is defeated, open the dungeon door behind him and rescue St Valentine. You can then obtain a substantial amount of Valentine's Day gifts as rewards.
strings.talk.28124.text: Upon defeating the Deity Dragon King, His Holiness will offer you rewards.
strings.talk.28125.text: Curses! I was this close to?conquering all of Lew's empire!
strings.talk.28126.text: You know, there's a very scary monster in the #RSecret Chamber/#R within the hidden passages of the ruined statue!
strings.talk.28128.text: We saw it when my brother and I snuck in previously. The monster seems to be guarding a treasure chest.
strings.talk.28129.text: I don't think Aston would go there. It is not a place for cowards.
strings.talk.28131.text: Act... actually I've fought scarier monsters, and I won!
strings.talk.28132.text: So you're a tough guy, eh? Then why not get the treasure in that chest for us? That way you won't be a coward anymore. You up for it?
strings.talk.28133.text: G... great. Wait for me here. I'll get the treasure back, you'll see!
strings.talk.28134.text: (That Aston kid appears to be lying. Follow and keep an eye on him for his safety.)
strings.talk.28135.text: Brat, are you trying to steal my treasure?
strings.talk.28136.text: N... No, but I would like to borrow it for a second. May I?
strings.talk.28137.text: Only by paying with your life!
strings.talk.28138.text: S... Save me! I promise I will never lie again! Please save me!
strings.talk.28139.text: #f1/#fI've come to save you, but you must never forget your promise!
strings.talk.28140.text: #f2/#fDarn, I'm not skilled enough to defeat it!
strings.talk.28141.text: Great! I have the treasure now and they can't call me a coward anymore!
strings.talk.28142.text: #f3/#fHope he keeps his promise to stop lying.
strings.talk.28143.text: Come take a look at this, everyone!
strings.talk.28144.text: You actually defeated the monster and brought back the treasure!
strings.talk.28146.text: I... I'll be honest with you. That guy was the one who defeated the monster, not me.
strings.talk.28147.text: I... I'll be honest with you. That lady was the one who defeated the monster, not me.
strings.talk.28148.text: I lied only because I was afraid you'd turn your backs on me if I admitted to being a coward.
strings.talk.28149.text: We're still your friends, even if you are a coward.
strings.talk.28150.text: I say, fate brought us together as friends.
strings.talk.28151.text: Lies would have broken our friendship!
strings.talk.28152.text: #f1/#fThat's right, you should be honest with your friends. Lying is wrong!
strings.talk.28153.text: Thank you, sir! This is for you.
strings.talk.28154.text: Thank you, lady! This is for you.
strings.talk.28156.text: That coward would never dare enter the #RSecret Chamber/#R. He's just boasting.
strings.talk.28157.text: Aston's scared. He won't step into the #RSecret Chamber/#R. I bet he'll come back with an excuse.
strings.talk.28158.text: Hope Aston's not in any danger.
strings.talk.28162.text: Of course! We'll be best friends forever!
strings.talk.28163.text: Don't even think of stealing my treasure!
strings.talk.28164.text: Wow! Such a cute little puppy!
strings.talk.28165.text: Why is it barking? Is it hungry?
strings.talk.28166.text: Be careful, Eva. The puppy might bite.
strings.talk.28167.text: No way! Puppies don't bite people.
strings.talk.28169.text: The puppy's gone. We better hurry too, Eva.
strings.talk.28172.text: I... I'm sorry, I'm not Eva. I'm Wendy, a ghost.
strings.talk.28175.text: I'm not joking. I am currently possessing this little girl's body.
strings.talk.28176.text: (A... a ghost possessing a demon? Such scenarios exist only in comics! But now it's happening right in front of my eyes! )
strings.talk.28177.text: Alright, Miss Wendy, how did you possess Eva's body?
strings.talk.28178.text: I had a date with my boyfriend today. On the way, I was chased by a dog and as I fled, I bumped into her.
strings.talk.28179.text: Now that the dog is gone, shouldn't you leave Eva's body?
strings.talk.28180.text: There is an immense power within her body holding onto me, and I can't leave.
strings.talk.28182.text: There is a #Rchurch/#R upfront. Maybe we should consult the priest. He might have an idea.
strings.talk.28183.text: Father, we have a problem but...
strings.talk.28184.text: No matter what sin you have committed, god will forgive you. Just be honest.
strings.talk.28186.text: The girl beside me has been possessed by a ghost. I hope you can help.
strings.talk.28187.text: Why does she have the wings and tail of a demon? Is she a demon?
strings.talk.28188.text: G... good puppy, don't come any closer.
strings.talk.28189.text: (Oh no! I can't let anyone know that Eva is a demon. There'd be chaos! )
strings.talk.28190.text: #F1/#FShe's cosplaying as a little demon. But then she got possessed.
strings.talk.28191.text: So she was possessed while cosplaying. I thought she was a demon possessed by a ghost.
strings.talk.28192.text: All right, I shall drive the ghost out of her body.
strings.talk.28193.text: In the name of god, I command this ghost to leave the girl!
strings.talk.28194.text: There is an immense power within her that is withholding the ghost. I am unable to separate them.
strings.talk.28197.text: Ah! You've left Eva's body, Wendy!
strings.talk.28198.text: Wow, I've left her body indeed!
strings.talk.28199.text: Thank you very much! I'm going for my date now! Here, take this! Bye!
strings.talk.28200.text: Humph! I won't talk to you anymore! (Pouts)
strings.talk.28201.text: #F1/#FNo problem! Just be careful in the future.
strings.talk.28202.text: What am I doing in the church? Where's that puppy?
strings.talk.28203.text: You have no idea what happened, do you?
strings.talk.28204.text: No. Tell me, did I miss anything fun?
strings.talk.28206.text: Meanie, you never tell me anything!
strings.talk.28207.text: #F1/#F(Well, this is interesting. I never thought that demons could be possessed too.)
strings.talk.28208.text: I'm so sorry. I will leave this girl right away.
strings.talk.28210.text: Alright, let's go to the #Rchurch ahead/#R.
strings.talk.28214.text: Welcome to the Royal City of Cornwall, sir Knight #n/#n.
strings.talk.28215.text: (Something seems to be bothering King Arthur)
strings.talk.28216.text: King Arthur, you look pale. Has something gone wrong?
strings.talk.28218.text: Sir Lancelot should have returned days ago? But there's no news of him at all.
strings.talk.28219.text: Something might have happened to Sir Lancelot. Either that, or he's turned his back against us...
strings.talk.28220.text: No, I believe Sir Lancelot will return to us safely. He will be back.
strings.talk.28221.text: (It's just like what's written in the book. There's a lot of trust between King Arthur and Sir Lancelot.)
strings.talk.28222.text: King Arthur, may I know where you sent Sir Lancelot?
strings.talk.28224.text: I would like to go look for Sir Lancelot.
strings.talk.28225.text: I see. Then proceed to Cairo and look for Sir Lancelot, Knight #n/#n.
strings.talk.28226.text: Thank you, King Arthur. I will leave for #RCairo/#R immediately.
strings.talk.28227.text: Excuse me, have you seen any outsiders?
strings.talk.28230.text: Well, here's one standing right before me.
strings.talk.28232.text: Have you seen any outsiders besides me?
strings.talk.28233.text: I did, but that was a couple of days ago.
strings.talk.28234.text: Do you know where he was headed?
strings.talk.28237.text: He was actually sailing northwest, but after a while, he started to sail south instead.
strings.talk.28238.text: Sudden change of direction to the South.
strings.talk.28240.text: (Did Sir Lancelot go to the #RAfrican Village/#R in the south?)
strings.talk.28241.text: I saw the cannibals capturing a blonde man. He put up a good fight though.
strings.talk.28242.text: I guess if he weren't heavily injured, they wouldn't have been able to capture him.
strings.talk.28243.text: Anyone caught by the cannibals gets eaten.
strings.talk.28244.text: Where did you see the blonde man?
strings.talk.28245.text: Over there on the #RAfrican Plain/#R. The cannibals are scary.
strings.talk.28246.text: (I must save Sir Lancelot from the cannibals.)
strings.talk.28247.text: Heheheh, this blonde man is well muscled. His meat must be delicious!
strings.talk.28248.text: Stop talking and move. I'm starving.
strings.talk.28249.text: Do you not feel ashamed of yourselves for capturing an injured man?
strings.talk.28250.text: Ha! What is shame? Something you can fill your stomach with?
strings.talk.28251.text: Is it my fate to die in this wild land?
strings.talk.28252.text: You will not die in such a place, Sir Lancelot.
strings.talk.28254.text: How dare you steal our food? We shall devour you as well.
strings.talk.28255.text: This guy is too strong for us! Run!
strings.talk.28256.text: Are you all right, Sir Lancelot?
strings.talk.28257.text: I am fine, but why are you here, Knight #n/#n?
strings.talk.28258.text: When you failed to return, I requested King Arthur?s permission to go looking for you. News of you led me here.
strings.talk.28259.text: I was on schedule and would have returned on time, but a storm led us astray and stranded us on this strange land.
strings.talk.28260.text: I was heavily injured when I was thrown ashore, and became easy prey for the cannibals. I am embarrassed that you've found me in this state.
strings.talk.28261.text: Do not worry, Sir Lancelot. You are heavily wounded. Allow me to escort you back to the castle.
strings.talk.28263.text: But these wounds are not fatal. I can return to the city on my own. There is no need to trouble you, Knight #n/#n.
strings.talk.28264.text: You are indeed worthy of your reputation, Sir Lancelot.
strings.talk.28265.text: Before I go, please accept this token of appreciation, Knight #n/#n.
strings.talk.28266.text: #F2/#FThe cannibals are tough. I must become stronger in order to defeat them.
strings.talk.28267.text: I wonder what this pot is for...
strings.talk.28268.text: #F1/#FIt has been a while, Altair. What are you doing here? Shouldn't you be meeting Vega at the Magpie bridge?
strings.talk.28269.text: I am doomed. If Vega finds out about this, she'll break up with me for sure.
strings.talk.28271.text: I lost the #RMemento Necklace/#R Vega gave me.
strings.talk.28272.text: #F2/#FThat is so careless of you. Quick, go look for it!
strings.talk.28275.text: The Match Maker has taken it. He will only give it back if I answer his questions correctly.
strings.talk.28276.text: The Match Maker's questions however, are too profound. I don't stand a chance at all.
strings.talk.28277.text: If that be the case, let me help you. What say you?
strings.talk.28278.text: That's great! My destiny rests in your hands.
strings.talk.28280.text: Greetings, Match Maker. I will answer your questions in the Altair's place.
strings.talk.28281.text: If the Altair doesn't have the answers, find someone else who does.
strings.talk.28282.text: So are you ready for my questions?
strings.talk.28284.text: Sorry, I am not ready yet.
strings.talk.28286.text: Question 1: Far from home on Qixi Festival, the inn deepens my sorrow. What is the next line?
strings.talk.28287.text: No weaver to be seen, only homesick longing*
strings.talk.28288.text: Silent jade pendants beneath dim lanterns
strings.talk.28289.text: The ferry maiden watches the distant clouds all night
strings.talk.28290.text: The luan stops dancing, the phoenix flies alone
strings.talk.28291.text: Question 2: A faint moon hangs in autumn sky, Silver River's meeting lasts forever. What is the next line?
strings.talk.28292.text: Palace night grows darker as fireflies drift by
strings.talk.28293.text: Night is cool, watching Cowherd and Weaver Girl stars
strings.talk.28294.text: Love flows like water, reunion fades like a dream
strings.talk.28295.text: Joy and sorrow return together every year on this night*
strings.talk.28296.text: Question 3: Cowherd stands west of the river, the Weaver Girl east of it. What is the next line?
strings.talk.28297.text: Bright moon, green mountains, white autumn dew
strings.talk.28299.text: Golden mirrors divide heaven, jade hooks shine below
strings.talk.28300.text: The fairy maiden meets yearly by the water
strings.talk.28301.text: Question 4: Who wrote Qixi in a Foreign Land?
strings.talk.28306.text: Question 5: Who wrote Cowherd and Weaver Girl? (Altair and Vega)
strings.talk.28311.text: Question 6: Who wrote poem of Qixi Festival in the Mountains?
strings.talk.28316.text: Perfectly answered! You may now pass this #RMemento Necklace/#R to the Altair.
strings.talk.28318.text: Brother Altair, is this the #RMemento Necklace/#R you spoke of?
strings.talk.28319.text: Indeed! This is the Memento Necklace bestowed to me by Vega herself. Bless you! Please take this little gift as a token of my appreciation.
strings.talk.28320.text: I need to rush off to meet Vega at the bridge. Let's have a hearty chat the next time we meet.
strings.talk.28321.text: #swav1517/#sMoo... (That Altair! He always forgets all about me. Next time I shall spend Valentine with my little cow sister and forget about him)
strings.talk.28322.text: #F1/#FPoor Mr Buffalo, Brother Altair has forgotten about him again.
strings.talk.28324.text: All of you believe you have extraordinary powers, but I don't think you have what it takes to defeat the #RVampire Monarch/#R and his minions. Listen up. I shall explain the rules now.
strings.talk.28325.text: You must complete #R20 levels/#R and then defeat the Vampire Monarch's #R4 minions/#R, before attacking the Vampire Monarch himself. Defeat the Vampire Monarch within 40 minutes to complete the instance.
strings.talk.28326.text: Fools, you really think you can defeat me?
strings.talk.28327.text: These imbeciles intend to defeat us. What a joke!
strings.talk.28328.text: You must be pretty skilled to overcome my minions.
strings.talk.28329.text: Darn, I cannot believe how easily I was defeated...
strings.talk.28330.text: You have not completed #R20 levels/#R yet. Come back to me when you have done so.
strings.talk.28331.text: You may have defeated me, but the Vampire Monarch will not go down so easily.
strings.talk.28332.text: Don't even dream of challenging me when you haven't even defeated my #Rminions/#R! Come back after you have defeated them.
strings.talk.28334.text: Argh! I was this close to escaping from this accursed place.
strings.talk.28335.text: You've defeated the Vampire Monarch? Your skills exceed my expectations. Take this as a gift.
strings.talk.28336.text: Please pass this to the Altair.
strings.talk.28337.text: Didn't the Match Maker pass the #RMemento Necklace/#R to you?
strings.talk.28338.text: Sir, you wouldn't believe who I saw the last time I went out on an errand.
strings.talk.28341.text: You sure you didn't have a drop too much?
strings.talk.28345.text: In a #RCave near Cornwall Plain/#R. Why do you ask?
strings.talk.28346.text: I have found him at last. The time for my revenge is nigh.
strings.talk.28347.text: There's something unnatural about this cave. Probably not a good idea to step inside...
strings.talk.28348.text: Louis, what revenge are you talking about?
strings.talk.28349.text: I've been after Dogna for ages. It's my goal to capture him.
strings.talk.28353.text: I became a professional bounty hunter ten years ago and was awarded the highest rank. I selected Dogna as my very first target. My girlfriend Lily and I set off together in search of him.
strings.talk.28354.text: (What was Louis thinking? Picking an A-list criminal for his first assignment, and worse, bringing his girlfriend along! )
strings.talk.28355.text: Back then, I thought Dogna would be an easy target. Little did I know that my pride would land us in Dogna's hands.
strings.talk.28356.text: When I was about to get killed, Lily threw herself before me and took the shot. From then on, I swore to become the best bounty hunter so that I can kill Dogna with my own hands.
strings.talk.28357.text: #F3/#FNo wonder you are so persistent in honing your skills.
strings.talk.28358.text: I have to kill Dogna myself and avenge Lily. Only then will I qualify as the best amongst bounty hunters.
strings.talk.28359.text: #F3/#FI understand that you are eager to avenge Lily, but it is wrong to take a person's life.
strings.talk.28360.text: So you think Dogna should get away with taking Lily's life?
strings.talk.28362.text: #n/#n, let's hurry to the #RCave near Cornwall Plain/#R.
strings.talk.28365.text: My, isn't this Louis the bounty hunter? You're here again to arrest me, aren't you? Got anyone to block the bullets this time round?
strings.talk.28366.text: Shut it. I'm here to finish you off.
strings.talk.28368.text: I would like to see how much your marksmanship has improved over the past ten years.
strings.talk.28369.text: I'm surprised! So you have improved after all.
strings.talk.28370.text: I will have mercy on you this time and spare your life. But I won't let you off next time.
strings.talk.28372.text: He has gotten stronger. I have to think of a way to become even stronger than him.
strings.talk.28373.text: #F3/#F(Louis's mind is occupied with thoughts of revenge. I should wait for him to calm down before talking to him.)
strings.talk.28374.text: This bumbling buffoon wants to kill me? What a joke...
strings.talk.28375.text: (His skills are way beyond mine. I must become stronger.)
strings.talk.28376.text: Who are you? I don't remember seeing you before.
strings.talk.28377.text: This place isn't the kind of place ordinary people can just step into.
strings.talk.28378.text: Why are there so many cave entrances?
strings.talk.28379.text: Dogna is very crafty. He created all of these cave entrances so that we can't find him easily.
strings.talk.28380.text: Looks like we'll have to spend some time looking for the right cave entrance.
strings.talk.28382.text: After enduring an entire year of malicious magical attacks, the Golden Snake King has mutated into the Vitria Snake King. Please defeat the #RVitria Snake King and his subordinates/#R and return the Snake King to his original state.

strings.talk.30789.text: I open the door and you can go to #R#B Holy Village /#R/#B. Hand the wine to #R#B bartender on the second floor /#R/#B. I will close the gate of path after you go through it because it's dangerous.
strings.talk.30790.text: Hello, An old brewster asked me to send the wine to you.
strings.talk.30791.text: Thank you very much. Please remember me to him.
strings.talk.30792.text: I must go back to tell brewster that I have finished the task.
strings.talk.30795.text: I've loved the princess for years. Several days ago I have planed to visit Chatelain for proposal. But Chatelain suddenly declared that the princess would marry a prince of a neighboring country.
strings.talk.30796.text: I think the Chatelain wants to ally with the neighboring country to realize his political ambition.
strings.talk.30797.text: #F2/#F Your Chatelain is hateful. How can he sacrifice the happiness of his daughter for his own sake.
strings.talk.30798.text: I think I can't marry the princess. I hope you help me send it to her.
strings.talk.30799.text: What's this? Why do you want to give it to the princess?
strings.talk.30800.text: This is our love token. I want you to hand it to the princess and tell her that she is my wife forever in my heart although we can't marry.
strings.talk.30802.text: #F3/#F Alas...Ok, I will do as you told.
strings.talk.30803.text: The princess is just in the #R#B General Residence /#R/#B. But it's defended by many guards. I'm afraid we have to come up with a plan.
strings.talk.30804.text: Common people are not admited into General Residence at will. Keep away!
strings.talk.30805.text: (It is so strictly defended here that even a mosquito can not get in)
strings.talk.30806.text: I think this man is a super official, judging from his clothes. If I can get #R#B his clothes /#R/#B, I will...
strings.talk.30812.text: (It is impossible for him to give me his clothes...)
strings.talk.30813.text: You...What would you like to do?
strings.talk.30815.text: It seems difficult to get his clothes. I'd better try to defeat him.
strings.talk.30816.text: It is easier to enter the General Residence with this clothes.
strings.talk.30817.text: Princess, Sano asked me to hand this to you. He also wanted to tell you that you are always the most beloved girl in his eyes.
strings.talk.30819.text: I am unable to leave here. Please ask #r#b Sano /#r/#b for me whether he is willing to come here. I have something to tell him.
strings.talk.30822.text: Qian...Master Qianzong, It's my honor to have you here!
strings.talk.30824.text: You frighten me. I thought it's Master Qianzong.
strings.talk.30825.text: The princess wanted you to enter the General's Residence. She seems to have something to tell you.
strings.talk.30826.text: The princess, does the princess wants me to see her? I will go there at once.
strings.talk.30827.text: Sano, let's leave here and live in a strange place.
strings.talk.30828.text: Princess, will you really leave here with me? We may lead a difficult life in the future? Will you?
strings.talk.30829.text: I don't care about hardship so long as I can live with you.
strings.talk.30831.text: Ah! Isn't this princess? Who are you? You dare to steal our princess. I must seize you!
strings.talk.30832.text: It is a misunderstanding. We haven't stolen the princess.
strings.talk.30834.text: Princess and Sano, hurry up. Or it will be late.
strings.talk.30835.text: #n/#n, thank you. We will appreciate you for ever. Princess, let's go.
strings.talk.30836.text: You dare to kidnap my daughter. How bold you are!
strings.talk.30837.text: Let them go. They love each other sincerely.
strings.talk.30838.text: Hum! We'll punish you sooner or later. Chatelain, do you need us to chase them and take Lunatic princess back.
strings.talk.30839.text: No, you needn't. In fact, I've known about their love for a long time. But I worry about that my daughter can not stand hardship after marrying Sano. Now I think I underestimate their affection.
strings.talk.30840.text: She has been spoilt since she was a child. I worry about her safety without my protection.
strings.talk.30841.text: I think the princess will be Ok with Sano. Chatelain, let them alone. Don't worry.
strings.talk.30842.text: Youth, can you do me a favor?
strings.talk.30843.text: Yes, of course. What's the matter?
strings.talk.30844.text: This #R#B Bright Bead /#R/#B is invaluable. Please hand it to them if you meet them. In addition...
strings.talk.30845.text: Pay attention! #n/#n can enter and out of General Residence freely.
strings.talk.30846.text: I'm certain to hand the Bright Bead to them. Don't worry.
strings.talk.30849.text: Defend the gate industriously. Don't be lazy! (Hah...)
strings.talk.30854.text: Old master, I've sent the wine for you.
strings.talk.30855.text: Thank you. You can choose one out of the two articles as your reward.
strings.talk.30856.text: Thank you for rescuing those villagers. Leave here quickly too. Or you will be seized by them. To keep your equipment, please unequip all pet?s equipment temporarily.
strings.talk.30857.text: No. I must find some other villagers that have suffered.
strings.talk.30858.text: Ok, I will leave at once.
strings.talk.30859.text: So strange. The figure is wrong however I count.
strings.talk.30860.text: I'm the cook of our tribe. I can make the best food in our village.
strings.talk.30861.text: Really? I would like to taste your food.
strings.talk.30862.text: In fact, I'm disturbed by one thing.
strings.talk.30863.text: What? Maybe I can help you.
strings.talk.30864.text: Ok, I find that 23 villagers want to eat beef alone, 17 chicken alone, 12 both of them and 6 fish alone. How many plates shall I prepare?
strings.talk.30865.text: Why are here a group of people?
strings.talk.30869.text: Er...It seems that they are all wrong. You'd better count again.
strings.talk.30870.text: I agree with you. Thank you for your help. The gift is yours now.
strings.talk.30872.text: Tomorrow is the annual Arbor Day.
strings.talk.30873.text: Really? Do you also have Arbor Day?
strings.talk.30874.text: Of course. We will plant 10 trees if we cut one. So the forest nearby is so dense.
strings.talk.30875.text: You have awareness of environmental protection.
strings.talk.30876.text: Oh! I forget how many seeds I should distribute to every team because of chatting with you.
strings.talk.30877.text: How about telling me the total number of trees you need to plant and the number of people every team. I help you count.
strings.talk.30878.text: Thank you. We need to plant 667 trees and we are divided into 4 teams. How many trees shall everyone plant?
strings.talk.30883.text: I'm responsible for tolling the bells here.
strings.talk.30885.text: I'm responsible for tolling the bells in the church. I am always disturbed by a question.
strings.talk.30886.text: I toll the bells 1 time at 1 o'clock, 2 at 2 o'clock, 3 at 3 o'clock and so on. Then how many times have I tolled after 12 hours?
strings.talk.30888.text: Alas, you are so smart. This is your rewards.
strings.talk.30893.text: What? The painting looks a bit strange. There are rows of letters or pictures in the bottom.
strings.talk.30894.text: Er, I know. They are Mayan letters. Mama told me that Mayan letters are based on shapes of everything in nature. So some of them look like pictures.
strings.talk.30899.text: It says that we can open the stone door by turning on a secret switch .
strings.talk.30903.text: Ah! It seems that we've activated the device. Go to that stone door to take a look.
strings.talk.30904.text: Ah! It opens. Shasha is smart.
strings.talk.30905.text: This door can not be opened. Maybe a certain device can open this door.
strings.talk.30907.text: How heavy... I can not pull it.
strings.talk.30909.text: Ah! It's open. I'm eager to know what are in it.
strings.talk.30911.text: Who are you? Why are you here? Since you come, I will not let you go out alive.
strings.talk.30914.text: Go back to #R#BControl Center/#R/#B to look for exit.
strings.talk.30915.text: Oh! The method to open the door is written on the altar...
strings.talk.30916.text: It says "To open the door, you must. ."
strings.talk.30917.text: What should we do? Why are you silent?
strings.talk.30918.text: Nothing...But I know how to open it. You go to inspect situation of #R#B stone door /#R/#B and I will meet you after pushing the device.
strings.talk.30921.text: The stone door is open. But, why does she not come out yet?
strings.talk.30923.text: It reads on the device: Only fresh blood from someone's heart can open this door. So I stabbed my chest with a knife???
strings.talk.30924.text: Shasha, are you Ok? How can you do this?
strings.talk.30925.text: You have saved my life. So I feel satisfied if you can leave here safely.
strings.talk.30926.text: Shasha, don't talk any more. Now let me take you to village to see a doctor.
strings.talk.30927.text: No...Leave here before my blood is exhausted.
strings.talk.30928.text: #n/#n, I am with you for a short time, but I feel happy. I will pray for you in the other world...
strings.talk.30930.text: Shasha...Wish you be happy in the other world!
strings.talk.30931.text: Do you agree that Shasha leaves the team?
strings.talk.30932.text: There is an object like UFO. It's possibly the vehicle. I will make good use of it after going out.
strings.talk.30933.text: That door can not be opened.
strings.talk.30939.text: You must spend 2 stars in praying for your partner. Are you willing?
strings.talk.30940.text: The partner you appoint is not necessary to be prayed to be reborn.
strings.talk.30941.text: Shasha doesn't die and she can't be reborn.
strings.talk.30942.text: Someone is looking at us. Let's leave here!
strings.talk.30944.text: Why is a girl lying on the desolate field?
strings.talk.30949.text: Are you ok? Why are you lying on the desolate field alone?
strings.talk.30952.text: (Oh, I can not understand her at all.)
strings.talk.30954.text: Ok, I see. Don't go on. What's your name?
strings.talk.30956.text: It is in vain. Let me call you "#R#B Niss /#R/#B"!
strings.talk.30957.text: Niss, it will be dark. Will you stay here or go back home with me?
strings.talk.30959.text: (It is strange that she seems to understand me...)
strings.talk.30961.text: Ah, it's Roca. What's the matter?
strings.talk.30964.text: It's interesting to venture with you. Let me travel with you again.
strings.talk.30965.text: I will come to you if you need me. Ok?
strings.talk.30967.text: The hair color of the two Orangutangs is the same with that of little Monkey...
strings.talk.30971.text: Sorry, your pet bar is already full.
strings.talk.30972.text: Ok! #n/#n, I will be here to bless you.
strings.talk.30974.text: No, it is harmful for you if I go with you.
strings.talk.30976.text: When I was born, an astrologian predicted that I would bring calamity even death to people around me. Now, my parents have passed away, even my grandma ...
strings.talk.30977.text: Will you be accompanied with such a person who can bring bad luck?
strings.talk.30978.text: I'm not superstitious. I think hard work will bring good luck.
strings.talk.30980.text: I think you need some time to recover from your grief. I'll see you later.
strings.talk.30982.text: I must go. Monkey, take care...(I hope I can return to my family someday.)
strings.talk.30983.text: Would you like to send me your favorite weapon Banana?
strings.talk.30987.text: Ok, I will wait for you in Kelan Village if you need me in the future.
strings.talk.30988.text: But...I want to venture with you. Can I?
strings.talk.30991.text: What's wrong with you? You looks like you are in pain. Are you tired because of the long travel?
strings.talk.30992.text: No surprise. You are tired after long time of walking. Let's have a rest here first. To keep your equipment, please unequip all pet?s equipment temporarily.
strings.talk.30993.text: She is sleeping like a log, so I can not bear waking her up. We go to visit #R#B Village Leader /#R/#B and ask him how to leave this small island.
strings.talk.30994.text: Hey~Are you that stranger finishing the tests in Kelan Village?
strings.talk.30995.text: How do you know about me?
strings.talk.30996.text: Because Village Leader of Kelan Village has been my closed friend since our childhood. We keep in touch with each other. You were just in the mine when I went to Kelan Village to see him. I remember your name is #n/#n.
strings.talk.30997.text: I want to ask your Village Leader about how to leave this island?
strings.talk.30998.text: Our island is surrounded by sea. You must leave here by crosssing the sea. There is a tunnel to South Island near the village. Many nonlocal residents gather there. I think you can get help from them.
strings.talk.31001.text: It's late. I wonder if Niss wake up or not?
strings.talk.31003.text: She was seen to calling up lightning. She is definitely sent by demons to burn the village. We must punish her with fire.
strings.talk.31005.text: Hateful nonlocal resident. We are killing demons. What do you want?
strings.talk.31006.text: #F2/#F She is not demon but my friend.
strings.talk.31008.text: Then you mean her identity is unknown. Go away, don't hinder us, or we'll throw you into the fire with her!
strings.talk.31009.text: I think you misunderstand her. Though I can't understand her words, I believe she does not hurt others. Look, I'm always Ok with her.
strings.talk.31010.text: AH!!! For helping her you will die together!
strings.talk.31011.text: Anyway, I do not allow you to hurt her!
strings.talk.31014.text: However strong you are,  you are impossible to defeat all villagers. Come on, seize them!
strings.talk.31015.text: #F2/#F (We are strangers in this land,and now we've offended all the people. This is terrible...)
strings.talk.31017.text: Village Leader, the two people with unknown identity...
strings.talk.31019.text: Let this youth and his friend go.
strings.talk.31020.text: Village Leader, how...how can we do so?
strings.talk.31021.text: This nonlocal resident is young, but his deeds have spreaded through the whole North Island. I believe they are not devils. Let them go!
strings.talk.31024.text: Don't worry. I will not let villagers hurt you.
strings.talk.31027.text: You are tired. Let me take you to a hotel for a good rest. We'll start off tomorrow morning.
strings.talk.31028.text: It's said magic and sharp weapon can be manufactured through melting the two weapons of #R#BFairy's Axe/#R/#B and #R#BPsychic's Dagger/#R/#B. But how can common people possess these two magic weapons?
strings.talk.31030.text: We'll burn a female devil at once.
strings.talk.31031.text: Shall I go to see their rite?
strings.talk.31032.text: Ah! Is that Sano? There seems to be another person beside him...
strings.talk.31034.text: Takeyoshi! What happened? Why are you lying here? Where is the princess?
strings.talk.31035.text: Princess was seized by a monster. I tried to resist her but was wounded seriously.
strings.talk.31036.text: Why so?...Takeyoshi, I will take you to see doctor firstly.
strings.talk.31037.text: Leave me alone. Go to save the princess for me! I can prop up myself.
strings.talk.31038.text: But you are injured heavily. You'll die without timely treatment.
strings.talk.31039.text: Let me alone. Go to save princess for me! There is a #R#B Cave /#R/#B in the forest. I think the princess was took there.
strings.talk.31040.text: So...Ok, Takeyoshi, wait for me. I'll come back soon!
strings.talk.31041.text: I'll depend on you to save the princess...Haw!
strings.talk.31043.text: I just heard your speaking. Was the princess caught by a monster?
strings.talk.31044.text: Yes. Now I must start off to save the princess and avenge for Takeyoshi!
strings.talk.31045.text: Don't be so impulsive. You should ask more people to save the princess with you. There will be larger possibility of success.
strings.talk.31046.text: I can't think more. Takeyoshi is my best friend since my childhood.  I would rather sacrifice my life to fight the monster for him.
strings.talk.31047.text: Sano, wait a minute. Calm down!
strings.talk.31048.text: We have no more time to think over. Better catch up with Sano, or the consequence will be too serious to be remedied.
strings.talk.31049.text: Yes. I hope the princess is safe...
strings.talk.31050.text: That monster went back up. I think it returned to its cave. Can you save the princess for me...
strings.talk.31052.text: Here is a cave. The Princess may be here.
strings.talk.31053.text: Hateful monster! Princess, wait for me. I will save you at once!
strings.talk.31056.text: Let the princess go! Or I'll defeat you!
strings.talk.31057.text: Ah! Isn't he the River Boy?
strings.talk.31058.text: I want to marry this pretty girl!
strings.talk.31059.text: Sano, be careful! I come to help you!
strings.talk.31060.text: Hateful monster! I will fight with you!
strings.talk.31063.text: Yes, I am. Sano, I'm glad to see you come to save me...
strings.talk.31064.text: Darling, nothing can stop me to save you.
strings.talk.31065.text: Where is Takeyoshi? Since he is wounded seriously, I really worry about him.
strings.talk.31067.text: I'm afraid Takeyoshi has been injured too heavily to be cured...
strings.talk.31068.text: Takeyoshi? Takeyoshi, are you joking? Open your eyes, please. Takeyoshi. No! Hateful monster, I will definitely kill you to avenge for Takeyoshi!
strings.talk.31070.text: Alas...Takeyoshi died for his owner out of faith. You needn't be too sad.
strings.talk.31071.text: Ah! By the way, Chatelain asked me to hand this Bright Bead to you.
strings.talk.31072.text: Chatelain? Is it possible? This Bright Bead is his treasure. Is it possible for him to present us?
strings.talk.31073.text: You misunderstood Chatelain. He loves you. He is only afraid that the princess could not endure hardship after marrying Sano...So he let me hand this Bright Bead to you. You are the only apple of his eyes.
strings.talk.31074.text: Dad...I misunderstood you. Please forgive me.
strings.talk.31075.text: What are you going to do?
strings.talk.31076.text: I think we should find a place to settle down. Then I can establish a Wushu hall with my speciality. Meantime, I will find chance to take the princess to Chatelain.
strings.talk.31077.text: Ok, I bless you to fulfill it and lead a happy living with the princess.
strings.talk.31079.text: Er, thank you for you constant help. #n/#n, we will leave.
strings.talk.31081.text: No, return my child to me!
strings.talk.31082.text: Master, what's up? Why are two women contending for a child?
strings.talk.31083.text: The two women, you both say this child is yours?
strings.talk.31084.text: It's simple. Testing DNA is enough.
strings.talk.31086.text: (Alas, they do not know this technology...)
strings.talk.31087.text: Quiet! Since both of you consider this child is yours, I will cut this child into two halves. A half for each!
strings.talk.31088.text: My God! Cut my child into halves! M...Master, I give up. I don't want this child!
strings.talk.31090.text: #n/#n, who do you think is the real mother of this child?
strings.talk.31095.text: Of course, the young woman. No parent would be willing to cut their child into halves.
strings.talk.31096.text: Er, it is reasonable. I judge that the young woman is the child's mother. The old woman, you are so bold that you dare to lie to me!
strings.talk.31097.text: I know it's my fault. This child looks like my abortive son. So I...
strings.talk.31098.text: Considering that you miss your dead son, I will lighten the punishment on you. You must clean streets for a week. You will be beaten heavily if you do not.
strings.talk.31100.text: In addition, this young woman did not look after your child well so that he was took by others. You are also to be blamed.
strings.talk.31101.text: I see. Thank you, Master. I will devote myself to look after my child later.
strings.talk.31102.text: Ok, the trial is over. You can go.
strings.talk.31103.text: (Well! This official can judge cases clearly and justly like Master Bao in ancient time.)
strings.talk.31104.text: How dare you stand in a court?
strings.talk.31105.text: Ah! Here is...Sorry, I don't know.
strings.talk.31106.text: Don't be careless. I do not blame you any longer. You performed well just now. It's prize for you.
strings.talk.31110.text: Look, the scenery is beautiful. Do you think so?
strings.talk.31111.text: The scenery in my hometown is also beautiful...
strings.talk.31112.text: You should take me to your hometown. I want to enjoy beautiful scenery there.
strings.talk.31113.text: Sometime take me to your hometown, will you?
strings.talk.31114.text: Really? I might as well go to your hometown to have a look.
strings.talk.31116.text: Let's fix it. You can not break it.
strings.talk.31118.text: Ha! Let's look forward to that day.
strings.talk.31119.text: I grow up in the village. I had never left the village before I met you.
strings.talk.31120.text: Father is always the most important person for me before. Now I finally meet another one.
strings.talk.31121.text: What did you say towards the sky?
strings.talk.31123.text: Am I the important person for you?
strings.talk.31124.text: No...Nothing, let's look for the way to your home.
strings.talk.31125.text: I'll tell you after you return to your hometown.
strings.talk.31126.text: Yes. I can hardly enjoy beautiful scenery here any longer but for your saving me.
strings.talk.31127.text: Ah! Why is a girl lying here?
strings.talk.31128.text: #n/#n, look, a girl is lying here and seems wounded.
strings.talk.31132.text: Presbyter! I know her. She is the daughter of Kelan Leader,called Roca! Recently many conflicts often occur between our people and the villagers of North Island. It's definitely her who killed our people.
strings.talk.31133.text: You misunderstand her. She did not kill your fellow and we just pass by.
strings.talk.31134.text: Don't explain. Come on! Detain this heretic named Roca for trial!
strings.talk.31136.text: Wait a moment. She is really treated unjustly.
strings.talk.31140.text: Take her to the prison under #R#B church /#R/#B and watch her closely. No one can let her go without my permission!
strings.talk.31141.text: Roca~lower your voice. I come here to rescue you.
strings.talk.31143.text: #n/#n, do you go to save me? Didn't I ask you leave me alone? Why do you still...
strings.talk.31144.text: Let's leave here before other jailers come.
strings.talk.31145.text: Terrible, too many members in my team...
strings.talk.31147.text: (Chatelain asked me to hand Bright Bead to them, but I seem not to take it with me...)
strings.talk.31148.text: Roca, I'm a stranger here. Will you continue to venture with me?
strings.talk.31150.text: My child, how can you promise him indiscreetly? What will you do if you suffer danger on the way?
strings.talk.31151.text: Dad... I want to go with this brave person. Do my part to help?
strings.talk.31152.text: Ala... Ok! Ok! You are always spoiled, so it is useless to persuade you. You are the same with your mother at this aspect.
strings.talk.31155.text: They said that they closed Roca in the prison under the church. I must go to pry into it...
strings.talk.31157.text: Congratulation to you two. I'll tell you a piece of extremely good news.
strings.talk.31158.text: Your record point has been restored here.
strings.talk.31159.text: This statue is a bit strange...
strings.talk.31160.text: The Mori letters on the totem seem to tell us the tongue of the statue can be stretched. To keep your equipment, please unequip all pet?s equipment temporarily.
strings.talk.31161.text: Do you want to have a try?
strings.talk.31163.text: Yoo! A big spider. It is biger than that one on the way.
strings.talk.31164.text: Hah! Stupid humans. You open this sealed door. I will give death to you as a prize!
strings.talk.31165.text: D...Damn! I'm actually defeated by your weak humans.
strings.talk.31166.text: Hum! Countless people will be killed by you without us!
strings.talk.31167.text: Xaolan...Why do you wear the Jade Magic Stone which can revive the dead in legend.
strings.talk.31168.text: What? Reviving the dead? Are you serious? Can I revive my grandma?
strings.talk.31169.text: Of course. Come on...I only tell you.
strings.talk.31170.text: Xaolan, don't go there! It is dangerous!
strings.talk.31171.text: Please tell me the secret of this jade.
strings.talk.31172.text: Ok, I tell you. That is...
strings.talk.31174.text: Hah! Foolish human. This jade has strong power. It can give me unlimited energy and make me immortal.
strings.talk.31176.text: Feel my power after my reviving.
strings.talk.31178.text: You kill me? Now I have combined the girl's life and mine. If one dies, the other will also die. Come on. Hah!
strings.talk.31180.text: #n/#n, it doesn't matter. Come on, kill me. I don't want to be used as a tool to kill others.
strings.talk.31182.text: It doesn't matter. Do you know? I grow up with an prediction that I would always bring misfortune. So I'm always excluded by others. Besides my grandma, you treat me best. I'm glad to have met you.
strings.talk.31183.text: Alas! My energy is decreasing and my body can not move!
strings.talk.31184.text: I hope you can put my life into end before my energy is exhausted, #n/#n...
strings.talk.31185.text: Stop! Do you want to kill the girl?
strings.talk.31187.text: #n/#n, good-bye. I'll meet with my grandma and my parents...
strings.talk.31191.text: Help! My wife was kidnaped by huge Cirrus. Please help me to save her, will you?
strings.talk.31193.text: I am making soup. I must go to put out the fire.
strings.talk.31195.text: Child, I will send you to school.
strings.talk.31196.text: Mama, hasn't the school a day off today?
strings.talk.31197.text: Get off my back! Do as I say.
strings.talk.31198.text: What... What shall I do? No one will help me. What shall I do?
strings.talk.31200.text: Really? Am I dreaming? You are so kind. Thank you! Thank you!
strings.talk.31201.text: Where is the Giant Corpse Flower?
strings.talk.31202.text: It is on the left of southern #R#BMaka/#R/#B. The monster is very fierce. You should be careful.
strings.talk.31203.text: Today I'm lucky enough to have lavish meal because of two of you.
strings.talk.31205.text: Thank Master Frederico for giving me unlimited energy. Finally I needn't feed on unsavory flies and mosquitoes.
strings.talk.31206.text: I can not only speak but also eat human beings. Come on, my good meal!
strings.talk.31207.text: You're crazy! I will stop you to hurt people again.
strings.talk.31208.text: Now you can not hurt human beings. Ah! This villager still be alive.
strings.talk.31210.text: Yes, I'm ok. Where is here?
strings.talk.31211.text: You nearly became a tasty meal for this Man-eating Flower. By the way, your husband is waiting for you in Holy Village.
strings.talk.31212.text: Re... Really? Then I must hurry up to go back.
strings.talk.31214.text: Thank you for saving my wife. I can't live without my wife.
strings.talk.31215.text: Why did you go to the desolate field?

strings.talk.31572.text: Ok, I'll help you to find them back. What kinds of garments have you got?
