strings.talk.31574.text: Ok,I will help you to find them.
strings.talk.31576.text: Oh, yeah, yeah! Hand them to me quickly. I'm so cold... Here is your reward.
strings.talk.31577.text: A-ha-ha, thank you, youth. Now I can successfully finish off my yearly task. See you next year!
strings.talk.31578.text: Look, your clothes! Aren't you Santa Claus?
strings.talk.31579.text: A-ha-ha... You got it. Now I'm leaving to send Christmas gifts to people.
strings.talk.31580.text: Am I dreaming? Is there really a Santa Claus?
strings.talk.31581.text: It's dark at the gate of the cave. It seems that we must get a #R#B flashlight /#R/#B so that we can go through it.
strings.talk.31582.text: Oh, yes. If you wear socks, you will get some surprising gifts. As long as you click the tree behind me.
strings.talk.31583.text: What's wrong with you? Why are you here sighing?
strings.talk.31584.text: I'm just an idling acrobat and I have only one skill. I make snakes in the pot dance to the music from my flute.
strings.talk.31585.text: But I lost my flute by accident. I don't know what can I do...
strings.talk.31586.text: Do you still remember where you lost it? I will help you find it.
strings.talk.31587.text: I might lose it in the mountain behind our village. Please do me a favor to look for my #R#B snake flute /#R/#B on your way past the mountain.
strings.talk.31589.text: #f2/#f My goodness! The child is in danger. I must save him right away.
strings.talk.31590.text: Wooh! I'm saved! Thank you for your help! Without your help, I really don't know what can I do.
strings.talk.31591.text: Well, why did the group of snakes attack you so suddenly?
strings.talk.31592.text: I don't know why. I found this flute on the ground. When I played it, they began to attack me.
strings.talk.31594.text: Since the flute is so dangerous, please give it to me.
strings.talk.31596.text: Sir, is this the #R#B flute /#R/#B that you lost?
strings.talk.31597.text: Great. Where did you find it? In order to repay you, please accept this as a gift.
strings.talk.31598.text: I'm too busy! I can hardly deal with it.
strings.talk.31600.text: I'm in charge of the farm. I must get in the crops and also feed the animals. However, the feed stuff has all been used up. I need five #R#B barley /#R/#B. Could you give me a hand to bring me five #R#B barley /#R/#B?
strings.talk.31601.text: Please help me collect five #R#B barley /#R/#B!
strings.talk.31603.text: Great, thank you. In order to show my appreciation, let me teach you the #R#B collecting skill /#R/#B.
strings.talk.31604.text: My axe has broken when I chopped trees with it. Now it's hard to use it to chop trees.
strings.talk.31605.text: Why not repaire it or buy a new one?
strings.talk.31606.text: The axe is handed down from generations to generations. And it was made of the legendary hard metal #R#B Bei's Ore /#R/#B. Unless I can get the #R#B Bei's Ore /#R/#B, it will remain useless forever.
strings.talk.31607.text: I have an ore with me. I don't know whether it's the one you need.
strings.talk.31608.text: Ah! It's just the #R#B Bei's Ore/#R/#B!Thank you. I will teach you the #R#B chopping skills /#R/#B to express my thanks.
strings.talk.31610.text: I can't dig it out. Is it strange? Why can't I dig it out?
strings.talk.31612.text: I'm a ore miner. I'm here digging ore. Tomorrow is the delivery time. However, I can't find  the other three #R#B iron ores /#R/#B that I need. What shall I do?
strings.talk.31613.text: (It seems that I should manage to provide him three #R#B iron ore /#R/#B.)
strings.talk.31614.text: I have three iron ores. Here you are.
strings.talk.31615.text: Thanks. Let's make it a deal that I will teach you the #R#B mining techniques /#R/#B.
strings.talk.31616.text: Lalalala...I'm a happy miner! I dig them out no matter what they are iron ore, silver ore or gold ore.
strings.talk.31620.text: The second? Where is the first Fire dragon you raised?
strings.talk.31621.text: Yeah...Many years ago, I made a small mistake in raising and the Fire Dragon became huge and furious. One day it broke through the cage and flew away.
strings.talk.31622.text: It may have flown to #R#B the navel of the world /#R/#B, where it's suitable for it.
strings.talk.31623.text: Why is there a Fire Dragon?
strings.talk.31624.text: Arez, you can follow #N/#N from now on.
strings.talk.31625.text: Check in for the TGC contest.
strings.talk.31628.text: How bold you are! Foolish man! How dare you to kidnap our captain!
strings.talk.31630.text: I didn't kidnap your captain. Why did you say that?
strings.talk.31631.text: Hum! It seems that you won't tell us where the captain is unless we teach you a lesson first. Come on! Beat them!
strings.talk.31632.text: Wow...You seem really powerful...Why would such  powerful guys like you  become pirates?
strings.talk.31633.text: You mistook us for pirates. Atcually we are not.
strings.talk.31634.text: Ok, since we can't save the captain from you, you may choose how your fate: killing or cutting, it's up to you.
strings.talk.31635.text: I said we are really not...Ah! The King Certificate given by the old uncle has been lost.
strings.talk.31636.text: Wait! This our captain's King Certificate. Where did you get it?
strings.talk.31637.text: Oh yes, I got this King Certificate from an old  bearded uncle in a country bar, where I helped him to beat some local ruffians.
strings.talk.31638.text: Oh you are friends of our captain! Sorry for our disrespect. Do please forgive us.
strings.talk.31639.text: Never mind. We hadn't expected Ferdinent to be your captain.
strings.talk.31640.text: Not long ago, the pirates attacked us. Finally they defeated us and the captain was kidnapped by them.
strings.talk.31641.text: It is strange that they kidnapped your captain rather than robbing your treasure.
strings.talk.31642.text: In my opinion, they wanted to take the captain as hostage so that they can ask for more treasures from their country and do what they want here in the sea.
strings.talk.31643.text: #f2/#f It is too bad! Where do you think did they took your captain?
strings.talk.31644.text: I don't know where they hid him. But, their hideout is at #R#B Blackwind Cave /#R/#B. You may go there to try your fortune.
strings.talk.31646.text: We must reach #R#B Blackwind Cave /#R/#B quickly, or Captain Magellan may be in danger!
strings.talk.31648.text: It's me. I'm Clive. I've brought a new companion to join us.
strings.talk.31649.text: Ahaha...So it is. Our pirate team is the most powerful one in the world. Many people have come to join us. But our captain has sailed out. Only the ship used as a prison for captives is in the harbor. You ought to wait here.
strings.talk.31650.text: The ship is in the harbor. You'd better have a rest there.
strings.talk.31651.text: We finally found the pirate ship. I hoped that the captain was safe.
strings.talk.31652.text: Are you Clive? Long time no see. I had thought you were eaten by the sharks. AhaAha...
strings.talk.31653.text: It isn't that case. I only went to accompish a mission assigned by our captain.
strings.talk.31654.text: Wo...So it is. Yee? The person behind you is...?
strings.talk.31655.text: I captured him from another place and planned to sell him at a slave market. But I don't know how much I can get from him?
strings.talk.31656.text: Ahaha...Clive, you are still powerful. Don't forget to treat us buddies when you make a fortune from it. Now, put him in!
strings.talk.31657.text: You are...Ah! You are the young guy who saved me in the Holy village bar. What? Are you aslo a pirate?
strings.talk.31658.text: No, I'm here to save you. Let's leave here quickly.
strings.talk.31659.text: Yes, Ferdinend Magellan is our captain.
strings.talk.31660.text: (I never think that the old uncle I met in the bar was Magellan, the great navigator).
strings.talk.31661.text: But, you said your captain had been kidnapped. What's the matter?
strings.talk.31662.text: We got it all behind the door. Clive, you dare to betray our blackbeard captain. I'll kill all of you.
strings.talk.31663.text: Captain Magellan, you get away from here first. I will deal with the situation here.
strings.talk.31666.text: The prisoner has gone. Catch him, buddies!
strings.talk.31668.text: Captain, let's move quickly, or we'll fail if the captain of pirates comes back.
strings.talk.31670.text: You can enter if all the teammates have checked in.
strings.talk.31671.text: Congratulations! You won the 15 Round Challenge. The rewards is yours.
strings.talk.31672.text: In addition, during the 15 Round Challenge players may be kicked off, but they won't lose any EXP or pet amity. Players can enjoy the challenge.
strings.talk.31673.text: Congratulaions. You have succeeded! Welcome to the next challgenge, you brave hero!
strings.talk.31674.text: Gods, Please help #n/#n escape the cave. I'll give my life to help!
strings.talk.31675.text: Papa and Mama, please forgive Shasha that I can't live on following your wish. If there is next life, I wish to be your loved daughter again.
strings.talk.31677.text: Sorry, only a team of 4 memebers can be checked in.
strings.talk.31678.text: Yee? Why is there a Magical Wand hung here?
strings.talk.31679.text: Hi! Niss, where are you going?
strings.talk.31680.text: What's wrong? Look, you are anxious. Do you really want the Magical Wand?
strings.talk.31682.text: Alas...Ok. I will get it for you.
strings.talk.31683.text: Well, Niss. The Magical Wand is yours now.
strings.talk.31684.text: Great. Niss hasn't been happy for a long time.(It seems that the Magical Wand was very special to Niss)
strings.talk.31685.text: Judging by the clothes of the buddy behind you, he is a pirate! So you must be related to my captain's kidnapping.
strings.talk.31686.text: Please help me to save our captain.
strings.talk.31687.text: I have to do what you want.
strings.talk.31688.text: Youth, my archery is well known. Do you want to challenge me? Let's have a contest. Who kills the most prey will be the winner.
strings.talk.31689.text: Ahaha, I have practiced archery for almost ten years. How can you a young guy defeat me?
strings.talk.31690.text: Ok! Let's have a hunting contest to decide who will win.
strings.talk.31691.text: I hadn't expected that the young can surpass the old. I admit I am the loser. This is your reward! Here you are!
strings.talk.31692.text: Since the huge dragon in the volcano persisted disturbing our village,the crops and critters can't survive. You are the elites in the village. You must kill the huge dragon.
strings.talk.31693.text: The guy who can kill the huge dragon alone can marry my daughter Ceres.
strings.talk.31695.text: Ceres, I will marry you after I kill the huge dragon.
strings.talk.31696.text: I will be waiting for you. Take care.
strings.talk.31698.text: Wo! Young hero, I have never met you before. Are you joining us to kill the huge dragon?
strings.talk.31699.text: Why do you want to kill the huge dragon?
strings.talk.31700.text: Alas...The volcano never erupted. Not long before, a huge dragon flew into the volcano and destroyed a lot, which caused the eruptions. Our crops and critters were badly affected...
strings.talk.31701.text: #f2/#f So it is. Where is the huge dragon?
strings.talk.31702.text: #R#B huge dragon /#R/#B is at the top of the mountain. You can enter it from #R#B the entrance at the foot of mountain/#R/#B.
strings.talk.31703.text: Are you here killing the huge dragon? Take care. It is not easy.
strings.talk.31704.text: Everybody should hold the rope tightly. Don't let the huge dragon escape.
strings.talk.31705.text: Ah! The rope is broken. Run, everybody!
strings.talk.31707.text: Nevermind! I would fight to death if it meant that I could marry Ceres.
strings.talk.31710.text: Ah, huge dragon...Who killed the huge dragon?
strings.talk.31711.text: #f1/#f It's me. It's really dangerous just now.
strings.talk.31712.text: Hmph! Why don't you mind your own business! You must want to marry Ceres!
strings.talk.31713.text: Huh!! I saved him but he just curses at me like this. Well...the huge dragon has just stuned. I'd better take this chance to return to the village to tell the Village Leader about it.
strings.talk.31714.text: Wowowo! Our hero comes back. I've heard that you killed the huge dragon. Is that right?
strings.talk.31715.text: (If I say yes, then Garrick can't marry Ceres...)
strings.talk.31716.text: No. In fact, it's Garrick who killed it. When I got there, Garrick already finished with the huge dragon and he lay on the ground exhausted. I was just there looking after him.
strings.talk.31717.text: So it is! Garrick, I knew you wouldn't let us down. According the former aggreement, you can marry Ceres.
strings.talk.31718.text: Well...It was him but not me who killed the huge dragon.
strings.talk.31719.text: Don't call me Village Leader any more. Call me father.
strings.talk.31721.text: Hey, this is a gift I received from a traveller. But it is useless for me. Now, I will give it to you as a reward.
strings.talk.31723.text: Thanks very much for your permission that Ceres and I can stay together. Here you are,the key. It is a badge symbolizing hero which was passed down from gererations to generations. It is said that it can open the door of #R#B Huge Image/#R/#B.
strings.talk.31724.text: What's the matter? Look. How happy you are!
strings.talk.31726.text: Well...Don't quarrel! Are you not willing to marry my daughter?
strings.talk.31727.text: I think your daughther and Garrick both love each other very much. So my share of the reward must go to Garrick.
strings.talk.31728.text: Since you two killed the huge dragon, both of you deserve it and will receive my rewards.
strings.talk.31730.text: You brave soldier...Both Garrick and I will appreciate it.
strings.talk.31731.text: Elder brother! Please, please don't hurt my elder brother!
strings.talk.31732.text: #f2/#f It seems that who is crying for help there?
strings.talk.31733.text: Ahaha, this is what you deserve fighting against me. Take away Qlaya.
strings.talk.31734.text: Elder brother...Sorry, it's I who put you in trouble.
strings.talk.31735.text: #f2/#f are you Ok? Hey! Wake up!
strings.talk.31736.text: Wooh...Come on...Come on...Save Qlaya. The Priest wants make use of her to do something frightening...
strings.talk.31737.text: #f2/#f you seem badly hurt. Let me help your stop bleeding! About saving your younger sister, let's talk about it later.
strings.talk.31738.text: No...the whole village will be in danger if you don't stop the Priest.
strings.talk.31739.text: There is #R#B a switch on the wall of the altar of Maya /#R/#B. A #R#B subway /#R/#B will appear if you touch the switch. The Priest must take my younger sister there.
strings.talk.31740.text: #f2/#f Good! I'll go there to save your younger sister. Do take care yourself!
strings.talk.31741.text: This is where he mentioned. But where on earth is the switch?
strings.talk.31742.text: An! It really has a subway. I must hurry up to save Qlaya.
strings.talk.31744.text: #R#B red flame number 1, green flame number 2, blue flame number 3 /#R/#B. If you light all the flames and add them up no matter it will be plused by horizon, upright or slanting. So long as #R#B the result is 6 /#R/#B, the door will open.
strings.talk.31745.text: Ahaha...My ceremony will soon be finished. All the world will be mine and all I need to do is pour the blood of this girl on my altar.
strings.talk.31747.text: How can you stop me? You must be ready to suffer my wrath.
strings.talk.31748.text: Hum! You seem to be a little strong! But it's all you had. Have a look at my power!
strings.talk.31750.text: #f2/#f So this is the real priest.
strings.talk.31751.text: It's your honor to be killed by me. Come on, be ready to die.
strings.talk.31755.text: You...Who are you? How do you know my name?
strings.talk.31756.text: My name is #n/#n. Your brother asked me to save you. He is badly hurt. He is in danger.
strings.talk.31757.text: Ah...Elder brother! I must save my elder brother...
strings.talk.31758.text: I have no idea what would go on with them. I'd better follow her.
strings.talk.31760.text: Qlaya? It's great that you can be safe...
strings.talk.31762.text: Qlaya, I want you to know one thing befor I die. You must pay attention! In fact, we are not real brother and sister...Sixteen years ago, our father were hunting outside when he saw a baby being discarded under a tree...
strings.talk.31763.text: Father couldn't leave you in the open air,so he brought you  back and brought you up as one of us. However, we don't know who your real parents are. We only know the special sign on your body and the crystal stick lying beside you at that time...
strings.talk.31765.text: It's the fact...Although you were discarded by them, you should try to look for your real parents. I think they have had no other choices to discard you. After all, no parents are perfect...
strings.talk.31766.text: #n/#n Thanks for saving my little sister. I have a request before I die. Please look after my little sister well...Please...
strings.talk.31767.text: Elder brother, why don't you talk again...Elder brother...Wake up...Elder brother...No!!!
strings.talk.31768.text: #f3/#f Don't worry. I am sure I can look after Qlaya very well...
strings.talk.31769.text: #f3/#f  Qlaya, the dead can not be reborn. You should be strong.
strings.talk.31770.text: I was discared by my parents and now the only relative I had is dead. How can I be tough?
strings.talk.31771.text: #f3/#f I know...But leading a good life was your brother's wish when he was alive. I will do my best to protect you.
strings.talk.31777.text: Youth, are you willing to look for the legendary Dragon Bead? I will give you a great reward if you do.
strings.talk.31778.text: Ok, how can I look for the so-called Dragon Bead you mentioned.
strings.talk.31779.text: There are #R#Bnine/#R/#B Dragon Beads scattered in different places around the world. Some might be in the forests and some might be in the maze. You should try your best to find them.
strings.talk.31780.text: Haven't your found the Dragon Bead?
strings.talk.31782.text: Have you? Let me have a look.
strings.talk.31783.text: You've found 2 of them. This is your reward.
strings.talk.31784.text: You've found 3 Dragon Beads. This is your reward.
strings.talk.31785.text: You've found 4 Dragon Beads. This is your reward.
strings.talk.31786.text: You've found 5 Dragon Beads. This is your reward.
strings.talk.31787.text: You've found 6 Dragon Beads. This is your reward.
strings.talk.31788.text: You've found 7 Dragon Beads. This is your reward.
strings.talk.31789.text: You've found 8 Dragon Beads. This is your reward.
strings.talk.31790.text: How great you are! You have got all Dragon Beads!
strings.talk.31791.text: Since you have got all Dragon Beads, I will abide by my promise. Now, here are your rewards.
strings.talk.31792.text: These Dragon Beads will be scattered to different places around the world again until someone can collect them. See you!
strings.talk.31793.text: This key of the statue may open the door.
strings.talk.31795.text: Hateful invaders. You not only invaded the sacred place but also wanted to steal treasures. Be ready to die!
strings.talk.31796.text: This clock slowers #R#B five minutes /#R/#B every hour. If put it right at #R#B 3 o'clock /#R/#B, what's the time after #R#B 5 hours /#R/#B?
strings.talk.31807.text: Wow, they don't move! There must be something wrong with the clock setting.
strings.talk.31808.text: Yee? It is strange! These statues were not here just now.
strings.talk.31811.text: #R#BFrom 11:00pm March 23rd to 12:00 midnight April 1st/#R/#B, give Dragon Beads to me and I will give your rewards according the number of Dragon Beads.
strings.talk.31812.text: I got the chance to show my power.
strings.talk.31814.text: Dealing with the clowns cost me nothing. Captain, you should take care of yourself because you are old.
strings.talk.31815.text: Ahaha...you youth seems to boast. I should work harder.
strings.talk.31816.text: It is stange? This secret room is  so mysterious. It mustn't be just for a capsule?!
strings.talk.31817.text: Yee? There are strange symbols on the back of the paper. It seems to be some kind of picture.
strings.talk.31819.text: Hey! What are you doing with the Dragon Beads given by Gods?
strings.talk.31820.text: Ah! I have been found out! Forgive my rudeness!
strings.talk.31821.text: Oh merciful gods! Please forgive the guilty people! Amen!
strings.talk.31823.text: Darling, we should buy the same with the person wearing a bamboo hat. We must follow his instructions.
strings.talk.31826.text: My goodness! You got it again! How great you are!
strings.talk.31827.text: Good, darling. You must buy me my favourite makeup...
strings.talk.31829.text: Oh no! I want to gamble with you again. This time I will throw the dice. Do you want big or small?
strings.talk.31830.text: Three,four and six. Thirteen is the biggest.
strings.talk.31831.text: Ok,open! Ahaha, yours is smaller than mine. Youth, you are still too young to compare with me.
strings.talk.31833.text: Why are there dices in your hand?
strings.talk.31834.text: Aiya! Ouch! Put...put your hand down!
strings.talk.31835.text: How can you play tricks on me! You must be tired of living! Ok, I'll help to teach you a lesson. Cheaters never prosper!
strings.talk.31837.text: Hold on! How dare you commit murder in front of so many people! Isn't there any law in your eyes?
strings.talk.31838.text: How funny is it! I'm the law!
strings.talk.31839.text: What! I must defeat you in order to make this a fair place to live.
strings.talk.31841.text: They even killed the Guandai. We can't be rivals and we must fight together against them. Run!
strings.talk.31843.text: Sorry. I entertain an angel unawares. In order to make up for it, I will treat you with the beauty and the best wine. Would you do me the honor?
strings.talk.31844.text: Best wine? Taking the best wine to account, I accept your treatment. However you will know what is going on if I'm not satisfied with it.
strings.talk.31845.text: Ok. I won't let you down. I will bring you there.
strings.talk.31846.text: Your honor, this way please. We are going to the geisha hotel.
strings.talk.31847.text: This guy has passed out. I heard that they were going to have a drink at the #R#B geisha hotel/#R/#B. I have no idea whether they will be in danger.
strings.talk.31849.text: Why are there so many people over there. What are they doing there?
strings.talk.31850.text: En...It's really good wine. Hey, I've got no more wine, come on, serve it quickly!
strings.talk.31851.text: Your honor, have a good drink! It's on me. I hope I can express my regrets.
strings.talk.31852.text: Wow mister, you are really good at drinking!
strings.talk.31853.text: Wooh? Why I feel dizzy...Did you drug the wine?
strings.talk.31854.text: Hehe...of course. You are a good swordsman. How could I deal with you if I didn't do that. Come on! Tie him up. Throw him to the sea. Ha...Hope you can swim.
strings.talk.31855.text: #f2/#f Ah! That swordman is in danger. I must save him right now!
strings.talk.31857.text: Are you ok? I drove away that group of people.
strings.talk.31858.text: Thanks for saving me just now or it would be all over for me! My name is Qancao. This is for you to express my thanks. I must leave!
strings.talk.31859.text: But didn't you drink the drugged wine? You are leaving so soon. Are you ok?
strings.talk.31860.text: If I am here, the boss of the casino will send more people here. By then, even you can't get away. I just feel a little bit dizzy. I am Ok. Bye!
strings.talk.31861.text: Yee? Why are so many dwarfs here?
strings.talk.31862.text: Who are you? Why not kneel when seeing the queen!
strings.talk.31863.text: Queen? You? Why do you look like an old grandpa?
strings.talk.31864.text: I'm not the queen. The queen is beside me.
strings.talk.31865.text: Behind you? Why I just saw a block of ice?
strings.talk.31866.text: The person in the ice block is our queen. The reason why our queen stays in the ice block is that our queen suffered from a cuss.
strings.talk.31867.text: Why don't you melt the ice block with fire?
strings.talk.31868.text: The ice block is in a prison. Unless #R#B mysterious ice crystal /#R/#B and #R#B mysterious crystal /#R/#B are put on the two altars nearby, the queen will stay in the ice block forever.
strings.talk.31869.text: How bold you are! You are bold enough to destroy the sign set by the master. You must be ready to die. I will teach you a good lesson.
strings.talk.31870.text: #R#B Odycis/#R/#B, please forgive me. I can't serve you any longer.
strings.talk.31871.text: Who is this Odycis that he murmured about just now?
strings.talk.31872.text: Ah! The Queen has been released.
strings.talk.31873.text: I've heard of it from the ministers. Thank you very much indeed for your help. Otherwise I would have stayed in the ice block for the rest of my life.
strings.talk.31874.text: I'm flattered! While I beat the monster down to the ground, it was murmuring a name:Odycis. Do you know her?
strings.talk.31875.text: Odycis is the queen's stepmother. She...
strings.talk.31876.text: Thank you for saving me. This gift is for you. Bye!
strings.talk.31877.text: (It is strange! Why did the queen seem be angry when I mentioned Odycis?)
strings.talk.31878.text: Here is the queen palace. Please leave here !
strings.talk.31879.text: On the altar, there must be a #R#B mysterious ice crystal /#R/#B.
strings.talk.31880.text: On the altar, there must be a #R#B mysterious ice crystal /#R/#B.
strings.talk.31881.text: The passage is too small. The team should split up to pass through it.
strings.talk.31882.text: Thank you for having saved me!
strings.talk.31883.text: I'm the number one in this city. You are unlucky!
strings.talk.31884.text: Often people only talk so much just before they are defeated! Come on!
strings.talk.31885.text: You...Bad guy! I'm really angry! I will defeat you!
strings.talk.31887.text: Wow! How strong the elder brother is! He defeated his rival down so quickly.
strings.talk.31888.text: Just so so. I was more powerful when I was young.
strings.talk.31890.text: Anybody wanna challenge me? If anybody can beat me, a big reward is waiting for you!
strings.talk.31891.text: Hey, you, dear friend, have a try?
strings.talk.31892.text: Yeah, plase take it easy. I will try in a moment.
strings.talk.31894.text: #f1/#f You are such a good swordsman, how can I defeat you?
strings.talk.31895.text: Hehe...you can challenge me when you are stronger.
strings.talk.31896.text: Great. I haven't thought there is a strong swordman like you in the capital city. This is your reward. Please take it!
strings.talk.31897.text: It seems that I should train harder.
strings.talk.31898.text: Who said that I would challenge him? I'm only here to watch it. I just stand a little further away.
strings.talk.31900.text: You, old grandpa, will you challenge that warrior?
strings.talk.31901.text: There are two people who are fighting.
strings.talk.31902.text: (There are too many people in my team. Even if I win, it's not worth mentioning.)
strings.talk.31903.text: Hi! Would you like to play hide and seek with me?
strings.talk.31904.text: Good! Get ready! I won't lose anymore!
strings.talk.31905.text: You won again. You are too strong. I have a Tying Foot which can increase the strength of Run Away. If you are willing to give me 3 stars, I will give it to you.
strings.talk.31906.text: This is the exchange office. What do you want to exchange for?
strings.talk.31910.text: Please choose the vehicle you want to exchange.
strings.talk.31915.text: Choose the item you want to exchange.
strings.talk.31916.text: Sorry, you don't have the voucher.
strings.talk.31917.text: Sorry, you don't have enough lottery tickets.
strings.talk.31918.text: Ok, this is your article you want to exchange for.
strings.talk.31933.text: Exchange for 30 Crisp Sparrows(2 lottery tickets)
strings.talk.31934.text: Exchange for 40 Garlic Sepias(3 lottery tickets)
strings.talk.31935.text: Exchange for 50 Pork Noodles.(4 lottery tickets)
strings.talk.31936.text: Exchange for Dark chocholate.(6 lottery tickets)
strings.talk.31937.text: Exchange for 2 Secular Bird's Feathers.(10 lottery tickets)
strings.talk.31939.text: Exchange for 2 Phoenix's Feathers.(15 lottery tickets)
strings.talk.31940.text: Exchange for 2 Love Bouquets.(20 lottery tickets)
strings.talk.31941.text: Exchange for Blue Devil's Spar.(30 lottery tickets)
strings.talk.31947.text: Recently, Captain Cook's honor badge given by royal queen was stolen by thieves, which made Captain Cook very angry. And he is looking everywhere for it.
strings.talk.31948.text: How is it going on the ship? Found the badge?
strings.talk.31949.text: Your honor captain, we have found all over the ship and found nothing.
strings.talk.31950.text: What about the suspects? Have you found any?
strings.talk.31951.text: Yes. A sailor disappeared in the roll calling. And he did something like that before.
strings.talk.31952.text: The sailor must have been the thief. #R#B Holy Village/#R/#B is the closest village. Take some people with you to find the thief.
strings.talk.31953.text: Excuse me, normally you are welome to visit our ship.However, we are searching for the thieves,if you don't have something important,please leave here.
strings.talk.31954.text: What did you lose?  Why you need so many people to find it?
strings.talk.31955.text: Since it was the badge given by the queen, which stands for the honor of the navy. Isn't it a serious matter to lose it?
strings.talk.31956.text: If you see any suspects nearby, inform our sailors. If the thief is caught, you will be rewarded.
strings.talk.31957.text: Yee? Why are you hiding here?
strings.talk.31958.text: Xu! Don't talk loudly, or I will be caught by Captain Cook's men.
strings.talk.31959.text: (Captain Cook? Is he the thief who stole Captain Cook's badge? What shall I do?)
strings.talk.31960.text: Call people around here to catch him!
strings.talk.31961.text: Ask him why he stole Captain Cook's badge?
strings.talk.31962.text: Are you the thief who stole the badge? Why did you steal it?
strings.talk.31963.text: Because Captain was too strict and most of us are exhausted. I wanted to escape from that ship. I wanted to warn the captain by stealing his badge.
strings.talk.31964.text: But it's not a good way for you to hide all the time. Let's make it a deal that you give the badge to me and I will persuade Captain not to catch you. Otherwise, you will be caught sooner or later.
strings.talk.31966.text: Did you give the badge to Captain Cook?
strings.talk.31967.text: Captain, I have got your badge back. The thief feels very regetful. Please forgive him.
strings.talk.31968.text: How can I?! If everybody here steals things and comes back to apologize, how can the military disciplines be carried out?
strings.talk.31969.text: Anybody might not make a mistake? The reason why the thief stole the badge is that you are too strict. You had better forgive him.
strings.talk.31970.text: (Maybe...I'm really too strict with my subordinates. If I don't have a good reflection, something more than thievery may occur.)
strings.talk.31971.text: Ok! Since the badge is back, I will forgive him. I should thank you for your help in getting it back. This reward is for you! Take it!
strings.talk.31972.text: #f2/#f You are the right person who stole Captain Cook's badge. Come on to catch the thief!
strings.talk.31973.text: Thief? Ah! You are hiding here! Catch him!
strings.talk.31974.text: Thanks for catching the thief. We are unable to catch him so easily without your help. This reward is for you. Take it!
strings.talk.31975.text: Grr! I want to tell you a secret. I have heard that there is a tomb stone near the church and some treasures left by early churchmen were put in the passage under the tomb stone. But...It's a ghost room, Ahaha!
strings.talk.31976.text: This is the tomb stone mentioned by the guy in the pub. Is there really a passage under it? Push it out and have a look at it!
strings.talk.31977.text: Goodness! It really has a passage!
strings.talk.31978.text: The knife on the wall pictures seem to be real...
strings.talk.31979.text: Ag! The knife suddenly fell down!
strings.talk.31980.text: There is a key hole, whose shape is similar to the sharp of a knife. Should I put it into it to see what will happen?
strings.talk.31981.text: Ah! The door is mysteriously opened!
strings.talk.31984.text: On hearing this, I think the secret equipment has gone.
strings.talk.31985.text: Takashi, judging from the shell of the sea turtle, it must have lived for nearly 100 years. If it is sold to the rich, it must be worth a lot of money.
strings.talk.31986.text: You'r quite right! Katou, let's tie up the sea turtle quickly.
strings.talk.31987.text: #f3/#f (The sea turtle is pitiful. We'd better save it.)
strings.talk.31988.text: #f3/#f Wait a minute. Since you want to sell the sea turtle, I will buy it. I can't not bear to think that he would be eaten by others.
strings.talk.31989.text: Youth, do you want to buy it? 100,000 gold! If the sea turtle is not so heavy, I really don't want to sell him.
strings.talk.31990.text: 100,000 gold?! How can I own so much money!!
strings.talk.31991.text: Takashi, the youth doesn't appear to be so rich. Ok, you just need answer a question. If you get the right answer, I will give you the sea turtle as a gift. Listen!
strings.talk.31992.text: Ten years ago, Takashi was 3 times as old as me. And this year, he is 50 years older than me. The question is: how old is Takashi now?
strings.talk.31993.text: En...Takashi, this youth is not only kind-hearted but also smart. What about giving him the sea turtle?
strings.talk.31994.text: Ahaha, it sounds good. But...Could you please not reveal my real age?
strings.talk.31996.text: You are free now. Go back to the sea now. Be careful! Don't be caught again!
strings.talk.31997.text: Thanks for saving me. I may die without your help.
strings.talk.31999.text: I was the resident of the Seabed Dragon Palace. I had planned to land on the island to sunbathe. But you see...I'm nearly...
strings.talk.32000.text: Well, if you like, you can climb on my back, I'll take you to the Dragon Palace.
strings.talk.32002.text: You're are climbing on my shell when you are talking...
strings.talk.32003.text: Amazing! I can also breathe under the sea.
strings.talk.32004.text: That's because I imparted you the Fin Techniques, which enabled you to swim freely like fish in the sea without being choked.
strings.talk.32005.text: Later on, if you wanna go back to land, tell me and I will take you there.
strings.talk.32006.text: Do you want to go back to the land?
strings.talk.32007.text: Are you going to the Seabed Dragon Palace?
strings.talk.32008.text: Run again? Your father ran away owing us a great deal of money. Now, you should pay for it by being our servant for the whole of your lifetime. Understand?
strings.talk.32010.text: #f2/#f The little child is in danger, I must hurry up to save him.
strings.talk.32011.text: Hold on! How can you do wrong publicly? Isn't there any law in your eyes?
strings.talk.32012.text: Wow! Ahaha! I'm the law! Since you want to be in my bad books, I will help you to be punished! Come on! Everybody! Beat him!
strings.talk.32013.text: It's Ok now, little guy, run!
strings.talk.32014.text: Yeo...Aren't you the man who interfered in our matters in the geisha hotel? The god's must have blessed me because we have met up again. Come on! Tie him up! Throw him in the Tokyo bay. Hope you can swim! AhaAha!
strings.talk.32017.text: Aaahhh! Who on earth are you?
strings.talk.32018.text: You bad guys are too humble to know my name!
strings.talk.32019.text: If you are bold enough to step further then I swear the next strike will not be so trivial.
strings.talk.32021.text: #n/#n, don't worry. Nobody can hurt you so long as I am here.
strings.talk.32022.text: Why are you standing there? Come on! Kill him!
strings.talk.32023.text: Little friend, it's really ok now. The group of bad guys have been driven off. You can go back to your family.
strings.talk.32024.text: Thanks. Kanako. Without your help, I might...
strings.talk.32025.text: Without your help, I couldn't have saved the little child.
strings.talk.32026.text: Is the comb yours? Your name is on it. I think it might be yours.
strings.talk.32027.text: Ah! Thank you very much! I thought that I had lost it.
strings.talk.32028.text: Here it is! It might help you if it is necessary. It is my gift for you.
strings.talk.32029.text: Yee? They seemed to be enemies before. What's going on?
strings.talk.32030.text: Once they wanted to murder a swordsman. But they failed because of me.
strings.talk.32031.text: These guys won't let you be. What about if we accompany each other? If so, we can look after each other.
strings.talk.32033.text: (Well, Canako's wood comb isn't with me right now...I'd better return it to her.)
strings.talk.32034.text: Ah! More bad guys are coming!
strings.talk.32035.text: The members of team are too many. The case can't be started.
strings.talk.32036.text: This transforming point is only for defenders.
strings.talk.32039.text: Youth, it's said that there are #R#B 20 /#R/#B Heaven Scrolls. I have got one here. If you can find the others for me, I will give you a magnificent gift. Ok?
strings.talk.32040.text: Here you are this is the Heaven Scroll. After #R#BMay 30th/#R/#B, you can give me any other Heaven Scrolls that you get. Then I will give you rewards. The more rolls you get, the better rewards is.
strings.talk.32041.text: After #R#BMay 30th/#R/#B, you can give me any other Heaven Books you get.
strings.talk.32042.text: Hey, sir, these are the Heaven Scrolls you need.
strings.talk.32043.text: En, good. If you exchange it now, you won't be able to exchange any further Heaven Scrolls in the future, no matter how many you have. Are you sure?
strings.talk.32044.text: Ok, if you don't exchange for it before June 13th, we will think you want to give it up.
strings.talk.32046.text: You are here. Then this Heaven Scroll is yours.
strings.talk.32047.text: Dear friend, do you want to buy the key to the Pyramids, where there are numerous treasures?
strings.talk.32048.text: It is strange! Why did't you go to get the treasures by yourself?
strings.talk.32049.text: Alas...I did want to get them myself and then I can share all the treasures. However, it's said that guards are fierce monsters. So...I have had to give up the idea.
strings.talk.32050.text: I have talked too much. Do you want to buy it? How about a little cheaper, just 30,000 gold.
strings.talk.32051.text: You are generous! So here is the key.
strings.talk.32052.text: With the key you bought from me, you can open the mysterious equipment somewhere in the pyramids, in which there is the legendary treasure.
strings.talk.32053.text: There is a hole for the key. It may be the mysterious equipment the peddler mentioned. Shall we open it with the Mears Key?
strings.talk.32054.text: Who is it? How dare you break into the Sutermos Master's Treasure House?
strings.talk.32056.text: Sutermos Master's treasures are to be given to those who have wisdom. If you can answer my questions correctly, you will have chances to get the treasures.
strings.talk.32057.text: Listen. There is a living animal, who has #R#B four feet in his childhood, two feet in his adulthood and three feet in his old age /#R/#B. What is it?
strings.talk.32058.text: It's man. Beause human beings crawl with four feets when they are babies, stand up and walk when they grow up and use a stick to assist them when they are old. So the answer is: human being.
strings.talk.32059.text: You are really smart, but you can receive the rewards after you defeat me.
strings.talk.32060.text: The statue doesn't talk. I may be wrong.
strings.talk.32062.text: Hi, old grandma, what are you doing here?
strings.talk.32063.text: Wooh! My grandson got a very strange disease. Only with the medicine made from the beard of Panax can he be saved. We are poor people. How can I get so much money to get this so precious medicine? So I'm risking come here for the Panax beard.
strings.talk.32064.text: Finding the Panax here is really not easy. Judging from it's big leaves, it must be over 1000 years old. I'm sure it can cure the disease of my grandson. While I'm too old to dig it out, would you give me a hand?
strings.talk.32067.text: Ouch! Who on earth are you?!
strings.talk.32069.text: Aaahhh! What on earth are you doing here? You are attacking me?
strings.talk.32070.text: Sorry, the granny's grandson got a strange disease and needed the Panax's beard. So...
strings.talk.32071.text: Why did you not tell me about this earlier! Instead you just started to pull hard at my hair? Hey, here you are, the Panax. I can hardly get the time have a nap when I keep getting disturbed!
strings.talk.32072.text: Hi, granny, here you are the Panax. Go and cure the disease of your grandson.
strings.talk.32073.text: Youth, I will remember you forever. This gift is for you.
strings.talk.32074.text: The Fire dragon beside you has good relationship with you. If you give me #R#B a star /#R/#B, I will help you to set a deed. Then the Fire dragon will grow up more healthily.
strings.talk.32075.text: I can help you to establish a deed with the Fire dragon in your team. While it seems that the Fire Dragon in your team is not in good relations with you, I can't help you.
strings.talk.32076.text: Hey, Ales. In the name of God, you will establish a deed with #n/#n, and the deed can be named as #R#B Soothing Soul/#R/#B!!
strings.talk.32077.text: The ceremony for the deed is over. Put the keepsake on Ales and it will grow up more healthily.
strings.talk.32078.text: Someone in the team is not qualified to get rewards because he already has them.
strings.talk.32079.text: If you want to back off to the last one, you can enter here only if you defeat the guards in it! Are you sure?
strings.talk.32080.text: The team can't accept the rewards.
strings.talk.32081.text: You can get to the desert in Egypt by canoe from here.
strings.talk.32084.text: That key can open the blue treasure boxes all around the world.
strings.talk.32085.text: Come on! There are so many articles you can choose from.
strings.talk.32086.text: It seems nothing special. I'm not interested in it.
strings.talk.32087.text: Wait! Guest, I will take out my favorite treasure. Look! It's the key.
strings.talk.32089.text: You have no sense about it. The key can open many mysterious treasure chests. I'm going to sell this magic key to you at only a price of one million! OK?
strings.talk.32091.text: My God! Why so expensive! A little cheaper?!
strings.talk.32094.text: Guest, your are good at bargaining. Ok, I will sell it to you at the cost price 20 thousand.
strings.talk.32095.text: Guest, you should be merciful! I have to raise my family... So... 10 thousand, it's under the cost!
strings.talk.32096.text: Ok! I'd better sell it to a buyer who has a better eye for a bargain.
strings.talk.32097.text: The road here has collapsed. So nobody can get through.
strings.talk.32098.text: Woo...Woo...I can't carry on anymore. I'd better jump into the river to drown my sorrows.
strings.talk.32099.text: #f2/#f Wait...Wait...! The life is precious. Why do you choose to die now?
strings.talk.32100.text: Because all of my family died in a big fire not long ago. I was lucky to get away from it. Now, I'm alone and I want to go back to my home town but I have no money. So...
strings.talk.32101.text: How much will it take to go back to your hometown? I will lend it to you.
strings.talk.32102.text: The ship and accommodation fee are at least 20,000 gold.
strings.talk.32105.text: Sorry, I am unable to help you.
strings.talk.32106.text: It seems that I have not enough money with me.
strings.talk.32107.text: Do you need a Strong Scroll to improve the weapons you bought from the item mall?
strings.talk.32108.text: I want to enhance the Dark Evil Wings.
strings.talk.32109.text: I want to enhance the angel wings.
strings.talk.32110.text: I want to enhance the Energy Halo.
strings.talk.32111.text: I want to enhance the Gold Ears.
strings.talk.32112.text: I want to enhance the Jade Ears.
strings.talk.32113.text: I want to enhance the Stand Ears.
strings.talk.32114.text: If you want to improve a certain weapon or armor, there must be the equipment in the props bar. You can purchase them in the item mall through the icon on top right corner.
strings.talk.32115.text: OK, I have improved the equipment you appointed.
strings.talk.32116.text: If you have the strong scroll with you, I can help you to improve the armors you bought in the item mall.
strings.talk.32118.text: I want to challenge the Abyssal Devil.
strings.talk.32119.text: Ok, I will take you to the place where the Abyssal Devil is.
strings.talk.32121.text: I want to enter the Training Island.
strings.talk.32122.text: It's said that Frederico has found where the Red Magic Stone is, and the whole world will be in the charge of Fredericoand King Howert. How shall we deal with it?
strings.talk.32123.text: In addition, I also know that Frederico and his subordinates would sail to Death Volcano. I don't know what they would do.
strings.talk.32124.text: Frederico sails to the Death Volcano? Where is it?
strings.talk.32125.text: Papanui is the sign of pirates, which means the hometown of stones: #R#B Revival Isle /#R/#B, I have been there when I was a pirate. There are many strange statues and a volcano on the island. It must be there.
strings.talk.32126.text: I don't know the specific location. I have heard that the place is named Lapamanui, which is only known to #R#B pirates /#R/#B.
strings.talk.32128.text: If you have the strong scroll with you, I can help you to improve the weapons you bought in the item mall.
strings.talk.32129.text: What's the matter? Why turn out to be 3 people?
strings.talk.32130.text: Roca, don't worry about the deed you set with me. My energy can destroy his boundary.
strings.talk.32131.text: Hey! You! How can you break into Fred's Forbidden Palace. You must be ready to die.
strings.talk.32133.text: #n/#n Let me deal with the situations here. Hurry to defeat Fred.
strings.talk.32134.text: #f2/#f I can't do that! How can you yourself deal with so many people?
strings.talk.32135.text: Go! I will block them. You must hurry to defeat Fred. Don't let him go.
strings.talk.32137.text: No but...! Go and beat Fred!
strings.talk.32139.text: It's you again. Are you tired of living? Ok,I will give you a hand to end it all.
strings.talk.32140.text: You...How did you break through my boundary?
strings.talk.32141.text: I see. Tim. You dare betray me?! I will let you go this time. You'll deserve it next time.
strings.talk.32143.text: They have escaped... Ah! #n/#n, let's hurry back to help Clive.
strings.talk.32144.text: You will meet Frederico if you move on. You should come with  #R/#B Roca /#R/#B.
strings.talk.32145.text: There may be many mysterious equipments. #R#B Cliff /#R/#B is familiar with this place. We'd better come with him together.
strings.talk.32148.text: Clive will leave #R#Bforever/#R/#B. Are you sure? To keep your equipment, please unequip all pet?s equipment temporarily.
strings.talk.32150.text: I didn't let even one of these soldiers pass. Did you accomplish your missions?
strings.talk.32151.text: #f3/#f We have defeated Frederico. However, he ran away before we killed him. You have been hurt badly. Let's find a place for you to have a rest.
strings.talk.32152.text: I'm very aware of my injury... #n/#n? This necklace is always with me. Now, I give it to you as a gift because I will never use it any longer. I hope it will do you a favor when you need it.
strings.talk.32153.text: I must hurry to the volcano in the #R#B Revival Isle /#R/#B.
strings.talk.32158.text: #f2/#f Clive, we will revenge for you.
strings.talk.32159.text: Please don't be so sad. Clive's death and Fred's failure is predeterminate.
strings.talk.32160.text: Although Frederico has run away, he was badly hurt. He can do nothing for a while. Clive must be proud of it.
strings.talk.32164.text: Oh, yes. He has caught a disease named Heat. This is the first time I have met this disease since I have become a doctor.
strings.talk.32166.text: Iron Medicine and Panax Beard are needed in curing this disease. They are very precious. His granny has gone out to look for it all over the mountain. But she can't find the Iron Medicine.
strings.talk.32167.text: Athough the Iron Medicine can be bought in the #R#B herd shop /#R/#B in this village, the boss is very keen on money. You can't get this kind of medicine from him without money.
strings.talk.32168.text: Hi, do you sell Iron Medicine here?
strings.talk.32169.text: Yes, I sold it at the price of 50 thousand. Since you are young, I will sell it to your at the price of 10 thousand.
strings.talk.32171.text: This is the Iron Medicine you need.
strings.talk.32172.text: I have not so much money. A little cheaper?
strings.talk.32173.text: No money? Then you can go now. Come back when you have enough money.
strings.talk.32174.text: I have bought the Iron Medicine you need. Yee? Aren't you the granny I met last time?
strings.talk.32175.text: Ah! It's you. Thank you for helping me to get the Panax Beard. And now you help me to find the Iron Medicine. I really don't know how to thank you. This gift is for you.
strings.talk.32176.text: He has just taken the medicine. He must have a rest for some time.
strings.talk.32177.text: Good. My grandson will be saved.
strings.talk.32178.text: Now, he needs a rest. Don't bother him!
strings.talk.32179.text: What...What was going on? Why are these people stunned?
strings.talk.32180.text: You must be careful. There is a witch called Medusa. If you look at her face, you too will be turned to stone!
strings.talk.32181.text: Another man wants to stop me from opening the Pandora's Box. However, you are late. The box will be opened and all people in the world will die. AhaAha!
strings.talk.32182.text: #f2/#f Oh no! I must close the Pandora's Box quickly.
strings.talk.32183.text: How...How can I be defeated by the human beings?
strings.talk.32184.text: #f2/#f Why not close the box quickly!
strings.talk.32185.text: AhaAhaha, the dark forbidden cuss has been opened and the dark energy in it will be released soon. You cannot stop it!
strings.talk.32186.text: I have finished my wish. There is no need for me to waste time here. I'll kill you when I meet you next time.
strings.talk.32187.text: I hadn't thought I would be late for just a moment. The Pandora's Box has been opened.
strings.talk.32188.text: What on earth is the Pandora's Box?
strings.talk.32189.text: Pandora's Box is a frightening box which contains all world's diseases, sorrows, fears, envy, doubts, hates, vanity and swindling which can inflict pain on people both physically and spiritually.
strings.talk.32190.text: If the box is opened,the whole world will be over.However,another article has been released which is called "hope".It will help people to cheer up,overcome difficulty bravely and get rid of disasters.
strings.talk.32191.text: So long as there is hope, everything can be made up. It can be viewed as a small joke played by the gods....
strings.talk.32192.text: I've heard that there is a Dragon Palace under the sea, in which different kinds of treasures are stored there. I really want to have a look at it.
strings.talk.32193.text: Dragon palace? I know it. I can take you there. However, there is just a scroll but not treasures.
strings.talk.32194.text: Really? That's great. Thanks. I'm waiting for you near the sea. (An old worn scroll means nothing. There must be more treasures in the Dragon Palace.)
strings.talk.32195.text: Is this the Dragon Palace? To my surprise, there are so many beautiful sisters. It is really worthy of it.
strings.talk.32196.text: People hardly came here. This gift box is for you as a present. But you must not open it before you are on the land.
strings.talk.32197.text: AhaAha, great. I know that there must be a lot of treasures in the box waiting for me there. Let me carry the heavy treasure box. I am getting out. #R#B The old sea turtle /#R/#B is waiting for me there.
strings.talk.32198.text: Hey, don't waste time. We should hurry back to the old turtle so that he can give us a ride to land. I can't helping opening the treasure box.
strings.talk.32199.text: I must open the treasure box quickly. Let's make it clear that it's my turn to take these treasures because you  have already taken away a scroll.
strings.talk.32200.text: (Coughing) Why is there so much smoke?
strings.talk.32201.text: My...My God! Why did I change like that?
strings.talk.32202.text: Hey! It is your fault! You made me change like this! Come on ! Figure out some ways to turn me back!
strings.talk.32203.text: Then I will go back to the Dragon Palace. Maybe I can change you back.
strings.talk.32204.text: Where is the beauty? A guy changed into an old and ugly man after he opened the treasure box she gave him.
strings.talk.32205.text: AhaAha! That's because the guy is too greedy. I'm just teaching him a lesson.
strings.talk.32206.text: I think he ought to be aware of this. Please forgive him.
strings.talk.32207.text: I have antidote with me. You can get it if you can beat me.
strings.talk.32208.text: You won. This is the antidote. He will change into what he was if he takes this.
strings.talk.32209.text: This is the antidote I got for you. Take it quickly! The beauty just wanted to teach you a lesson for your greediness.
strings.talk.32211.text: Thank you very much indeed. I think I won't be so greedy. This gift is for you. Thank you for your help.
strings.talk.32213.text: Medusa? Okay... I was called Medusa before. But now my name is...
strings.talk.32215.text: I want to enhance the Dark Evil Wings.
strings.talk.32216.text: I want to enhance the Sky Sword.
