strings.talk.33711.text: This is the last power that King Howert has bestowed on me. Let us die together!
strings.talk.33714.text: #n/#n, it turned out that you've helped me solve the problem again this time round.
strings.talk.33715.text: I think one of the reasons for travelling with you was to protect you, at least this time I've protected you.
strings.talk.33716.text: Jeanne, trust me, you will be fine.
strings.talk.33717.text: Seeing this situation, my journey with you might end here.
strings.talk.33718.text: At last, may God's grace bestowed upon you.
strings.talk.33719.text: I hope this grace can continue to guard you instead of me.
strings.talk.33721.text: I will never forget this journey with Jeanne D Arc In france.
strings.talk.33722.text: Beware! Jeanne D arc will leave the party, please remove equipment to avoid equipment loss.
strings.talk.33723.text: #R#BJeanne will leave the team permanently/#R/#B, are you willing?
strings.talk.40003.text: It's a fine day! Let's play beach dodgeball.
strings.talk.40009.text: Oh, there is a hole under the tree.
strings.talk.40010.text: Who are you? Go away! You are stomping on my house!!!
strings.talk.40012.text: The ground you stamping on and the empty tree is my house.
strings.talk.40013.text: The tree? That's why the leaves are faded.
strings.talk.40014.text: I can do anything that I want to. It's none of your business.
strings.talk.40016.text: I defeat you, you should leave here right now!
strings.talk.40018.text: East of the KaMa Cave. South of Welling Village.
strings.talk.40019.text: Oh, my dear son, where are you? I miss you so much!
strings.talk.40020.text: Several days ago, some people held a celebration on the beach. My dear son went to watch. But until now, he hasn't come back. Could you help me to find him?
strings.talk.40021.text: (Celebration? Did he go to the #R#B Village /#R/#B with humans? The little river boy may be in danger!)
strings.talk.40022.text: My dear son wanted to see the human's celebration...
strings.talk.40024.text: That's a monster over there. It looks very strange. Fortunately, it doesn't want to attack us!
strings.talk.40025.text: There was a human celebration not long ago, I was attracted by it and fellowed human come here.why human here always scream when they see me? I'm afraid,so I hide here.Can you help me find my Mother?
strings.talk.40026.text: Fool, never do it again, come on, I take you to find your mother.
strings.talk.40028.text: Stop! Give me the River Boy behind you!
strings.talk.40030.text: Whether he did harm or not, he is a monster.
strings.talk.40031.text: Right, they are monsters, why not get along well with them?
strings.talk.40032.text: Get along well with them? Do you know how many fishermen were attacked by river boys?!
strings.talk.40033.text: Villager live on fishing, but river boys also need food, why not bear it?
strings.talk.40034.text: You're right, I think we need mutual understanding.
strings.talk.40035.text: Oh, my dear son, I missed you so much but I didn't know where you were!
strings.talk.40036.text: Sorry, mom. I'll never do it again.
strings.talk.40037.text: Thanks for your help, this is the gift.
strings.talk.40038.text: Oh, my dear, let's go back.
strings.talk.40040.text: I hope all the world is peaceful forever!
strings.talk.40041.text: Little river boy, why do you come here alone? Your mom is so worried about you!
strings.talk.40042.text: Come with me to find your mother!
strings.talk.40043.text: How can I do the fungus soup if there are not enough mushrooms?
strings.talk.40045.text: Yes, I want to cook it for my grandson. But there are not enough mushrooms in the village.
strings.talk.40047.text: I need #R#B Mushroom*2, Su Mushroom*2, Fungus*2, Brazil Mushroom*1 and Sun Mushroom*2 /#R/#B.
strings.talk.40048.text: Here, these are all the mushrooms that you needed.
strings.talk.40049.text: Thanks! This is the gift for it.
strings.talk.40050.text: I need #R#B Mushroom*2, Su Mushroom*2, Dried Mushroom*2, Brazil Mushroom*1 and Sun Mushroom*2 /#R/#B.
strings.talk.40051.text: I'll go and find some for you!
strings.talk.40052.text: Yuna, why have you come here?
strings.talk.40053.text: Oh, long time no see. I want to pick up some flowers here, but the villagers is not friendly to me. Can you help me?
strings.talk.40054.text: Of course. Whant kind of flowers do you want?
strings.talk.40055.text: I need #R#B Blue Wild Flower*1, Small Daisy*6, Persian Mum*1 and Chrysanthemum*2 /#R/#B. Thank you!
strings.talk.40056.text: Here, these are all the flowers that you needed.
strings.talk.40057.text: Thanks! This is the gift for it.
strings.talk.40058.text: These flowers have been collected, it's time to go back my village. Thank you.
strings.talk.40059.text: I need #R#B Blue Wild Flower*1, Small Daisy*6, Persian Mum*1 and Chrysanthemum*2 /#R/#B.
strings.talk.40061.text: Oh! You! Do you want to challenge me again?
strings.talk.40062.text: Challenge you? Do you forget that I defeated you last time?
strings.talk.40063.text: I was not very lucky last time! I'll be winner this time!
strings.talk.40065.text: Disgusting! Never let me meet you again! (escape...)
strings.talk.40070.text: I think you love me! So you follow me!
strings.talk.40071.text: I love you? Oh, that's impossible!
strings.talk.40072.text: Oh, I loss it again, I don't love you any more! (shy)
strings.talk.40074.text: If you told me that you love me, then I might accept your affections.
strings.talk.40075.text: Hi, uncle, what are you doing?
strings.talk.40076.text: Please speak lowly! You may scare my prey.
strings.talk.40078.text: Youth, can you use the gun?
strings.talk.40080.text: Speak lowly! I'll give you a reward if you help me to catch the prey.
strings.talk.40086.text: Oh, uncle, you are still hunting here?!!
strings.talk.40087.text: I am just inspecting the gun. I need a more powerful gun with longer cannon-shot.
strings.talk.40088.text: I have a design. Maybe, it can help you!
strings.talk.40090.text: Oh! I finished! Do you want to have a try?
strings.talk.40092.text: I think it's a good idea to give you the gun!
strings.talk.40094.text: This is your reward for your help.
strings.talk.40096.text: You are not good at it. Please practice more then come back and try again.
strings.talk.40097.text: I think you are good at shooting. Make good use of it.
strings.talk.40099.text: Uncle, could I use the gun again?
strings.talk.40103.text: Where is the hero from the legend.
strings.talk.40104.text: Where is Charlotte? The Elder is looking for her.
strings.talk.40105.text: Is this Holy Land in Alfer? The hometown of the elves?
strings.talk.40106.text: Can you hear the murmur of trees?
strings.talk.40107.text: Excuse me, what are you doing here?
strings.talk.40108.text: I am fixing the Giant Statue. But it keeps being destroyed over and over again, I can't finish fixing it.
strings.talk.40109.text: It seems that someone is doing it on purpose, the village leader had sent someone to look into the matter. But we still can't find the culprit.
strings.talk.40110.text: Do you have any clues? Maybe I can help you?
strings.talk.40111.text: Let me see...Oh! Yes! The Giant Statue #R#B At the seaside /#R/#B keeps being badly broken time after time.
strings.talk.40112.text: You can go to take a look at #R#B the seaside/#R/#B, maybe you will find something there.
strings.talk.40114.text: (It is the crab that who is the culprit)
strings.talk.40116.text: Don't call me crab! I am the Hermit Crab!
strings.talk.40118.text: Since you are the Hermit Crab, where is your shell?
strings.talk.40119.text: Shell? Do you mean my house? Can't you see that I am digging my house?
strings.talk.40120.text: Please! You are breaking the Giant Statue! It's the vestige of the world!
strings.talk.40121.text: What does the Giant Statue mean? And what does the vestige of the world mean? I only know that I must dig a house.
strings.talk.40122.text: If you find a house for me, I will stop digging.
strings.talk.40123.text: OK! I will find a house for you. After that you must stop digging.
strings.talk.40124.text: Let's take things as they come.
strings.talk.40126.text: (What will be the right object to be its house? Ah! #R#B shell of the coconut/#R/#B, there are so many coconuts on the island, surely I can make use of them.)
strings.talk.40127.text: Mr. Hermit Crab! I have found a house for you. Do you like it?
strings.talk.40128.text: I will try it on... Oh! It's the right size and my favorite color. I have a house now! I won't need to dig up the big stones anymore.
strings.talk.40129.text: Ok, so you promise that you won't dig up the Giant Statue again?
strings.talk.40130.text: Ok! I will keep my word. Ha-ha! I will go to show my new house off to other hermit crabs.
strings.talk.40131.text: The full story had already come out. I must go to tell the engraver.
strings.talk.40134.text: The destroyer is a self-righteous Hermit Crab. He dug up the Giant Statue in order to make a house for himself.
strings.talk.40135.text: I had given him a house. You can be assured that he won't dig up the Giant Statue again.
strings.talk.40136.text: Really? That's great! Thank you very much; We insist that you accept this gift.
strings.talk.40137.text: Open it with #R#B the key of the rusty box/#R/#B.
strings.talk.40138.text: Alas, what can I do? It seems that the storm is coming soon.
strings.talk.40139.text: Aunt, what are you worrying about?
strings.talk.40141.text: En...my husband went fishing this morning, but the storm is coming soon, I am very worried about him.
strings.talk.40142.text: Is that all! I will go out to sea to find him. Just relax.
strings.talk.40143.text: Ah, what's the name of your husband... ?
strings.talk.40144.text: His name is #B#R He Qi/#B/#R. I'm sorry to have put you to trouble. I hope you go and return quickly.
strings.talk.40145.text: My husband was going to the #B#R south-western of the sea/#B/#R, it must be not far from here.
strings.talk.40146.text: Ok, I will take care of it. I will go now.
strings.talk.40147.text: My husband was going to the #B#R south-western of the sea/#B/#R
strings.talk.40148.text: Excuse me, are you He Qi?
strings.talk.40150.text: The storm is coming soon your wife is very worried about you! She hopes you can go back soon.
strings.talk.40151.text: Uh,oh! I forgot to observe the weather. I must go home right now Thank you very much, youth.
strings.talk.40152.text: Don't be angry, sweet heart. I will observe the weather next time.
strings.talk.40154.text: Don't be angry, aunt. Uncle forgot to observe the weather because he has to support the family. He will pay attention to it from now on.
strings.talk.40156.text: Do you know how much I worry about you? What can I do if you were overtaken by a storm?
strings.talk.40157.text: You should take care of yourself for the sake of Chunchun and our old mother.
strings.talk.40159.text: It's said that the couple quarrel every morning and make it up every evening. Uncle will definitely remember what Aunt said. Please forgive him, Aunt!
strings.talk.40160.text: Ok! As this youth says, I will forgive you this time, if you do that again I won't forgive you. Umph!
strings.talk.40161.text: Thank you for saving my careless husband before the storm hits. I have got a little gift for you!
strings.talk.40162.text: Thank you for saving my careless husband before the storm. Youth.
strings.talk.40163.text: The weather is fit for fishing.
strings.talk.40164.text: I will be sure to observe the weather at all times.
strings.talk.40165.text: Young, help me to persuade my wife to not be so angry!
strings.talk.40166.text: Hey Jade Rabbit, where are you?
strings.talk.40167.text: Please tell me what's the matter with you?
strings.talk.40168.text: You ask what's bothering me? My jade rabbit has left me alone in the mortal world, without telling me and I am very worried about it.
strings.talk.40169.text: Your Jade Rabbit? So you must be Chang-er?
strings.talk.40170.text: Yes, I am. Youth, could you please help me to find it?
strings.talk.40171.text: Certainly, I will go to find your jade rabbit. Wait here for my good news!
strings.talk.40172.text: Wait a moment, my servant told me that the Jade Rabbit is very fond of China. So maybe it went to#R#BChina/#B/#Rto have some fun.
strings.talk.40173.text: Jade rabbit, you know how much Chang-er cares about you.  How could just leave like that without telling her?
strings.talk.40174.text: Oh no! She has caught me again. I suppose that is the end of my fun then.
strings.talk.40175.text: You must come back with me.  Chang-er is very worried about you.
strings.talk.40176.text: No, I don't want to. I', m having too much fun here.
strings.talk.40177.text: Don't you care about your owner?  You must come back with me.
strings.talk.40178.text: Only once you have beat me.
strings.talk.40179.text: I can't believe that I lost. You have been cheating! Yes, you must have used some tricks on me!
strings.talk.40180.text: Oh, it's you again! Well you can just tell Sister Chang'er that I will come back once I have had enough fun.
strings.talk.40181.text: I won last time, but you escaped before I could capture you.  Now I won't let that happen again. I will take you back to Chang-er, that's a promise.
strings.talk.40182.text: No! We have to fight again.
strings.talk.40183.text: See, I won again!  Now you will come back with me.
strings.talk.40184.text: Uh-uh! Only after you have caught me.
strings.talk.40185.text: That was the last chance that I would have given you. Now I will teach you a lesson!
strings.talk.40187.text: If that is the only way, then so be it.
strings.talk.40188.text: Now you have to go back to see Chang-er with me.
strings.talk.40190.text: Jade Rabbit, my dear. I was so worried about you. You must promise never to run away from me again.
strings.talk.40191.text: But it is so boring here. And you have no time to play with me. I am so lonely!
strings.talk.40192.text: You never told me that you were lonely. I can ask my servants to play with you.
strings.talk.40193.text: But it is only you I want to play with not your servants. (Crying...)
strings.talk.40194.text: Well, well~ stop crying. I will play with you. Is this okay?
strings.talk.40196.text: Youth, thank you. Please accept my many thanks. Now I will take the Jade Rabbit to the Cold Palace. I hope that we can meet again, in fact I'm sure that we will.
strings.talk.40197.text: The Cold Palace?  I have never heard of it before.  I hope the Jade Rabbit and Chang-er can live together happily forever there.
strings.talk.40198.text: My servant told me that the Jade Rabbit is very fond of China. So he may have gone to #R#BChina/#B/#Rto have some fun. Also the#R#BJade Rabbit likes to hide in holes/#B/#R?If you wish to find it then you must keep your eyes open.
strings.talk.40199.text: How fast that Jade Rabbit ran away! Now I must find him all over again!
strings.talk.40200.text: This is private property. All trespassers will be severely punished.
strings.talk.40201.text: God. Please bless my husband with a speedy recovery from his illness.
strings.talk.40202.text: Did you go to Buddha's Temple every day?
strings.talk.40203.text: Yes, since my husband fell ill through overwork, I come here everyday to pray to God to bless my busband.
strings.talk.40204.text: I'm sure that God will hear you and help your husband to have a speedy recovery.
strings.talk.40206.text: The Court Jester has begun to commit evil acts. He may be placing our Country in terrible trouble.
strings.talk.40208.text: Youth, I think that it may be safer for you if you do not know all of the details.  That you may avoid trouble.
strings.talk.40209.text: Please, tell me, maybe I can help you.
strings.talk.40210.text: Premier Trados has begun to get rid of people who hold different political opinions.
strings.talk.40211.text: Today, he presented the King with an ox as a gift but told the king that it was a horse. However, anyone in the court who dared to contradict him by saying that it was an ox would be killed.
strings.talk.40212.text: He is hell bent on taking over.  Is there no way to stop him?
strings.talk.40213.text: Actually, the horse I have beside me was also to be a tribute to the King. But, after watching Trados's  actions earlier I am too scared to present it to him.
strings.talk.40214.text: Even though I am willing to sacrifice my life to tell King the truth, I still have to consider the safety of my family members.
strings.talk.40215.text: How about if I were to present the horse to King on your behalf you?  And in the process tell him about Trados's plot.
strings.talk.40216.text: Youth, I, Duckriver believe that you will definately succeed. Here take my black horse and present to the King. The fate of our Country rests with you. Good luck!
strings.talk.40217.text: Your Majesty, may I present you with this black horse, a gift from Korea.
strings.talk.40218.text: Wow! What a horse. It's really amazing. Premier, you have opened my eyes. Now I will send the Treasurer to dispatch a box of gold to your mansion.
strings.talk.40219.text: Thank you very much, your Majesty. Please let me arrange for someone to take the horse to Royal Gardens.
strings.talk.40220.text: Wait! That is not a horse but an ox!
strings.talk.40221.text: Who said that this is not a horse?  How dare you!
strings.talk.40222.text: You dare to try and cheat the King?  When we can all see that is clearly an ox.
strings.talk.40223.text: My majesty, this is real horse. Don't be taken in by Trados. He just wants to steal your gold by lying you.
strings.talk.40224.text: Aaah!  You ruined my plan!  Your Majesty, please listen to me.   This young fool is the one who is lying.  I would never dare to cheat you.
strings.talk.40225.text: You need not give me any explanations.  I have decided to spare your life this time, so that you may return to your hometown and enjoy your life of  retirement with your ox.
strings.talk.40226.text: Your Majesty I'm afraid that I must be going now.
strings.talk.40227.text: Youth, thank you for exposing Trados's plot.  This is to reward you.
strings.talk.40228.text: Your  Majesty, in fact this horse is a tribute from Duckriver. If you wish to reward somebody it should be him.
strings.talk.40229.text: Duckriver! I see! So it is all thanks to him. With that in mind I shall appoint Duckriver as my new Premier
strings.talk.40230.text: You may present your black horse to King now.
strings.talk.40231.text: Bangkok has become a prosperous city through all of the new premier's hardwork. Don't you agree my friend?
strings.talk.40232.text: Curses!  Just wait I will surely get my revenge on you.
strings.talk.40233.text: As for you, youth, please accept this reward. If it was not for you, I would never have known about Trados's plot.
strings.talk.40234.text: Thank you your Majesty, it is my honor to accept this reward.
strings.talk.40235.text: Please tell me aren't you Santa Claus?
strings.talk.40237.text: Youth, since you have found out my true identity, please could you help me to find my lost bells.
strings.talk.40239.text: I have 3 special bells that mean a lot to me, the 2013 Wish Bell, 2013 Safety Bell and 2013 Christmas Bell. I must have dropped them on my way here. Could you help me find it?
strings.talk.40240.text: Ok, I will find them for you.
strings.talk.40241.text: Youth, you are a promising youth...
strings.talk.40242.text: (What is connection between finding the bells and being a promising youth? strange?)
strings.talk.40243.text: Have you found my bells yet? I'll repeat, it's the 2013 Wish Bell, 2013 Safety Bell and 2013 Christmas Bell.
strings.talk.40244.text: Yes sir, I have found them all. Here you are.
strings.talk.40245.text: Great, here is your reward. When you hang them up on a Christmas tree they will produce an unbelievable power. Do you have the time to help me to find more bells?
strings.talk.40247.text: Yes, it is my fault that I have lost so many. I must find the three kinds of bells before 28th.
strings.talk.40248.text: I see. Ok, I will help you.
strings.talk.40249.text: Come here, so that I may give you the prize that you deserve.
strings.talk.40251.text: Aaahh you have finally come!  I have been waiting here for more than 4000 years.
strings.talk.40252.text: Who said that?  Who is talking to me?
strings.talk.40253.text: It is me, the monster that wishes to lead you to the Magic World.
strings.talk.40255.text: Let me join your team and I will guide you to the Magic World.
strings.talk.40256.text: Here is the entrance to the Magic World.  Now that I have fullfilled my task, I will return to the world where I belong.
strings.talk.40257.text: What, are you leaving?  Why aren't you going to travel with me?
strings.talk.40258.text: Sadly, I cannot go with you.  Please take care of yourself.
strings.talk.40259.text: Please, don't leave me. You haven't told anything about the magic world yet.
strings.talk.40260.text: The Directing Monster asks to leave the team. Do you agree or disgree?
strings.talk.40261.text: It is written on the paper: Without the help of the  Directing Monster, this road will be endless.
strings.talk.40262.text: Alas!  When is the right time to express my adoration?
strings.talk.40264.text: Ah, It is not polite to eavesdrop.
strings.talk.40265.text: Eavesdrop? No, I was just passing through and happened to overhear what you said.
strings.talk.40266.text: Don't worry, it's my own fault.  I just can't hold my true feelings in.
strings.talk.40267.text: So you say you are in love with someone?
strings.talk.40268.text: Yes, to tell you the truth, I am adoring #B#R Xaohui, the daughter of hotel owner in Chang'an City/#B/#R.
strings.talk.40269.text: Have you ever told Xaohui that you like her?
strings.talk.40270.text: Tell her? No! I don't dare to.
strings.talk.40271.text: Let me think how I can help you. Is this Xaohui's portrait?  You must present it to her as a gift.  Then she will understand your feelings.
strings.talk.40272.text: Do you think that will work?
strings.talk.40273.text: It can't hurt! Here let me help you to give this picture to her.
strings.talk.40275.text: Excuse me, would you like a room or are you just taking a break.
strings.talk.40277.text: Yes, I am. Is there anything I can do for you?
strings.talk.40278.text: Do you know the picture vendor in the street?
strings.talk.40279.text: Yes, I know him. What's wrong with him?
strings.talk.40280.text: Here is a painting that he has done of you. I believe that you will understand his true feelings for you after you have taken a look at it.
strings.talk.40281.text: Actually, I do know how he feels about me.  But I'm not sure that my father can accept him.
strings.talk.40283.text: Ahem!  I have heard everything. You were talking too loud.
strings.talk.40285.text: Xaohui, you are a big girl now! It is the time for you to find your Mr.Right. That young man out there has shown you his true feelings and I believe him to be sincere and that he will bring you happiness.
strings.talk.40286.text: Also, I have noticed that whenever you pass by his stall, you always look at him secretly. You are already in love with him. Why don't you let this man act as your match maker?
strings.talk.40287.text: Dad, I.... I don't know what to say......
strings.talk.40288.text: Since your father agrees to the match, I will go to tell your suitor the good news. I am sure he will make his proposal soon.
strings.talk.40290.text: By the way, sir, may I know your name?
strings.talk.40293.text: What is the good news?  Does Xaohui know of my feelings?
strings.talk.40294.text: Much better than that! In fact, Xaohui has already fallen in love with you. But she is too shy to tell you.
strings.talk.40295.text: So you can prepare to propose to her.
strings.talk.40296.text: Proposal...I can't. I do not have enough money to pay to her family.
strings.talk.40300.text: Since you both truly love each other, I want to do you a favor. Here this is the money that you will need to present to her family.
strings.talk.40302.text: Yes, I am serious. Take it.
strings.talk.40303.text: Thank you so much.  Here please take this, it is a family heirloom, I want you to have it.
strings.talk.40304.text: Hehe! Thank you. I hope you will marry her as soon as possible.
strings.talk.40305.text: Sir, would you like to drink something?
strings.talk.40306.text: Have you given the picture #B/#Rto the dauther of hotel owner/#B/#R??
strings.talk.40307.text: Have you told#B/#Rthe piciture vendor /#B/#Rto prepare his proposal?
strings.talk.40309.text: I will treat Xaohui like a queen.
strings.talk.40311.text: This pearl must be a very rare treasure...
strings.talk.40312.text: It would better for me not to take it...
strings.talk.40313.text: Who dares to steal my pearl?
strings.talk.40314.text: Ah, what?  Oh no, a dragon!
strings.talk.40316.text: Wah!  Where is that thunder coming from?  It sounds like it is coming from the bottom of the ocean.  But how can that be?
strings.talk.40317.text: I must teach you a lesson...
strings.talk.40318.text: What power you have. . .are you the savior from the legend. Please, forgive my rudeness.
strings.talk.40319.text: How did such a big pearl get here?  And why do you turn up suddenly?
strings.talk.40320.text: This is not a pearl, but the Holy Ball which guards the whole ocean. If it is ever moved, a giant tsunami will come and the whole world will be flooded.
strings.talk.40321.text: How terrible! Thank goodness that I did not move it.
strings.talk.40322.text: So it is your job to bear this heavy responsibility.
strings.talk.40323.text: Yes this is my duty.  So I hope that you can understand my rudeness.  Please accept this present with my most heartfelt apologies.
strings.talk.40324.text: No, it is my fault, really. I dare not imagine the results if I really had moved this Holy Ball!  Thank you for stopping me.
strings.talk.40325.text: To ensure the everlasting peace of this ocean, I will willingly guard here for all eternity.
strings.talk.40326.text: This... looks like a turtle's shell?
strings.talk.40327.text: That is the Holy Ball which guards the whole ocean.
strings.talk.40328.text: What?  This is a turtle shell.  What's hiding inside.?
strings.talk.40329.text: I need an iron bar to lever the shell open.
strings.talk.40330.text: Wait, wait! What? An iron bar? I am not a bad turtle! What would make you want to treat me like this?
strings.talk.40332.text: Alive?Of course, I am alive. Young man, you don't show me enough respect.
strings.talk.40333.text: Since you are here, let me play a game with you. I will give you a little present if you win.
strings.talk.40334.text: OK I will play the game with you.
strings.talk.40335.text: You are so clumsy!  But you are still so young I cannot imagine what you will be like when get older. You should have to take more exercise.
strings.talk.40337.text: Young man, what a good job you have done. I am true to my word. This is the present for you.
strings.talk.40338.text: Thank you very much Mr. Turtle.
strings.talk.40339.text: That's OK.  I am going back to sleep now so leave me alone.
strings.talk.40340.text: Hey, do you want play a game with me? Is that OK?
strings.talk.40341.text: OK, naughty fish, what do you want to play?
strings.talk.40342.text: I want to play hiding and seeking game.  Do you know how to play?
strings.talk.40343.text: (play hide and seek with naughty fish?)
strings.talk.40344.text: Unfortunately I have something important to do so I can't play with you.  I'm very sorry.
strings.talk.40345.text: Ok, I will play with you.
strings.talk.40346.text: You are the seeker. Now you count from 1 to 10.
strings.talk.40348.text: I'm ready. Come and find me.
strings.talk.40349.text: Wow. I can't believe you found me so quickly. Please can we play again.
strings.talk.40350.text: Now naughty fish must hide somewhere nearby.
strings.talk.40351.text: Ah, You found me again. Please play with me again.
strings.talk.40352.text: Er...all right.!You find somewhere to hide I promise I will not peep.
strings.talk.40353.text: You are so good at this game. Next time you must promise to play with me.
strings.talk.40354.text: OK I will come back to play with you when I am free.
strings.talk.40355.text: The old sea turtle is sleeping. Don't wake him up.
strings.talk.40356.text: Ah? There is something shining that nest?
strings.talk.40359.text: Ah! Don't be angry, bird mother. I only want to take the Ocean Heart, I will leave immediately.
strings.talk.40362.text: Old Grandma, why do you call it Dead Vale?
strings.talk.40363.text: Hehe, it is said that many brave men came here to find the Angel so they can obtain #B#R the Bright Shield/#B/#R.
strings.talk.40364.text: But, for some unknown reason, no one ever came back alive. So people call it the Dead Vale.
strings.talk.40365.text: (Ah, it is quite possible that the Bright Shield may be hidden there )
strings.talk.40366.text: There are no angels or demons in world. All of them have been created by humans.
strings.talk.40369.text: (Oh no! I stood on branch and it has made a loud noise.)
strings.talk.40370.text: What was that?  Who is over there?
strings.talk.40371.text: (I am taken aback for a while because I have been heard.)I am sorry but I didn't see anything.
strings.talk.40373.text: Sorry do you think that it would be better for me leave here for a while?
strings.talk.40374.text: Since she is the only one feeling embarrassed, I will just wait here and see what happens.
strings.talk.40375.text: Wait, where are my clothes? Have you hidden them?
strings.talk.40376.text: No, I didn't see anything since I have been here.
strings.talk.40377.text: So what can I do now?  How can I get home?
strings.talk.40378.text: Why don't you stay in water and I will help you to find your clothes.
strings.talk.40379.text: En, thank you so much for helping me.
strings.talk.40380.text: Wow!  The wind is really strong. It's possible that her clothes were blown away by it.
strings.talk.40381.text: It's just as I thought.  My clothes were blown away by the wind. I should find a #B#R ladder/#B/#Rto go and fetch them.
strings.talk.40382.text: I must return her clothes as soon as I can.
strings.talk.40383.text: Here are your clothes. Please put them on quickly. I promise that I won't peep.
strings.talk.40385.text: Take a peep, maybe she won't notice.
strings.talk.40386.text: You can ask ask her for the Bright Shield after she puts her clothes on.
strings.talk.40392.text: Yes, I am an angel. My name is Angela
strings.talk.40394.text: Hehe, I was testing you and you have passed it. You have proved yourself to be a genuine and helpful savior.
strings.talk.40395.text: (Actually I was struggling with my heart...)
strings.talk.40396.text: I know you came here to get the secret of the Bright Shield.
strings.talk.40397.text: (Cool!)Yes, I really want to know the secret of the Bright Shield.
strings.talk.40398.text: The Bright Shield is a holy weapon from the immortal world. It can help you to defeat King Howert. Since you have passed my test, I will give it to you.
strings.talk.40399.text: But the Bright Shield can be used once, then it will disappear. So you have to be very careful how you use it.  You only get one chance so don't waste it.
strings.talk.40400.text: Wait, King Howert is not that easy to defeat. So if I make a mistake when using the Bright Shield, will it be destroyed?
strings.talk.40401.text: Yes, but when you compare failing to kill King Howert to losing the sword, then there is no choice. So you just have to bide your time until the right opportunity presents itself.
strings.talk.40402.text: Would you be willing to join my team to look for King Howert. When the opportunity comes, you can teach me how to use the Bright Shield.
strings.talk.40404.text: Please don't hesitate. I'm sure that with your help we can find King Howert quickly.
strings.talk.40405.text: Ok, but I must leave as soon as the task has been completed.
strings.talk.40407.text: I must return with my Jade Rabbit. Take care of yourself, young man.
strings.talk.40408.text: I should help her find her clothes or she may catch a cold. I will go to the #B#RDead Vale/#B/#Rto look for them.
strings.talk.40410.text: Oh dear! There is #B/#R no Rabbit's Mashu /#B/#R available?what can my Jade Rabbit eat instead?
strings.talk.40411.text: Grandma, does your jade rabbit only eat Rabbit's Mashu?
strings.talk.40412.text: Yes. It is the only thing it can eat. If it eats anything else it is likely to become ill...
strings.talk.40413.text: Do you know where to buy Rabbit's Mashu?
strings.talk.40414.text: Grandma, I have some Mashu that I can spare for your Jade Rabbit.  I will happily give it to you.
strings.talk.40415.text: Young man, thank you. By the way, why have you come here?
strings.talk.40416.text: I came here to look for the legendary holy weapon.
strings.talk.40417.text: I was hoping ask you something.
strings.talk.40419.text: Honestly, I did not spy on you bathing on purpose. I didn't know that you were there.
strings.talk.40420.text: (I have one rabbit's mashu available. Give it to this grandma?)
strings.talk.40421.text: I feel so sorry for the Jade Rabbit, he is so hungry.  I will give the mashu to the grandma.
strings.talk.40422.text: Mashu is such a rare item.  How can I give it to her so easily.
strings.talk.40424.text: I don't have any mashu. Sorry.
strings.talk.40425.text: My rabbit is so cute, isn't he?
strings.talk.40426.text: Where am I from?  I am from wherever I go.  I am a floating cloud.
strings.talk.40427.text: Wow, what a beautiful voice. You are a bard?
strings.talk.40429.text: What a pity.  I have no home, where am I from is wherever I go ...
strings.talk.40430.text: So let me play you some songs and then you can guess their names.
strings.talk.40431.text: Ok play for me and let me guess.
strings.talk.40435.text: Sorry, could you play it once again.
strings.talk.40441.text: Correct. Young man, what a good job you have done. You must know a lot about music.
strings.talk.40442.text: Young man, do you want to listen to me playing songs?
strings.talk.40444.text: Thanks. I've heard of them.(little star, honey bee and two tigers are quite famous. Everyone knows their names.)
strings.talk.40445.text: Here is the prize for you .  I hope you can make good use of it.
strings.talk.40446.text: The Village Leader has asked me to restore these giant statues. But they are so slippery that I can't climb to the top of them...
strings.talk.40447.text: (Prepare #B#R a ladder for him /#B/#R, then he may climb to the top and restore these giant statues.)
strings.talk.40450.text: Oh, that is great. Thanks! This is the gift to express my thanks.
strings.talk.40451.text: Thanks for your ladder. Now I can restore giant statues very quickly.
strings.talk.40452.text: How on earth to climb up? It's too difficult.
strings.talk.40454.text: I have been hiding here for thousand of years.  I never thought I would be found.
strings.talk.40455.text: It is fate that has brought us together.  Let me present you with this gift as a token of our friendship.
strings.talk.40457.text: Welcome to the Hanging Garden.  This is a beatiful city. Don't you agree?
strings.talk.40459.text: The King built this city for the Queen. Now even though hundreds of years have passed. It is still magnificent.
strings.talk.40460.text: A stately building and a sad love story are all that is left of them....
strings.talk.40461.text: A stately building and a sad love story. What is this sad love story?
strings.talk.40462.text: The king built this city for his Queen. But the Queen died before it could be completed leaving the King living in this empty castle alone...
strings.talk.40463.text: Qiqi stole my puppet and now I don't know where he is. How can I get my puppet back?
strings.talk.40464.text: (Help her to get the puppet back?)
strings.talk.40465.text: Let me help you get the puppet back.
strings.talk.40466.text: Are you serious? Thanks so much.
strings.talk.40467.text: I hid the puppet here. Angeli must not find it.
strings.talk.40469.text: Wow!  You are really scared me. You should learn to make noise when you walk.
strings.talk.40470.text: Why do you not answer me. Why have you hidden Angeli's puppet here?
strings.talk.40471.text: She never wants to play with me when she has that stupid puppet.(shy)
strings.talk.40472.text: So, you are jealous of puppet?
strings.talk.40473.text: All right, give puppet to me and I will tell Angeli to play with you.
strings.talk.40474.text: En, deal. I give you the puppet but you have to tell Angeli to play with me.
strings.talk.40476.text: Strange, the puppet seems to stare at me.
strings.talk.40477.text: Oh you got my puppet back. Thank you so much.
strings.talk.40478.text: Qiqi only wanted to play with you but you ignored him, so he stole your puppet.
strings.talk.40479.text: But the puppet has told me not to play with Qiqi.
strings.talk.40480.text: The puppet talks to you!  Let me see. There something must be unnatural with it.
strings.talk.40482.text: I am waiting for the moment when I can become reborn into this young girl's body. But you have a much more powerful body than her. So I will choose you instead. I can not wait. I want you.
strings.talk.40485.text: I have fallen asleep and had a terrible dream.
strings.talk.40487.text: The puppet had become a monster. It is much safer to play with Qiqi not the puppet.
strings.talk.40488.text: Oh no! I can not let this monster get my body!
strings.talk.40489.text: I give the puppet to you. You have to tell Angeli to come to play with me.
strings.talk.40490.text: Have you got my puppet back?
strings.talk.40494.text: I'd better to think a way out of here.
strings.talk.40495.text: Are you Robinson? Why are you here?
strings.talk.40496.text: I woke up from my sleep to see a giant sea monster swallow up the whole island ...
strings.talk.40497.text: Yes, but you know how to get out of here?
strings.talk.40498.text: Can you see the cave over there?
strings.talk.40499.text: Oh, that cave. Can I get out of here through that way.
strings.talk.40500.text: That cave only opens at special times.   You must wait.
strings.talk.40502.text: You maybe don't understand what I mean. Here take this. Wait outside the cave for a while and the door will surely open.
strings.talk.40504.text: I cannot. I have become too accustomed to living here. You'd better leave here quickly.

strings.talk.40506.text: Yes. You'd better take it to the cave gate, wait there for while and then you can leave here.
strings.talk.40507.text: Thank you, you are so kind.
strings.talk.40508.text: It seems that there is no way to get out of here without #B#R special jalap /#B/#R...

strings.talk.40695.text: I need to find out what happened.

strings.talk.40787.text: In thousands of years, you're the first one to pass that test...
strings.talk.40789.text: We should ascend back to the heavens now.
strings.talk.40790.text: Come have a look, great medicines from Chang'an!
strings.talk.40791.text: You are not allowed to come in.
strings.talk.40792.text: You shouldn't be here, please leave.
strings.talk.40793.text: Young man, hear my questions now.
strings.talk.40794.text: Young man, you need more training.
strings.talk.40795.text: Am I going to end my life today?
strings.talk.40796.text: Uncle is surrounded by a lot of poisonous flowers!
strings.talk.40801.text: Thank you for helping me, as well as your friend. What is his name?
strings.talk.40805.text: Don't worry about it, just take it. I insist.
strings.talk.40807.text: #n/#n, you and Louis are good at shooting, don't stop practicing!
strings.talk.40811.text: The Priest caught the King. He wants to exchange the King's Heart with his Lover's Soul and build a Mummy Army...
strings.talk.40812.text: If you don't kill all the Mummies and the Priest within #R25 Minutes/#R, the King will die!
strings.talk.40813.text: Dare you stop me from saving my lover?!
strings.talk.40814.text: You killed my lover!!! I need to use your heart to bring her back to life!
strings.talk.40815.text: Priest, please let me go. Reviving the dead is strictly forbidden!
strings.talk.40816.text: Thank you for saving me from the Priest... Please take this.
strings.talk.40817.text: You want to kill me?! Kill my followers first! (#RKill all of the mummies/#R)
strings.talk.40818.text: It's time to retire... Give this gun to Louis... Hopefully he'll use it properly.
strings.talk.40819.text: Anyone can become a marksman, it just takes practice!
strings.talk.40820.text: Thank you, and you too Louis... It would've been a shame to be killed by these little flowers.
strings.talk.40821.text: You've defeated the Priest and the Mummy Army... You more than deserve this reward.
strings.talk.40822.text: Give this gun to Louis, he'll know how to use it.
strings.talk.40823.text: Odd, why are wolves chasing that cat and not dogs?
strings.talk.40825.text: #swav1530/#sAwooo! (Haha, caught you! Now let us eat you up!)
strings.talk.40826.text: Aohoo... (I'm starving, can I eat it now? )
strings.talk.40827.text: Aohoo! (Eat it, eat it, eat it! ! ! )
strings.talk.40829.text: Are the wolves going to eat this poor cat?!
strings.talk.40831.text: Don't worry little cat, they're gone.
strings.talk.40835.text: Looks like you're okay. Try to be more careful!
strings.talk.40839.text: I didn't mean it, but that cat...
strings.talk.40840.text: You just mentioned Shizune... What is that?
strings.talk.40841.text: Shizune, can you show #n/#n your human shape?
strings.talk.40842.text: Sam, I'm surprised that you still recognize me...
strings.talk.40844.text: (Oh, she can shape shift like Sam, are they the same race?)
strings.talk.40848.text: Well... I missed you. I left the village to find you.
strings.talk.40849.text: Are you kidding me? Girl's shouldn't leave the village alone! They're probably worried sick, go back!
strings.talk.40850.text: Why are you shouting? I really like you, I wasn't kidding...
strings.talk.40852.text: Sam, you should be more caring. It's dangerous for her to go alone.
strings.talk.40853.text: If she doesn't go back, everyone will worry!
strings.talk.40854.text: But if you go with her she'll be safe!
strings.talk.40855.text: ... but I just made her mad...
strings.talk.40856.text: Shizune can't be too far. Let's find her!
strings.talk.40857.text: I shouldn't have said that Shizune... I'm sorry.
strings.talk.40858.text: Humph, you know it's your fault. How are you gonna fix it?
strings.talk.40859.text: Well... if you come with us, I can watch over you...
strings.talk.40860.text: #f1/#feh Sam means that he cares about you and wants to look after you.
strings.talk.40861.text: Really Sam? I can go with you?!
strings.talk.40862.text: The cat and wolves entered#R the Cave/#R, let's go check it out.
strings.talk.40863.text: I have to save the cat!
strings.talk.40867.text: There is a code lock on the door, I'll try to open it.
strings.talk.40868.text: I can NOT let the invaders take the #RKey of  Hell Power/#R!
strings.talk.40871.text: We can't open the door unless we find the key.
strings.talk.40872.text: Maybe the Key of  Hell Power can open the door.
strings.talk.40873.text: I'm surprised you found this place child...
strings.talk.40874.text: Just because you came in doesn't mean you can leave!
strings.talk.40875.text: You think you can save Apollo?!
strings.talk.40876.text: Don't waste time, let him see our power.
strings.talk.40878.text: Let Athena bless you to beat evil.
strings.talk.40879.text: Ha! Medusa lost to a child!!!
strings.talk.40880.text: I didn't expect you to be so strong, but you still can't have King Howert! Let's leave!
strings.talk.40881.text: When Medusa dies, the curse on Apollo will go away.
strings.talk.40882.text: Thanks for saving me. You didn't even need Athena and Venus' help.
strings.talk.40883.text: You're wrong Apollo, without me and Venus you'd be dead. We helped a lot.
strings.talk.40884.text: Yeah, without Athena and Venus, I would be dead.
strings.talk.40885.text: Apollo, be more careful! You were easily caught!
strings.talk.40888.text: It was made by the wine god!
strings.talk.40889.text: ...You're important to all creatures, just be more careful!
strings.talk.40890.text: Yeah yeah, I know, I know! Ack, I have to go check the plants! I left them a while ago! I Hope you can defeat King Howert soon.
strings.talk.40891.text: Athena, I have a question. Why don't the Gods punish King Howert?
strings.talk.40892.text: The Gods wouldn't have intervened if King Howert hadn't offended them...
strings.talk.40893.text: Since King Howert kidnapped Apollo, we decided to help humans against him.
strings.talk.40895.text: The ones in front of you silly!
strings.talk.40897.text: Yeah, Zeus sent us to help, but you can only choose one of us!
strings.talk.40901.text: Can Athena help me against King Howert?
strings.talk.40902.text: I want Venus to help me against King Howert!
strings.talk.40905.text: Let's clear King Howert's minions first, so we don't get surrounded!
strings.talk.40906.text: I hope you'll defeat King Howert soon.
strings.talk.40907.text: Venus, I have a question, why don't the Gods punish King Howert?
strings.talk.40908.text: This lock is hard to open.
strings.talk.40909.text: With me and Venus's blessings, you can defeat the Nether General!
strings.talk.40910.text: With me and Athena's blessings, you can defeat the Nether General!
strings.talk.40911.text: You need more training to save Apollo.
strings.talk.40913.text: (Nether Generals are strong... I may die.)
strings.talk.40915.text: Ha-ha-ha! The combined power of the Six Nether Generals is not something a tiny ant like you can deal with!
strings.talk.40916.text: Thank you for helping save Apollo!
strings.talk.40918.text: Sorry, I must have made a mistake. I'll leave.
strings.talk.40920.text: Medusa, kill this little kid quickly, or we'll be in big trouble when Athena and Venus join him!
strings.talk.40921.text: Shizune... Sam... it's so beautiful here!
strings.talk.40922.text: Yeah, the wind blows all my troubles away. Don't you agree Sam?
strings.talk.40927.text: It's nice to see them getting closer.
strings.talk.40928.text: Here comes food, which should I catch first?
strings.talk.40930.text: Shizune, get behind me, I'll protect you!
strings.talk.40931.text: Hah, I'll eat ALL OF YOU!
strings.talk.40932.text: You're not as weak as I thought... I'll still get one of you!
strings.talk.40933.text: Let me go, let me go! Sam, HELP ME!
strings.talk.40936.text: The hawk flew west... let's get him!
strings.talk.40937.text: Did you see that feather? This must be his nest!
strings.talk.40938.text: But we need to find a #Rladder/#R to climb up.
strings.talk.40940.text: Sam, Shizune passed out... let's get her out of here.
strings.talk.40941.text: Hey, don't leave with my supper! ! !
strings.talk.40943.text: Shizune, you finally woke up! Sam was worried about you!
strings.talk.40946.text: I was just worried that if you died your dad would kill me.
strings.talk.40949.text: Since Shizune is okay, we'll get going now.
strings.talk.40953.text: The Hawk flew to #Rthe west/#R, we have to catch it before it eats Shizune!
strings.talk.40954.text: Shizune will leave the team, is this okay?
strings.talk.40955.text: Need to find a #Rladder/#Rto climb up.
strings.talk.40959.text: It's my fault for not protecting her...
strings.talk.40960.text: Shizune will leave the team. Please unequip armor first so you don't lose it.
strings.talk.40962.text: Did you see blood under that tree?
strings.talk.40964.text: Was it Hayate? How did she fall from the tree? She's hurt badly, I have to save her!
strings.talk.40965.text: Who are you, what are you doing?!
strings.talk.40966.text: Hayate has left her organization, she has nothing to do with Kurokawa now.
strings.talk.40967.text: People who betray the organization must die!
strings.talk.40969.text: Then I will kill you first!
strings.talk.40970.text: We won't give up. Hayate will die sooner or later. Let's go!
strings.talk.40971.text: Hayate is badly hurt, we need some #RRecovery Potion/#Rto cure her.
strings.talk.40973.text: Yeah, you're badly hurt. We can't leave you by yourself.
strings.talk.40975.text: I was attacked by Kurokawa's minion and hid in the tree.
strings.talk.40976.text: Hayate, let's travel together so we can look after one-another.
strings.talk.40977.text: But Kurokawa will chase you too!
strings.talk.40978.text: #f1/#fIt doesn't matter. I've saved you, so they're already my enemy.
strings.talk.40979.text: Let's team up to fight Kurokawa together!
strings.talk.40980.text: Okay, but can I trust you?
strings.talk.40982.text: How do I know? Bad people would just lie!
strings.talk.40983.text: I guess I can't argue with that. Only time will tell.
strings.talk.40985.text: #f2/#fI have to defeat the Kurokawa Ninja.
strings.talk.40986.text: Kurokawa Ninja won't give up so quickly.
strings.talk.40987.text: I can only use #RRecovery Potion/#R to save Hayate.
strings.talk.40988.text: I feel tired... I need to sleep.
strings.talk.40993.text: Are you the Captain of the Sunken Ship?!
strings.talk.40994.text: Yes... last time you took my Love Music Box.
strings.talk.40995.text: I can give it back to you if you want...
strings.talk.40996.text: No... but you can give it to my daughter.
strings.talk.40998.text: Yes, it was a birthday gift to her, but I can't see her anymore...
strings.talk.41000.text: They live in #RRome/#R. Give it to my daughter, or I will forever give you bad luck!
strings.talk.41001.text: Are... are you threatening me or asking for help?
strings.talk.41003.text: Er... I'll be quick, I'd prefer to not have bad luck!
strings.talk.41005.text: Are you looking for Vivila? Wait a minute.
strings.talk.41006.text: Vivila, someone is looking for you.
strings.talk.41008.text: Why are you looking for me? Did you want to play?
strings.talk.41009.text: Vivila, this is a Love Music Box, it's a birthday gift from an important person.
strings.talk.41011.text: The ghost Captain said his daughter lives in #RRome/#R, let's go to #RRome/#R.
strings.talk.41013.text: Vivila, you have to take it, or your dad won't be happy.
strings.talk.41015.text: Give it to me Vivila, you can go play with your friends.
strings.talk.41018.text: Yeah. I accidentally got this music box and the Captain asked me to give it to Vivila.
strings.talk.41019.text: But... my husband disappeared five years ago!
strings.talk.41020.text: I never heard anything from him... I wish he could come back!
strings.talk.41021.text: Even in death he misses you. He wanted Vivila to have this.
strings.talk.41022.text: Thank you so much... Please tell him I love him if you see him!
strings.talk.41023.text: (Oh my god, I forget to bring #RLove Music Box/#R)
strings.talk.41024.text: I wish dad would come back to have dinner with us!
strings.talk.41027.text: What happened outside? Let's find out.
strings.talk.41030.text: Hey, let's catch it together and give it to the General.
strings.talk.41031.text: #f2/#fStop, the Unicorn is a holy animal, you can't hurt it.
strings.talk.41032.text: Don't you know that drinking Unicorn's blood gives you long life?
strings.talk.41033.text: It's just a rumor, now STOP!
strings.talk.41034.text: Go away, or I'll kill you first!
strings.talk.41035.text: Calm down, let me make sure you're okay.
strings.talk.41037.text: What can I do, I can't get closer...
strings.talk.41039.text: Lona, you're so bad. I told you not to let humans see you. Now you know it's dangerous.
strings.talk.41040.text: You're lucky someone saved you, I wouldn't have ever seen you again!
strings.talk.41042.text: No problem, Holy animals shouldn't be mistreated.
strings.talk.41045.text: Hah, I'm Venus, of course I know your name!
strings.talk.41046.text: Take this Lily, it will help you. I'm going now. I Hope you defeat King Howert soon.
strings.talk.41047.text: Venus, I still want to tell you many things...
strings.talk.41048.text: #f1/#fVenus is so beautiful, I hope to see her again.
strings.talk.41049.text: #f2/#fDang, we have to stop them from catching the Unicorn.
strings.talk.41051.text: Who is disturbing me from my sun bath?
strings.talk.41053.text: I'm angry, I came from far to take this sunbath!
strings.talk.41054.text: Then, let me give you a lesson.
strings.talk.41055.text: I'll find another place to take a sunbath, but don't think I'm afraid of you!
strings.talk.41056.text: Want to beat me? It's not easy.
strings.talk.41057.text: You can't protect the unicorn for your life. Let's go.
strings.talk.41059.text: Who are you? How do you know my name?
strings.talk.41060.text: Don't ask so many questions. Your fellow borrowed the priest's body to rebirth, but it's a body with no soul.
strings.talk.41062.text: I can bring his lost soul back, and he will be reborn, but you need to unequip your fellow's armor first.
strings.talk.41063.text: Do you want to make your fellows rebirth?
strings.talk.41064.text: Watch out Lily, don't lose it!
strings.talk.41066.text: Hang in there, my little darling.
strings.talk.41069.text: Baby, I bring some spring water for you!
strings.talk.41070.text: You seem happy. I'll come by again tomorrow!
strings.talk.41071.text: (There is something in the water vat)
strings.talk.41075.text: I'm back baby, I forgot to feed you!
strings.talk.41076.text: My... my baby! Why did it come out?!
strings.talk.41077.text: Help, get this frog away from me!
strings.talk.41079.text: Find my froggy, or you'll regret it!!! It's all your fault!
strings.talk.41080.text: Don't cry... I'll find it for you.
strings.talk.41082.text: Not yet, but it couldn't have gone far...
strings.talk.41083.text: Gotcha! Now come with me, we have to find out your master.
strings.talk.41086.text: Of course I can, I'm a holy frog.
strings.talk.41087.text: If you're a holy frog, how did you get caught?
strings.talk.41088.text: I was wounded while fighting a snake. He saved me.
strings.talk.41090.text: ...but I have to leave him now. Give him this gem as my thanks.
strings.talk.41092.text: The frog is no longer in the vat.
strings.talk.41093.text: Take this gem, and don't lose it.
strings.talk.41095.text: He... went back to his parents.
strings.talk.41096.text: Oh... okay, I'll find a new pet!
strings.talk.41097.text: Your baby wanted you to have this.
strings.talk.41098.text: Wow... it's beautiful! I'm going to show it to everyone!
strings.talk.41099.text: It's so good to see you! I have some great news to share with you! Now you can earn Cool Coins by playing mobile games and exchange them for virtual items!
strings.talk.41100.text: Answer the following questions now, and if you get them all right, you can easily earn 600 Cool Coins!
strings.talk.41101.text: Are you ready for a Q&A session?
strings.talk.41104.text: Question 1: Which mobile number do I need to use NetDragon's Treasure Hunt service?
strings.talk.41109.text: Question 2: How do I obtain Cool Coins from NetDragon's Treasure Hunt?
strings.talk.41110.text: Upload score to any mobile game to earn points
strings.talk.41113.text: Question 3: Can I redeem virtual items across games in NetDragon's Treasure Hunt Hall?
strings.talk.41114.text: Yes, as long as the game supports the Treasure Hall
strings.talk.41115.text: No. You can redeem in Treasure Hunt Hall within a single game
strings.talk.41116.text: Awesome! After you get your Cool Coins, remember to download the NetDragon Treasure Hunt mobile game, upload your achievements, and earn more Cool Coins to redeem for virtual items!
strings.talk.41117.text: Alas! You won't get Cool Coins if you don't answer all the questions correctly! Go check the Treasure Hunt website carefully before coming back to try! NetDragon Treasure Hunt: http://mobile.chinesegamer.net/wabau/
strings.talk.41118.text: That little boy looks strange, I'd better have a look...
strings.talk.41119.text: When your fellow reaches level #R100/#R, I will use my power to find his lost soul so he can be reborn.
strings.talk.41120.text: Don't ask too much. Your fellow hasn't got the test.
strings.talk.41122.text: Only those who pass the test can grow up.
strings.talk.41124.text: Don't ask too much. The God of Fate hasn't come yet.
strings.talk.41126.text: You have to pass the God of Fate's test for ultimate power.
strings.talk.41128.text: The God of Fate grants his power to those who pass his test.
strings.talk.41129.text: I should look in the Water Vat when the Little Brother isn't here.
strings.talk.41130.text: Your fellow has obtained new energy. Please cherish the time with him.
strings.talk.41132.text: My queen, why are you sad?
strings.talk.41134.text: I'm too sick to travel the world. I miss it's beauty.
strings.talk.41136.text: Really? Can you get me some#R Purple Roses?/#R
strings.talk.41137.text: Purple Roses? I don't see why not.
strings.talk.41138.text: Have you found any #R Purple Roses/#R?
strings.talk.41141.text: This is beautiful! If the King gave it to me...
strings.talk.41143.text: ...But you are ill! You should rest.
strings.talk.41144.text: Then, can you catch a #RFlamboyant Parrot/#R for me? A parrot can speak, and make sure I'm not lonely.
strings.talk.41145.text: Ok, I will go catch a #RFlamboyant Parrot/#R now.
strings.talk.41149.text: What?! It called me an idiot!
strings.talk.41150.text: Whoever talks to me is an idiot!
strings.talk.41153.text: Anyways, you won't be lonely now.
strings.talk.41154.text: Thanks for your help. Have this gift.
strings.talk.41155.text: Don't mention it, I'm happy to see your smile.
strings.talk.41156.text: (Give the Flamboyant Parrot to queen or not?)
strings.talk.41157.text: Should I listen to the Bloody Monk or my wife?
strings.talk.41158.text: Can you help me? Bloody Monk or wife?!
strings.talk.41159.text: I don't know what you're talking about!
strings.talk.41160.text: It's a long story. I met Miss White several months ago, and we got married.
strings.talk.41161.text: ...but then the Monk told me she was a snake demon!
strings.talk.41163.text: How do you know my name?! Surely you're a god! Can you help?
strings.talk.41165.text: Please tell me what to do!
strings.talk.41167.text: But I give my fate to you! Who do I trust?!
strings.talk.41168.text: (This decision will change his life... What to do?)
strings.talk.41169.text: I don't believe the Bloody Monk, choose your wife.
strings.talk.41170.text: I hate to say it, but she must be a Snake Demon. The monk is right.
strings.talk.41171.text: Bloody Monk is in #RDeep Forest/#R of Chang'an.
strings.talk.41172.text: I live near the #RBypath/#R outside Chang'an.
strings.talk.41175.text: Mr Xu doesn't believe his wife is a Snake Demon... What evidence do you have?
strings.talk.41176.text: Have his wife drink this Realgar Wine... She'll revert to a snake demon when drinking it.
strings.talk.41177.text: Really? I will give #RRealgar Wine to Mr Xu/#R.
strings.talk.41178.text: Did you let Miss White drink the wine?
strings.talk.41179.text: Ok, I will give #RRealgar Wine to Mr Xu/#R and ask him to drink it with Miss White.
strings.talk.41180.text: Mr Xu, the Bloody Monk gave me Realgar Wine, if your wife is a Snake Demon she'll revert after drinking it.
strings.talk.41182.text: #f2/#fYou are such a coward How about I go with you?
strings.talk.41183.text: Okay, I'll take the Wine. I live near here, why don't you go yourself?
strings.talk.41184.text: Honey, you're back... You brought a friend!
strings.talk.41185.text: Yes, they're a good friend, really nice!
strings.talk.41186.text: Hi, I'm #n/#n, have this wine as a gift of peace.
strings.talk.41187.text: Thank you, what kind of wine is it?
strings.talk.41188.text: It's Realgar Wine, it's popular at the Dragon Boat festival.
strings.talk.41190.text: What's wrong? Don't you like it?
strings.talk.41191.text: Yeah, I like it, thank s #n/#n.(maybe one cup is ok.)
strings.talk.41193.text: You really are a snake demon! The monk was right!
strings.talk.41194.text: Honey... I'm not... Argh what is this?
strings.talk.41195.text: It was the Bloody Monk's Realgar Wine.
strings.talk.41196.text: That dumb bald idiot! I'LL EAT ALL OF YOU!
strings.talk.41197.text: Mr Xu, you can wake up... I beat the snake demon.
strings.talk.41199.text: Bloody Monk, you were right... Such a tragedy...
strings.talk.41200.text: Mr Xu, you have great potential, do you want to train yourself?
strings.talk.41201.text: I... I'm willing to follow you.
strings.talk.41202.text: Mr Xu, do you have any feelings for your wife?
strings.talk.41204.text: Bloody Monk, take me to your temple! I want to be a monk!
strings.talk.41205.text: Okay... I will seal the Snake Demon under the pagoda.
strings.talk.41206.text: Youth, you have some potential... Do you want to join us?
strings.talk.41207.text: #f2/#fCommon, I'm a girl, how can I become a monk?
strings.talk.41208.text: #f2/#fOh, thank you, but... I like my hair, I don't want to be bald!
strings.talk.41209.text: You'll regret your decision, but thanks for your help anyways.
strings.talk.41210.text: Are you Miss White ? I'm #n/#n, your husband's friend. A monk told your husband that you're a Snake Demon.
strings.talk.41211.text: To tell the truth... I am a Snake Demon. Fate brought me to Mr Xu... I love him too much to ever hurt him.
strings.talk.41212.text: Mr Xu is in the forest now... What if the Monk follows him and captures you?
strings.talk.41213.text: Can you help me then? This fair rope will help resist the monk.
strings.talk.41214.text: Why don't you go with me?
strings.talk.41215.text: I'd like to, but the strong energy from the sun would hurt me right now...
strings.talk.41216.text: Ok, I will go find the monk now.#R(Find Mr Xu first to ask where Bloody Monk is)/#R
strings.talk.41218.text: Not yet. Let me find him. #R(Find Mr Xu to ask where Bloody Monk is)/#R
strings.talk.41219.text: Mr Xu, your wife wants me to deal with the Bloody Monk. Come with me.
strings.talk.41220.text: What? Do I have to go with you? Why don't you go yourself?
strings.talk.41221.text: But you know where the Bloody Monk is!
strings.talk.41223.text: #f2/#f Come on, you'd better go with me. Take this Fair Rope.
strings.talk.41224.text: The Bloody Monk is near the #RDeep Forest/#R, follow me.
strings.talk.41225.text: You are here, Mr Xu. Do you believe me now about your wife?
strings.talk.41226.text: Yes... I believe you. This is my friend...
strings.talk.41229.text: You said his wife is a Snake Demon. She is, but she hasn't hurt anybody. Do you just not want to see them happy?
strings.talk.41231.text: This is Fair Rope, you can't move now!
strings.talk.41233.text: Argh, beaten by a little kid!
strings.talk.41234.text: Fate brought them together, why destroy their lives?
strings.talk.41237.text: We love each other. This won't change from something you say!
strings.talk.41239.text: Fine... you will see I am right some day...
strings.talk.41240.text: Thanks for the advice. Even though she is a demon, I will still love her.
strings.talk.41241.text: This is your life! I can't make this decision easily... let me think...
strings.talk.41242.text: I won't trust the Bloody Monk, but what if he keeps bothering me?
strings.talk.41243.text: Can you ask my wife what to do about the Bloody Monk at my house?
strings.talk.41244.text: Okay, I'll trust the Bloody Monk.
strings.talk.41245.text: Can you help me find the Bloody Monk? He'll know what to do...
strings.talk.41246.text: Take this Realgar Wine, don't lose it.
strings.talk.41247.text: Take this Fair Rope, don't lose it.
strings.talk.41250.text: Don't worry. Come back to me again if you want your fellow to have a complete soul.
strings.talk.41254.text: Mr Xu passed out Bloody Monk, we need to wake him!
strings.talk.41256.text: I need to prepare the Crete Fete. It's a really bad time for Athens.
strings.talk.41257.text: What's so bad about it? Is it just a common fete?
strings.talk.41258.text: You are not local. Everybody here knows Crete Fete.
strings.talk.41259.text: Every Crete Fete, we must sacrifice people to Minotaur...
strings.talk.41260.text: If not, the Minotaur will bring hell to Athens.
strings.talk.41261.text: Why don't you kill the monster?
strings.talk.41262.text: We tried, but our warriors died.

strings.talk.41798.text: OK! I will let you give it to me.

strings.talk.41814.text: Master Lion General! Official Nanase  was attacked by Kurokawa ninjas.
strings.talk.41815.text: Oh, no! Where is the Sky Scroll?
strings.talk.41816.text: The Sky Scroll is here. Official Nanase  gave it to me before he died, so I came back to Yamataikoku to give it to you.
strings.talk.41817.text: The Sky Scroll that was protected by Official Nanase .
strings.talk.41818.text: Please don't be so sad, Master Lion General.

strings.talk.41820.text: You want to give it to me?

strings.talk.41822.text: OK, I will keep it safe.
strings.talk.41823.text: I will defeat the Kurokawa ninjas.

strings.talk.41857.text: How can I have lost it to you?!

strings.talk.41861.text: I'm just happy that you are OK.
strings.talk.41862.text: It was good to have known you.
strings.talk.41864.text: Do you still remember the first time we met? Maybe you joined us just for the cursed scroll ...
strings.talk.41865.text: But I will never forget you.
strings.talk.41867.text: I hope someday we will meet again and travel together once more.
strings.talk.41868.text: Why are there so many caves here? Maybe they contain some treasure.
strings.talk.41869.text: #f1/#fKanako, let's go on an adventure together.
strings.talk.41870.text: #n/#n, what should we do if there are monsters inside instead of treasure?
strings.talk.41871.text: I don't know, but we'll never find out until we try.
strings.talk.41875.text: Kanako, let's go investigate. Maybe it's just an hallucination.
strings.talk.41879.text: Ha ha, now I will eat this baby to regain my strength. Then I will deal with you!
strings.talk.41881.text: What a pity! You missed me. Now it's my turn!
strings.talk.41882.text: I won't let you hurt Kanako!
strings.talk.41883.text: Do you think you can protect everyone?
strings.talk.41884.text: No, I can't kill you, but I can make sure you have a wretched life.
strings.talk.41889.text: This air keeps me away from Kanako. What can I do about it?
strings.talk.41890.text: This body contains great power. Let it become my second body!
strings.talk.41891.text: No, you can't take my body!
strings.talk.41895.text: Nine-tail Fox, I didn't expect to find you here!
strings.talk.41896.text: Master Himiko, you have arrived at just the right time. Please rescue Kanako!
strings.talk.41897.text: #n/#n, I did not come here for Kanako!
strings.talk.41898.text: Why? Why don't you want to rescue Kanako?
strings.talk.41899.text: If we don't kill Kanako, Nine-tail Fox will use her body to hurt other people.
strings.talk.41900.text: So we have to kill her!
strings.talk.41901.text: No, Master Himiko! There must be something else you can do. Please help Kanako!
strings.talk.41902.text: Who wants to kill me? Killing me will kill Kanako!
strings.talk.41903.text: #n/#n, please kill me! Don't let Nine-tail Fox use my body for evil!
strings.talk.41905.text: #n/#n, we have no time to come up with another plan. All we can do is strand Nine-tail Fox here.
strings.talk.41906.text: Kanako uses her last strength to control Nine-tail Fox.
strings.talk.41907.text: Act quickly, or Nine-tail Fox will escape.
strings.talk.41908.text: Do it, #n/#n! Kill me and defeat Nine-tail Fox.
strings.talk.41911.text: #n/#n, don't hesitate! I don't have enough strength left to control Nine-tail Fox.
strings.talk.41914.text: If I had not been so curious, this would never have happened.
strings.talk.41915.text: I can't lose you, Kanako! I am so sorry.
strings.talk.41916.text: Don't be sorry! You're doing the right thing.
strings.talk.41917.text: My grandmother said that when I die I will become a star, and I will see you from the sky.
strings.talk.41919.text: #n/#n, Kanako sacrificed herself to save others. She was very brave!
strings.talk.41920.text: Nine-tail Fox is dead. You must continue your journey and be strong like Kanako.
strings.talk.41921.text: #f3/#fVery well, I will continue my journey.
strings.talk.41923.text: After this, Kanako will leave the team. Please remove your equipment to avoid losing it.
strings.talk.41924.text: #R#BKanako will be permanently removed from the team./#R/#B Do you wish to proceed?
strings.talk.41927.text: Master Odyssea, why do you serve Persia? Have you forgotten the honor of Rome?
strings.talk.41928.text: Odyssea has been brainwashed by a girl. What a shame!
strings.talk.41929.text: Arrest Odyssea and the Persian girl, and Woklone will give you a valuable reward.
strings.talk.41930.text: You have made a mistake! They are peaceful envoys sent by the Persian king.
strings.talk.41931.text: No, they are not. They are spies planning to attack Rome.
strings.talk.41932.text: You're such a fool. You've been deceived by Woklone because he wants to start a war.
strings.talk.41933.text: Roman soldiers, arrest these betrayers, and attack the Persians.
strings.talk.41935.text: You speak too much! Shut up!
strings.talk.41937.text: Roman soldiers, please listen to me. I represent the Persian king and have come here to negotiate peace. Please let us go.
strings.talk.41938.text: OK, let me show you where to go.
strings.talk.41940.text: Let me see your wound, Kacy.
strings.talk.41942.text: The blood is black. The sword of Floyd is poisoned.
strings.talk.41943.text: Ha ha, you will feel the pain!
strings.talk.41947.text: #f3/#fWhat should I do? There's only enough antidote for one person!
strings.talk.41951.text: Princess, he is a Roman soldier. Why would you want to save him?
strings.talk.41952.text: You are the princess of Persia. If you die, it will start a war.
strings.talk.41953.text: Don't say that! You can't die ...
strings.talk.41954.text: (What should I do? We have just one antidote. Should I give it to #RKacy/#R or #ROdyssea/#R?)
strings.talk.41957.text: No, please give it to Odyssea.
strings.talk.41958.text: Odyssea is right. You can't die. You have to complete your mission.
strings.talk.41962.text: No, Odyssea! Don't close your eyes, please ...
strings.talk.41964.text: There's no time to weep. I must complete the mission.
strings.talk.41965.text: Kerst, let's go. We must get to Rome to negotiate for peace.
strings.talk.41966.text: Roman leaders, I am the princess of Persia and I have come to negotiate a peace treaty.
strings.talk.41967.text: Peace? Are you kidding? You Persians attacked us first!
strings.talk.41968.text: Our king respects Rome's strength and hopes that we can get along with each other peacefully.
strings.talk.41969.text: Woklone, if we can have peace for a hundred years, I think it's worth negotiating a treaty.
strings.talk.41970.text: Are you kidding? I've talked it over with others ...
strings.talk.41971.text: #f3/#fWhy won't you consider peace? Are you planning to get rich from the war?
strings.talk.41972.text: You are full of lies! Take them away!
strings.talk.41974.text: This proves that Woklone has been scheming with the merchants.
strings.talk.41975.text: Woklone, can you explain your behavior?
strings.talk.41976.text: As a Senator, it's not unusual to keep some documents confidential, is it?
strings.talk.41977.text: But you're working with merchants for a share of the profits, aren't you?
strings.talk.41980.text: I will get my revenge soon.
strings.talk.41981.text: Young man, thank you for preventing war.
strings.talk.41982.text: Prime minister, let's discuss the terms of the peace.
strings.talk.41983.text: No, I don't want the antidote! #n/#n, please give it to Kacy.
strings.talk.41984.text: I want you to live, for you have many dreams yet to realize.
strings.talk.41985.text: Tell the Romans that the world is not full of war ...
strings.talk.41988.text: I will wait here for you.
strings.talk.41989.text: No, Kacy! Please don't close your eyes.
strings.talk.41990.text: Princess ... (The princess loves this Roman soldier so much, she would die for him.)
strings.talk.41992.text: Kerst, let's go. We must go to Rome and negotiate peace.
strings.talk.41993.text: Roman leaders, I am the Persian prime minister. I've come here to negotiate a peace treaty.
strings.talk.41994.text: We hope that Rome and Persia can build a friendly relationship.
strings.talk.41995.text: I'm trying to find someone to rescue you!
strings.talk.41997.text: Grandma, what happened? Your kitty fell into the well?
strings.talk.41998.text: Why would it jump into the well? Isn't it afraid of the water?
strings.talk.41999.text: I don't know why. Maybe somebody threw it into the well.
strings.talk.42000.text: The water level is not high, but the kitty is caught on the stones in the well.
strings.talk.42001.text: Can you help get it out?
strings.talk.42004.text: Shizune, are you afraid of the water?
strings.talk.42005.text: No matter how dangerous it might be, I will rescue that kitty.
strings.talk.42011.text: Kacy, this is the only antidote. Please take it.
strings.talk.42012.text: Odyssea, this is the only antidote. Please take it.
strings.talk.42013.text: I must stop Floyd. These envoys must get to Rome.
strings.talk.42014.text: It's our duty to keep the peace between these two countries.
strings.talk.42015.text: Kacy, I will lead Kerst to Rome.
strings.talk.42016.text: Odyssea, I will lead them to Rome.
strings.talk.42017.text: Kacy leads the peace envoys to #RRome/#R.
strings.talk.42018.text: Odyssea leads the peace envoys to #RRome/#R.
strings.talk.42019.text: Stop these Persians from entering Rome.

strings.talk.42021.text: We hope Rome and Persia will stop waging war and instead have peace forever.
strings.talk.42022.text: I will help you kitty. Don't be afraid.

strings.talk.42025.text: Don't be afraid. I will hold you.

strings.talk.42027.text: You are welcome. I am happy I could help you.

strings.talk.42049.text: Thank you for saving my kitty.

strings.talk.42057.text: No, not this one. You can do some research and then come back.

strings.talk.42062.text: I think it must be #R#Bnearby/#R/#B. Thank you.

strings.talk.42064.text: OK, I will ask someone else to help me.

strings.talk.42078.text: Thank you so much. I hope this reward will help you.

strings.talk.42083.text: You defeated the Elephant God, so now it's my turn.
strings.talk.42084.text: Ha ha, it's a pleasure to fight such a strong adversary. Here is your reward.
strings.talk.42086.text: Defeat the two animal gods first.

strings.talk.42089.text: Come have a look. It's a good Persian carpet.

strings.talk.42095.text: I am sorry, but I have other things to do.
strings.talk.42096.text: Thank you. People in the village will be very happy.

strings.talk.42132.text: Do you want to help this child?
strings.talk.42134.text: I think it will soon return on its own.
strings.talk.42135.text: Thank you. My little dog ran in the direction of the forest.

strings.talk.42147.text: Do you want to help her?
strings.talk.42148.text: I am sorry, but I don't know where to find it.
strings.talk.42150.text: Thank you. Here is a gift I prepared for you.
strings.talk.42151.text: Thank you for your help. I can finish my carpet now.
strings.talk.42152.text: Young one, can you do me a favor?
strings.talk.42153.text: I am ready to help you.

strings.talk.42156.text: Thank you. Here is a reward for you.
strings.talk.42157.text: Thank you. I can finish making my rice cakes now.

strings.talk.42159.text: Do you want to challenge me?
strings.talk.42160.text: You are good, but how will you do next time?
strings.talk.42161.text: I will defeat you this time!
strings.talk.42162.text: You were lucky to win this time. You won't be so lucky next time.
strings.talk.42163.text: Do you want to challenge me?
strings.talk.42166.text: You are strong, but this is just a small victory.
strings.talk.42167.text: I know what you can do, so come on.
strings.talk.42168.text: Have you lost your confidence? You can't defeat me!
strings.talk.42170.text: This time you win, but next time you will lose!
strings.talk.42171.text: It's such a bore to keep fighting!
strings.talk.42172.text: You are stronger than I expected.
strings.talk.42173.text: Why are you nagging me so?
strings.talk.42174.text: You want to defeat me? No way!
strings.talk.42175.text: Those who follow me are so hateful.
strings.talk.42179.text: Do you think you can defeat me? That's hilarious!
strings.talk.42180.text: You are strong enough to defeat the black stars.
strings.talk.42182.text: You defeated Athena and have proved your power.
strings.talk.42183.text: You must be feeling lucky that you didn't have to confront me.
strings.talk.42185.text: You have defeated us, but will you accept our ultimate challenge?

strings.talk.42187.text: It looks like Zeus is about to stand up!
strings.talk.42188.text: How majestic! But how much gold and ivory will it consume?
