strings.talk.42190.text: When grandma is fine she will greet outsiders outside the door.
strings.talk.42191.text: It's so rare to go ashore, that it's been so long since I've set foot on the land.
strings.talk.42192.text: Oops~ It's a foreigner! Welcome to Rhodes!
strings.talk.42193.text: This bronze statue of the Sun God is a symbol of victory on our island.
strings.talk.42194.text: I'm not boasting, the goat cheese made on our island is very famous!
strings.talk.42195.text: This is the place where wine is produced, you must definitely come and try!
strings.talk.42196.text: Hmm... drinking it, it seems to be lacking something...
strings.talk.42197.text: Sweetheart, this flower is for you, representing the goddess who guards this island. You are the goddess, I am the Sun God who guards you.
strings.talk.42198.text: Oh~my dear, thank you~ I love you the most~
strings.talk.42199.text: My mother said that each constellation has its own story.
strings.talk.42200.text: This is the Temple of Zeus, please visit with a pious heart.
strings.talk.42201.text: Oops... what should I do now...
strings.talk.42202.text: You seem to be troubled, what's wrong?
strings.talk.42203.text: There were cracks in the bronze statue and It was necessary to repair it. It was discovered that we are lacking 5 bronze material. If It is not repaired quickly, It might collapse.
strings.talk.42204.text: (If I have 5 bronze materials, I can help this craftsman.)
strings.talk.42205.text: (There are exactly 5 bronze materials, In my inventory, do you want to give to the craftsman?)
strings.talk.42206.text: I happen to have 5 bronze materials, please take them to repair the bronze statue.
strings.talk.42207.text: Are you sure! Thank you so much, in order to thank you for help, please accept this.
strings.talk.42209.text: Keeping the bronze statue intact, it is a very important task.
strings.talk.42210.text: Huh? Ghostdom forces? How did they appear here?
strings.talk.42211.text: Let's take a look at the past, maybe we will find out!
strings.talk.42212.text: Ghostdom forces are gone, but the magic circle is found!
strings.talk.42213.text: It seems to be inside the magic circle.
strings.talk.42215.text: What conspiracy they may be planning... Let's go in and stop them!
strings.talk.42216.text: Intruder! You guys are not welcome here!
strings.talk.42217.text: It seems that we have come in something important!
strings.talk.42219.text: Let's defeat the soldiers in front of us!
strings.talk.42221.text: The one in front... is King Howert!
strings.talk.42223.text: I didn't expect to come here so soon.
strings.talk.42224.text: Don't miss this opportunity! You must be sealed here!
strings.talk.42225.text: Hahaha, do you really think you can seal me?
strings.talk.42228.text: Here is the stage I specially prepared for you, "Savior"! I see... use Medusa's soul fragments to summon monsters to consume your physical strength first!
strings.talk.42229.text: #f2/#fDamn King Howert, even uses souls of this own subordinates!
strings.talk.42230.text: I will destroy the "Savior"! I really look forward to it! Hahaha!
strings.talk.42233.text: Using Medusa's soul fragments as a medium, come out, servants!
strings.talk.42234.text: What do we do! We are surrounded by these monsters!
strings.talk.42235.text: Come and help #n/#n, let's repel these snake girls together!
strings.talk.42236.text: #f2/#f It's hard to get rid of them!
strings.talk.42237.text: It seems that a lot of your physical strength has been consumed, I'll defeat you here!
strings.talk.42240.text: King Howert has revealed his weakness!
strings.talk.42241.text: It seems King Howert was successfully weakened by us!
strings.talk.42244.text: #R#BEva will leave the team permanently/#R/#B, are you sure?
strings.talk.42245.text: During this quest Eva will be leaving the team so make sure you remove any special equipment/gear before she leaves.
strings.talk.42246.text: You need the Ma Stone to seal King Howert.
strings.talk.42247.text: I have used the power of the Dark Sword to give him a blow! Charlotte, use the magic stone to seal King Howert!
strings.talk.42249.text: Magic Stone, seal the evil King of Ghostdom!
strings.talk.42252.text: #f2/#f Damn it! Why did the seal fail!
strings.talk.42253.text: Hahaha! I won't be defeated by you so easily! The flaws are just to make you careless!
strings.talk.42254.text: This armor is made by adding part of my soul, and your seal against me will also react to the armor! This armor can be said to be my stand-in!
strings.talk.42255.text: What, what do we do... The Ma Stone cracked! ?
strings.talk.42256.text: A piece of armor can be changed to the weakness of the dark sword and the damage of the magic stone, which is really worth it!
strings.talk.42259.text: Humph! You have used all your power to attack my armor. You have not become the power of the dark sword, you are just a low-level demon!
strings.talk.42260.text: So happy! Today the life of the "Savior" can be ended! Hahaha!
strings.talk.42262.text: It's not over yet! The power of the Dark Sword is not defeated! As long as I still have life, I am the Dark Sword!
strings.talk.42264.text: Ha-ha... I defeated King Howert, I will be safe for now.
strings.talk.42267.text: No need... I know that I have no strength to stand up again ...
strings.talk.42268.text: #f3/#f Eva! Don't close your eyes! Didn't you say that you will show me the demon world?
strings.talk.42269.text: Haha... but I can't walk anymore...
strings.talk.42271.text: #f2/#fI will definitely lead this world back to the right way... After that, we will definitely meet again!
strings.talk.42272.text: These sheep have been working hard to produce milk. It's time to treat them to a big meal, but I'm busy, can you help me find #R#B3 Cabbage/#R/#B?
strings.talk.42275.text: This is the cabbage you wanted.
strings.talk.42276.text: Thank you, my sheep can have a big meal now.
strings.talk.42279.text: I am about to go on a voyage, but I am worried about the lack of lemon juice that can prevent scurvy.
strings.talk.42280.text: (Would you like to find lemon juice to help the captain sail?)
strings.talk.42281.text: How much lemon juice do you need?
strings.talk.42282.text: Five are needed, thank you for your willingness to help.
strings.talk.42284.text: Here's five lemon juice for you.
strings.talk.42285.text: Thank you so much, I can sail now.
strings.talk.42286.text: (I think someone else will help him.)
strings.talk.42287.text: It's a pity that I came here specially to try the famous goat's milk cheese, but I couldn't find the store.
strings.talk.42288.text: Thinking about it makes saliva flow out. Can you help me find it?
strings.talk.42291.text: Where can I buy goat milk cheese?
strings.talk.42292.text: As long as the goat milk cheese on our island is made, there will be a large number of merchant ships buying it. It can be a little difficult to get them in general stores.
strings.talk.42293.text: But I can give you some.
strings.talk.42294.text: We should be helpful to each other.
strings.talk.42295.text: I helped you find a delicious goat's milk cheese.
strings.talk.42296.text: Thank you so much, I can finally eat goat's milk cheese which I have always thought about!
strings.talk.42297.text: Uhh, looking at the bronze statue does not provoke inspiration ...
strings.talk.42298.text: Maybe you can find new inspiration by going out for a walk?
strings.talk.42299.text: If you have exotic ornaments as a reference, maybe you can arouse my inspiration without going far.
strings.talk.42300.text: (Maybe you can make a #R#BLucky Cat/#R/#B for reference?)
strings.talk.42301.text: I really want to see exotic ornaments ...
strings.talk.42302.text: This is called the Lucky Cat, and it is a characteristic decoration of a country in Toyo, for your reference.
strings.talk.42303.text: Do you use animals as the main characters? This is fun! Why didn't I think of it? Thank you for helping me find inspiration.
strings.talk.42304.text: Young man, can you do me a favor?
strings.talk.42305.text: Want to find your inspiration again?
strings.talk.42306.text: This time I want you to help me find an item. On my birthday, my sons and I jointly ordered an exquisite carving knife. I love it so much that I always carry it with me.
strings.talk.42307.text: But when I went home this time, I found that it was gone. Recently, I only walked around the town.
strings.talk.42309.text: By the way, my name is engraved on the carving knife, please help me find it.
strings.talk.42310.text: Did you find the carving knife?
strings.talk.42311.text: Haha, I picked up this seemingly advanced carving knife, maybe I can resell it and make a fortune.
strings.talk.42312.text: Can I confirm the carving knife?
strings.talk.42313.text: No, if you take it and leave, I will lose money unless you can prove that this is the one you are looking for, otherwise you will pay for it!
strings.talk.42314.text: Then please see if the name "Agsand" is engraved on it.
strings.talk.42315.text: Ah, there really is... think carefully, not many people will search for carving knives, and you can't find buyers if you want to resell.
strings.talk.42319.text: Thank you for helping me retrieve the carving knife.
strings.talk.42320.text: What should I do... I will lose my blood.
strings.talk.42322.text: At first, the weather here is very good, and you can definitely grow delicious fruits. However, the shipment has to be made by sea, and when it comes ashore, the fruit will run out.
strings.talk.42323.text: I later thought that the remedy is to make dried fruits, but now the materials used to make tools are not enough. Can you help me find insufficient materials?
strings.talk.42325.text: I need #R#B15 Cypress/#R/#B, so that I can make a platform for drying fruits.
strings.talk.42327.text: Here are the fifteen cypresses you wanted.
strings.talk.42328.text: Thank you for your help, I won't lose everything now.
strings.talk.42329.text: Doctor Hua Tuo is a rare talent in the world, please save the doctor!
strings.talk.42330.text: Doctor Hua Tuo seems to have a gift of gratitude, so go find a doctor!
strings.talk.42331.text: Alas... Do I have to die here ...
strings.talk.42332.text: Thank you for your life-saving grace. Please accept this gratitude.
strings.talk.42333.text: The Persian empire struck, and the strength was very different, but we, Spartans, vowed to stay here!
strings.talk.42334.text: Because of your joining, we won a miraculous victory! This gift represents supreme gratitude, please accept it.
strings.talk.42335.text: The Spartans only have victory or death, even if there is no chance, we will not leave!
strings.talk.42336.text: Thank you for fighting with us!
strings.talk.42337.text: Where are you going? It is recommended not to pass, there is a griffin there.
strings.talk.42338.text: Although the griffin is regarded as a guardian beast here, it looks irritable and may attack outsiders.
strings.talk.42339.text: Maybe we can go and see why the guardian beast has a bad temper?
strings.talk.42340.text: What! There's a griffin in the valley! Why are you here?
strings.talk.42341.text: Humph! It turned out to be the elf who made me lose my appetite.
strings.talk.42342.text: Are you the rumored guardian beast?
strings.talk.42343.text: I'm just resting here, and the nearby humans treat me as the guardian beast without permission, and only take some unpalatable food... Huh! Thank me for not eating them.
strings.talk.42344.text: Wait... the one next to you, wouldn't it be...
strings.talk.42345.text: That's right! He is the legendary savior!
strings.talk.42346.text: It turns out to be you ...
strings.talk.42347.text: It turned out to be me?
strings.talk.42348.text: I heard that as long as I eat you, I can achieve any wish!
strings.talk.42349.text: Huh? People and flesh are not delicious ~
strings.talk.42350.text: In order to achieve the wish, I have to swallow you even if you are unpalatable!
strings.talk.42351.text: Damn it! Be ready to try again!
strings.talk.42352.text: Gee! I didn't expect it to be so powerful!
strings.talk.42353.text: Ah! Is it Gilbert, one of the Six Underworld Generals!?
strings.talk.42354.text: Hahaha ~ Long time no see, savior!
strings.talk.42355.text: Did you deceive the griffin to attack me?
strings.talk.42356.text: Even if he is a glutton, you should not deceive it like this!
strings.talk.42358.text: King Howert will grant any wish to anyone, who eliminate you guys
strings.talk.42359.text: Roar! Don't be noisy, I must eat the savior!
strings.talk.42361.text: Power and strength fill the whole body!
strings.talk.42362.text: Use the power of King Howert, hahaha ~
strings.talk.42363.text: Roar ~! This time we will be able to eat the savior smoothly!
strings.talk.42366.text: Not enough... Not enough! It must be that the power is not enough!
strings.talk.42367.text: Eat... You will have strength after eating! I want to eat, eat, eat you! Roar ~!
strings.talk.42369.text: Could it be that the power of King Howert, coupled with the desire to eat too much, made it explode?
strings.talk.42375.text: The Magic Stone reacts with power of Ghostdom. Using my body to seal the lion dove mixed with the power of Ghostdom. But without a body, I can't continue to travel with you..
strings.talk.42377.text: #n/#n, thank you for your willingness to take me to travel with you. I have experienced many wonderful memories and know how wonderful this world is! I will disappear now, but I have no regrets, thank you!
strings.talk.42379.text: #R#BCharlotte will leave the team permanently/#R/#B, are you sure?
strings.talk.42380.text: Charlotte will leave the team. Please remove the equipment first to avoid the loss of equipment.
strings.talk.45031.text: Thank you very much, young one!
strings.talk.45033.text: Thank you. You help Houyi shoot down the sun and save us!
strings.talk.45034.text: Haha... Thank you! You've help me to become white again!
strings.talk.45035.text: I can finally pay attention to my work. Thank you! Please accept this wood!
strings.talk.45038.text: Thank you! You are a hero!
strings.talk.45039.text: There is no time to lose. Let's start at once!
strings.talk.45041.text: You dare to challenge our brothers?! You will die!
strings.talk.45043.text: Haha...Go back to upgrade your level!
strings.talk.45044.text: Curses! You have killed our three brothers... We want to avenge them!
strings.talk.45046.text: How can you little kids defeat us?
strings.talk.45047.text: You have killed our 6 brothers. We have to revenge for them!
strings.talk.45048.text: Haha! It is impossible that you are so powerful!
strings.talk.45050.text: Thank you. You help me shoot down the suns. I have to leave now!
strings.talk.45051.text: OK! Take care of yourself! See you!
strings.talk.45053.text: Kind-hearted sirs and misses, please buy a box of matches from me!
strings.talk.45054.text: All right. I will buy one!
strings.talk.45056.text: Sorry! I have sold all matches and there is no more material to make them left at home.
strings.talk.45057.text: Can you help me collect some firewood?
strings.talk.45058.text: What can I do for you?
strings.talk.45059.text: I need #B#R three firewood /#B/#R to be made the matches.
strings.talk.45060.text: Please! I am afraid of going into the forest. Please do me a favor!
strings.talk.45061.text: I can make many boxes of matches with the firewood.
strings.talk.45062.text: However, the business here is not so good. It is better for me to go to the colder area.
strings.talk.45063.text: Really?! Please take care of yourself!
strings.talk.45064.text: Ok! You are so kind! I hope I can see you again!
strings.talk.45066.text: Thank you! Thank you very much!
strings.talk.45070.text: Would you like to send the letter to Anlyna?
strings.talk.45073.text: Why not send it by yourself?
strings.talk.45074.text: Sigh... we were used to be a couple, but Anlyna's father won't allow us to be together because of my poverty. I still miss her; I hope you can send this letter to her.
strings.talk.45075.text: Can you tell me the contents of this letter?
strings.talk.45076.text: I want to make an appointment to meet her under the tree, I hope she can go together with me to turn over a new leaf in a strange place.
strings.talk.45077.text: You are so brave... ok! I will send this letter for you.
strings.talk.45079.text: Yes, I am. Who are you?
strings.talk.45080.text: I am #n/#n. I have come here to give you this letter. (give the letter to Anlyna)
strings.talk.45081.text: (Anlyna burst into tears after reading the letter)
strings.talk.45082.text: I didn't expect that Kita would still miss me. But...
strings.talk.45084.text: My father will be sad if I go with Kita... but I also want to live with Kita. What can I do?
strings.talk.45085.text: Your father isn't lacking intelligence. You and Kita may affect him with your sincerity.
strings.talk.45086.text: I have decided to go to live with Kita... Thank you for bringing this letter to me.
strings.talk.45087.text: Such a trifling thing is hardly worth mentioning. (go to their blessing under the tree tonight)
strings.talk.45088.text: You are coming, Anlyna. I was worried that you might not come...
strings.talk.45090.text: We must go in the still of night.
strings.talk.45093.text: You dare to elope with Anlyna! It will be demeaning to let you run away! Somebody kill this fellow.
strings.talk.45094.text: Stop! You are away too far! They love each other so much, why do you break them up.
strings.talk.45095.text: You there, it?s none of your business.
strings.talk.45096.text: Leave here, if you don't want to have an accident!
strings.talk.45097.text: Do you dare to come? You are weary of life!
strings.talk.45098.text: Stop! #n/#n, please let my father go! I believe he is a good man.
strings.talk.45100.text: Uncle... I really love Anlyna with my whole heart. Currently I am penniless, but I promise I will give her happiness, please accept us!
strings.talk.45101.text: (Kita and Anlyna fall on their knees)
strings.talk.45102.text: Sigh... daughters must get married eventually... you little fellow! Take care of Anlyna. I won't forgive you if you ruin her.
strings.talk.45103.text: #n/#n, thank you for helping us. We have something to give you.
strings.talk.45104.text: Sigh, the crop is not growing well; everyone said that it's the punishment of the god.
strings.talk.45105.text: Sigh, the crops will all die.
strings.talk.45107.text: The crop isn't growing well these days. We will starve to death because of the lack of food.
strings.talk.45109.text: Fertilization? No, we have no fertilizer...
strings.talk.45110.text: (Er, it seems that the denizens do not know what muck is, let me make some for them. Maybe #R#B 20 Organic Muck /#R/#B is enough...)
strings.talk.45112.text: Here is the fertilizer, it will be helpful.
strings.talk.45113.text: Oh. Thank you very much, but can you tell me how to make the fertilizer.
strings.talk.45114.text: Oh... this is my secret recipe! I won't tell other people.
strings.talk.45115.text: Thank you for your help last time, the crops are much better now.
strings.talk.45116.text: We must thank you. This honorarium is for you.
strings.talk.45117.text: Whoops, my bucket has broken, how can I get water from the river?
strings.talk.45118.text: Whoops, what can I do now? It is troublesome!
strings.talk.45119.text: (If I had a #R#B bucket/#R/#B, I would help the old woman.)
strings.talk.45120.text: This bucket is for you, grandma. Do you need me to fetch water for you?
strings.talk.45121.text: Thank you for finding the bucket for me, young man. I feel ashamed to ask you to fetch the water for me. This gift is for you.
strings.talk.45123.text: (I will make #R#B 20 organic muck/#R/#B for them.)
strings.talk.45126.text: I am the researcher of this island; I want to do some research of the animals. Can you help me to catch 3 different kinds of animal from this island, because I am too old to do it?
strings.talk.45127.text: That it is...OK, I will catch them for you.
strings.talk.45128.text: You are brave, now catch #R#B Intensified Male Beetle/#R/#B for me first.
strings.talk.45129.text: The first animal is #R#B Intensified Male Beetle/#R/#B, I will wait for you here.
strings.talk.45130.text: I can't believe that you finished it so quickly. I chose the right person to help me. Give it to me and then catch the #R/#B Rain Forest Frog/#R#B.
strings.talk.45131.text: The second animal is #R#B Rain Forest Frog/#R/#B, I will wait for you here
strings.talk.45132.text: You did it! Great! Give it to me. Last, catch the #R#B Squirrel/#R/#B.
strings.talk.45133.text: The last animal is #R#B Squirrel/#R/#B; I will wait for you here.
strings.talk.45134.text: I can't believe that you caught these 3 kinds of animal so quickly, young man. It is really not simple.
strings.talk.45136.text: Thank you for your help, the gift is for you.
strings.talk.45137.text: Thank you for your help last time, I will ask you for help if I want to do any research.
strings.talk.45139.text: What's wrong with you, old woman?
strings.talk.45140.text: I am hungry because I can't beg for food these days.
strings.talk.45141.text: (may be #R#B 10 sushi/#R/#B is enough for her)
strings.talk.45142.text: Hold your own. I will go to find some food for you.
strings.talk.45143.text: (I must quickly find out #R#B 10 sushi/#R/#B for the old woman, or she are untenable)
strings.talk.45144.text: Thanks for your sushi; I have never eaten such delicious food before.
strings.talk.45145.text: Smelly beggar, I had ask you that do not beg here again?
strings.talk.45146.text: M'lord, I don't do it on purpose. Please forgive me.
strings.talk.45147.text: Stop! Don't treat an old woman so cruelly. What a sight!
strings.talk.45148.text: Who are you? Somebody come and kill him!
strings.talk.45149.text: It really overestimates your strength. Scram!
strings.talk.45150.text: Dare you come here? Somebody come to beat him down!
strings.talk.45151.text: Thank you young man, I would have died without you.
strings.talk.45152.text: Don't say that. I only did what was right!
strings.talk.45153.text: A kind man give this to me last time, I have no use of it. I will give it to you.
strings.talk.45154.text: Thank you for saving me last time, young man.
strings.talk.45156.text: Old woman, are you ok? Eat the sushi quickly.
strings.talk.45158.text: Little sister, what do you admire about?
strings.talk.45159.text: The trend in the village is keeping pets, I wanted to catch one, but my parents won't allow...
strings.talk.45160.text: (It seems that she wants to have a pet very much, what about catching a pet for her?)
strings.talk.45161.text: I will catch one for you. Ok?
strings.talk.45162.text: Really? I want to have a #R#B Poisonous Mushroom/#R/#B, it will make me imposing.
strings.talk.45163.text: Wait me here; I will catch one for you.
strings.talk.45164.text: You told me that you will catch a #R#BPoisonous Mushroom/#R/#B for me. Don't jazz me.
strings.talk.45165.text: Is this the pet that you want, little sister?
strings.talk.45167.text: I will give it to you if you like.
strings.talk.45168.text: Really? I will name it Mushroom.
strings.talk.45170.text: These are some shells that I picked up by the seaside, I will give them to you.
strings.talk.45174.text: What's up? Why do you cry here?
strings.talk.45177.text: We raised Aniu for decades. It disappeared when I let it go out for grass. I can't find it anywhere.
strings.talk.45178.text: We depend on Aniu for a living. What can I do if my dad knows the truth?
strings.talk.45179.text: Don't cry any longer. Would you like me to find the buffalo for you?
strings.talk.45180.text: Really? Can you find an #R#B Easy-going Buffalo /#R/#B for me?
strings.talk.45181.text: Don't worry! Wait here for me.
strings.talk.45182.text: It is an #R#B Easy-going Buffalo /#R/#B. I will wait for you here.
strings.talk.45183.text: Is it the buffalo you wanted?
strings.talk.45185.text: It is great. The buffalo looks like my Aniu. My parents won't discover the truth if I take it home. I need to teach it some rules.
strings.talk.45186.text: Thanks for your help. I have been saving my money for a long time to buy this gift. I will give it to you.
strings.talk.45188.text: From now on, I will call you Aniu.
strings.talk.45189.text: Hi! Would you like to make a deal?
strings.talk.45191.text: I wanted to make a fur coat for my distant relative who lives a great distance away, but I don't have any #R#Bhide/#R/#B at all, can you find #R#B10 hide/#R/#B for me.
strings.talk.45192.text: No problem! Wait for me, I will do it.
strings.talk.45194.text: This is the hide you want.
strings.talk.45195.text: Great, I can make the fur coat with these hides.
strings.talk.45196.text: Thank you for helping me, this is for you.
strings.talk.45197.text: Thank you for your help, I have begun to make the coat.
strings.talk.45199.text: Madam, why are you so angry?
strings.talk.45200.text: The noise of the #R#Bcrow/#R/#B woke me up when I was sleeping this afternoon, but after I got up, I could?t find the #R#Bgold necklace/#R/#B that my husband gave me.
strings.talk.45201.text: Damn! I won't let the thief get away easily.
strings.talk.45202.text: As the necklace was given to you by your husband, it must be very special.  I will keep my eyes open for it.
strings.talk.45203.text: If you find my #R#B gold necklace/#R/#B, please tell me immediately.
strings.talk.45204.text: It's really strange. Why is there a nest on the Moai statuary?
strings.talk.45205.text: It's really strange. Why is there a nest on the Moai statuary? It seems that there is something shining in the nest.
strings.talk.45206.text: Isn't it a necklace? The gold necklace was taken by the crow; I have to return it to its original owner.
strings.talk.45208.text: Madam, is this the necklace that was stolen?
strings.talk.45209.text: Yes! This is the stolen necklace; did you catch the thief and teach him a lesson?
strings.talk.45210.text: I have taught him a lesson, he won't do it again, and you must put the valuable things away next time.
strings.talk.45211.text: I will put them away from now on, thank you for finding the necklace for me. This present is for you.
strings.talk.45212.text: The necklace is back, I am so relieved!
strings.talk.45213.text: Here is a temple, I have to make a wish in earnest...May the god bless us...
strings.talk.45215.text: Ha-ha, I haven?t met one so faithful as you are, if you can pass the test, I will give you a big present.
strings.talk.45216.text: Do you want to rise to the challenge?
strings.talk.45219.text: It doesn?t matter, come to find me if you rise to challenge.
strings.talk.45220.text: Congratulations, this is the present for you. Please accept it.
strings.talk.45222.text: Ha-ha, what a pity that you failed the test, try again later.
strings.talk.45223.text: You come to rise to the challenge again. Let's begin.
strings.talk.45224.text: I am dead... please keep me company...
strings.talk.45225.text: You dare to hurt innocent people here. I will let you feel what it is like to be bullied.
strings.talk.45226.text: Sorry, I won't. Please let me go.
strings.talk.45228.text: What's up? Why do you cry?
strings.talk.45229.text: I was teased by others before I died. I swear that I don't want to be reborn if I am not able to scare people. However, nobody is scared of me. I am even teased by kids.
strings.talk.45230.text: It seems that it is impossible for me to be reborn...
strings.talk.45231.text: (He is pitiful. Let me help him.)
strings.talk.45232.text: All right. Don't cry. I can help you scare a person.
strings.talk.45234.text: (Go to #R#B Fishing Village /#R/#B to find some people.)
strings.talk.45239.text: No. I am the bravest kid in the village.
strings.talk.45240.text: Great. Can you do me a favor?
strings.talk.45243.text: It is too easy to pretend to be scared by a ghost. But I have one requirement.
strings.talk.45245.text: I will help you if you can give me #R#B 50 thousand /#R/#B.
strings.talk.45250.text: I will help you when you have #R#B 50 thousand /#R/#B.
strings.talk.45251.text: Come to find me when you have #R#B50,000/#R/#B.
strings.talk.45252.text: Thank you. You go there first and I will follow you.
strings.talk.45253.text: You go there first and I will follow you.
strings.talk.45254.text: I helped you to find a kid. You can scare him.
strings.talk.45256.text: Oh? The sound of step. It must be that kid. Please prepare for it.
strings.talk.45258.text: Wow! I am a ghost! I want to eat you!
strings.talk.45259.text: It is a ghost! So horrible! I am so afraid!
strings.talk.45260.text: (The acting of Lengzi is so bad.)
strings.talk.45263.text: Thank you for your help. I have finished my wish. I can go to be reborn.
strings.talk.45264.text: I have kept it for a long time. Now it is yours.
strings.talk.45270.text: There is a organ in the pillar and the shape of the flute in the organ is a stone. Does it need #R#B Mars Aerolith /#R/#B to open the organ?
strings.talk.45271.text: The shape of the flute is the same as the Mars Aerolith. Let me have a try!
strings.talk.45273.text: Is there any secret? Let me enter it.
strings.talk.45274.text: There are five pillars in the front of the stone door. Is there any way to open it?
strings.talk.45275.text: It said that the stone door can be open when five pillars go down.
strings.talk.45276.text: En, I will have a try.
strings.talk.45277.text: You have come finally. You are not a common people because you can pass the trial of stone door.
strings.talk.45279.text: Yes. I am Tutan Khamen. My Priest has told me, before I died, that there would be a Savior. The Savior will come to visit my tomb and I can give him the power of Lion Heart. I have waited for a long time.
strings.talk.45280.text: Although you are able to come to my tomb, I still have a trial for you. Only the real Savior can pass it.
strings.talk.45284.text: Maybe you are not the Savior...
strings.talk.45285.text: Maybe you are brave as the Savior. But you have to pass my trial. Let's begin it.
strings.talk.45286.text: You are the real Savior. I have waited for you for a long time. I will give you the power of Lion Heart. I hope you can use it properly.
strings.talk.45287.text: I can sleep without any troubles...
strings.talk.45288.text: Please have a rest. I will never disappoint you.
strings.talk.45291.text: You can choose one weapon without any regret and you are unable to trade it. What do you want?
strings.talk.45294.text: You dare to enter the Dragon Cave!
strings.talk.45295.text: I will let you go. Go away!
strings.talk.45296.text: Great. You have passed the trial. You can enter now!
strings.talk.45297.text: Why are there so many stone soldiers?
strings.talk.45298.text: You should pass our trial if you want to open the stone door.
strings.talk.45299.text: Don't consider that it is easy to pass the trial!
strings.talk.45301.text: Great. Nobody will arrive here for a long time. Are you ready to accept my trial?
strings.talk.45302.text: Are you afraid of the trial?
strings.talk.45303.text: It seems that you are unable to challenge me. Go away!
strings.talk.45304.text: It seems that you don't want to give it up. Are you ready to accept my trial again?
strings.talk.45307.text: You will be powerful in the future because you can pass my trial. I will give you my power.
strings.talk.45309.text: Dragon Soul Sword (ATK+15, SPD+30, Critical chance +14%)
strings.talk.45310.text: Dragon Soul Wand (MATK+15, SPD+28, Critical chance +14%)
strings.talk.45311.text: Come to find me if you decide it...
strings.talk.45312.text: The shape of the flute on the wall is the same as the #R#BDragon Spirit/#R/#B. Let me have a try.
strings.talk.45313.text: I have guessed the right answer. There is a path. Let me enter.
strings.talk.45314.text: The shape of the flute on the wall looks like #R#BDragon Spirit/#R/#B.
strings.talk.45315.text: The shape of the flute is not the same as the Dragon Spirit. Is there any other flute?
strings.talk.45316.text: Why are there flutes with strange shapes on the wall?
strings.talk.45317.text: We swore that we would propect Xu Fu with our lives.
strings.talk.45318.text: Xu Fu sincerely protected the Elixir for the Emperor. It is my honor to follow Xu Fu.
strings.talk.45319.text: I miss my family because I have been here for a long time.
strings.talk.45320.text: Although Xu Fu is old, he is powerful.
strings.talk.45321.text: I never thought that you would pass the tasks that I had set. You are strong.
strings.talk.45325.text: The Emperor died before I got the Elixir. But I believe that the Emperor will be reborn one day. So several heelers and I took a small amount of the medicine. I hope that I can hand the Elixir to the Emperor by myself.
strings.talk.45326.text: I set many organs because I am afraid of revealing the secret of the Elixir. I have waited here for thousands of years. However, the Emperor is unable to be reborn.
strings.talk.45327.text: All right. You are lucky. I will teach you all my skills if you can pass my trial.
strings.talk.45329.text: You can accept my trial when you are powerful enough.

strings.talk.46461.text: Ok, I will go to #R#Bcarnie, South Island, China, Korea, Egypt and Bangkok/#R/#B now to collect all the cards.
strings.talk.46462.text: Happy New Year! Please accept this local card!
strings.talk.46463.text: I have 6 cards, here you go!
strings.talk.46466.text: There's a key in the coffin!
strings.talk.46467.text: Is this the key to the Captain's room?
strings.talk.46472.text: There's skeletons next to the treasure, are they protecting it?
strings.talk.46478.text: Sorry Captain, I can't protect the treasure...
strings.talk.46480.text: I'm a loser. I thought I would get rich from the Mummy Coffin, but was cursed and my ship sunk... I lost everything!
strings.talk.46485.text: I hope the Captain rests in peace.
strings.talk.46486.text: Do you know my strength? LEAVE!
strings.talk.46489.text: I was so busy preparing for the New Year that I forgot the Rat's Wedding!
strings.talk.46491.text: Yeah, it's the Rat's Wedding day every January 3rd! Everyone prepares salt and rice for the Rat so rats won't hurt us.
strings.talk.46493.text: What do you need for the Rat's Wedding?
strings.talk.46494.text: Just some #R#BSea Salt and Rice/#R/#B, five for each one.
strings.talk.46495.text: Wait here, I'll go get them!
strings.talk.46496.text: Here's the items for the Rat's Wedding!
strings.talk.46497.text: Great, thanks for the help! This is for your troubles!
strings.talk.46498.text: I hope the rats won't harm the farmers anymore.
strings.talk.46500.text: I lost the materials to make Sweet Box, it's all my fault!
strings.talk.46501.text: Can you help me find the materials I need?
strings.talk.46504.text: I need #R#BLover's Ribbon/#R/#B, #R#BPaper Box/#R/#B and #R#BFlamy Ribbon/#R/#B
strings.talk.46505.text: I will find#R#BLover's Ribbon/#R/#B, #R#BPaper Box/#R/#B and #R#BFlamy Ribbon/#R/#B now.
strings.talk.46507.text: Yes! Yes it is! Thanks, take this for the trouble!
strings.talk.46508.text: So what kind of gift do you want to trade for?
strings.talk.46512.text: You need at least 10 tickets to exchange.
strings.talk.46513.text: This is an Item Mall item. Are you sure you want to sell it?
strings.talk.46514.text: This is an Item Mall item. Are you sure you want to discard it?
strings.talk.46515.text: It seems you're having some trouble. Can I help you?
strings.talk.46516.text: My dad is old now and he needs a crutch. Can you help me get #R#B3 Oak wood/#R/#B?
strings.talk.46517.text: OK, I will get them for you.
strings.talk.46518.text: Here are the 3 Oak wood you wanted.
strings.talk.46519.text: Thank you so much. This is your reward.
strings.talk.46521.text: It's a nice day to take a walk.
strings.talk.46522.text: What kind of food are you making now? It smells so good.
strings.talk.46525.text: Yeah, are you interested in learning how to do it? I can teach you how to use #R#BMayan Cocoa Nibs/#R/#B to make chocolate.
strings.talk.46527.text: First heat up the cocoa powder and then mix it with granulated sugar, milk powder, emulsifier,  gum arabic and so on. Soon it will start to cool.
strings.talk.46529.text: It sounds easy, but can be a little tricky. You must be careful.
strings.talk.46530.text: Unfortunately, I don't have enough #R#BMayan Cocoa Nibs/#R/#B. Can you help me get some #R#BMayan Cocoa Nibs/#R/#B?
strings.talk.46531.text: I can't make chocolate without Mayan Cocoa Nibs.
strings.talk.46532.text: OK, I will get some #R#BMayan Cocoa Nibs/#R/#B for you. Can you tell me where to get them?
strings.talk.46533.text: Mayan Cocoa Nibs can be found in the #R#BMayan Forest/#R/#B.
strings.talk.46538.text: It's dangerous to search alone. Take the beans.
strings.talk.46539.text: I found some Mayan Cocoa Nibs.
strings.talk.46540.text: Thank you so much. Now I can make some chocolate. Here is your reward.
strings.talk.46541.text: Be careful! There are many wild animals in the jungle, and even some #R#Bcannibals/#R/#B.
strings.talk.46542.text: There are too many cannibals. I'd better make sure I'm prepared.
strings.talk.46543.text: Return with the #R#BMayan Cocoa Nibs/#R/#B as quickly as you can.
strings.talk.46544.text: I'm really scared. There was a snake in my house.
strings.talk.46545.text: Mine too. Thank goodness I ran fast enough.
strings.talk.46547.text: If the snake can't eat people, it will eat your food.
strings.talk.46548.text: I discovered some of my food had been eaten.
strings.talk.46549.text: It is awful to have that snake in your house.
strings.talk.46551.text: A snake has appeared in our village.
strings.talk.46552.text: We're lucky nobody has been hurt.
strings.talk.46553.text: But it's awful having that snake in our houses.
strings.talk.46555.text: (Er.. #R#BEats human/#R/#B? You'd better talk to the #R#BSnake Charmer/#R/#B.)
strings.talk.46556.text: It's awful having that snake in the house.
strings.talk.46557.text: If it eats all my food, what will I eat?
strings.talk.46558.text: I can't go home while it's in there.
strings.talk.46560.text: Are you #n/#n? Thank you for finding my Snake's Flute.
strings.talk.46562.text: I've heard there's a #R#Bsnake that eats human food/#R/#B in your village.
strings.talk.46563.text: The #R#Bsnake that eats human food/#R/#B is one of my snakes. It's so old that it can't hear my Snake's Flute.
strings.talk.46565.text: Have you tried to find it?
strings.talk.46566.text: I tried, but I couldn't find it. I'm surprised it's in the village.
strings.talk.46567.text: Can you help me get it back?
strings.talk.46569.text: How should I deal with it if it hurts people?
strings.talk.46572.text: A huge snake! A #R#Bhorrible snake is inside/#R/#B. Help! Help!
strings.talk.46573.text: (It has appeared. Go catch it before it attacks anyone.)
strings.talk.46575.text: Come with me. Your owner misses you so much.
strings.talk.46577.text: It sounds like you're angry, so forgive me but I must force you to return with me.
strings.talk.46578.text: I need more time to prepare.
strings.talk.46580.text: Huge snake, you are very strong.
strings.talk.46582.text: I will take you back to your owner.
strings.talk.46587.text: I've brought it back to you.
strings.talk.46590.text: No problem. You better keep your eyes on it this time.
strings.talk.46592.text: Here is your reward. Thank you.
strings.talk.46593.text: (It seems this snake has made a lot of trouble for you. Come ask the #R#BSnake Charmer /#R/#B for help.)
strings.talk.46594.text: It really scares me. Thank you for driving it away.
strings.talk.46595.text: Yuki? Nana? or Fish sama? I can't remember now.
strings.talk.46598.text: Excuse me, can you repeat that?
strings.talk.46599.text: You don't believe me, but it's true.
strings.talk.46600.text: I've forgotten when I began to forget my name.
strings.talk.46601.text: I have a habit of walking through #R#BCherry Forest/#R/#B to enjoy the cherries.
strings.talk.46602.text: I heard someone call my name on my last walk, then I fell down and forgot my name ...
strings.talk.46603.text: My family tries to help me remember my name, but I keep forgetting.
strings.talk.46604.text: You are the only one who can help me now. Please help me remember my name.
strings.talk.46605.text: It doesn't matter. I will try my best to remember it.
strings.talk.46607.text: Really? I am so happy that you want to help me.
strings.talk.46608.text: You said you lost your memory in the #R#BCherry Forest/#R/#B?
strings.talk.46609.text: Yeah, I've been looking for someone to help me investigate, but nobody believes me.
strings.talk.46610.text: She hasn't come? She usually comes twice a month.
strings.talk.46612.text: How can you see me? Oh, I forgot to hide myself. You've seen me, so you must die.
strings.talk.46613.text: Please wait a moment. I still have something to say to you.
strings.talk.46614.text: (Why does this man want me to leave the forest? Does he know something important?)
strings.talk.46615.text: I'm sorry. I'm the #R#BCherrytree Spirit/#R/#B. I apologize for what I have done.
strings.talk.46616.text: The Cherrytree Spirit? Do you know why that girl can't remember her name?
strings.talk.46617.text: You say a girl walked through here and then forgot her name? #R#BI stole her name/#R/#B.
strings.talk.46619.text: Because I love her. I wanted to see her forever. I am the Cherrytree Spirit, so I can't leave here.
strings.talk.46620.text: I thought she would come back to find her memory, but she didn't.
strings.talk.46621.text: Please return the name to her.
strings.talk.46624.text: Now I will use my true skill to defeat you.
strings.talk.46625.text: No one can stop me from loving her.
strings.talk.46627.text: Don't you know that if you love her, you must do your best to make her happy?
strings.talk.46628.text: You are right. I have made a mistake. This scroll contains her name. If she sees it, she will remember her name.
strings.talk.46629.text: Please don't tell her about me. I just want to see her walk through the Cherry Forest again.
strings.talk.46633.text: Your name is in this scroll. Open it.
strings.talk.46634.text: I remember my name is #R#BSukura/#R/#. Thank you so much.
strings.talk.46635.text: #f1/#fI am so happy that you have remembered your name.
strings.talk.46636.text: If you have time, please go have a walk in the Cherry Forest. The cherries miss you so much.
strings.talk.46637.text: I miss them, too. Here is your reward.
strings.talk.46638.text: The cherries in Kyoto are very beautiful, go there to have a walk.
strings.talk.46639.text: This scroll contains her name. As long as she sees it, she will once again remember her name.
strings.talk.46640.text: I hope I will see the girl in the Cherry Forest.
strings.talk.46641.text: You can't defeat me, so go away.
strings.talk.46643.text: What happened? Old man, why you crying so much?
strings.talk.46644.text: My son #R#BKennaca/#R/# has been taken away by human traffickers.
strings.talk.46645.text: Kennaca is injured, so he had no power to resist.
strings.talk.46647.text: These human traffickers have caught many Africans before, so all the young men run away and hide.
strings.talk.46648.text: But this time they've taken the old people hostage, so ...
strings.talk.46649.text: What about the young men who left?
strings.talk.46650.text: They went out hunting, so they managed to avoid being captured this time.
strings.talk.46651.text: Please help me rescue my Kennaca.
strings.talk.46653.text: Tell me what direction the human traffickers were heading in.
strings.talk.46654.text: They left here just a moment ago. Now they must be at the #R#BSlave Ship outside the village/#R/#B.
strings.talk.46656.text: Have you found the Slave Ship and my Kennaca?
strings.talk.46657.text: Are you a client? Want to buy some slaves?
strings.talk.46658.text: I have many kinds of slaves. What kind would you like?
strings.talk.46659.text: I have #some special ways/#R/#B to help you select a slave.
strings.talk.46660.text: I have come to give them freedom!
strings.talk.46661.text: Oh, you are one super liberator!
strings.talk.46663.text: You will make an excellent slave. Catch him!
strings.talk.46667.text: You are too weak to be a slave.
strings.talk.46669.text: We can't defeat him. Go summon more people.
strings.talk.46672.text: I came here to rescue all of you. Is Kennaca here?
strings.talk.46674.text: Your father asked me to rescue you.
strings.talk.46676.text: I thought I wouldn't see my family anymore.
strings.talk.46678.text: Let's talk about these things when we're really safe. You guys should leave now!
strings.talk.46679.text: I must find the key to set them free.
strings.talk.46682.text: They are so evil that they have taken old men as hostages.
strings.talk.46683.text: Who said you can leave! You are my commodity, how can you just leave without my permission?
strings.talk.46684.text: It's over! So we still can't escape after all?
strings.talk.46685.text: Am I really destined to be a slave for the rest of my life?
strings.talk.46686.text: Damn it! I didn't expect you guys to be back so soon!
strings.talk.46688.text: We must prove that we are not just common human traffickers.
strings.talk.46689.text: We must teach him a lesson.
strings.talk.46690.text: Shut up! All of you are rubbish!
strings.talk.46691.text: You defeated them! You are quite skilled. Would you like to be my assistant? I will provide you with lots of benefits.
strings.talk.46692.text: I'm sorry, but I am not interested.
strings.talk.46695.text: OK. Everyone has gone home. I don't think they will try this business again.
strings.talk.46696.text: It's wonderful that we won't be forced into slavery.
strings.talk.46697.text: Thank you so much, I will always remember your kindness!
strings.talk.46698.text: Everyone, please go back to your villages.
strings.talk.46700.text: Why are you still crying? Do you have other difficulties?
strings.talk.46701.text: I am so happy that I don't know how to express my gratitude.
strings.talk.46705.text: Thank you so much. I hope you enjoy your adventure.
strings.talk.46706.text: Why have you been standing here for so long?
strings.talk.46707.text: I am waiting for my boyfriend, #R#BLamont/#R/#B. He's late returning home.
strings.talk.46709.text: It never happens, so I am worried about him.
strings.talk.46710.text: Before he set sail, he proposed to me, but I was so nervous that I didn't answer him. I hope he arrives soon so I can tell him "I do."
strings.talk.46711.text: I worry about him so much.
strings.talk.46712.text: Don't worry, I will help you find him.
strings.talk.46713.text: Can you tell me his vessel and his destination?
strings.talk.46714.text: His vessel is the #R#BThunder/#R/#B. All I know is he was to take a man called #R#BProfessor Sue/#R/#B to #R#BAustralia/#R/#B.
strings.talk.46715.text: OK, I will go to #R#BAustralia/#R/#B, so don't worry.
strings.talk.46717.text: Excuse me, are you Professor Sue?
strings.talk.46718.text: Don't speak so loudly. You will attract the dinosaur.
strings.talk.46719.text: Oh, sorry. Are you Professor Sue?
strings.talk.46720.text: Yes, are you one of my fans? I could tell you about that time ...
strings.talk.46722.text: ... that time I stepped on the tail of a dinosaur. You can imagine what happened next.
strings.talk.46723.text: (He is speaking more and more loudly.)
strings.talk.46724.text: Don't you agree that I am the bravest, most intelligent ...
strings.talk.46727.text: ... so many dinosaurs nearby. I warned you not to speak so loudly.
strings.talk.46731.text: Thank you. Without your help, they would have eaten me.
strings.talk.46732.text: It must your voice that attracted them, but never mind. Thank you for your help. This is a #R#BMagical Cure Potion/#R/#B. I'd like you to have it.
strings.talk.46733.text: I'm trying to find the vessel that carried you here.
strings.talk.46734.text: After we arrived, a drunken man wanted to go to #R#BCentaur Island/#R/#B. Maybe they took him there.
strings.talk.46736.text: Thank you for your help. This #R#BMagical Cure Potion/#R/#B is your reward.
strings.talk.46738.text: He washed up on shore and keeps saying the ship will be wrecked, the #R#BThunder/#R/#B. I think he must have been in a shipwreck during a storm.
strings.talk.46739.text: (If he is from the Thunder, maybe the #R#BMagical Cure Potion/#R/#B will help him recall what happened.
strings.talk.46740.text: This Magical Cure Potion may work.
strings.talk.46742.text: You are on Centaur Island. Are you a sailor from the Thunder?
strings.talk.46743.text: I was one of the passengers. We got caught in a storm and our vessel sank.
strings.talk.46744.text: Do you know a man named Lamont?
strings.talk.46745.text: Lamont went back to the vessel to see if there were others still inside, and finally sank along with the ship.
strings.talk.46747.text: Yes. He gave me something before he entered the vessel again.
strings.talk.46748.text: He said this ring is for his girlfriend. If he didn't survive, he wanted me to give it to her. Sadly, I don't know who she is.
strings.talk.46749.text: Give it to me. I know where his girlfriend is.
strings.talk.46750.text: This man is unconscious again. How should I wake him up?
strings.talk.46753.text: Where did you get this Magical Cure Potion?
strings.talk.46754.text: This ring is what Lamont wanted me to give his girlfriend. Thank you for your help.
strings.talk.46755.text: Thank you for your potion. I feel better now.
strings.talk.46756.text: Have you found him? How is he?
strings.talk.46757.text: He was caught in a storm and sank with his ship.
strings.talk.46758.text: I can't believe it, I can't ...
strings.talk.46759.text: I do, Lamont! Can you hear me?
strings.talk.46760.text: He wanted you to have this.
strings.talk.46761.text: Lamont wanted to #R#Bpropose again/#R/#B, so he bought it.
strings.talk.46762.text: A ring?! I don't want it! I want Lamont! You can have the ring. Take it from my sight!
strings.talk.46763.text: It was awful to see so many dinosaurs. I wanted to come home again.
strings.talk.46764.text: I don't think Lamont is dead. I shall wait for him here.
strings.talk.46765.text: I think I've done all I can to help, so I will leave.
strings.talk.46766.text: You forgot to take Lamont's #R#BRing/#R/#B with you.
strings.talk.46767.text: He is groaning. He must be badly wounded.
strings.talk.46768.text: Before we set sail, we must consider the weather.
strings.talk.46769.text: This ring means nothing to me now. Please help me find Lamont it will be your reward. Thank you!
strings.talk.46770.text: I met a strange bear yesterday.
strings.talk.46773.text: There is a #R#BRed Nosed Bear/#R/# in Fog Jungle.
strings.talk.46774.text: It stares at you from a distance.
strings.talk.46775.text: A Red Nosed Bear that stares at you from a distance? It doesn't attack people?
strings.talk.46776.text: I saw it many times, but it just stared at me and then ran away.
strings.talk.46777.text: However, there was one man who said he had been attacked by the #R#BRed Nosed Bear/#R/#B.
strings.talk.46778.text: Who is he? Why was he attacked?
strings.talk.46779.text: He's a young man called #R#BSis/#R/#B. He's here in this village.
strings.talk.46780.text: I don't think I believe that story.
strings.talk.46782.text: I hope I see that Red Nosed Bear.
strings.talk.46783.text: (A Red Nosed Bear sounds very strange. I want to see it, but I must find #R#BSis/#R/#B first.)
strings.talk.46784.text: Ask #R#BSis/#R/#B about the strange Red Nosed Bear.
strings.talk.46785.text: I would like to see that Red Noses Bear with my own eyes.
strings.talk.46786.text: Have you seen the Red Nosed Bear?
strings.talk.46787.text: If you see it, please tell me.
strings.talk.46789.text: What a pity! I have never seen such bear.
strings.talk.46791.text: He's gone to work. You can find him in the #R#BFog Jungle/#R/#B.
strings.talk.46792.text: (Someone is being attacked by the Red Nosed Bear. Do you want to help him or not?)
strings.talk.46793.text: (Maybe it is just a rumor. Let it end here.)
strings.talk.46795.text: The Red Nosed Bear is so strong! I must prepare myself if I want to challenge it.
strings.talk.46796.text: Are you hurt? I drove away the bear.
strings.talk.46797.text: Thank you, I'm OK. That Red Nosed Bear has attacked me many times, but I don't know why it only attacks me.
strings.talk.46798.text: It only attacks you? Are you Sis?
strings.talk.46799.text: You know my name? I guess you've already heard that I'm the only one the #Red Noses Bear/#R/#B attacks.
strings.talk.46800.text: Nobody believes me, including my fiancee.
strings.talk.46802.text: You may not believe me. The Red Nosed Bear will stop to howl, which gives me a chance to escape.
strings.talk.46803.text: What a strange bear it is!
strings.talk.46804.text: I must pass through here for my job. I really don't know why it only attacks me.
strings.talk.46805.text: I think I'd better drive it away, or it may hurt others.
strings.talk.46806.text: That's great. I think it's hiding in the #R#BFog Jungle/#R/#B.
strings.talk.46807.text: I will return to #R#BCornwall/#R/#B and wait for your good news.
strings.talk.46808.text: (It is the Red Nosed Bear, but it looks very strange.)
strings.talk.46809.text: I hate him but I can't kill him.
strings.talk.46810.text: Are you the bear that attacks Sis? Why do you attack Sis?
strings.talk.46811.text: You know my secret, so I can't let you leave.
strings.talk.46813.text: Hold on, I don't want to hurt you!
strings.talk.46814.text: It's hard to believe a girl could have such power. I must prepare myself if I want to fight her.
strings.talk.46815.text: Why do you turn into a bear? Why do you attack Sis?
strings.talk.46816.text: He is a heartless man. He gave me the cold shoulder and decided to marry some rich miss.
strings.talk.46817.text: I hate him, so I begged #R#BWitch Baddy/#R/#B to help me.
strings.talk.46818.text: Witch Baddy gave me a bottle of #R#BTransform Potion/#R/#B that enables me to become an animal.
strings.talk.46820.text: But when finally got my paws on him, I couldn't kill him. Sob ...
strings.talk.46821.text: I don't think you'll get revenge this way. You must find a new love instead.
strings.talk.46822.text: I don't want to think about him any more. I must take care of myself from now on.
strings.talk.46823.text: I think I should leave this sad place and start a new life.
strings.talk.46824.text: That is a good idea. I think you will find a better life.
strings.talk.46825.text: Thank you so much. Can you return this #R#BFeena Ring/#R/#B to Sis? He gave it to me before things changed.
strings.talk.46826.text: I will take it to him.
strings.talk.46828.text: I have driven the bear away.
strings.talk.46829.text: That's great! I won't be attacked by the monster anymore.
strings.talk.46830.text: So the Red Nosed Bear was my former lover? I am so sorry.
strings.talk.46831.text: Everything is OK now. It's safe to enter the jungle again.
strings.talk.46832.text: A girl named #R#BFeena/#R/#B wanted me to give you this ring.
strings.talk.46836.text: She is ... I need a moment to calm down.
strings.talk.46837.text: Here is your reward. Thank you for driving the bear away.
strings.talk.46839.text: Have you found the Red Nosed Bear? Did you drive it away from Fog Jungle?
strings.talk.46840.text: You must be joking. How could a girl become a bear and attack people?
strings.talk.46841.text: It's true. You must believe me.
strings.talk.46843.text: Sis must be in the #R#BFog Jungle/#R/#B.
strings.talk.46844.text: Please give this Feena Ring to Sis.
strings.talk.46845.text: I have decided to leave and start a new life.
strings.talk.46846.text: You forgot to take the Feena Ring with you.
strings.talk.46847.text: Sis and his fiancee Eleanor live in the #R#Bvillage near the capital/#R/#B.
strings.talk.46848.text: The Red Nosed Bear is attacking someone. I must rescue him at once.
strings.talk.46850.text: What happened? Why are you talking to yourself?
strings.talk.46851.text: I think I must tell the truth.
strings.talk.46852.text: I am human, not a monster.
strings.talk.46854.text: You'd say it, too, if you saw what I'm hiding.
strings.talk.46856.text: Please be quiet. First listen to what I have to say.
strings.talk.46857.text: This is what happened. I went to Cornwall for my job recently.
strings.talk.46858.text: I met a girl who called herself #R#BWitch Baddy/#R/#B.
strings.talk.46859.text: I have heard that name before.
strings.talk.46860.text: She said she had made a potion that would turn me into an animal and asked me to give it a try.
strings.talk.46861.text: I didn't believe her, but I drank it anyway.
strings.talk.46862.text: I became a wolf, but I could return to my human form at will.
strings.talk.46864.text: You know of it?! Unfortunately I can't control the change any longer.
strings.talk.46865.text: I can't find the witch to ask for a remedy. Would you please find #R#BWitch Baddy/#R/#B and get the #R#BTransform Remedy/#R/#B for me?
strings.talk.46866.text: Do you know where to find her?
strings.talk.46867.text: Witch Baddy harvests materials in #R#BFog Jungle/#R/#B.
strings.talk.46868.text: Have you found Witch Baddy? Did she give you the remedy?
strings.talk.46869.text: #f2/#fShe is surrounded by wolves. I must rescue her.
strings.talk.46870.text: The wolves are so fierce that I need more time to prepare for battle.
strings.talk.46871.text: Are you OK? Are you hurt?
strings.talk.46872.text: You hurt #R#Bmy bodyguards/#R/#B! What do you want?
strings.talk.46873.text: Your bodyguards are wolves? Are you ...
strings.talk.46874.text: You don't know my name? I am #R#BWitch Baddy/#R/#B.
strings.talk.46875.text: You are Witch Baddy. Do you know Matthew?
strings.talk.46876.text: Matthew? Yeah, I know him. He is the first man who drank my potion.
strings.talk.46877.text: I'm glad you remember him. Something went wrong after he drank your potion.
strings.talk.46878.text: Do you have a remedy that could help him?
strings.talk.46879.text: This Transform Remedy should do the trick, but you must pay me #R#B20,000 gold/#R/#B.
strings.talk.46880.text: Your potion caused the problem. Why should I pay you to fix it?
strings.talk.46881.text: Very well, if you don't want to pay it, I won't give you the remedy and Matthew will continue to suffer.
strings.talk.46882.text: Get #R#B20,000 gold/#R/#B to buy the remedy.
strings.talk.46884.text: Here's the Transform Remedy. Give it to Matthew.
strings.talk.46885.text: Unfortunately, I don't have enough money.
strings.talk.46886.text: Feel free to come back for it later if you need it, ha ha ...
strings.talk.46887.text: I found the remedy. Please drink it.
strings.talk.46889.text: This is great! My tail has disappeared.
strings.talk.46890.text: I'm happy to see you've returned to normal.
strings.talk.46891.text: Thank you for your help. Here is your reward.
strings.talk.46893.text: So do you see my tail?
strings.talk.46895.text: You forgot to take the #R#Transform Remedy/#R/#B with you.
strings.talk.46896.text: You can think twice, ha ha ...
strings.talk.46897.text: Come find me when you have 20,000 gold.
strings.talk.46898.text: Throw it away or keep collecting?
strings.talk.46899.text: What's wrong? Why are you talking to yourself?
strings.talk.46900.text: I like to collect out-of-print books. I bought one called [Sherry] and then I met a series of misfortunes.
strings.talk.46901.text: So it started with the book? Is it cursed?
strings.talk.46902.text: The day I bought it I was bitten by a dog and then my bag was stolen. Then my room key broke.
strings.talk.46903.text: I should throw it away, but I'd hate to lose it.
strings.talk.46904.text: Is there some way I can keep it without suffering from bad luck?
strings.talk.46905.text: (Do you want to help her or not?)
strings.talk.46906.text: (Maybe this book is cursed. I should keep away from her.)
strings.talk.46908.text: Please lend me the book and I will try my best to find a solution.
strings.talk.46909.text: Please take care of the book.
strings.talk.46910.text: You should talk to bookseller #R#BRee/#R/#B. He always visits the #R#BProps Shop/#R/#B to sell his books.
strings.talk.46911.text: Very well. Wait here until I find out more.
strings.talk.46912.text: Do you know anything about this book?
strings.talk.46913.text: Do you want to buy some books? I have lots of books.
strings.talk.46914.text: #f3/#f(I have no time to put these books in order. They are a mess.)
strings.talk.46915.text: I didn't come here to buy books. I want to ask you about this book.
strings.talk.46916.text: Oh, this book is the #R#BUnfortunate Book/#R/#B that I sold.
strings.talk.46918.text: When I acquired this book, bad luck started to follow me everywhere, so I call it Unfortunate Book.
strings.talk.46919.text: But I must warn you I won't let you return it.
strings.talk.46920.text: Do you know how to break the curse?
strings.talk.46921.text: I think you must go find its writer. His name is #R#BAbeni/#R/#B.
strings.talk.46922.text: He has bought books from me, but I haven't seen him lately.
strings.talk.46923.text: Excuse me, do you know where Abeni lives?
strings.talk.46924.text: Abeni lives in the #R#Bhouse in the north corner of Domremy/#R/#B.
strings.talk.46925.text: Want to buy some books to read?
strings.talk.46927.text: It seems nobody has lived here in a long time. I won't find any clues here. I'd better move on.
strings.talk.46928.text: Why did the book fall all by itself?
strings.talk.46932.text: The book can go inside by itself?
strings.talk.46933.text: I must be seeing things. I'd better take the book and get out of here.
strings.talk.46934.text: Who are you? Why you are here?
strings.talk.46935.text: I am Abeni, master of this house and the author of that book.
strings.talk.46937.text: Yes, after I finished the book, I attached my soul to it.
strings.talk.46938.text: Why would you want the book to bring bad luck to its owner?
strings.talk.46939.text: I want to teach a lesson to those who don't love the book, who can't understand it and who aren't qualified to have it.
strings.talk.46940.text: #f2/#fI think you went a bit too far.
strings.talk.46941.text: You want some bad luck? Ha ha, I will teach you a lesson.
strings.talk.46943.text: You are stronger than I expected.
strings.talk.46945.text: It's good that you want the book to be appreciated, but you can't make others think of it the way you do.
strings.talk.46946.text: They don't understand its meaning. They are stupid!
strings.talk.46947.text: People interpret books differently and enjoy different types of books. Maybe if nobody understands your book, it's because your writing wasn't good enough!
strings.talk.46956.text: I think it's OK to take this book now.
strings.talk.46958.text: I think you should read it to calm yourself.
strings.talk.46959.text: I think you are right. Thank you for your help. Here is your reward.
strings.talk.46960.text: [Sherry] is a profound book that isn't easy to understand.
strings.talk.46961.text: You forgot to take #R#B[Sherry]/#R/#B with you.
strings.talk.46963.text: I'll catch you this time, ha ha!
strings.talk.46965.text: Where are you going? You can't leave this place, ha ha!
strings.talk.46966.text: Don't approach me, or I will hurt you!
strings.talk.46968.text: (It's better not to have a finger in every pie.)
strings.talk.46969.text: Stop! You can't beat a child like that.
strings.talk.46971.text: This child appeared in our place from out of nowhere.
strings.talk.46972.text: He stole things and did a lot of damage.
strings.talk.46973.text: He stole all our fruit, including the things I had planted that weren't even ripe yet.
strings.talk.46974.text: Why did he steal the unripe fruit?
strings.talk.46975.text: My hen was scared and wouldn't lay eggs.
strings.talk.46977.text: He also broke my farm tools.
strings.talk.46978.text: I just wanted to borrow them, but as soon as I touched them, they broke.
strings.talk.46980.text: I must teach you a lesson today!
strings.talk.46981.text: Then I'll send you to the authorities.
strings.talk.46982.text: You caused all these problems. Don't come near me!
strings.talk.46983.text: Please wait! He is just a child. Why not give him another chance?
strings.talk.46984.text: But he must pay for the losses.
strings.talk.46985.text: You want to help him pay for the losses?
strings.talk.46987.text: (Do you want to pay 30,000 gold for him?)
strings.talk.46988.text: (This naughty boy needs to learn a lesson.)
strings.talk.46989.text: I advise you to stop resisting.
strings.talk.46990.text: Go to the authorities with us.
strings.talk.46992.text: I am not afraid of you!
strings.talk.46994.text: If you pay it for him, we won't go hard on him.
strings.talk.46995.text: Don't do it again, or we will send you to the authorities!
strings.talk.46997.text: #f1/#fLittle boy, please don't be so naughty next time.
strings.talk.47000.text: Hmph! Who asked you to meddle? I can beat those three people up in one go.
strings.talk.47001.text: I have another name. It is #R#BXao Yee/#R/#B. Please don't call me little boy.
strings.talk.47003.text: There is some jade on the floor. The word Yee is carved into it.
strings.talk.47004.text: It looks like Yee's jade. I will return it when I next see him.
strings.talk.47005.text: It looks like he went off toward the #R#BChinese Seaside Village/#R/#B.
strings.talk.47006.text: What should I do in this situation?
strings.talk.47007.text: Can I help you? You look like you need help.
strings.talk.47008.text: My boyfriend Sadler went to the Royal Palace alone.
strings.talk.47010.text: It's all my fault. I said I wanted #R#BKusarikku's Heart/#R/#B.
strings.talk.47012.text: There is a Kusarikku Statue in the royal palace. Persia is protected by Kusarikku.
strings.talk.47013.text: If a man has the Kusarikku's Heart, he will be a warrior forever.
strings.talk.47014.text: But that's just a legend, isn't it?
strings.talk.47015.text: Yes, and if a man enters the palace without permission, he will die.
strings.talk.47016.text: So I am worried about my boyfriend.
strings.talk.47017.text: What should I do? I want Sadler back right away.
strings.talk.47018.text: (Do you want to help her or not?)
strings.talk.47020.text: (So I can only pray for Sadler here?)
strings.talk.47021.text: Don't worry, I will help you find him.
strings.talk.47023.text: Where might Sadler be? Do you know?
strings.talk.47024.text: The Kusarikku Statue is in the #R#Broyal Palace/#R/#B. Maybe he is there.
strings.talk.47027.text: #f1/#fIt's so huge! It must be the Kusarikku Statue.
strings.talk.47028.text: Oh, sorry. I came here looking for Sadler.
strings.talk.47029.text: There is a statue of a man beside the Kusarikku Statue. Go have a look.
strings.talk.47031.text: It looks like a real man.
strings.talk.47032.text: But it's so strange to see such a thing here.
strings.talk.47035.text: Why do you come before the great #R#BParth/#R/#B?
strings.talk.47037.text: If you want to be a statue like him, I can #R#Btake your soul/#R/#B, ha ha!
strings.talk.47038.text: (This statue of a man is Sadler?)
strings.talk.47039.text: So you took this man's soul?
strings.talk.47040.text: I am sorry to disturb you. I just came to get this man back.
strings.talk.47041.text: You managed to dodge my attack. Your skills are good.
strings.talk.47042.text: I have never encountered anyone who could defeat me. Very well, I shall restore him.
strings.talk.47043.text: Yes, that's the right thing to do.
strings.talk.47044.text: Ha ha, I've never had such a wonderful challenge before.
strings.talk.47045.text: How powerful are you? I would have thought it impossible to restore his soul.
strings.talk.47046.text: #f2/#fI think I have to get in better shape before I accept this challenge.
strings.talk.47049.text: You are powerful indeed, Parth, but I won in the end.
strings.talk.47050.text: Your skills are impressive. What's your name?
strings.talk.47051.text: #n/#n, I will remember your name. You are the second human to earn my admiration.
strings.talk.47052.text: The second one? Who was the first one?
strings.talk.47053.text: The first one was the king. He used his wisdom to best me, but you used your skill.
strings.talk.47054.text: I will restore him. Don't worry.
strings.talk.47058.text: Please take this man away and leave me to my rest.
strings.talk.47059.text: I hope you will keep it secret so people won't come here to get the Kusarikku's Heart.
strings.talk.47063.text: Who are you? How do you know my name?
strings.talk.47064.text: Lacey asked me to find you. She said she was only kidding, but you came to the palace anyway.
strings.talk.47065.text: I must find the Kusarikku's Heart for her.
strings.talk.47066.text: You should let it go. Lacey is very worried about you. Please return to her.
strings.talk.47067.text: But how can I go back with nothing?
strings.talk.47068.text: (Help him and give him the #R#BLife Crystal/#R/#B.)
strings.talk.47069.text: I must destroy that statue to get it.
strings.talk.47070.text: Don't do that. I will give you something that can take the place of the Kusarikku's Heart.
strings.talk.47072.text: Maybe I can tell her this is the Kusarikku's Heart.
strings.talk.47074.text: Can you get out by yourself?
strings.talk.47075.text: Don't worry. I got in, so I know how to get out.
strings.talk.47076.text: Lacey, this is the Kusarikku's Heart.
strings.talk.47078.text: #f3/#f(I don't know if I helped Sadler or not.)
strings.talk.47079.text: Now we can prepare for our wedding.
strings.talk.47081.text: I hope you will attend our wedding.
strings.talk.47082.text: I will use this to make a beautiful necklace for our wedding.
strings.talk.47083.text: Parth is resting now, so I should not disturb him.
strings.talk.47084.text: Is the Kusarikku's Heart really in this statue?
strings.talk.47087.text: Sob ... I am not! Go away.
strings.talk.47088.text: #f2/#fStop! Why are you still being so naughty?
strings.talk.47089.text: Give the jade to Xao Yee and stop him from bullying a little girl.
strings.talk.47090.text: Why should I listen to you? Go away!
strings.talk.47092.text: You always bully me. I will tell my grandma!
strings.talk.47093.text: (You can't stop Xao Yee from bullying this little girl.)
strings.talk.47095.text: (You forgot to bring Xao Yee's jade with you.)
strings.talk.47096.text: Xao Yee, see what I have for you?
strings.talk.47099.text: OK, I will let you see my jade.
strings.talk.47102.text: This is my jade. When did you steal it from me?
strings.talk.47103.text: You are wrong. After I helped you, I found it on the road. I want to return it to you.
strings.talk.47104.text: This jade is important to me. It's a #R#Btoken from my father/#R/#B.
strings.talk.47106.text: Then you must promise me that you won't bully this little girl anymore.
strings.talk.47107.text: We caught him today. He is the great liar who spoiled the reputation of Wildboar League.
strings.talk.47108.text: He will receive harsh punishment from Wildboar League.
strings.talk.47110.text: Sorry, I shouldn't bully you like that. Can you forgive me?
strings.talk.47113.text: I must go to Chang'an as soon as I can.
strings.talk.47114.text: (Xao Yee wants to go to Chang'an.)
strings.talk.47115.text: My granddaughter, why are you talking with a stranger?
strings.talk.47116.text: Grandma, Xao Yee was bullying me again, but this passerby got him to stop.
strings.talk.47118.text: Do you know Xao Yee? Is he always so naughty?
strings.talk.47119.text: He is an unhappy boy. His mother, #R#BMrs. Liu/#R/#B, brought him here recently.
strings.talk.47120.text: She said she wanted to find her husband, but she couldn't find him.
strings.talk.47124.text: I think Xao Yee is naughty because he is very insecure and sad.
strings.talk.47125.text: It's a shame for such a little boy to be in a strange place all alone.
strings.talk.47126.text: Now there is only one person that Xao Yee can rely on, and that is his father.
strings.talk.47128.text: Thank you for stopping Xao Yee from bullying my granddaughter.
strings.talk.47129.text: Let's go home now. I will make some sweets for you.
strings.talk.47130.text: I love you. Thank you, Grandma.
strings.talk.47131.text: I hope Xao Yee finds his father soon.
strings.talk.47132.text: Commander, I brought all my food and wine.
strings.talk.47134.text: Aha, you did a good job!
strings.talk.47135.text: Now, you need to do one last thing and then I will allow you to join the Wildboar League.
strings.talk.47136.text: Really? Please tell me what it is.
strings.talk.47137.text: In #R#BBoar's Den/#R/#B there is a boar king called #R#BFiery Boar/#R/#B. Go catch it for me.
strings.talk.47138.text: OK, I will do it right now.
strings.talk.47139.text: Excuse me, what's the Wildboar League?
strings.talk.47140.text: You don't know? It was founded to protect the peace of the Mayan Forest.
strings.talk.47141.text: Do you want to join? If so, please bring your food and wine and 10,000 gold, then complete some quests.
strings.talk.47143.text: OK, go away then and don't disturb me.
strings.talk.47145.text: (Richard is going to #R#BBoar's Den/#R/#B to catch a Fiery Boar. It's very dangerous. I should go help him.)
strings.talk.47146.text: OK, are you ready to join the Wildboar League?
strings.talk.47149.text: Richard is in danger! We must go rescue him!
strings.talk.47151.text: How savage the Fiery Boar is. I will return when I am better prepared!
strings.talk.47153.text: Huh! It is very dangerous now!
strings.talk.47155.text: Where is the Fiery Boar? Where did it run? I can't join the Wildboar League if I don't capture it.
strings.talk.47156.text: The Fiery Boar has been chased off. Why would you want to join the Wildboar League? You almost lost your life.
strings.talk.47157.text: The Fiery Boar has already run away. What should I do now? I can't join the Wildboar League.
strings.talk.47158.text: Oh, of course. If I go see League Leader, he may give me another chance.
strings.talk.47160.text: The Wildboar League was created to guard the peace of the Mayan Forest. How could you ask this youngster to do such a dangerous thing? Please hurry and #R#Bfind Richard#R#B.
strings.talk.47161.text: Richard, what's going on? There are so many men here! When did they show up?
strings.talk.47162.text: The Leader?!  He is a complete liar! He's cheating his way along, as always. We've spent much too much time tracking him already.
strings.talk.47163.text: Oh, God. He is a liar. That's why he gave Richard such a tough quest.
strings.talk.47164.text: He has been captured! We promise that he will suffer a painful punishement.
strings.talk.47165.text: You are still too young, little one, but if you remain a friend of the forest, we will one day welcome you to join us.
strings.talk.47166.text: Well, we are leaving now. Farewell!
strings.talk.47167.text: #f1/#fRichard, that's great! You can join the Wildboar League when you grow up!
strings.talk.47168.text: I stole their money. If they realize the money is gone, I'll be in big trouble.
strings.talk.47170.text: What should I do? How can I earn another #R#B30,000 yuan/#R/#B?
strings.talk.47172.text: (Don't interfere. He needs to learn a lesson!)
strings.talk.47173.text: What should I do? I dare not go home!
strings.talk.47174.text: I hope you have learned your lesson. Take the money!
strings.talk.47177.text: You have not only saved my life, but helped me overcome a crisis. Please take this.
strings.talk.47178.text: I beg you! I will not do it anymore.
strings.talk.47179.text: It's time to head out, brave one!
strings.talk.47180.text: Let's go. The target is the Wildboar League Hall.
strings.talk.47181.text: Hold on! I can't ride a Wild Boar. It's too savage.
strings.talk.47182.text: Who asked you to steal our Wild Boar if you can't ride it?
strings.talk.47183.text: Take it easy. Don't get upset. We'll ask someone to help you.
strings.talk.47185.text: Hey, this is our domain! Who said you could enter?
strings.talk.47186.text: This is the Colosseum, where only man are allowed. Get out, girls!
strings.talk.47187.text: You want to get it back? No way! Ha ha, how will you deal with that?
strings.talk.47188.text: That's my father's Badge. Please return it to me.
strings.talk.47189.text: (It seems someone is being bullied. Will you go help him?)
strings.talk.47190.text: It's just a game between kids. Leave them alone.
strings.talk.47191.text: #f2/#fWhat are you doing? Why are you bullying a girl?
strings.talk.47192.text: Uh oh! Someone is coming. Let's run!
strings.talk.47193.text: These boys are too naughty! Why would they bully a little girl?
strings.talk.47194.text: I'm fine. Thanks. I must find them quickly and get my Badge back.
strings.talk.47195.text: Excuse me, have you seen a little girl?
strings.talk.47196.text: Yes, but she has gone to find her Badge.
strings.talk.47197.text: Ah, was someone bullying her? I am so worried about her.
strings.talk.47198.text: Why on earth would they bully her?
strings.talk.47199.text: Her father was Queene, the Ghost Soldier. He was so brave that the king gave him a Badge for bravery.
strings.talk.47200.text: How dare those boys bully her?
strings.talk.47201.text: Her father disappeared in the war. Everyone thinks that he's dead, but she firmly believes that her father only got lost.
strings.talk.47202.text: Since then, she often comes to the Colosseum and sits alone with his Badge.
strings.talk.47203.text: #f3/#fMaybe she just needs time before she can accept the truth.
strings.talk.47204.text: It is a terrible thing to lose one's relatives. I have tried to straighten her out, but she hasn't come around yet.
strings.talk.47205.text: I should help her. It's not safe for a girl to hang around the Colosseum.
strings.talk.47206.text: Are you willing to help me? That's wonderful!
strings.talk.47208.text: I am not sure, but the children like to play in the Colosseum. If you check the #R#BColosseum/#R/#B, they may still be there.
strings.talk.47209.text: All right, stay here. I'll check the Colosseum.
strings.talk.47211.text: Boo hoo! They are so awful!
strings.talk.47212.text: Don't worry! I will think of a way to distract the lions. Get ready to run away.
strings.talk.47213.text: I'm too scared, and my legs are unsteady. What should I do?
strings.talk.47214.text: Oh, no! The lions will attack them. I must hurry to rescue them.
strings.talk.47215.text: How savage those lions are! I will return when I'm better able to defeat them.
strings.talk.47216.text: I've defeated the lions. Are you all right?
strings.talk.47217.text: Boo hoo! They are so awful! I can't even stand.
strings.talk.47218.text: Boo hoo! I wet my pants!
strings.talk.47219.text: How shameful! I thought you were tough guys. You are really just cowards! You  shouldn't bully Yenela anymore.
strings.talk.47220.text: We're sorry, Yenela! We won't bully you anymore. Would you like to be our leader?
strings.talk.47221.text: No, I just want my Badge back.
strings.talk.47222.text: Yenela, were you scared when you saw the lions?
strings.talk.47223.text: I was afraid for a moment, but my father once told me that we should protect the weak.
strings.talk.47224.text: You are so brave. What's your name?
strings.talk.47226.text: Yenela, were you scared when you saw the lions?
strings.talk.47228.text: You seem as brave as your father. If he knew that, he would be very proud.
strings.talk.47229.text: Hey, Colosseum guard! How did the lions escape?
strings.talk.47230.text: I am so sorry for my carelessness in letting the lions escape. Hee hee ...
strings.talk.47232.text: For their safety I will send Yenela and the other children home. I'll also ask someone to bring the lions back to the Colosseum.
strings.talk.47233.text: It looks like it's all clear. I better hurry and find Yenela and Ella.
strings.talk.47234.text: Thank you for helping us tame the lion.
