strings.talk.47235.text: The lion will not wake up for a while.
strings.talk.47236.text: Yenela, I heard what Colosseum guard said.
strings.talk.47237.text: You are very brave, but it's dangerous there. Please don't do that again.
strings.talk.47239.text: My darlings Ella and Yenela! I am coming!
strings.talk.47242.text: Sorry I'm late! It was because ...
strings.talk.47243.text: My dear, I am so glad to see you again. I was so worried about you.
strings.talk.47244.text: Dad, I missed you so much! Why did it take you so long to return?
strings.talk.47245.text: #f1/#f Um, Yenela looks fine now. She doesn't need my help anymore. I'll leave them to enjoy their family reunion.
strings.talk.47246.text: My darlings Ella and Yenela! I missed you so much!
strings.talk.47247.text: Sweeties, I was so worried about you. I couldn't sleep for many days and nights.
strings.talk.47248.text: Dad, I knew you would come back one day.
strings.talk.47250.text: I have to get back and find Ella and Yenela as soon as possible!
strings.talk.47251.text: Her father, Queene, is a powerful Ghost Soldier who killed many cruel monsters in the Colosseum.
strings.talk.47252.text: The king gave him a Badge for bravery.
strings.talk.47253.text: Mom, have you seen my father?
strings.talk.47254.text: Sweetheart, your father may be in line for the team.
strings.talk.47256.text: What should I do? Must I beg him?
strings.talk.47258.text: Ah, actually I was the assistant to Professor Jacob. He fired me because I wanted to get engaged to his daughter, Hanna.
strings.talk.47259.text: But Professor Jacob will go on a long journey soon to conduct his research. If don't figure out what to do, they will be gone soon.
strings.talk.47261.text: Oh, my Hanna! Am I going to lose you?
strings.talk.47262.text: If you really love Hanna, why not ask Professor Jacob for another chance?
strings.talk.47263.text: You're right! I will go find Professor Jacob on #R#Bthe second floor of the hotel#R/#B.
strings.talk.47264.text: I'd better go to #R#Bthe second floor of the hotel#R/#B to see what will happen.
strings.talk.47265.text: Go away! I will not rehire you.
strings.talk.47267.text: Dad, please give Athletic another chance!
strings.talk.47269.text: I would never give my sweet girl to someone as careless as you.
strings.talk.47270.text: Professor, I will make the most of this opportunity to be a better man.
strings.talk.47271.text: Stop that senseless bickering. I'm the important one here! Have you no regard for me?!
strings.talk.47272.text: I hate you, Dad! You are always like this.
strings.talk.47273.text: Hanna, where are you going? Hold on!
strings.talk.47274.text: Ah, Hanna is still too capricious.
strings.talk.47275.text: Why not give Athletic another chance? I think he really loves Hanna deeply and wants to come with you.
strings.talk.47276.text: Actually, being an assistant is not a tough job. I know Athletic is a diligent and hard-working young man, but ...
strings.talk.47277.text: But what? Are you worried about their relationship?
strings.talk.47278.text: My wife passed away long ago, so I try my best to protect Hanna from being hurt.
strings.talk.47279.text: I think this is your best chance. If you hire Athletic as your assistant, you can stay close to them.
strings.talk.47280.text: You may be right, but I just had an argument with them.
strings.talk.47281.text: Professor, let me help find them.
strings.talk.47282.text: Do you know where they might have gone?
strings.talk.47283.text: Hanna sometimes goes to the #R#BPool Bank/#R/#B when she is unhappy. I think you'll find them there!
strings.talk.47284.text: Please wait here, Professor! I will bring them back.
strings.talk.47285.text: What's up? Is Hanna still angry?
strings.talk.47286.text: Ha! Hand over all your money!
strings.talk.47287.text: Hmm, the little girl looks very sweet. She is just my type. Give her to me!
strings.talk.47290.text: Ha! Stop struggling. It's useless to resist!
strings.talk.47292.text: Athletic, are you all right? Stay with me, Athletic!
strings.talk.47293.text: Run, Hanna! I will distract them.
strings.talk.47294.text: How strange, you still have strength.
strings.talk.47295.text: Argh! Little girl, you should be more careful.
strings.talk.47300.text: How can you claim to be the envoy of justice when you don't have the strength! Get out of here!
strings.talk.47301.text: You are so weak. I feel guilty for bullying you.
strings.talk.47302.text: Blast! I must figure out how to save them.
strings.talk.47303.text: Boo hoo! I dare not do it again.
strings.talk.47306.text: Boo hoo! I'm fine, but Athletic is still unconscious.
strings.talk.47307.text: Athletic, are you all right? Please wake up!
strings.talk.47308.text: Dad, I didn't know you were coming.
strings.talk.47309.text: From what I've just seen, you are too weak to be my assistant.
strings.talk.47310.text: You ruffians had better leave my Hanna alone! Don't touch her!
strings.talk.47312.text: Athletic, wake up! That's my father!
strings.talk.47313.text: Oh, my mistake! Professor, I didn't do it on purpose.
strings.talk.47314.text: As my assistant, you will be in charge of that from now on.
strings.talk.47316.text: You're my assistant now. Hurry and get your backpack or we'll be late.
strings.talk.47317.text: Hanna, let's go back to the hotel first so you can help me put medicine on my wound. Oh, ouch!
strings.talk.47318.text: How splendid! Thanks to you, I finally proved myself.
strings.talk.47319.text: You were the hero, not me! But shouldn't you be hurrying to get your backpack?
strings.talk.47320.text: Oh! I almost forgot it. Thank you very much indeed. Here is a gift for you.
strings.talk.47321.text: Ah ... should I let someone else run my life?
strings.talk.47323.text: Oh, I didn't think anybody would hear me here. I was sent to Pettora's house to be a servant when I was young, but recently the master began pressuring me to be his lover.
strings.talk.47324.text: I lost my freedom long ago, but I don't want my life to be dictated by one such as him. What should I do?
strings.talk.47325.text: Is there any way I could help you?
strings.talk.47326.text: Actually there is one way you could help. If you sneak into the #R#BUnderground Trap Path/#R/#B in Pettora's house and bring back my #R#BSlave Contract/#R/#B, then I will be free.
strings.talk.47327.text: Can you go to the #R#BUnderground Trap Path/#R/#B in Pettora's house and bring back my #R#BSlave Contract/#R/#B?
strings.talk.47328.text: I'm sorry, but I can't help you. I'd better leave now.
strings.talk.47329.text: Have you heard about my terrible experience? Will you show me some compassion?
strings.talk.47330.text: I will go get your Slave Contract.
strings.talk.47331.text: Hah! I knew you would help me.
strings.talk.47332.text: Excuse me, where is Pettora's house?
strings.talk.47333.text: His house is nearby. Slave Contract is hidden in the #R#BUnderground Trap Path/#R/#B. Be careful, though. Pettora is a famous device designer.
strings.talk.47334.text: Have you found my Slave Contract yet?
strings.talk.47335.text: Ovna looks so weird, but never mind. We should hurry up and find her Slave Contract.
strings.talk.47336.text: A piece of paper was left here. What does it say?
strings.talk.47337.text: The real way is always out of sight, but if you search for it, you may find it nearby.
strings.talk.47338.text: Your patience and strength of will are an advantage.
strings.talk.47339.text: It seems that we need to open some devices before entering the gate.
strings.talk.47341.text: How did the crocodile appear here? I should hurry and figure out how to proceed.
strings.talk.47342.text: When you have the flame like mine, you can move on.
strings.talk.47343.text: The room is stuffed with so many vivid portraits. I feel like they might move at any moment.
strings.talk.47344.text: The Slave Contract should be in that chest. Hurry and give it to Lily.
strings.talk.47345.text: These portraits really can move. We will only get the Slave Contract if we defeat them.
strings.talk.47346.text: These portraits are too powerful. I must figure out a way to defeat them!
strings.talk.47348.text: I have a chance to beat them.
strings.talk.47349.text: You are too powerful. You are quickest to have ever opened this device.
strings.talk.47350.text: Lily? Why are you here? What do you think would be the speediest way to open this device?
strings.talk.47351.text: Sorry to deceive you, but I am Lily Pettora. Our family's ancestors used to design traps for Pharaoh Kabyph to keep grave robbers out of the Pyramids.
strings.talk.47352.text: That was my masterpiece! But YOU ... you busted it in a matter of seconds! You have even reduced my newest robot to smithereens. I need to make improvements ... many, many more improvements.
strings.talk.47353.text: So, you're saying this has all been just a test?
strings.talk.47354.text: Oh, I wouldn't call it a test. Consider it research and development.
strings.talk.47355.text: Thanks for your help. Here is a gift for you!
strings.talk.47356.text: You can find the entrance by walking through the gate next to you.
strings.talk.47358.text: When I finish my new device, I will invite you to try it out. Ha ha ha ...
strings.talk.47359.text: Freeze! Are you soldiers of the Evil King? Give the princess to me, and I will  spare your life.
strings.talk.47360.text: Um, what are you talking about? I don't understand!
strings.talk.47361.text: You don't serve the Evil King, do you? I am in a good mood and won't trouble you, but I must get to #R#BSecret Base/#R/#B quickly. See you later.
strings.talk.47362.text: Excuse me, but have you seen a strange young man pass by?
strings.talk.47363.text: A strange young man? Do you mean Prince Huggen?
strings.talk.47364.text: The child is on the loose again.
strings.talk.47365.text: Does he always behave in this way?
strings.talk.47366.text: He always behaves like a child and acts like he's living in his own little world, even though he is of a marriageable age now.
strings.talk.47367.text: Oh dear ... he ran away from another date? It's not nice to keep others waiting. Please, could you bring him back here?
strings.talk.47368.text: Young man, can you help me get the Huggen back? I have to comfort our guest.
strings.talk.47369.text: What shall I do? Shall I go find the Huggen first or comfort our guest?
strings.talk.47370.text: Excuse me, where is Huggen's Secret Base?
strings.talk.47371.text: It is located in the nearby #R#Bcave/#R/#B. I'd better find the Huggen first.
strings.talk.47372.text: I can't open the door. Check it out. Maybe we need to find some devices to open it.
strings.talk.47373.text: Here is a device. Open it!
strings.talk.47374.text: How did you find me? Who are you? Have you come to help me or kill the Evil King?
strings.talk.47376.text: I am your guardian, the representation of Light.
strings.talk.47377.text: Prince Huggen, I have found a more qualified person to undertake your task. You can go back home and rest. Thanks so much for your efforts.
strings.talk.47378.text: What? You want me to quit, even though I haven't challenged the Evil King yet? I won't accept that.
strings.talk.47379.text: If I can defeat you, I will obtain the strength of the Valkyrie.
strings.talk.47380.text: Hold ... hold on! I don't want to fight you!
strings.talk.47381.text: The Valkyrie is just so-so! I can challenge the Evil King if I get more training.
strings.talk.47382.text: I would never have thought he would be so powerful. I must figure out a way to defeat him.
strings.talk.47383.text: How awesome! Is it the strength of the Valkyrie?
strings.talk.47385.text: I am the root of all evil and you are my eternal enemy, Evil King #n/#n.
strings.talk.47386.text: Prince Huggen, this is your doom! Prepare for my challenge.
strings.talk.47387.text: What? I never thought that you would come visit me.
strings.talk.47388.text: I will defeat you for my sweet princess!
strings.talk.47390.text: This Devil isn't so terrible. I must hurry and rescue the princess!
strings.talk.47391.text: Evil Devil, have you come to kidnap the princess?
strings.talk.47392.text: Hold on! Prince Huggen, I am Princess Sheena !
strings.talk.47393.text: Ah, Prince Huggen. I have seen your bravery. You are great indeed!
strings.talk.47394.text: Princess, you are so pretty! Are you running from the Devil?
strings.talk.47395.text: That's not the point! My dear, please take me to your castle and tell me about your adventures.
strings.talk.47396.text: My darling, follow me! I'll show you the way to my castle.
strings.talk.47397.text: What's going on? Who is Princess Sheena?
strings.talk.47398.text: Sheena  is a novelist. When she heard about Huggen, she couldn't wait to meet him.
strings.talk.47399.text: Sheena  is always looking for inspiration, so the Huggen is the just the right person to provide her with some fantastic material.
strings.talk.47400.text: #f1/#fGreat! You won' t have to worry about the Huggen anymore!
strings.talk.47401.text: Thanks for your help. Here is a gift for you! Now I must go plan a wedding.
strings.talk.47404.text: Furou, why don't you stay with Mabel?
strings.talk.47405.text: Blast! Why is another man intervening now?
strings.talk.47406.text: Another man? What do you mean?
strings.talk.47407.text: Mabel saved a man named #R#BLeith/#R/#B on the beach long ago. Finally this guy fell in love with her and is crazy in his pursuit of her. Mabel is now unsure about getting married.
strings.talk.47408.text: If this keeps up, Mabel might even tie the knot with Leith. I must figure out how to fix this situation.
strings.talk.47410.text: (It's none of our business. We'd better leave him alone!)
strings.talk.47411.text: Blast! How will I win Mabel's heart again?
strings.talk.47413.text: Mabel and Leith are taking a walk in the #R#BAfrican grassland/#R/#B.
strings.talk.47414.text: OK, I will go speak with them.
strings.talk.47415.text: Mabel, you are so sweet and pretty!
strings.talk.47417.text: Um, I'm sorry to interrupt you.
strings.talk.47418.text: What's up? If you have nothing important to say, I won't forgive you for interrupting our conversation.
strings.talk.47420.text: I ... I don't remember. Truth be told, I can only remember part of my name: #R#BLei/#R/#B. The last thing I remember was running into a #R#Bshipwreck/#R/#B. The next thing I knew, I had been rescued by Mabel.
strings.talk.47421.text: You said you suffered a sailing accident? Your family must be worried about you.
strings.talk.47422.text: Everything else is gone! If I can stay with Mabel, I would sacrifice anything.
strings.talk.47424.text: Sweetheart, you look so cute when you blush.
strings.talk.47427.text: Blast! We had decided to get married! How could you try to steal my Mabel's heart?
strings.talk.47428.text: Huh! Mabel and I would be the perfect couple. Don't attempt to tear us apart!
strings.talk.47429.text: Let's fight! Whoever wins the match will tie the knot with Mabel.
strings.talk.47430.text: This is a most welcome opportunity! Come on, I am waiting!
strings.talk.47431.text: They are fighting over me! God! Beauty can be such a curse!
strings.talk.47432.text: (He has Lei in his name. He suffered a sailing accident, and look at his costume. Is he the missing #R#BLamont/#R/#B?
strings.talk.47433.text: (I should show the #R#BWedding Ring/#R/#B to Leith! Maybe the ring will remind him of his life before the accident.
strings.talk.47434.text: (Too bad I forgot to bring the ring. Hurry and get the #R#BWedding Ring/#R/#B to show Leith!)
strings.talk.47435.text: Hold on! Leith, let me show you something before you begin this fight!
strings.talk.47436.text: ... Oh, this ... Is it the Ring I gave to Sydney? I ... I remember everything.
strings.talk.47438.text: I have made a terrible mistake. I'm sorry, Mabel, but I must leave now. Someone is still waiting for me back at home.
strings.talk.47439.text: What a heartbreaker! Thank goodness my sweetie didn't give up on me!
strings.talk.47441.text: Darling, you have always been foremost in my heart!
strings.talk.47442.text: Marry me! Nobody can tear us apart!
strings.talk.47443.text: Furou, I know you love me deeply.
strings.talk.47445.text: Thanks for your help. Here is a gift for you!
strings.talk.47446.text: (I don't know whether Lamont has safely returned to Sydney. If you are free, go check it out.
strings.talk.47447.text: I'm so sorry! To stay with you forever, I quit my job.
strings.talk.47448.text: Boo hoo! I knew you would return one day!
strings.talk.47452.text: I ... I have coughed continually for a whole day. Why did this happen today of all days?
strings.talk.47453.text: My dream is to become an opera singer, but I can't attend the singing contest, thanks to this cough.
strings.talk.47454.text: Is there any way to solve this problem?
strings.talk.47455.text: There is one way ... (coughs) ... but I can't leave or I'll be disqualified.
strings.talk.47456.text: I want to make my dream come true. Can you help me?
strings.talk.47459.text: Find #R#BJimy in the hotel#R#B ... (coughs) ... and ask for some #R#BCough Drop/#R/#B from him.
strings.talk.47461.text: Have you found the Cough Drop yet?
strings.talk.47464.text: Gaby asked me to get some Cough Drop from you.
strings.talk.47465.text: Oh, Gaby wants some? But I just sold out. Can you gather some materials for me?
strings.talk.47466.text: What kind of materials do you need for the Cough Drop?
strings.talk.47467.text: Hold on! Cough Drop is not so cheap. It will cost you #R#B20,000 Gold/#R/#B to get 3.
strings.talk.47468.text: #f2/#fWhat? I have to find the materials for you and it still costs so much?
strings.talk.47469.text: The process of producing the Cough Drop is very complicated. You must know that. If you don't want to pay, then just go away!
strings.talk.47471.text: I need to take this into serious consideration.
strings.talk.47472.text: Well if someone else buys the Cough Drop, don't blame me!
strings.talk.47474.text: Be careful! Cough Drop can only be taken one tablet at a time.
strings.talk.47475.text: Um ... (One dose at a time? Why do I need to buy three?)
strings.talk.47476.text: Hazard, two bottles of beer, please!
strings.talk.47479.text: Why did you swallow all the pills?
strings.talk.47480.text: Take it easy! It's more effective that way.
strings.talk.47481.text: Wow, I feel much better now.
strings.talk.47485.text: Have you seen the little cat?
strings.talk.47486.text: #f2/#fWhat? The little cat sure can move quickly.
strings.talk.47488.text: Oh! The pressure is growing stronger and stronger. My ears are really hurting.
strings.talk.47491.text: #f2/#fThis is awful. I can't bear it any more. I seem to be shaking to death.
strings.talk.47492.text: Huh ... the competition is almost over. I can't stand it anymore ... Thank goddess! Nobody is here.
strings.talk.47493.text: My voice sounds better now! I'm going to become an opera singer!
strings.talk.47494.text: #f1/#fThis ... this is wonderful. (Because of the effectiveness of the pill? How sweet your voice is!)
strings.talk.47495.text: Thanks for your help. Here is a gift for you!
strings.talk.47496.text: It will be my turn soon. I should go to the opera now.
strings.talk.47498.text: The ingredients for the Cough Drop are #R#B20 Nectar/#R/#B, #R#B10 Chrysanthemums/#R/#B, #R#B10 bags of Tea/#R/#B and #R#B5 bottles of Boiled Water/#R/#B.
strings.talk.47499.text: Wait a moment. I will get the ingredients right away.
strings.talk.47500.text: I've got the ingredients. Please check them.
strings.talk.47501.text: All right! I shall make it now? It's done!
strings.talk.47502.text: Thank you so much! I will take the Cough Drop to Gaby at once.
strings.talk.47503.text: Ah! My hands, my shoulders and my feet are aching. It's quite painful to make the Cough Drop. I will feel better if I can sell it for 20,000 yuan. It normally would be much more expensive.
strings.talk.47504.text: You lost the Cough Drop? Oh, god! Take one box of tablets as a reward for your hard work.
strings.talk.47505.text: Unfortunately I forgot to bring the Cough Drop.
strings.talk.47506.text: #f3/#f(We can't be sure that he is Lamont, so we'd better not tell her.)
strings.talk.47507.text: Sydney, I think Lamont will be back soon.
strings.talk.47509.text: (Did Lamont say he wanted to go back? Could something have happened?)
strings.talk.47510.text: Are you Xao Yee? Where are you going?
strings.talk.47511.text: Is that you? Go away! I must hurry to the #R#B Great Wall/#R/#B.
strings.talk.47512.text: Xao Yee, why are you planning to go to the #R#BGreat Wall/#R/#B? I think I may come with you.
strings.talk.47513.text: Xao Yee, what are you planning to do?
strings.talk.47514.text: Oh! I have something urgent to deal with, so please leave me alone.
strings.talk.47515.text: This jade was given to me by my mother. Take a look.
strings.talk.47516.text: Ah, the jade. So you are Mrs. Liu's kid?
strings.talk.47517.text: She is looking for you, because you are my ...
strings.talk.47518.text: Oh, I see. Don't go on.
strings.talk.47520.text: I appreciate what your mother did before, helping me pay for my studies. But all that is in the past now.
strings.talk.47521.text: I will send some money to you when I am famous. I don't think we should be involved with each other. You should hurry back to your mother.
strings.talk.47522.text: Oh. I would never have thought you were such an ungrateful rat!
strings.talk.47523.text: I have some urgent business and must leave now.
strings.talk.47525.text: Hey, whiner! Are you listening to yourself?
strings.talk.47526.text: Behave yourself, child, or I will teach you a lesson!
strings.talk.47528.text: I never thought that my #R#Bfather/#R/#B would be such an ungrateful rat!
strings.talk.47529.text: Official is your father? I see.
strings.talk.47530.text: He is not qualified to be my father. Forget what I said before.
strings.talk.47531.text: #f3/#fXao Yee, I don't think so! He looked sad when he saw you and your jade.
strings.talk.47533.text: Oh, you are still here. Then I can save some time looking for you.
strings.talk.47534.text: Excuse me. What else can I do for you?
strings.talk.47535.text: It's none of your business! Go away!
strings.talk.47536.text: We've got questions for you. Come with us!
strings.talk.47537.text: What? You should ask Official if you want to talk to me!
strings.talk.47538.text: How arrogant you are! It seems I'll have to treat you a little rough.
strings.talk.47540.text: If you don't figure out how to defeat them, Xao Yee will be taken away.
strings.talk.47541.text: Please forgive us! I will tell you everything you want to know.
strings.talk.47543.text: Actually, we have another boss. Our primary duty is something more important than simply protecting Official.
strings.talk.47545.text: Our main duty is to #R#Bspy on/#R/#B Official.
strings.talk.47547.text: Official is diligent in handling government affairs and loves the people, but sometimes his stubborn behavior offends a lot of people, so ...
strings.talk.47549.text: Our boss has ordered us to seize all the relatives of Official.
strings.talk.47550.text: What do you want to know?
strings.talk.47551.text: Please let us go! We don't know anything more.
strings.talk.47553.text: #f3/#fIt seems that Official must have had his reasons and problems.
strings.talk.47554.text: I don't care! I will teach him a lesson for my mom.
strings.talk.47555.text: #f1/#fThey are looking for you. You're in danger. Do you want to go with us?
strings.talk.47556.text: Um, I don't need your help.
strings.talk.47557.text: Official is busy staking out the Great Wall. If you don't have anything urgent to discuss, please leave.
strings.talk.47558.text: How strange. I hear something like a baby's cry coming from far in the distance.
strings.talk.47559.text: You mean you heard a baby's cry in the open air?
strings.talk.47561.text: But there is only a goup of evil wolves out in the canyon. How could you have heard a baby?
strings.talk.47562.text: Well, let's have a look around anyway. Perhaps we'll find a baby after all.
strings.talk.47563.text: #f2/#fOh, no! The little baby is in danger.
strings.talk.47564.text: #f2/#fBlast! We must figure out how to rescue the baby.
strings.talk.47565.text: Hurry and see if the baby is hurt!
strings.talk.47566.text: Aw! How beautiful this baby is.
strings.talk.47569.text: So, our baby will be as cute as this baby?
strings.talk.47574.text: The baby is as cute as Shizune! Shizune feels so happy when she receives praise from Sam.
strings.talk.47576.text: Great! #n/#n, see how we are a family?
strings.talk.47577.text: Ha! Sam is growing even redder!
strings.talk.47578.text: We'd better take the little baby away from here before the wild wolves come back.
strings.talk.47579.text: All right. Shizune, let's get out of here!
strings.talk.47581.text: Shizune, hold onto the little baby!
strings.talk.47582.text: Sam, take it easy! I will protect the little baby.
strings.talk.47584.text: Thank you for saving my little baby.
strings.talk.47585.text: It's no big deal, but why was this little baby out there?
strings.talk.47586.text: When I was taking a walk in the forest, I saw some beautiful flowers on the river bank. They were gorgeous and I wanted to bring some home.
strings.talk.47587.text: When I was picking the flowers, a wolf appeared and took my baby away. I had no idea where to turn for help.
strings.talk.47588.text: Thank goodness the baby is safe now.
strings.talk.47589.text: Great! Your mom will take you back, little one.
strings.talk.47590.text: The baby seems to like you very much.
strings.talk.47591.text: Really? Would the baby mistake them for its parents?
strings.talk.47593.text: Thanks for your help. Here is a gift for you!
strings.talk.47594.text: I am exhausted after so much running. We should take a short break now.
strings.talk.47595.text: There are so many wild wolves wandering in the forest. Be careful!
strings.talk.47596.text: Thank you so much for saving my baby.
strings.talk.47598.text: How strange. Shizune heard a sound that seemed to come from here.
strings.talk.47601.text: How strange. Where is the baby?
strings.talk.47603.text: Somebody is yelling. Let's find them.
strings.talk.47606.text: #f2/#fOh, no! A parrot is attacking him! I hope we will get there in time.
strings.talk.47610.text: I ... I am fine. Thank you so much!
strings.talk.47611.text: Why were you being attacked by a parrot?
strings.talk.47612.text: I ... I have no idea! It attacked as I was walking.
strings.talk.47614.text: #f2/#fOh, no! There are too many parrots. We're surrounded!
strings.talk.47615.text: #f2/#fThese parrots are incredibly strong. I must figure out how to drive them away!
strings.talk.47616.text: #f2/#fOh, no! There are too many parrots.
strings.talk.47617.text: Do you have anything to use against them?
strings.talk.47620.text: It's all clear now, but Louis, how did you know he had something we could use?
strings.talk.47621.text: Because such birds are interested in reflective things, so I guessed something like that must have attracted them.
strings.talk.47622.text: Thank you so much! I won't make that mistake again!
strings.talk.47624.text: You flatter me! It just takes a lot of practice.
strings.talk.47625.text: Why, do you want to be No. 1?
strings.talk.47626.text: Um, we'd better leave now before the parrots return.
strings.talk.47627.text: Oh, you're right. We'd better get going.
strings.talk.47629.text: Where is Louis? These parrots are incredibly strong. I can't defeat them.
strings.talk.47630.text: #f1/#fDo you believe it? We are back in Rome again.
strings.talk.47634.text: How ignorant you are! Don't you know who I am?
strings.talk.47635.text: Of course we know you, or else we wouldn't have been waiting for you.
strings.talk.47636.text: Remember Rome's glory? I can't believe we signed a #R#BPeace Agreement/#R/#B with barbarian Persian. Don't expect that to last!
strings.talk.47637.text: Rome's fame is based more on its cultural innovations than war.
strings.talk.47638.text: Ha! Shut up and come with me!
strings.talk.47639.text: No! I must get the Peace Agreement to Persia.
strings.talk.47640.text: In that case, we'll have to use a little more force.
strings.talk.47641.text: Even though I don't like that arrogant Roman, he's up against unfair odds. I'm going to stop them.
strings.talk.47646.text: Rome is supposed to be a country of freedom and nobility. I wasn't expecting such a savage attack.
strings.talk.47647.text: That barbaric woman dares to preach to us!
strings.talk.47648.text: You will receive double rewards for capturing them both.
strings.talk.47651.text: #f2/#fOh, no! We must figure out how to save them!
strings.talk.47652.text: In the name of peace, I must get this Peace Agreement to Persia.
strings.talk.47654.text: I can claim double rewards. That's terrific!
strings.talk.47655.text: You coward! How dare you sign a Peace Agreement with barbaric Persia?
strings.talk.47656.text: I never thought you would be so powerful.
strings.talk.47659.text: Here is the Peace Agreement! Take it and go!
strings.talk.47660.text: Put your right foot forward, man!
strings.talk.47661.text: I can't accomplish my mission without it.
strings.talk.47663.text: Are you OK? Let me check your wound.
strings.talk.47664.text: I'm fine. I am a proud Roman soldier, after all.
strings.talk.47665.text: You're injured, so give it a rest.
strings.talk.47666.text: What's going on with him? Is he badly hurt?
strings.talk.47667.text: Thank goodness, he wasn't badly hurt. I can bind the wound for him.
strings.talk.47668.text: He looks like he's feeling faint.
strings.talk.47669.text: He's feeling faint because he lost too much blood.
strings.talk.47670.text: Um, pardon? What did you say just now?
strings.talk.47671.text: All right, you'd better take care of him. I need to get going.
strings.talk.47673.text: (Kacy is still as beautiful as ever.)
strings.talk.47674.text: Ka ... Kacy, are you all right?
strings.talk.47675.text: She's fine. She left after she dressed your wound.
strings.talk.47676.text: Oh, then I feel better now. Do you know where she's going?
strings.talk.47677.text: No, but why did they want to stop you? What's going on with the Peace Agreement?
strings.talk.47678.text: Um, I feel ashamed to mention it. Sadly, most Romans aren't in favor of peace. They are more concerned about profit than honor.
strings.talk.47679.text: So that's why they were trying to prevent you from delivering the Peace Agreement to Persia.
strings.talk.47680.text: I would never have thought that the Peace Agreement would be stolen. If not for you, we would have been captured as well.
strings.talk.47681.text: Is that Kerst? Why was he talking with the soldiers in that dark corner?
strings.talk.47683.text: Eavesdropping? Oh, no! That's not polite. You'd better leave now.
strings.talk.47685.text: Even force wasn't enough to retrieve them.
strings.talk.47687.text: It doesn't matter. I will sacrifice anything for my Persian Empire.
strings.talk.47688.text: Yes, Prime Minister. We must leave for Sand Valley right away.
strings.talk.47689.text: Are you talking about #R#BPrincess Kacy/#R/#B? Hasn't she come back yet? Did he kidnap the princess?
strings.talk.47690.text: I must go to #R#BSand Valley/#R/#B and find the princess.
strings.talk.47692.text: Nobody noticed! We should leave now.
strings.talk.47693.text: #f2/#fYou are too cruel! I  never thought that you would retrieve the king such a brutal manner.
strings.talk.47694.text: Oh, no! I have been discovered. We'd better get rid of him quickly.
strings.talk.47695.text: #f2/#fWe'd better not let their plot succeed.
strings.talk.47697.text: I beg you! Do not open it.
strings.talk.47698.text: Is ... is this Kacy? There is a bronze medallion with #R#BPrincess Kacy's/#R/#B face carved on it. What the hell is going on?
strings.talk.47699.text: The bronze medallion hanging from the Lizard's neck has a likeness of #R#BPrincess Kacy/#R/#B on it.
strings.talk.47701.text: I never thought that you would discover my secret.
strings.talk.47703.text: #n/#n, don't reveal my secret. I beg you!
strings.talk.47704.text: I won't do that, but what the hell is this?
strings.talk.47705.text: Kacy and I were good childhood friends. I've known her since I was a child, but I also knew that she only thought of me as a friend and nothing more.
strings.talk.47706.text: This blue sky lizard is the first gift I received from her. That's why I named it as I did.
strings.talk.47708.text: Exactly. Can you keep the secrect for me? Otherwise it will cause trouble later.
strings.talk.47710.text: #f1/#fNo problem, I will keep the secrect for you!
strings.talk.47711.text: Thanks for your help. We are leaving now. Farewell.
strings.talk.47712.text: Come on, my Princess Kacy. We should go home now.
strings.talk.47713.text: The Peace Agreement has been stolen.
strings.talk.47714.text: OK, it seems that someone wants to make some trouble tonight.
strings.talk.47715.text: I'm so sorry. It was all due to my carelessness.
strings.talk.47716.text: Forget it. You're safe now. Let me try some other things to get the Peace Agreement.
strings.talk.47717.text: Odyssea, why are you still here? Weren't you supposed to prepare the military equipment?
strings.talk.47719.text: Don't be angry, but I just asked Odyssea to do me a favor.
strings.talk.47720.text: Odyssea, the Roman soldier? Don't forget your mission. You'd better stop daydreaming.
strings.talk.47721.text: We work for the wellbeing of Rome's citizens day and night.
strings.talk.47723.text: Such barbaric behavior! Are you really such a sore loser? I refuse to spar with the likes of you!
strings.talk.47724.text: I will accept any punishment earned for this failure. We'd better hurry to camp.
strings.talk.47725.text: Ah, if our soldiers were like Odyssea, the Roman Empire would be more powerful these days.
strings.talk.47726.text: Huh! Odyssea, I should keep strip you of your authority. You'd better examine yourself closely.
strings.talk.47727.text: Come with me and wait for your orders in the camp.
strings.talk.47728.text: We finally got out of there. Who are you?
strings.talk.47730.text: You are #n/#n? Odyssea told me that you did a great favor for him.
strings.talk.47731.text: Sorry about that! Disputes are always arising between the Roman generals and the Senate.
strings.talk.47732.text: Well, what about the Peace Agreement?
strings.talk.47733.text: The Senate wants to have a peaceful negotiations with the Persians, but others want a fierce war. I will never give up my beliefs! There should be other ways to settle the differences between Rome and Persia.
strings.talk.47734.text: #f1/#fHow ambitious you are! You will make your dream come true!
strings.talk.47735.text: Oh, I have urgent matters to attend to and must go now.
strings.talk.47736.text: #f3/#f(Ah, I hope they will find peace together.)
strings.talk.47737.text: Is that Odyssea? What is he doing now? He looks like he's meditating.
strings.talk.47739.text: He looks upset. We'd better leave him alone!
strings.talk.47741.text: (Hold on. It looks like he's doing something.)
strings.talk.47742.text: Kacy, I hope I will see you again.
strings.talk.47743.text: #f1/#f(Oh! You are foremost in my thoughts.)
strings.talk.47744.text: Miss Kacy, you are foremost in my thoughts.
strings.talk.47747.text: (I am finally exposed. Huh? Hold on.)
strings.talk.47749.text: Ka ... Miss Kacy, it's you. I am so sorry for my rude behavior.
strings.talk.47750.text: That's all right. Thanks for your help. Are you feeling better now?
strings.talk.47751.text: Thanks to you, I have completely recovered.
strings.talk.47752.text: Huh! You are much more interesting and different from the Romans I know. You can call me Kacy.
strings.talk.47754.text: Why are you blushing? Aren't you  feeling well?
strings.talk.47755.text: I am fine, I just feel a little hot. But why are you here? Aren't you worried about being in danger?
strings.talk.47756.text: I am interested in Roman culture. Alas, now that Rome and Persia are in chaos, I can't visit Rome.
strings.talk.47757.text: I know a mountain where you can get a bird's eye view of Rome and the surrounding areas.
strings.talk.47758.text: I really enjoy that spot. Especially when I am in a bad mood, I like to take walks there.
strings.talk.47760.text: Er ... that's right! There are so many interesting places around Rome. Let me show you the way!
strings.talk.47761.text: Really? Thanks for your help! Let's go.
strings.talk.47762.text: #f1/#f(They must be lovers. I hope they will not be affected by the war.)
strings.talk.47763.text: (I stepped on a branch and it made a loud noise.)
strings.talk.47764.text: Hey, have you heard of Odyssea?
strings.talk.47765.text: Yes, but I don't trust him.
strings.talk.47766.text: (Did he take Kacy to look around the outskirts of Rome?)
strings.talk.47768.text: It's no big deal. I should do my job first!
strings.talk.47770.text: Odyssea should be ashamed of himself for failing to fulfill his duty, but somebody told me he was having a date with a girl.
strings.talk.47771.text: Are you sure? Maybe it was just a man who looks like Odyssea.
strings.talk.47772.text: The general sent someone to find Odyssea, but he hasn't been home in quite some time.
strings.talk.47773.text: The general thinks the girl was the spy from Persia and she's attempting to lure Odyssea into betraying Rome. We need to find Odyssea before it's too late.
strings.talk.47774.text: The general summoned the Ghost Soldiers. They are standing by now. Their mission is to find Odyssea.
strings.talk.47775.text: Well, if Odyssea is really dating the Persian girl, what will they do with her?
strings.talk.47776.text: All the Persians will be captured and thrown in the #R#BPrison/#R/#B.
strings.talk.47778.text: (It sounds a little complicated. Hurry to the #R#BGhost Soldiers Temple/#R/#B and have a look around.)
strings.talk.47780.text: The general has sent someone to find him. The situation is getting worse.
strings.talk.47781.text: General! It's horrible! Hordes of Persian soldiers are on their way here.
strings.talk.47782.text: What? This may be what they were planning all along!
strings.talk.47784.text: I don't believe Odyssea would betray us!
strings.talk.47785.text: I am #n/#n, a friend of Odyssea. I can't believe Odyssea would ever betray his country!
strings.talk.47786.text: I trust Odyssea, but this all seems like more than a coincidence! I'd better send someone to get him back, but now I can't spare any soldiers. What should I do?
strings.talk.47787.text: I will go find Odyssea while you deal with those Persian soldiers.
strings.talk.47789.text: Come on, men, let's expel those wild Persians from our country!
strings.talk.47790.text: I can't believe Odyssea would betray his country!
strings.talk.47792.text: Where did Odyssea go during such a crucial moment?
strings.talk.47793.text: Odyssea is concerned more about honor than his life.
strings.talk.47794.text: So many Persian soldiers are lingering at the edge of Persia. What are they doing now?
strings.talk.47795.text: I must find Odyssea and Kacy right away. It would be terrible if someone else finds him.
strings.talk.47796.text: What are you doing here, Persian soldiers?
strings.talk.47797.text: We did not come to argue with you, arrogant Roman! We came for our ...
strings.talk.47798.text: Well, anyway, I must bring back the girl. It's none of your business!
strings.talk.47799.text: I am not going to leave now. Please get out ot here. It would be terrible if other Romans were to find you.
strings.talk.47800.text: Kacy has asked you to leave now, otherwise ...
strings.talk.47801.text: How offensive you are! How daring ...
strings.talk.47802.text: The girl must have drank the drugged wine meant for you. I never thought Romans could be so cruel.
strings.talk.47803.text: Forgive us, but we had no choice but to employ more brutal tactics.
strings.talk.47804.text: I will never leave my Kacy!
strings.talk.47807.text: How strong these guards are! I must figure out how to defeat them!
strings.talk.47808.text: I will never let you take my Kacy away.
strings.talk.47809.text: For your safety, please come with me to Persia.
strings.talk.47810.text: Good heavens, you finally defeated them. You are a worthy soldier.
strings.talk.47811.text: Kacy, are you OK? Who are you?
strings.talk.47812.text: Why are you listening to him?
strings.talk.47813.text: I am a Roman soldier. I can't reject a challenge from another soldier like me.
strings.talk.47814.text: Don't you know how worried I am about you?
strings.talk.47815.text: I'm sorry. I will never do it again.
strings.talk.47818.text: Listen to me, someone already knows about you. Kacy is thought to be a spy.
strings.talk.47819.text: Wait, what!? They don't know what they're talking about. How could they mistake Kacy for a spy?
strings.talk.47820.text: We need to return and tell everyone that you are innocent, or else you will be treated as a traitor.
strings.talk.47821.text: No! If  you return now, you will be put into prison. Stay where you are, and I will go.
strings.talk.47822.text: Trust me! If they know who I am, they will not mistreat me.
strings.talk.47823.text: It's too risky! Even if you are the Persian princess, you can't ensure that they will not put you into prison.
strings.talk.47824.text: I will go despite your protests.
strings.talk.47827.text: Go home and prepare before leaving for Rome.
strings.talk.47828.text: #n/#n, thanks for your information. Here is a gift for you. Please take it.
strings.talk.47830.text: Ah, what should I do now?
strings.talk.47831.text: (Our king looks a little upset. Will you give him a hand?)
strings.talk.47832.text: (He can solve his own problems. Don't bother him!)
strings.talk.47833.text: How could Kacy go to Rome?
strings.talk.47834.text: (Our king knew about it. That's why he sent someone to find Kacy.)
strings.talk.47835.text: It's hard to understand children nowadays. Why did she go there? The situation in Rome is dangerous.
strings.talk.47836.text: Why did they wage war on Rome?
strings.talk.47837.text: I used to want to conquer Rome, but I realized it was a noble country. So I sent the envoys and hoped that we could reach a peaceful agreement with them.
strings.talk.47838.text: So you planned to have a peaceful negotiation with Rome?
strings.talk.47839.text: That's right! I have sent many envoys to Rome, but we quickly lost contact with them.
strings.talk.47840.text: Really? I happen to know that Rome is also willing to negotiate with Persia.
strings.talk.47841.text: What about my envoys? Where are they?
strings.talk.47842.text: Um, I'm not sure. Could someone be trying to sabotage your efforts?
strings.talk.47843.text: If so, perhaps it is Kerst.
strings.talk.47845.text: You will be in charge of this peaceful negotiation. I will also send a strong army to keep you safe.
strings.talk.47847.text: If you see Kacy in Rome, please tell her to suspend her trip until the two countries have reached a peaceful agreement.
strings.talk.47850.text: Sir, what can I do for you?
strings.talk.47851.text: The news is out that Persia is willing to talk with Rome. Someone has also leaked our route.
strings.talk.47852.text: Pick the best guards for the group. You need to protect the ambassador.
strings.talk.47853.text: Will the peace envoy be in danger?
strings.talk.47854.text: Those who want to kill the peace envoy will likely take pause when they hear the news.
strings.talk.47855.text: If everything goes smoothly, you can sign the peace agreement with Rome. Besides, if Kacy can travel in Rome, maybe we will find our envoys as well.
strings.talk.47856.text: I think this plan will be successful!
strings.talk.47857.text: Thanks for your blessing! I appreciate you bringing us news of Rome. Here is a gift for you. Please take it.
strings.talk.47858.text: I hope everything goes smoothly with Kacy!
strings.talk.47859.text: Kacy, you have grown up. We don't need to worry about you!
strings.talk.47861.text: This is Kacy. She comes from Persia.
strings.talk.47863.text: Odyssea, take your men and return to Rome. Never come back! Your have lost your way. You are no longer fit to be one of the honored riders!
strings.talk.47864.text: Don't be angry, general. Kacy is fond of Roman culture.
strings.talk.47865.text: Nevertheless, you are banned now and forever. You are not permitted to act without my permission. Take her to prison!
strings.talk.47868.text: Stop! I'm disappointed in how cruel they are being.
strings.talk.47869.text: Oh, God! Aren't you Kacy, the daughter of the Persian king?
strings.talk.47870.text: What? Who is the Persian princess?
strings.talk.47871.text: I've heard that Kacy is interested in culture, so she often travels abroad.
strings.talk.47872.text: Kacy, are you the Persian princess?
strings.talk.47873.text: Yes, I came to experience Roman culture.
strings.talk.47874.text: I've come to Rome to deliver a message that the Persian Empire wants to negotiate a peace agreement with Rome.
strings.talk.47875.text: When we have peace, soldiers won't be forced to leave their loved ones.
strings.talk.47877.text: What? Don't you think the war will end now?
strings.talk.47878.text: Woklone, what are you doing? A peaceful way to end the war should be your first priority.
strings.talk.47879.text: Um, what the hell is going on? Shouldn't it be ...
strings.talk.47880.text: So that's why my father never received any information from the ambassador.
strings.talk.47881.text: Ha ha! Don't you understand there are tremendous profits to be made from the war? Now I will take advantage of having Kacy as a prisoner and force Persia to bend to our will.
strings.talk.47882.text: I won't let you get away with this! Your plot will fail.
strings.talk.47883.text: You used to be a strong and powerful soldier, but now you are in the Senate. Don't forget your place.
strings.talk.47885.text: Ha ha! Not only will I be rich, but I'll also be the most respected soldier in Rome.
strings.talk.47886.text: #f2/#fIf there is to be peace between Persia and Rome, I must figure out how to defeat them!
strings.talk.47887.text: Run! I will hold them back!
strings.talk.47890.text: Ha ha! I am not what you think!
strings.talk.47891.text: Fame and money?! Are they so important that you would betray your country, your people and yourself? I'm terribly disappointed in you.
strings.talk.47892.text: Shut up! You are a general in charge of no one now! Your men have decided to join me!
strings.talk.47893.text: We have caught both of them already!
strings.talk.47894.text: Send Odyssea to prison and take the princess to my quarters! Lock the general his home and watch him. Nobody may leave without my permission.
strings.talk.47895.text: I will expose your plot the first chance I get!
strings.talk.47896.text: #f2/#fYou are too evil. I never thought that you would lie to me!
strings.talk.47897.text: I am in a good mood, so I'll let you go. After all, there's nothing you can do.
strings.talk.47898.text: Wait and see what will happen! Ha!
strings.talk.47899.text: #f2/#fThis is bad. What should I do?
strings.talk.47900.text: (Odyssea and Kacy have arrived at Rome. Go greet them and find out what they are talking about.)
strings.talk.47901.text: #f1/#f(They will be OK. I'd like to leave now.)
strings.talk.47902.text: The Senate is holding an important meeting now. You may not enter!
strings.talk.47903.text: If you don't want me to hurt you, you'd better give up!
strings.talk.47904.text: I don't want to fight you!
strings.talk.47907.text: (I've never met her, so how does she know my name?)
strings.talk.47908.text: Excuse me, how do you know my name?
strings.talk.47909.text: Don't worry about that now! I have brought a message. Please listen to me!
strings.talk.47910.text: Go to the cellar near the hotel, then you will have a chance to save Princess Kacy.
strings.talk.47912.text: The cellar near the hotel has access to the Roman sewers. Use that and you will find the cell in which Princess Kacy and Odyssea are being kept.
strings.talk.47913.text: If so, then I must hurry and rescue them.
strings.talk.47914.text: Woklone may have sent someone there, so watch out!
strings.talk.47915.text: I know. Thank you so much!
strings.talk.47916.text: Sorry I can't tell you more. The longer I stay here, the more likely I'll be exposed.
strings.talk.47917.text: (I must hurry to the #R#Bcellar/#R/#B and rescue Kacy and Odyssea.)
strings.talk.47918.text: Hey! Hey! We'd better leave quickly.
strings.talk.47920.text: Aren't you #n/#n? Woklone has mentioned you before.
strings.talk.47921.text: #f2/#fLeave the key and get out of here.
strings.talk.47922.text: How arrogant you are! You must defeat me if you want the key!
strings.talk.47923.text: He he he! Stop! You've won, so here's your reward.
strings.talk.47924.text: #f2/#fI must find a way to defeat the guard so I can rescue Odyssea and Kacy.
strings.talk.47925.text: The door is locked. We need a key to open it.
strings.talk.47926.text: The door is still locked! Is this the key to another door?
strings.talk.47927.text: This is the army's prison. Someone told me about it before.
strings.talk.47928.text: I've been so generous to you. Won't you help me?
strings.talk.47930.text: You are so concerned about your honor as a soldier, but you wouldn't be betraying Rome.
strings.talk.47931.text: I think I'd better discuss this with Kacy.
strings.talk.47932.text: Blast it! What you are talking about?
strings.talk.47933.text: Ha ha ha! Think it over. I'll come to see you soon.
strings.talk.47934.text: I will never forgive you if you kill her.
strings.talk.47935.text: (It's clear now. Hurry and save Odyssea.)
strings.talk.47937.text: #n/#n! How did you get in here?
strings.talk.47938.text: I snuck in through the sewer. Where is the key?
strings.talk.47941.text: Besides, I also have the key to the other door.
strings.talk.47942.text: #f2/#fIf you have both keys, then you've saved me the trouble of looking for them.
strings.talk.47943.text: How arrogant you are! If you think you can get the keys, then show me what you've got!
strings.talk.47944.text: What? You dare to rescue the prisoners? I am not who you think!
strings.talk.47945.text: #f2/#fI must find a way to defeat him and get the key!
strings.talk.47947.text: Thank you so much! I'm fine, but what about Kacy?
strings.talk.47948.text: I am going to rescue her next.
strings.talk.47949.text: What did you say!? You saved me first and left Princess Kacy alone?
strings.talk.47951.text: There's no time for chit-chat! Give me the key. I must hurry and save Princess Kacy.
strings.talk.47952.text: Odyssea, calm down! Let's go together.
strings.talk.47953.text: This is the Woklone's Official Residence, yet it seems that someone is knocking at the door.
strings.talk.47954.text: Princess, don't worry! Nobody will hurt you!
strings.talk.47956.text: No one can escape from here!
strings.talk.47957.text: We have a group of our brethren waiting outside. I suggest you surrender!
strings.talk.47958.text: My enemy Odyssea, now we can finally have a fair fight.
strings.talk.47959.text: Great! It's Official Floyd. Come on!
strings.talk.47961.text: How dare you look down upon us? I'll show you!
strings.talk.47962.text: There are too many enemies! I must hurry and think of a way to defeat them!
strings.talk.47963.text: How could you let my Kacy get injuried? I won't forgive you!
strings.talk.47964.text: Ha ha ha! They are a rather barbaric race.
strings.talk.47965.text: Hey! Take care of yourself, Odyssea!
strings.talk.47967.text: I ... I am fine. And you?
strings.talk.47968.text: A wound is the greatest honor a Roman soldier can carry.
strings.talk.47969.text: What are you talking about? Don't you know I worry you so much?
strings.talk.47970.text: Sorry. I will try to be more careful.
strings.talk.47971.text: Ha! You always talk about next time. When will that be?
strings.talk.47972.text: Sorry to interrupt you, but Rome has fallen into the enemies' hands. What will you do?
strings.talk.47974.text: As a Roman soldier, I can't leave while the Roman people are suffering.
strings.talk.47975.text: The king has already sent Kerst and the ambassor. They should be arriving in Rome soon.
strings.talk.47976.text: If you can find them, it will give you a chance to expose Woklone's plot.
strings.talk.47977.text: This may be our only oppotunity, so we'd better seize it before it's too late.
strings.talk.47979.text: (The army is waiting there. I'd better get out of here now!)
strings.talk.47980.text: This is the Woklone's Official Residence, yet it seems that someone is knocking at the door.
strings.talk.47981.text: You are the beautiful Persian Princess.
strings.talk.47982.text: Huh! I never thought that you were such a barbaric guy.
strings.talk.47983.text: Ha ha ha, you're a fiery girl. That's just my style.
strings.talk.47984.text: You have no chance of returning to Persia. Why not be my concubine and enjoy wealth and fortune?
strings.talk.47985.text: I'd prefer death over such a deal.
strings.talk.47986.text: That's OK, I'll give you time to think about it. I'll be back later.
strings.talk.47987.text: Get out of here! I never want to see your disguisting face again.
strings.talk.47988.text: (It's all clear! We must hurry and rescue Kacy.)
strings.talk.47990.text: I snuck in through the sewer. Do you know where the key to the cell is?
strings.talk.47992.text: Thank you so much! I'm fine, but what about Odyssea?
strings.talk.47993.text: I am going to rescue him next.
strings.talk.47994.text: Odyssea is in danger. Even now our enemies might be hurting him.
strings.talk.47995.text: There's no time for chit-chat. Give me the key so I can hurry and rescue Odyssea.
strings.talk.47996.text: Kacy, calm down. We should go together.
strings.talk.47997.text: (The offical is nearby. I'd better leave now!)
strings.talk.47998.text: The key seems to fit the door.
strings.talk.47999.text: Cursed Englishman, how dare you come here to make trouble?
strings.talk.48000.text: Calm down, Frenchman! I'm only here on a trip.
strings.talk.48001.text: No matter what your purpose is, we will not let you make any trouble here.
strings.talk.48002.text: (Is that Lancelot? He seems to have encountered some trouble. Would you like to help him?)
strings.talk.48003.text: #f1/#f(Lancelot is a master of martial arts. I'm sure he can solve his own problems.)
strings.talk.48004.text: Please trust me! It wasn't me!
strings.talk.48005.text: #f2/#fHow can you catch them without considering what's right and wrong?
strings.talk.48007.text: That's none of your business. Who are you?
strings.talk.48008.text: If you won't come quietly, we'll have to use more persuasive means.
strings.talk.48009.text: Are you looking for a fight?
strings.talk.48010.text: Silence! If you won't go with us, we will kill you.
strings.talk.48011.text: Don't butt into my business, or you will be captured as well.
strings.talk.48012.text: I must find a way to fix this, or else Lancelot will be captured.
strings.talk.48014.text: Joan, we have discovered a suspicious character. He may be a spy from Britain.
strings.talk.48015.text: Don't you know this is #n/#n, who has helped us many times?
strings.talk.48016.text: Oh, sorry! I apologize for being so rude.
strings.talk.48017.text: Anyway, who is this other guy?
strings.talk.48018.text: I am Lancelot, a traveler from Britain.
strings.talk.48019.text: Um, the British traveler's clothes cover his knightly attire.
strings.talk.48020.text: Lancelot is my friend. I can assure you that he is not a spy.
strings.talk.48021.text: Lancelot is #n/#n's friend, so I will trust him as well.
strings.talk.48023.text: France is in chaos now, so be careful on your trip!
strings.talk.48024.text: I have to go now, as I have to inspect some places.
strings.talk.48026.text: But ... why did you travel to France at such a dangerous time?
strings.talk.48028.text: It seems there is something you can't tell me. I will not ask you again.
strings.talk.48029.text: Thank you so much, #n/#n, for both your help and your trust.
strings.talk.48030.text: Think nothing of it. No matter who is in trouble, I am willing to lend a hand.
strings.talk.48031.text: Here is a gift for you. Please take it. Well, I must be going.
strings.talk.48032.text: (Why has Lancelot come to France now? I hope he's all right.)
strings.talk.48033.text: Huh! I will let you go this time, but next time you won't be so lucky.
strings.talk.48047.text: Huh? Why did my body shine suddenly! ?
strings.talk.48048.text: This is... Sister Missia's armband! Could it be that King Howert is around here?
strings.talk.48049.text: Did we finally find King Howert?

strings.talk.48084.text: You firmly believe legends... The shield of light, the sword of darkness, and the stone of the magic... have no effect on me.

strings.talk.48086.text: #f2/#fIf it is true... how can you say so easily? Must be trying to confuse us!
strings.talk.48089.text: The savior... I must put you to death today!
strings.talk.48091.text: Don't dare to hurt #n/#n, I won't let you!

strings.talk.48116.text: Huh? What are you doing out here all alone?
strings.talk.48117.text: What do you mean by "uncle"? I'm the 30,000-strong South China Sea Pirate King, Mr. Zhang Baozai!
strings.talk.48119.text: You're scared, aren't you? But you don't seem like an ordinary man to me. How about it? Are you interested in joining my pirate crew?
strings.talk.48121.text: You can't just join the Pirates, you have to pass a test to qualify.
strings.talk.48123.text: That treasure map you're carrying, it's got all my treasure in it, so you'll just have to get there on your own, hahaha!
strings.talk.48124.text: Bowie! Bao-chan! How did he know I had a treasure map on me? How does he know I have a treasure map?
strings.talk.48125.text: How did he know I had a treasure map on me? (GROANS) (GASPS) What should I do?
strings.talk.48126.text: Why are you sighing, my lord? What's troubling you?
strings.talk.48127.text: I can tell you. (GROANS) (SIGHS) There's a group of about 30,000 Chinese and South Sea thieves in this area, and their leader is called "Cheung Po Chai".
strings.talk.48128.text: (Cheung Po Chai? So he's really a pirate leader.)
strings.talk.48129.text: We fought with Cheung many times, resulting in many deaths and injuries on both sides...
strings.talk.48130.text: I also sent someone to ask the villagers for information about Zhang Baozai, but the villagers refused to say anything because we are officials of the imperial court.
strings.talk.48131.text: So that's how it is. (GASPING) I'm sorry.
strings.talk.48132.text: By the way, you don't look like a local.
strings.talk.48133.text: Can you ask the villagers for me to find out more about Zhang Baozai?
strings.talk.48134.text: No problem. Leave this matter to me.
strings.talk.48135.text: I have something to do now, you'd better find someone else to help.
strings.talk.48136.text: Mr. Cheung Po Chai is not as vicious as the court officials said, he takes care of everyone in the village.
strings.talk.48137.text: Every time he comes to the village, he gives us new and delicious snacks.
strings.talk.48138.text: You mean Mr. Zhang Baozai? He sometimes gets someone to help me with the fish.
strings.talk.48139.text: Last time when my son was seriously ill, Mr. Baozai helped me pay for the medical bills.
strings.talk.48140.text: You mean Mr. Zhang Baozai? He brings me supplements from time to time, just like my own son.
strings.talk.48141.text: I've heard that the pirates robbed the villagers, but no one has ever been harassed by pirates.
strings.talk.48142.text: I've asked all the villagers for information, so let's report back to the Governor.
strings.talk.48143.text: If you hear anything, please tell me again.
strings.talk.48144.text: What is it? Have you heard anything about Mr. Cheung?
strings.talk.48145.text: According to the villagers, Mr. Cheung often helps the local people to relieve their hardship and is quite loved by them.
strings.talk.48146.text: No wonder the villagers are reluctant to disclose anything about him.
strings.talk.48147.text: In fact, I have met Bowie Cheung before, and although he is a bit strange, I can sense that he is not a bad guy.
strings.talk.48148.text: But... Even so, as long as he is still a pirate, there is no way to stop the war between us.
strings.talk.48149.text: By the way, I have a suggestion for you, Your Excellency, what do you think?
strings.talk.48150.text: Zhang Baozai is very popular with the local people, why don't we recruit him to serve the court, not only to stop the war, but also to help him manage the region?
strings.talk.48151.text: I think this should be the best result for both the court and Zhang Baozai.
strings.talk.48152.text: That's great, that's a good idea.
strings.talk.48153.text: But I've been fighting pirates for a long time, and when they see us, they'll probably go straight to war...
strings.talk.48154.text: Since you have met with him before, please help me to pass on the message to Bowie.
strings.talk.48155.text: No problem. Leave this matter to me.
strings.talk.48156.text: As a token of my sincerity, please take my official seal of the Governor to Cheung Po Chai, and I will wait for your good news here.
strings.talk.48157.text: This is the Governor beside me.
strings.talk.48158.text: Please take care of Cheung Po Tsai.
strings.talk.48159.text: Welcome to the Typhoon Shelter. Our fried crabs are famous, so be sure to try them when you have a chance.
strings.talk.48160.text: When I grow up, I want to go fishing like my father!
strings.talk.48161.text: It's a beautiful day today, and I'm sure I'll have a great fishing trip.
strings.talk.48162.text: I caught a big fish yesterday, as big as a small boat!
strings.talk.48163.text: That's strange... (GROANS) The family at the pier had another baby, but her husband's been out fishing all year. (GASPS) (SIGHS)
strings.talk.48164.text: I'm going to take a break before the next freighter docks.
strings.talk.48165.text: Oh, no. (GROANS) (GASPS) The tide is too rough to pass through here, so we'll need Bowie's #R#BPirate's Treasure Map/#R/#B to get through.
strings.talk.48167.text: Where are you from? I don't think I've seen you in the neighboring villages?
strings.talk.48168.text: Sorry, I'm here to see Paul Cheung.
strings.talk.48169.text: Looking for the boss? What's the matter?
strings.talk.48170.text: It's like this: the Governor asked me to bring the seal to convey the message about the recruitment. The Governor asked me to bring the official seal to deliver the message about the recruitment. (GOVERNOR'S VOICE) Governor!
strings.talk.48171.text: Governor! It's the court! The imperialists are here all of a sudden!
strings.talk.48172.text: Quickly, go in and tell the men!
strings.talk.48173.text: Oh, no. (GROANS) (GROANS) There's been a misunderstanding. We'll have to go straight to Zhang Baozai. (GROANS) (GROANS)
strings.talk.48174.text: There should be a mechanism to open this door, look around.
strings.talk.48175.text: Strange, why isn't this torch lit?
strings.talk.48176.text: There seems to be a sound coming from the distance.
strings.talk.48177.text: This piece of paper says, "Raise the five pillars at the same time to open the stone door; use the mechanism next to it to restore the pillars to their original state".
strings.talk.48178.text: It seems that we can't go any further without cracking this mechanism.
strings.talk.48179.text: The stone door seems to be open, let's continue.
strings.talk.48180.text: This piece of paper says, "If you ignite the flames on all eight pedestals at the same time, you can open the stone door.
strings.talk.48181.text: It seems that we can't go any further without cracking this mechanism.
strings.talk.48182.text: The stone door seems to be open, let's continue.
strings.talk.48183.text: Damn, I can't believe I'm invading this place!
strings.talk.48184.text: Wait a minute, guys! I didn't come here to fight you! (GASPS) I'm not here to fight you.
strings.talk.48185.text: Let's just cut the crap, guys. Let's go!
strings.talk.48186.text: Oh, shit. (GASPS) (GROANS) I can't believe we're sending such a great guy. (GROANS) (GROANS)
strings.talk.48187.text: I can't believe it! I'm going to fight even if I can't win!
strings.talk.48188.text: I think you've got the wrong idea. (GASPS) (GROANS)
strings.talk.48190.text: Ah, it's the Boss and the Sisters! It's the boss and the sister!
strings.talk.48191.text: But you went to a nearby village and came back to find the gate completely unguarded?
strings.talk.48192.text: That's not true. No... No, no, no. The court has sent a great guy!
strings.talk.48193.text: He's cracked my sister's trap and killed his way here!
strings.talk.48194.text: What? There's such a great guy here?
strings.talk.48195.text: No, no, no, no. No, no, no, no. No, no, no, no. It's okay. (GASPS) (GROANS)
strings.talk.48196.text: Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait. (GASPS) (GROANS) This young man. (GASPS) . Isn't he the young man I met on my last tour in the South Seas?
strings.talk.48197.text: What cruise? He was drunk at night and slept on a boat, not knowing where he was floating.
strings.talk.48198.text: I don't know where he went. (GASPS) I don't know where they went. Ha ha ha, in short, I can't believe that in order to join in, you followed the treasure map I gave you to find this place!
strings.talk.48199.text: I can't believe you found this place with such a simple chart, and you've even cracked my trap! (GROANS)... and cracked my trap... He's really something. (GASPS) (GASPS)
strings.talk.48200.text: Simple, simple charts? That's my work. (GASPS) (GASPS)
strings.talk.48201.text: Actually, I was asked to come here today by the Governor.
strings.talk.48203.text: Your strength is on par with the court's, and you can take care of the people in this region.
strings.talk.48204.text: So the court would like to recruit you to serve the country as an official.
strings.talk.48205.text: This... You're not trying to trick me, are you?
strings.talk.48206.text: Of course not. I have the official seal of the Governor here, so as a token of my sincerity, I'll give it to you.
strings.talk.48207.text: I can't believe I'm giving you the seal. I think it's real.
strings.talk.48208.text: I think it's true. (GASPS) I'll think it over. Anyway, I'll give serious consideration to the matter of recruitment.
strings.talk.48209.text: If it's acceptable, I think it's the best outcome, given your knowledge of the neighborhood and your popularity with the people.
strings.talk.48210.text: Thank you for bringing such important information. Please accept this as a gift.
strings.talk.48211.text: Thank you. I will carefully consider whether or not to accept the offer.
strings.talk.48212.text: No matter what the result is, I will follow Paul Cheung.
strings.talk.48213.text: If I can join the imperial court, I will perform well and honor my ancestors.
strings.talk.48214.text: Wouldn't it be better to be a pirate and take care of my village?
strings.talk.48215.text: These seem to be the treasures collected by Zhang Baozai, so I'd better not touch them.
strings.talk.48216.text: I wonder what kind of rare treasures are behind this door.
strings.talk.48217.text: It seems that we need the right key to open this door.
strings.talk.48218.text: Oh no, I don't have the Governor's Seal on me. They won't believe I'm here to deliver the message.
strings.talk.48219.text: How dare you come here alone!
strings.talk.48220.text: You won't get out of here alive today!
strings.talk.48221.text: There doesn't seem to be anyone in there, so let's check somewhere else first.
strings.talk.48224.text: Behind that door is my treasure trove! But... (GASPS) But?
strings.talk.48226.text: Too much treasure attracted a monster that made it its own nest and ate all the treasure. (GASPS) (GASPS)
strings.talk.48228.text: To keep the monster at bay, I locked the door and hid the key in a place I didn't even know existed!
strings.talk.48229.text: You hid it in a place you don't even know?
strings.talk.48230.text: That's a pretty good story. (GROANS) You lost the key. I lost the key. (GASPS) (GASPS)
strings.talk.48231.text: (GASPS) (GASPS) . Anyway, if you can find the key you can get in.
strings.talk.48232.text: I think you're good enough to fight off the monster.
strings.talk.48233.text: Any treasure that falls out of the monster will be yours.
strings.talk.48234.text: I'm sure you'll have no problem finding the key and defeating the monster!
strings.talk.48235.text: I want to know how to get into the treasure vault.
strings.talk.48236.text: If you can defeat monsters/#R#Bof #R#Blevel 10 or higher, you'll have a chance to get a key to the Treasure Trove; if you collect five of them, you'll be able to unlock the door to the Treasure Trove once.
strings.talk.48237.text: However, the Treasure Trove closes automatically every day, so if you want to re-enter it the next day, you still need a Treasure Trove key.
strings.talk.48238.text: I'd like to know about the Treasure Trove monster.
strings.talk.48239.text: That monster not only ate all the treasure, but also made this place its own nest.
strings.talk.48240.text: After defeating it today, it will come back the next day.
strings.talk.48241.text: However, after defeating the monster, the treasure I collected earlier will appear.
strings.talk.48243.text: I'm still considering whether or not to accept it.
strings.talk.48244.text: Is this the monster that's in the treasure trove?
strings.talk.48246.text: Oh, no! The monster is angry!
strings.talk.48247.text: It seems that you have to improve yourself before you can fight it off!
strings.talk.48248.text: Now that you've defeated the monster, let's see what's in the treasure chest. (GASPS) (GASPS)
strings.talk.48249.text: I wonder what's behind this door?
strings.talk.48250.text: If you have #R#Bone Golden Treasure Vault Key/#R/#B or #R#Bfive Treasure Vault Keys/#R/#B on your person, you can open the door to the Treasure Vault.
strings.talk.48251.text: I wonder what's behind this door?

strings.talk.48259.text: I heard that you can lead me to enter my dream, Is it true?
strings.talk.48260.text: After all, I'm the one that knows it.

strings.talk.48269.text: I'll go, you're not a scammer right?
strings.talk.48270.text: In-fact, I want to take this opportunity to return to the world! Hey I did nid not expect it to fail.

strings.talk.48400.text: This event's story takes place between the quests #R#BLife in the Vale/#R/#B and #R#BLast Guardian/#R/#B. For the best experience, we recommend completing those quests first.
