strings.talk.48402.text: Would you like to travel to the event map?
strings.talk.48403.text: We finally made it. This island feels pretty nice. Shizune, how did you know about this place?
strings.talk.48404.text: My ears told me! I had this feeling, like someone on this island was calling out to us. It felt like we just had to come.
strings.talk.48405.text: Shizune's always been like this. Even among the beast-folk, she's special. She can sense things others can't hear. She's been the first to notice danger in our village more than once. Even I have to admire that.
strings.talk.48406.text: Hehe, Lil' Sam is praising me again~ You're my favorite, Lil' Sam!
strings.talk.48408.text: (I have a feeling I'll need to keep my shades on the whole time we're here...)
strings.talk.48410.text: Welcome to Chatham Isle. I'm Tyr. It's been a long time since outsiders visited, but the villagers always hope for guests. Everyone here is very welcome! Please make yourselves at home.
strings.talk.48411.text: There's also an empty house on the island you can use to rest during your stay. I'll take you there shortly.
strings.talk.48412.text: We just arrived and you're already being so generous. I'm sorry we don't have anything to give in return.
strings.talk.48413.text: Ha-ha, don't worry about formalities. If anything, just share your stories with us. Life on the island is quiet, we're mostly self-sufficient and don't hear much from the outside world.
strings.talk.48414.text: And you two, please feel at home as well. Hmm... a cat and a dog? What should I call you?
strings.talk.48415.text: Yep, I'm definitely the cat one! Just call me Shizune!
strings.talk.48416.text: My name is Sam. Why am I the dog...?
strings.talk.48417.text: (Looks like that impression is really hard to shake off.)
strings.talk.48419.text: Glad to meet you all. Now then, let me show you to where you'll be resting.
strings.talk.48420.text: This is where you'll be staying. Apologies that there aren't many beds. If you need anything else, just look for me. The island is small, so I'm easy to find.
strings.talk.48423.text: Let's share a bed, Lil' Sam~ Just like when we were kids!
strings.talk.48424.text: ...No, I'll sleep outside. Shizune, we're adults now. Sharing a bed is...
strings.talk.48425.text: ...I'm going to take a look around the island!
strings.talk.48426.text: Oh, Lil' Sam... sharing a bed would've been perfectly fine.
strings.talk.48427.text: No... if they shared a bed, Sam probably wouldn't sleep a wink all night.
strings.talk.48428.text: (Sam really is such an innocent soul.)
strings.talk.48429.text: Tyr and the others seem like good people. Just let them know if you need anything. Shizune, I'm going to find Sam~ See you in a bit.
strings.talk.48432.text: Sorry... I got a little carried away back there.
strings.talk.48433.text: It's fine. That's just how Shizune is.
strings.talk.48434.text: I know. We've known each other since we were kids, but when she says exactly what's on her mind like that... I never know how to respond.
strings.talk.48435.text: All I can do is take care of her. Perhaps #R#Bbefore this journey ends/#R/#B, I'll be able to prove I can truly protect her. We'll see...
strings.talk.48437.text: Anyway, Tyr has been so kind to us. I feel uneasy just accepting help without giving anything back. Let's see if there's anything we can do for the islanders.
strings.talk.48438.text: There's a cave on the island where monsters have been appearing more frequently lately. We can handle them, but it's concerning. Could you look into what's causing it?
strings.talk.48441.text: Who are you? What are you doing here?
strings.talk.48443.text: You're standing right there, aren't you?
strings.talk.48444.text: #n/#n, the aura coming off him isn't normal! Be careful!
strings.talk.48445.text: You... you are... I've finally found it. The thing I've spent my whole life searching for...
strings.talk.48446.text: I won't let anyone stand in my way!
strings.talk.48448.text: What incredible power... Come back when you're ready to try again.
strings.talk.48449.text: So close... The fluffiness I've longed for my whole life...
strings.talk.48450.text: Didn't he say something about fluffiness before vanishing...? Don't tell me you were his target?
strings.talk.48451.text: I've got a chill all of a sudden... Whatever, the problem should be solved. Let's go report back.
strings.talk.48452.text: (You told Yok what happened in the cave.)
strings.talk.48453.text: A ghost...? That's quite unexpected. I'll discuss it with the other islanders. Thank you for your hard work! I found this on the island by chance, please take it as a token of thanks.
strings.talk.48454.text: Our part here is done for now. Let's go find Shizune.
strings.talk.48455.text: Yeah, let's check the cabin first. She might still be inside.
strings.talk.48456.text: Shizune's not in the cabin. Let's look around the island.
strings.talk.48461.text: Hehe, does it suit me? The other residents prepared it. They said it's called a "swimsuit". It's a little embarrassing, but they said Lil' Sam would definitely like it, so I figured I'd give it a try...
strings.talk.48462.text: (For someone like Sam, this outfit is probably a bit too much to handle.)
strings.talk.48463.text: Well, Lil' Sam? Does it suit me? Are you head over heels for me?
strings.talk.48465.text: I'll take Sam back to the cabin to rest. Shizune, just wait here for me.
strings.talk.48467.text: Sam, just lie down and rest for a bit. I'll go keep Shizune company.
strings.talk.48468.text: I really made a fool of myself...
strings.talk.48469.text: Don't be too hard on yourself. It was kind of a culture shock for you...
strings.talk.48470.text: ...I'll go talk to Shizune in a bit.
strings.talk.48472.text: #n/#n, is Sam alright? Maybe I should go be with him after all...
strings.talk.48473.text: Don't worry! Sam said he just needs a short rest. He'll come find you soon. Try not to think too much of it.
strings.talk.48475.text: #n/#n, do you think Lil' Sam could ever hate me?
strings.talk.48476.text: I'm always causing him trouble. I wonder if he's already tired of me...
strings.talk.48478.text: Sam cares about you more than anyone.
strings.talk.48479.text: I know... that's exactly why I worry.
strings.talk.48480.text: #n/#n, I want to tell just you something. I've had a recurring dream for a long time now, that one day, Lil' Sam will leave me and go somewhere very far away. I don't know why.
strings.talk.48481.text: So whenever I have the chance, I want to say what's on my mind and let him know how I feel. I don't want to leave anything unsaid. That's how I think about it.
strings.talk.48482.text: (Sam just mentioned #R#Bbefore it ends/#R/#B, and now Shizune is also saying Sam will leave. Even as a coincidence, it's a little too ominous.)
strings.talk.48483.text: Don't tell Lil' Sam what I just said! I may seem a bit scatter-brained, but please keep this between us. If he knew, he'd definitely get a big head about it.
strings.talk.48485.text: (These two really do have this side to them.)
strings.talk.48486.text: Oh right... Hm? Is that... Lil' Sam?
strings.talk.48487.text: Sam, are you feeling better? What's with the outfit?
strings.talk.48488.text: More or less. Tyr brought me this "swimsuit" too. It's light and comfortable. Besides...
strings.talk.48490.text: I couldn't just leave Shizune as the only one dressed like this... I should be with you... or something like that.
strings.talk.48491.text: Lil' Sam looks great in it too!
strings.talk.48492.text: Also... Tyr mentioned there's a path in the cave leading to the mountaintop. Shizune... do you want to check it out?
strings.talk.48493.text: Of course! If Lil' Sam's asking, I'm in!
strings.talk.48494.text: You two go ahead. Sam, make sure to keep Shizune safe~
strings.talk.48496.text: I'll wander around the island for a bit and check in on those two lovebirds later.
strings.talk.48497.text: I think I spotted a #R#Btreasure chest/#R/#B somewhere on the island earlier. Might as well look for it now.
strings.talk.48498.text: Should be about time. Let's head up to the summit and check on those two.
strings.talk.48499.text: Found them. It's those two... I'll hide here and watch.
strings.talk.48500.text: It feels like it's been a long time since we last looked at the moon together like this.
strings.talk.48501.text: Yeah. And ever since what happened when we were young, you've become so strong and dependable.
strings.talk.48502.text: Being beast-folk, being treated like animals is just part of life. My parents only confirmed that. I nearly lost my life back then. Fortunately, I met #n/#n.
strings.talk.48504.text: If you hadn't been by my side back then, I might not have chosen this path at all.
strings.talk.48505.text: You gave me someone I want to protect, and a reason to become stronger.
strings.talk.48507.text: (So there was a story like that behind it all...)
strings.talk.48512.text: Don't you dare lay a finger on Shizune!
strings.talk.48515.text: Thank you, #n/#n. I didn't expect you to be here.
strings.talk.48516.text: It's... a long story. Let's deal with the enemy first!
strings.talk.48519.text: I didn't think the ghosts would be so fixated on you two. That's terrifying.
strings.talk.48522.text: It's getting late. Let's head down together and rest.
strings.talk.48523.text: Sounds good, it is getting late.
strings.talk.48526.text: Where are we? Weren't we just on Chatham Isle? And who are you?
strings.talk.48527.text: Just a passing fisherman. I happened to see the three of you lying here and came to check on you.
strings.talk.48528.text: I remember the three of us were on an island called Chatham Isle...
strings.talk.48529.text: Right, we went through a lot there. Even encountered what seemed like ghosts.
strings.talk.48530.text: Ghosts, huh... I've heard a legend about that. Long ago, this area was home to a group of people who had a deep love for beast-folk with furry ears and fluffy animals.
strings.talk.48531.text: But as the climate changed, the island gradually disappeared. They say most of those people died never having had the chance to feel that fluffiness.
strings.talk.48533.text: Though I suppose it's just a legend~ Ha-ha. You three look like you'll be fine. I'll be on my way~
strings.talk.48535.text: I think that's probably the whole story... Let's just act like none of it happened.
strings.talk.48536.text: The story that fisherman told... it felt so sad. Where did Tyr and the other residents go?
strings.talk.48537.text: And how did we end up here? All that's left nearby is this box.
strings.talk.48538.text: Let's see what's inside. There's also a note.
strings.talk.48539.text: Thank you for coming to our island and fulfilling our wish. Even without actually touching, knowing that a fluffy beast-folk truly exists in this world is enough to satisfy us.
strings.talk.48540.text: Keep this as a memento. And best wishes to the two beast-folk lovebirds, may you be happy together.
strings.talk.48542.text: The "Chatham" in Chatham Isle... it probably means "legend" or "tall tale."
strings.talk.48546.text: It's been so long since anyone visited the island. Let us know if you need anything!
strings.talk.48547.text: Also, in case you haven't noticed, besides the lodging we've prepared, there's also a trading area used by the villagers. Feel free to make use of it.
strings.talk.48548.text: By the way, I've never seen clothing like this anywhere else. It's quite charming, isn't it?
strings.talk.48549.text: He-he, I'm sure the little cat over there would look wonderful in it too.
strings.talk.48551.text: Are the other two interested as well?
strings.talk.48552.text: It's alright! We're fine for now...
strings.talk.48554.text: What would you like to do today?
strings.talk.48556.text: Would you like to return to Starter's Beach?
strings.talk.48558.text: (Let Sam rest for a bit and clear his head.)
strings.talk.48559.text: Would you like to be teleported directly to the cave entrance?
strings.talk.48560.text: I'll be the one to protect Shizune!
strings.talk.48561.text: It seems there's still much in this world I don't understand... I must need more training...
strings.talk.48562.text: This concludes the Holiday Legend storyline. Once you leave this map, you won't be able to return.
strings.talk.48632.text: Welcome, Savior. This is the #R#BPhantom Temple/#R#B, allow me to show you around.
strings.talk.48636.text: Here lie the fantasy mythical foes you faced on your journey: #R#BSphinx, Anubis, Medusa, the Scorpion King/#R#B.
strings.talk.48637.text: After you, Savior, defeated their bodies, we use this place to monitor their soul?forms. The Phantom Temple's purpose is to harmonize the energies they emit, keeping the mortal world?s balance intact.
strings.talk.48638.text: They're not inherently evil, you can think of them as natural harmonizers. Someone tampered with them, and that upset the balance.
strings.talk.48639.text: We conduct a #R#Bone-per-week/#R#Bharmonization ritual. If you assist, Savior, you'll receive a fitting reward.
strings.talk.48640.text: Before the ritual, you can pay chanting fees to the ritual assistant here to gain blessings usable only within the Phantom Temple.
strings.talk.48641.text: #R#BBlessings/#R#Bcome in 8 types. From them 3 are randomly drawn, and #R#Bone/#R#Byou can choose yourself.
strings.talk.48642.text: #R#BFixed HP/SP regen per turn, Damage Reduction, Seal Resistance, Speed Boost, Critical Rate, Critical Damage, Damage Increase, All-Stat Buff/#R#B
strings.talk.48643.text: After you pick an ability, and then choose their potency: #R#B3%, 5%, or 10%/#R#B. Confirm to apply the blessing.
strings.talk.48644.text: Finally, blessings are #R#Blimited to Phantom Temple area/#R#Band reset each week. Please take note.
strings.talk.48645.text: Spend #R#B5, 000 gold/#R#Bto gain a Temple blessing? (#R#BYou can still proceed without taking the blessing. Selecting "Yes" deducts gold immediately./#R#B)

strings.talk.50002.text: Are you fine? Why do your eyes seem so sad?
strings.talk.50003.text: Sorry, I know I shouldn't talk about my private matters.
strings.talk.50004.text: Oh, no. You will be ill if you keep the matters in your heart.
strings.talk.50005.text: Ok! Let me tell you the matter. I had fell in love with KaVo before I turned to the gods.
strings.talk.50006.text: I have believed in the gods since my childhood and I also believed that my faith would bring me the support and happiness.
strings.talk.50007.text: Kavo has no faith, doesn't believe in god, but I don't care that. The faith issue does nothing to our affection. But one day...
strings.talk.50008.text: Fortunately he was saved, but due to the injury on his head, he doesn't remember me at all. Now I'm a nun, I don't know how to talk to him.
strings.talk.50009.text: I can't stop myself from crying whenever I see him, and every time I look at this necklace... but I'm a nun, I can't be like this any more.
strings.talk.50010.text: Would you do me a favor,and take #R#B this necklace to Kavo/#R/#B?
strings.talk.50011.text: I know that I shouldn't talk about such things, but I feel much better now.
strings.talk.50013.text: #R#B Kavo/#R/#B he should be #R#B near the pool/#R/#B. Thanks for your help!
strings.talk.50014.text: That sister again! I have told her that I don't know her. She is lovely but I am betrothed to someone else!
strings.talk.50015.text: Be patient, Kavo, you are not aware of all of the facts...
strings.talk.50016.text: I believe in your sincerity, anyway, I can't accept this necklace.
strings.talk.50017.text: Send my words to her that I thank her for remembering me and our past,but she should keep the necklace as it is more meaningful to her!
strings.talk.50018.text: Really, he said that? Oh dear... My goodness!
strings.talk.50019.text: The necklace only makes me sad, so I will give it to you!
strings.talk.50020.text: Don't worry, I still have god. Thank you very much! May you find your happiness!
strings.talk.50021.text: What a beautiful landscape!   Why have you taken me here?
strings.talk.50024.text: Hehe~ I want to give you this necklace!
strings.talk.50025.text: Oho! It's really nice! Is it a real diamond?
strings.talk.50026.text: Why do you cry like this? Please, don't cry!
strings.talk.50027.text: Tell me honestly if you robbed it?
strings.talk.50028.text: Robbed it? How could you think that?!
strings.talk.50029.text: It often appears in the drama. You don't have much money, and the big diamond like this must be very expensive!
strings.talk.50030.text: You're completely wrong, I have an old friend who works in the ore mines.  He has found many diamonds while digging.
strings.talk.50031.text: I asked him for one which was not very superior, but I worked on it and crafted it into the heart shape!
strings.talk.50032.text: Really? Thanks for your painstaking work, you're great.
strings.talk.50033.text: It was not too hard and you make my life seem more meaningful. So I used you for the inspiration to make this. Do you like the necklace?
strings.talk.50034.text: Of course, I like it, I love you!
strings.talk.50035.text: Eunos, so... would you ... would you marry...
strings.talk.50036.text: It's him again!! He's a heretic, he insults god in the holy church! We should teach him a lesson!!
strings.talk.50038.text: It's trouble! Eunos, you had better leave now...
strings.talk.50040.text: What do you want to do?
strings.talk.50042.text: We come to arrest you and take you to the Vatican!
strings.talk.50043.text: Take me away?  You will only manage to do so in your dreams!
strings.talk.50044.text: If you don't obey, we will punish you here!
strings.talk.50049.text: It is his fortune, He falls down by himself!
strings.talk.50050.text: Eunos! They're all devils! You've been lied to!! Come away with us!!
strings.talk.50052.text: We're the fastest shrewmice in the world!  You are so lucky to have seen us, hehe...
strings.talk.50053.text: You are really mouthy, I can't believe it!
strings.talk.50054.text: Let's have a contest. If you win, you can get our favorite pachyrhizus!!
strings.talk.50055.text: Oh, you're much faster than us! This is our precious pachyrhizus, here take it!
strings.talk.50056.text: Aha, go back and train more!
strings.talk.50057.text: Oh, I can't believe I lost. I will go home to train some more, bye bye!
strings.talk.50058.text: You left your necklace here, fortunately I noticed it!
strings.talk.50059.text: Oh? Where is the necklace now? Maybe I left it at  #B#R Kavo's /#B/#R.  Please go back to ask him.
strings.talk.50060.text: You don't have the necklace in your hand right now, did you forget to ask#B#R Eunos /#B/#R for it?
strings.talk.50061.text: No more things to collect now.
strings.talk.50062.text: Oh, you have no more room on your body to keep things.
strings.talk.50064.text: Which event did you apply for?
strings.talk.50066.text: The Golden Compass is during 7:00pm-7:30pm every Tuesday.
strings.talk.50067.text: You should go to the correct ans. in  #R#B Six Seconds /#R/#B after the qn. is shown. After six seconds, your ans. is invalid. If you are false for #R#B three times /#R/#B, you will be disqualified. A Registration Voucher is needed to restar the event.
strings.talk.50068.text: The event will be held on #R#B Tuesday from 7:00pm to 7:30pm /#R/#B, and top 20 players will be awarded. Please note that the winner will be disqualifed if there is no enough room for the rewards in their item bar.
strings.talk.50069.text: Players can enter the scene with an organized team, but only the team leader can join the competition and get the prize, so please join the competition without an organized team.
strings.talk.50070.text: The player who can survive and win at least one round will get the Suvival Reward, and the top three winners who won the most rounds will be recieve Special Rewards once the event has finished.
strings.talk.50071.text: Are you sure that you want to go to the Harbor Island alone?
strings.talk.50072.text: Ok, you've registered for the event, please go through the door behind me. I wish you good luck.
strings.talk.50073.text: One "Registration Voucher" is required, do you want to join the Golden Compass again?
strings.talk.50076.text: I'm sorry that you were attacked by the monster, it was my carelessness.
strings.talk.50077.text: Never mind, the monster was not so fierce.
strings.talk.50078.text: Hehe, you're great. I still feel sorry so I give you this gift as atoken of my apologies.
strings.talk.50079.text: Why there is a small hole, It looks like a specially designed keyhole.
strings.talk.50080.text: Oh, How can a stone talk?!
strings.talk.50081.text: The Holy Spirit sleeps here, you'd better leave!
strings.talk.50082.text: Once you have woken the Protector of the Holy Spirit, you won't be able to leave!
strings.talk.50083.text: You dare to interrupt the Holy Sprit when it sleeps!  Get ready to accept your punishment!
strings.talk.50084.text: Leave here at once! It is a forbbidden area!
strings.talk.50085.text: The shape of this cave resembles that of Stone Carving Key, Let's try it.
strings.talk.50086.text: The color of this wall is a little different from the rest.  It seems that it can be opened.
strings.talk.50087.text: Ah, Holy spirit! We can't protect you any longer!
strings.talk.50088.text: This is a small punishment, please go!
strings.talk.50089.text: A "Registration Voucher" is required to join the game again after you failed once.
strings.talk.50090.text: The shape of the Stone Carving Key is of a unique design!
strings.talk.50091.text: #swav9902/#s Aha, it really is a key, I'm right!
strings.talk.50092.text: Crude man, you have destroyed the order on this island!   You must be punished!
strings.talk.50093.text: Oh no! It is too difficult to keep the peace on this Island! Ululant....
strings.talk.50095.text: Is she the Little Red Riding Hood from the Fairy Tale? Oh no! A group of wolves are attacking them.
strings.talk.50097.text: You, mean wild wolves, let me teach you a lesson!
strings.talk.50098.text: Are you OK? Why were you attacked by the wolves?
strings.talk.50099.text: Because my Grandma is sick, so we came here to collect some natural herbs from #B#R Holy Village /#B/#R in the south.
strings.talk.50100.text: We came across the wolves by accident. Fortunately you were here to defend us.
strings.talk.50101.text: You saved me and my granddaughter, also drove away the wolves from the village, thank you very much!
strings.talk.50102.text: In order to express our gratitude, I will give you this reward!
strings.talk.50103.text: Please come back to Holy Village when you have time!
strings.talk.50104.text: Thank you for killing the wolves for us!
strings.talk.50106.text: You haven't chosen your event or the someone in your team hasn't registered yet.
strings.talk.50107.text: Great Survivor, what can I do for you?
strings.talk.50109.text: Go to the Capitol in Welling Village.
strings.talk.50112.text: #e/#e In fact I'm the prince of Darstell Kingdom, and I offended the enchantress here. So she cursed me and I became a frog.#e/#e
strings.talk.50113.text: Could you appease her for me?
strings.talk.50114.text: Ok, where is the enchantress now?
strings.talk.50115.text: She is in #R#B the fourth cave on the left /#R/#B.Go into the cave until you see the Stone Door. Say the secret word "Rose" , then the door will open.#e/#e #e/#e
strings.talk.50116.text: There is a Stone Door here, but it appears only magic can open it.
strings.talk.50117.text: Oh, I remember. This is the Stone Door that the Frog told me about, and the secret word is ...
strings.talk.50123.text: Ah-ha, it has opened.   But what does the enchantress look like?
strings.talk.50124.text: There is another Stone Door, the sign next to the Stone Door says: #R#B533/#R/#B,#R#B422/#R/#B,#R#B1234555/#R/#B, What does it mean?
strings.talk.50125.text: Er...the numbers must be related to the closed door, let me move according to the order of these numbers.
strings.talk.50126.text: The door is open, go inside to have a look!
strings.talk.50127.text: Do you come to beg for that frog?
strings.talk.50129.text: Of course, I know, but it's useless, I have no plans to ever let him change back into a prince.
strings.talk.50130.text: Although I'm four hundred years old, how can he call me "Aged Witch"?!
strings.talk.50131.text: #f1/#f You are four hundred years old? (You're really very old... )
strings.talk.50132.text: Fight with my Disciple, if you win, then I will tell you how to turn the frog back.
strings.talk.50133.text: Really? You will let the Frog turn back into a man if I win?
strings.talk.50134.text: Fight with my Disciple, if you win, then I will tell you how to turn the Frog back.
strings.talk.50135.text: Eeuuuhhh!  I have to kiss the Frog!
strings.talk.50136.text: So, the whole thing is like this...
strings.talk.50139.text: (I remember a fairy tale in where a Frog was able to change back into a prince after being kissed.)
strings.talk.50140.text: Oh no!  Why is it still a frog!
strings.talk.50141.text: In my country all of the people are frogs, so it is nothing strange. I must go now.  Welcome to my country.  Please give me the chance to thank you, and if you want I'll let you marry my daughter.  Bye bye!
strings.talk.50142.text: In my country all of the people are frogs,  so it is nothing strange. I must go now.  Welcome to my country. Please give me the chance to thank you, and if you want I'll marry   you.  Bye bye!
strings.talk.50143.text: (Er... who would want to marry you!)
strings.talk.50144.text: (Your daughter? She must be another frog.)
strings.talk.50145.text: Why is this a device? I must have done something wrong!
strings.talk.50146.text: The witch is not in now, please come another day.
strings.talk.50147.text: How can you still come in? Please go away!
strings.talk.50148.text: You have to give it a big kiss!
strings.talk.50149.text: OK, I gotta to tell him right now.
strings.talk.50151.text: The five device must be very important, I'd better not touch it before I know its use.
strings.talk.50152.text: The note next to the Stone Door says: #R#B???/#R/#B, #R#B???/#R/#B, #R#B???????/#R/#B. It must have some relation to the Stone Door, let me move them according to the order of these numbers.
strings.talk.50153.text: Er... this is the fifth device,so the next one is the fourth,and the third next... which device should I move next?
strings.talk.50154.text: So why did you agree to help the frog?
strings.talk.50155.text: Done, go inside to have a look.
strings.talk.50156.text: Ah! There is something wrong when I move...
strings.talk.50157.text: The devices have re-set, I must start again.
strings.talk.50158.text: What can I do for you?
strings.talk.50159.text: Grandpa, what are you doing here alone?
strings.talk.50160.text: Er? It's you, young man, you must be the one the gods sent to help me. I'm the matchmaker.
strings.talk.50162.text: You see, there is a couple who are destined to be lovers, but due to some unkown cause, I can't put them together with the Red Thread.
strings.talk.50163.text: I cannot go into crowded places, could you help me to see what has happened?
strings.talk.50164.text: Thank you, they are #R#B Ade /#R/#B and #R#B Pei /#R/#B living in the #R#B Fishing Village /#R/#B.
strings.talk.50165.text: If ... we can go to sea for all of our life, how wonderful it would be!
strings.talk.50166.text: Yes, Ade, I have the same idea as you!
strings.talk.50167.text: Pei, what's the matter with you?  Recently you sometimes neglect me.
strings.talk.50169.text: Pei! What's wrong with you?! Don't scare me!
strings.talk.50170.text: My God, the Spirit did something wrong, so Pei fainted!! Anyway, I should report it to the Match Maker!
strings.talk.50171.text: Matchmaker, I see, there is black Spirit who makes trouble...
strings.talk.50172.text: Oh, the Spirit! I see, here is a Love Pill, tell Pei to take it, then she will be OK.
strings.talk.50173.text: (I'd better let Pei eat the Love Pill ASAP.)
strings.talk.50174.text: Oh, the Love Pill didn't work, go to Matchmaker for another one!
strings.talk.50175.text: Ade, this is the pill I got from the Matchmaker, tell Pei to take it, be quick!
strings.talk.50177.text: It's more important to save Pei, I will tell you the details later.
strings.talk.50181.text: Pei, it's ok you're fine.  But you had me so worried that I am never taking my eyes off you again!
strings.talk.50183.text: #f1/#f Oho, It's effective. They're so sweet. I can go back to Matchmaker to report the good news!
strings.talk.50184.text: Curses! We made trouble for Pei because she still owes us from her past life. You ruined my plan, so it's only fair that I should take your life.
strings.talk.50185.text: Past life? But you ruin Pei's happiness in this life, you have no right to destroy it?!
strings.talk.50186.text: You should give sincere wishes to them rather than revenge.
strings.talk.50187.text: If you promise to leave them alone I, the Matchmaker, promise to find you your true love next time you are re-born.  Why not hurry and do it now?
strings.talk.50189.text: Oho!  What a great man, I don't know how I would have solved this problem without you.
strings.talk.50190.text: This Red Thread is yours now! Bye bye!
strings.talk.50192.text: This horse is one of the best horses around.   Aha, I know you are interested in it.
strings.talk.50193.text: In a short while, I will ride it to the hunt, Aha!
strings.talk.50195.text: This is your prize, congratulations, you are the winner!
strings.talk.50196.text: Oh, I haven't picked a prize.
strings.talk.50197.text: A team is unable to sign up for the Slaughter Activity.

strings.talk.55174.text: Sigh... what a nice morning, and I can't even enjoy it.
strings.talk.55176.text: I passed the Grape Garden, and the Vanilla Grapes smelled so good, but I'm too shy to ask the Fruit Grower to give me some.
strings.talk.55177.text: Can you help me to get some #R#BVanilla Grapes/#R/#B?
strings.talk.55179.text: Fine, I'll ask someone else to help me.
strings.talk.55180.text: Okay, I'll help you. Wait here.
strings.talk.55181.text: I hope I'm not bothering you too much.
strings.talk.55182.text: The fruit grower is near the#R#B Grape Garden /#R/#B.
strings.talk.55183.text: Can I have some Vanilla Grapes?
strings.talk.55184.text: You smelled them? Haha! You can have some, I've made a lot of money anyways!
strings.talk.55186.text: Yeah, it was easy. Here you go!
strings.talk.55187.text: Thanks so much, take this Lauan!
strings.talk.55189.text: You already have some Vanilla Grapes.
strings.talk.55190.text: The Vanilla Grapes were so good that I ate them all, can I have more?
strings.talk.55191.text: Heh, I knew you'd like them! You can have some more!
strings.talk.55194.text: #f1/#f Is superb, successfully defeated the enemies in the level. Able to continue to the next level now!
strings.talk.55195.text: Congratulations on defeating the current level, you may now continue to the next level.
strings.talk.55196.text: Do you want to accept the challenge of Lord Zeus?
strings.talk.55197.text: On the way to Zeus, you'll have to defeat the guardian of the level to enter the next level. If you do not have #R#Binventory slots, the item will be deemed gone forever/#R/#B, please pay special attention to this.
strings.talk.55198.text: Okay, you may now enter the temple. The entrance is behind me, I wish you success in your journey.
strings.talk.55199.text: Behind me is the Temple of Zeus. Only qualified participants are allowed to meet Master Zeus.
strings.talk.55200.text: Please do not enter before activity has started.
strings.talk.55201.text: Congratulations, you have completed the activity. You are welcome to participate again next week.
strings.talk.55202.text: You seem strong, are you wiling to accept my challenge?
strings.talk.55203.text: You or someone in your party has not completed the registration, unable to enter.
strings.talk.55847.text: Monkey's parents, it's been a long time. I've brought Monkey to see you.
strings.talk.55848.text: Monkey, come and give me a hug.
strings.talk.55849.text: Squeak, squeak, squeak. Squeak, squeak, squeak, squeak. Squeak. Squeak, squeak, squeak. Squeak! Squeak...
strings.talk.55850.text: I hope you'll agree that I've brought my little monkey with me to say goodbye.
strings.talk.55852.text: If we're going to let you go on this trip together, we have conditions.
strings.talk.55853.text: That is, we need to test you to see if you can safely care for a baby monkey?
strings.talk.55855.text: That's good. I can trust you with the monkey.
strings.talk.55857.text: Oh, no. The tremor just sent the fire crystal flying to Earth.
strings.talk.55858.text: It seems to have fallen near the largest volcano in the southern hemisphere. Let's go look for it.
strings.talk.55859.text: If you find it, just take it back to the World Wide Man and you'll be fine.
strings.talk.55860.text: It seems that you have to expel these hell ants before you can get back the Fire Crystal.
strings.talk.55861.text: Hurry up and take the fire crystal stone back to the high master of the world.
strings.talk.55956.text: Squeak, squeak, squeak. (SQUEAKING) Squeak, squeak, squeak, squeak, squeak.
strings.talk.55957.text: This monkey seems to be very humane.
strings.talk.55958.text: Of course, but I can't understand what it's saying.
strings.talk.55959.text: It's not impossible to understand its language. I've heard that there are people on the mysterious island who can... (GROANS) Hoo-hoo-hoo. (GASPS) (GROANS)
strings.talk.55960.text: Can what? Wake up! (GASPS) . I'll go look for it.
strings.talk.55961.text: Mr. World Wide, is that you?
strings.talk.55962.text: What do you want from me?
strings.talk.55963.text: The monkey is my best friend, but I don't understand his language, so I don't know how we can communicate normally.
strings.talk.55964.text: I have a solution for you to communicate with your friend.
strings.talk.55965.text: I've collected all of them, finally I can talk to the little monkey.
strings.talk.55966.text: First, go to Mars and bring me the fire crystals.
strings.talk.55967.text: Now that you've melted it into a complete Fire Crystal, go back and give it to the World Guru.
strings.talk.55968.text: It will make the Book of Heaven without Words manifest.
strings.talk.56166.text: Have you brought back the Fire Crystal?
strings.talk.56168.text: With the Fire Crystal, I can open the path to the Dragon.
strings.talk.56169.text: Then I can make a wish to the Dragon.
strings.talk.56170.text: Should I go to the Dragon's Hall?
strings.talk.56171.text: Come back to me when the little monkey is on your team.
strings.talk.56173.text: Yes. It's been a long time since anyone's been here.
strings.talk.56175.text: Has anyone been here before? Who is he? What was he doing here?
strings.talk.56176.text: Well, that's in the past. So, what do you want from me?
strings.talk.56177.text: Dragon, I want you to let the monkey communicate with me.
strings.talk.56178.text: I hope you can let the little monkey communicate with me normally.
strings.talk.56179.text: It's fate that I met you today, so I'll fulfill your wish!
strings.talk.56180.text: It's a mythological demon sealed in the other world. You need to help me stop them, or else there will be an accident for me and the little monkey!
strings.talk.56181.text: #R Monkey/#R will be leaving the team, do you agree?
strings.talk.56182.text: What's going on? What happened to Monkey?
strings.talk.56183.text: The crack in space-time just now has affected the casting of the spell, and I've done all I can!
strings.talk.56184.text: Then come back to me when you're ready.
strings.talk.56185.text: It's an otherworldly sealed mythological demon, and I need you to help me stop them, or else something will happen to me and Monkey!
strings.talk.56583.text: Do you want to return to the last cleared floor check point?
strings.talk.56589.text: You haven't cleared challenge to this floor yet
strings.talk.56590.text: You can use this function after clearing floor 5 or above.
strings.talk.57153.text: Yay, Savior! I've been waiting for you for a long time! I'm Noa, nice to meet you.
strings.talk.57154.text: What? You said the Chinese voice is subtle? I'm shy to make my voice heard in my favorite game! Give me patience! Then get used to it!
strings.talk.57155.text: You want to take me on an adventure with you? It's not impossible... I'll tell you what! Let's do the quiz! If you get all the answers right, I'll join your team!
strings.talk.57158.text: Well, come back to me when you've changed your mind, I'll be here anytime, anywhere... You think I'm going to make the mayor's voice when I'm rejected like everyone else? No, I don't think so!
strings.talk.57159.text: Are you ready? Here we go!
strings.talk.57160.text: You got a few questions wrong, I see! Did you get them wrong on purpose because you wanted to talk to me more? No problem! Talk to me more!
strings.talk.57161.text: You're amazing! You got all the answers right! That's great! Now I can wander around the Wonderland World! I'm so happy, so please take care of me from now on, Savior!
strings.talk.57162.text: It's better to have a companion on the journey, isn't it? I'm not going to become a constellation!
strings.talk.57163.text: Let's start with the basics: Who is the character who can trigger a special conversation and exchange identities after 10 drifting conversations?
strings.talk.57165.text: It's a hidden egg in the game next door! Either side of the service industry is an awe-inspiring existence, right? Only you can fight for the chance to change your own destiny!
strings.talk.57167.text: Correct answer! This is one of many easter eggs you'll find in Wonderland world! Speaking 10 times to Breillat will trigger appearance swap, but not identity , of course!
strings.talk.57168.text: Let's go a little further: what person to find when you want to pray for resurrection of a deceased partner's body?
strings.talk.57170.text: The priest's mission is to resurrect the body, while the Energizer's mission is to retrieve the lost soul! But then again, they're both quite powerful, aren't they? Resurrection and invocation?
strings.talk.57172.text: The correct answer! What the priest resurrect is a body of partner, just the body. The world is full of surprises, right? I was so shocked when I found out that the resurrected partner I have is just a body without a soul!
strings.talk.57173.text: Let's talk about me! Guess what I'm good at?
strings.talk.57175.text: Correct answer! But it's rather my passion than profession. It's always been my dream to draw things and people I like, and the scenery I want to see, and show it to everyone.
strings.talk.57177.text: Oops, now that you've chosen that answer, how about a taste of my recently developed special chocolate pudding? Although the last person who ate it was poisoned, it shouldn't be a problem, there's an antidote for it here.
strings.talk.57178.text: So next - guess what my character attributes are?
strings.talk.57180.text: There is a chance that you will be chosen for this option, right? There's a chance! Because I'm so soft and gentle haha, but unfortunately that's not the right answer!
strings.talk.57182.text: Correct answer! Do you feel my burning passion for Norn Saber and Wonderland? Or it's my liver is burning... ahem, that's not the point anyway!
strings.talk.57183.text: Last question, who is my favorite person?
strings.talk.57185.text: Aha, I got you here! I won't give any other options for this question! I'd like to introduce you to Rey, who is the leader of the Knights in Norn Saber game. He's handsome and capable, so be sure to meet him if you have a chance!
strings.talk.58000.text: Happy Halloween! What do you want to redeem?

strings.talk.58003.text: Exchange 1* strange candy for mini hp bottle.

strings.talk.58006.text: Exchange 30 strange candies for Space Capsule?

strings.talk.58008.text: Exchange 1* strange candies for mini Sp bottle?

strings.talk.58012.text: Happy Mid-Autumn Festival! What would you like to redeem?
strings.talk.60004.text: Hateful monster! I will fight you!
strings.talk.60012.text: Thank you for helping me. May I have your name?
strings.talk.60017.text: In my opinion,we should give up!
strings.talk.60019.text: Let me deal with this situation.
strings.talk.60026.text: In my opinion,we should give up!
strings.talk.60034.text: Old man, are you calling me?
strings.talk.60038.text: #f2/#f It seems that who is crying for help there?
strings.talk.60051.text: Excuse me, but what's going on?
strings.talk.60200.text: #n/#n, thank you. . .and I am sorry about. . .
strings.talk.60602.text: It's you again. Are you tired of living? Ok, I will give you a hand to end it all.
strings.talk.60700.text: Ok. Return to me when you need my help. I will be here.
strings.talk.60900.text: Damn it! I won't let you get away with this!
strings.talk.60901.text: That's all right. Come see me when you're ready.
strings.talk.60903.text: Oh my God! You must remember this!
strings.talk.60905.text: Cough cough... Huh? Where am I?
strings.talk.60908.text: Ok, I will come right now.
strings.talk.60912.text: After strengthening your ability, come see me again.
strings.talk.60924.text: Some of your answers are wrong. You should study some more before coming back.
strings.talk.60925.text: You ... what are you going to do?
strings.talk.60929.text: What can I do for you?
strings.talk.60930.text: You should study more before coming back.
strings.talk.60932.text: It's OK. Come to me if you need any help.
strings.talk.60936.text: You are welcome! Come see me if you need any help.
strings.talk.62002.text: Want to try our wine? It is famous.
strings.talk.62003.text: Go tell your boss to get out of here! Otherwise we will destroy your shop.
strings.talk.62004.text: Don't destroy the shop! You'll hurt people!
strings.talk.62005.text: This is none of your business. Go away!
strings.talk.62007.text: Who is it? Come on out!
strings.talk.62008.text: I am bored. I think I'll play with you.
strings.talk.62010.text: #f2/#fI'm here to make sure you don't bully anyone else!
strings.talk.62011.text: Want to be a hero? Then die with him!
strings.talk.62012.text: I'm in a good mood, so get out of here!
strings.talk.62013.text: Want to be a hero? Then die with him!
strings.talk.62014.text: I am Louis. Feel free to find me if you need anything.
strings.talk.62016.text: You are so brave. It wasn't your problem, but you helped me anyway.
strings.talk.62017.text: They looked dangerous, so I had to give you a hand.
strings.talk.62019.text: He must have dropped this pocket watch. Where has he gone?
strings.talk.62020.text: Well, I will keep it and return it to him when I see him again.
strings.talk.62034.text: When I went to check out today, I discovered I had no money, so the owner tied me up.
strings.talk.62035.text: Don't worry. I'll untie you and then discuss it with the owner.
strings.talk.62037.text: Ah, guard, here is the man who has no money to pay for his long stay. What? Who untied you?
strings.talk.62040.text: I want him put in prison!
strings.talk.62041.text: What can I do for you?
strings.talk.62042.text: Is this your pocket watch? You left it in the bar.
strings.talk.62043.text: Oh, I left it in the bar? I've been looking for it for a long time.
strings.talk.62044.text: Oh, a pocket watch? Let me see ... It seems quite good. OK, I'll take this instead of money.
strings.talk.62047.text: Don't worry about it. You are not from around here, are you? Why did you come here?
strings.talk.62048.text: I want to travel all over the world to learn new skills so I can be the best fighter in the world.
strings.talk.62049.text: But you have no money now. What are you going to do?
strings.talk.62051.text: (He is quite a good fighter. Maybe I could ask him to join me.)
strings.talk.62052.text: Louis, I have a suggestion. Would you like to travel the world with me? We have the same dream. You won't need to worry about money and we can defeat enemies together.
strings.talk.62053.text: That's a great idea. I'd like to join you.
strings.talk.62054.text: It's interesting traveling with you. I'd be happy to travel with you again.
strings.talk.62056.text: You are his accomplice! I can't trust you.
strings.talk.62057.text: Hey, boss, I just spent all my money. If I hadn't lost my pocket watch, I would give it to you.
strings.talk.62058.text: Oh, a pocket watch? Let me see ... It seems quite good.
strings.talk.62060.text: Lately some robbers have been spotted near the village. Please be careful.
strings.talk.62061.text: I have seen this armlet somewhere before.
strings.talk.62062.text: Apparently a group of robbers has been attacking passersby. Their base is in the #R#BPine Forest/#R/#B, but we couldn't find anything there when we searched the area.
strings.talk.62063.text: (We must stop them from harming the villagers.)
strings.talk.62064.text: Let me deal with the robbers.
strings.talk.62066.text: I'm sure you could help us get rid of the robbers in the #R#BPine Forest/#R/#B.
strings.talk.62068.text: This seems to be the robbers' base.
strings.talk.62070.text: There is a passage underneath. What's inside? I'll go and see.
strings.talk.62071.text: These treasures must have been snatched by those vicious robbers.
strings.talk.62072.text: These treasures must have been snatched by those vicious robbers.
strings.talk.62073.text: I must inform the villagers of the thieves' hidden treasure.
strings.talk.62075.text: Ha! Since you've discovered our hideout, we cannot let you go. You will starve to death here. Ha ha! Let's go.
strings.talk.62078.text: #f2/#fUh oh! The robbers may have sent a wolf to eat me!
strings.talk.62079.text: Benefactor, take it easy. I won't eat you.
strings.talk.62080.text: Are you the wolf I saved? How can you speak? And how did you get here?
strings.talk.62081.text: I am Sam. I got through this door easily, but my armlet is missing, so I cannot bring you out.
strings.talk.62082.text: An armlet? Is this it? I picked it up after you left last time.
strings.talk.62083.text: Great! I can save you now!
strings.talk.62086.text: There's no time to talk. Let's get out of here first.
strings.talk.62087.text: I'll wait for you outside. Follow me!
strings.talk.62088.text: Ah, you want to escape? Not so fast!
strings.talk.62090.text: Hum, want to escape? Not so easily!
strings.talk.62093.text: Yeah, we won. By the way, you didn't tell me why you can speak and become a human.
strings.talk.62094.text: I come from beast-human tribe. We can speak human language, but we need the armlet to become a human.
strings.talk.62095.text: Last time I was trapped in the Holy Village and lost my armlet. Thank you for saving me.
strings.talk.62096.text: Now that you have the armlet again, you may go back to the beast-human tribe.
strings.talk.62097.text: You saved my life, I am willing to accompany you forever.
strings.talk.62098.text: Fine, but I don't have a house?
strings.talk.62100.text: It's interesting traveling with you. I'd like to travel with you again.
strings.talk.62113.text: What's going on? Ah! The Curse Scroll has disappered! Catch that thief!
strings.talk.62114.text: You made a mistake. There was a female ninja here.
strings.talk.62116.text: Well, can I help you find the thief and get the scroll back?
strings.talk.62117.text: Hmm ... OK, if you find another thief then I'll believe you.
strings.talk.62119.text: If you find another thief I'll believe you.
strings.talk.62121.text: Give me the scroll you just stole!
strings.talk.62123.text: Oh, I see you are all thieves! Give me back the scroll!
strings.talk.62124.text: When I got here, the scroll had disappeared already.
strings.talk.62125.text: #f2/#fBoth of you are spies from other countries!
strings.talk.62126.text: You made a mistake. You forgot your scroll when you left home!
strings.talk.62128.text: If you had told us earlier, this misunderstanding might never have happened.
strings.talk.62130.text: I'm so sorry. I thought you were a thief. Here, take this and please forgive me.
strings.talk.62131.text: #f1/#fWell, just don't make that mistake again.
strings.talk.62132.text: Ha ha, I have to go now.
strings.talk.62140.text: I never imagined it would be so beautiful.
strings.talk.62142.text: You can enjoy the scenery. I'd better take a rest!
strings.talk.62146.text: Look at the Cloud Sea. It's like fairy land, don't you think?
strings.talk.62147.text: I never knew the Cloud Sea could be as marvellous as this!
strings.talk.62148.text: Yes, there are such clouds everywhere in my Fairy Land!
strings.talk.62149.text: Oh, look! The silvery Cloud Sea looks like soft snow has gently landed there. It's so beautiful!
strings.talk.62150.text: The Cloud Sea is really splendid!
strings.talk.62151.text: (But Angela's golden heart is more beautiful than that.)
strings.talk.62160.text: Hey, wake up! What happened here?
strings.talk.62163.text: Why is there a letter on the desk?
strings.talk.62164.text: Hey, wake up! What happened here?
strings.talk.62166.text: Who are you? Where is my father?
strings.talk.62167.text: It must've been you who seized my father and killed the others!
strings.talk.62168.text: This is just a misunderstanding. I only came aboard a moment ago.
strings.talk.62169.text: You are lying! It was you who captured my father and killed the others!
strings.talk.62171.text: I told you, I didn't do anything!
strings.talk.62172.text: Oh really? Though I cannot defeat you, I will find your hideout and rescue my father!
strings.talk.62175.text: Does the letter have something to do with Zheng He's disappearance?
strings.talk.62177.text: The letter says: Take 500,000 Gold to #R#BLeviathan's den in Ancient Yazhou City/#R/#B, or else Zheng He will die!
strings.talk.62178.text: Zheng He was taken away by pirates. Rescue him from #R#BLeviathan's den in Ancient Yazhou City/#R/#B.
strings.talk.62181.text: (Zheng He is a eunuch. How can he have a daughter?)
strings.talk.62183.text: I don't have that much money. Even if I did, I would never give it to you.
strings.talk.62184.text: Then I will kill Zheng He!
strings.talk.62187.text: #F2/#FIt's awful. The guilt is too hard to deal with.
strings.talk.62189.text: I am fine. Thank you, Victoria and #N/#N.
strings.talk.62191.text: Dad, do you know him? I think he is also a pirate.
strings.talk.62192.text: Don't be rude. Without #N/#N, I would have been killed by those pirates.
strings.talk.62193.text: You flatter me. However, I was surprised to learn this girl is your daughter.
strings.talk.62194.text: Victoria is my foster daughter. Please forgive her rudeness.
strings.talk.62195.text: I admire your daughter's bravery very much.
strings.talk.62196.text: I want her to go out into the world and gain some experience, but I am too busy. #N/#N, can you do me this favor?
strings.talk.62197.text: Um, I don't know if Victoria will agree to go.
strings.talk.62198.text: All right, I am willing to go with #N/#N. (I can watch him in case he tries to harm my father).
strings.talk.62200.text: #f1/#fI could learn from Victoria. (Maybe she still thinks I am one of those pirates.)
strings.talk.62210.text: Where are we? Why is there a moon design on the door?
strings.talk.62211.text: This is Koyota. The trees are called cherry.
strings.talk.62213.text: #f1/#fHa ha! (I didn't realize Victoria was so cute.)
strings.talk.62214.text: What beautiful cherry flowers! It's the first time I've ever seen them.
strings.talk.62215.text: #f1/#f(This is my first time seeing her smile.)
strings.talk.62216.text: #f1/#f(Actually, Victoria's smile is more beautiful than the flowers.)
strings.talk.62217.text: What a nice place! I was right to follow you.
strings.talk.62218.text: Though you kidnapped my father, you are not so bad.
strings.talk.62219.text: (She still thinks I am the leader of the kidnappers.)
strings.talk.62230.text: Ancilla Chief? Why are you here?
strings.talk.62231.text: Eva, Evil King Samile has issued a new order. Can I talk with you for a moment?
strings.talk.62232.text: #f1/#fOh, um, I must go out for a while. (Why are they being so mysterious?)
strings.talk.62234.text: You've been here for quite a long time, and the Evil King wishes to give you this present.
strings.talk.62237.text: Wow! What beautiful garments. The pictures on them are very cute!
strings.talk.62238.text: They have magic powers. They will help you defeat all of your enemies.
strings.talk.62239.text: Magic powers? I must try them on.
strings.talk.62240.text: How do I use these? I can feel the power. How strange! I'd better take them off.
strings.talk.62245.text: Long, long ago the Devil caught me and sealed me in these garments. Oh! Ouch! What are you doing?
strings.talk.62246.text: I want to take you off. Um, but why can't I do it?
strings.talk.62247.text: You can't take me off before you finish your quest.
strings.talk.62250.text: Oh, um, I like chatting with myself.
strings.talk.62252.text: Ah! #n/#n! It's dangerous! Don't come here!
strings.talk.62253.text: #n/#n? Is he the Evil one? I want to defeat him!
strings.talk.62254.text: I was sent to assist Eva. This is my realm! Your powers will be of no use here. I will only offer you one chance at redemption. Will you join the forces of darkness?
strings.talk.62255.text: #f2/#fI would never do that, even if you try to force me.
strings.talk.62257.text: You'd better give up now. You are about to be defeated.
strings.talk.62259.text: Eva? How can you disobey the Devil?
strings.talk.62261.text: Oh, what power! The Dark Sword has awoke?
strings.talk.62262.text: #f2/#fWhat is this ... Dark Sword? Is Eva the Dark Sword?
strings.talk.62263.text: #n/#n! We must break the trap with our power.
strings.talk.62264.text: You broke my trap! Impossible! Is it the power of the Dark Sword?
strings.talk.62266.text: I can defeat you without the trap! I will kill you!
strings.talk.62268.text: How about you, Eva? Are you really the sword?
strings.talk.62269.text: I don't know. My father used to say that I had magical powers, but I never really believed him.
strings.talk.62270.text: (You are the Dark Sword, but where is the Bright Shield?)
strings.talk.62272.text: #f1/#fEva, will you be my sword? If so then I think we will surely defeat every enemy we come across!
strings.talk.62273.text: Oh, no! I don't want to be a sword.
strings.talk.62274.text: #f1/#fHa! It's just a joke. Let's go.
strings.talk.62281.text: Why does the Luna Jade glow so brightly?
strings.talk.62283.text: Why does the Luna Jade glow so brightly?
strings.talk.62284.text: What is the power that draws us in?
strings.talk.62285.text: #N/#N, this is Luna's power. Maybe my mother is inside. Let's go in.
strings.talk.62287.text: The cave can't be accessed. A mysterious force prevents us from entering.
strings.talk.62288.text: Only the #R#BLuna Jade/#R/#B can open the iron door?
strings.talk.62289.text: Qlaya, leave here before the evil one discovers you.
strings.talk.62290.text: Qlaya, leave here before the evil one discovers you.
strings.talk.62292.text: Qlaya! Why are you here? I left you with a Mayan family for your own safety.
strings.talk.62293.text: The evil one seized us to get the power of the Secret Fete Book. Please leave before you are discovered.
strings.talk.62294.text: No! I will leave with you or not at all. I will rescue you and my people.
strings.talk.62295.text: Impossible! King Howert won't let us go until he has the power of the Secret Fete Book.
strings.talk.62296.text: The power of the Secret Fete Book? Why does he want it?
strings.talk.62300.text: Give me the power of the Secret Fete Book now, or I will kill Yanasy and your clansmen.
strings.talk.62301.text: Qlaya, please don't release the power! If you do, nobody will be able to stop King Howert.
strings.talk.62302.text: Qlaya, even if it costs our lives, we must not let Berthaud win!
strings.talk.62303.text: If you release the power of the Secret Fete Book to me, I will let the people of the Luna Clan go.
strings.talk.62305.text: Fine. Once I release the power, you must set them free!
strings.talk.62307.text: Casting spells ... (I will release the power sealed in the Secret Fete Book.)
strings.talk.62309.text: All right, I have released the power. Now set the Luna Clan free.
strings.talk.62312.text: Oh, no! Why did you break your promise and kill my clansmen?!
strings.talk.62313.text: Ha ha! Now it's your turn.
strings.talk.62314.text: #f2/#fYou killed the innocent people of the Luna Clan and now you want to kill Qlaya and her mother? I will stop you and avenge them!
strings.talk.62315.text: Are you sure you can stop me?
strings.talk.62317.text: Go get some more training, weakling!
strings.talk.62319.text: I am unstoppable now thanks to the power of the Secret Fete Book. Are you ready to die?
strings.talk.62321.text: The only way is by destroying the Luna Jade.
strings.talk.62322.text: How I wish I had brought the #R#BLuna Jade/#R/#B along with me.
strings.talk.62323.text: That's the only way to get rid of the Secret Fate Book.
strings.talk.62324.text: The Luna Jade contains the life force of Luna and her daughter. If it is damaged, they will die.
strings.talk.62326.text: It doesn't matter, #N/#N. I am willing to sacrifice my life. At least I will die with my mom.
strings.talk.62328.text: The Luna Clan have always been pursued by killers because of that power. I am willing to sacrifice my life to stop it.
strings.talk.62330.text: You fool! You destroyed the Luna Jade.
strings.talk.62331.text: Don't be so smug. Other evils are not easy to deal with. Nobody can destroy King Howert.
strings.talk.62334.text: Although I cannot stay with you anymore, if you look up to the sky, you will see me there.
strings.talk.62335.text: Promise me you'll live your life to the fullest! I don't want to see you sad, OK?
strings.talk.62337.text: Enter the first level of the prison?
strings.talk.62338.text: Qlaya will leave #R#Bforever/#R/#B. Are you sure you want to proceed?
strings.talk.62340.text: You good for nothing! You only had to steal something for me. How could you mess that up?!
strings.talk.62342.text: Forget it. Your next mission will be to kill the Lion General, owner of the Curse Scroll.
strings.talk.62343.text: You want me to kill the Lion General?
strings.talk.62344.text: Yes. After you kill him, bring the Curse Scroll back to me. If you fail again, you know what will happen to you.
strings.talk.62346.text: (How awful! They want to kill the Lion General.)
strings.talk.62347.text: (I must inform the #R#BLion General/#R/#B of their plan.)
strings.talk.62348.text: I heard the Yamataikoku are famous for their magic. That's why I'm here.
strings.talk.62349.text: (He wants the Curse Scroll. That's why he ordered me to kill the Lion General. I must inform the #R#BLion General/#R/#B of this news as soon as possible.)
strings.talk.62351.text: This is your death, Lion General.
strings.talk.62352.text: Stop. I'll never let you kill the Lion General.
strings.talk.62354.text: Argh! I have to stop her from killing the Lion General.
strings.talk.62355.text: Why did you prevent me from killing the Lion General?
strings.talk.62357.text: As a ninja, I have to do everything my lord asks of me. That's my duty.
strings.talk.62358.text: You are wrong. A ninja must be responsible by giving good advice and pointing out that which is wrong rather than blindly taking orders.
strings.talk.62364.text: It makes no difference to me. A weak ninja doesn't deserve to be alive. Time to meet your end. Hayate and Lion General, death has come for you.
strings.talk.62365.text: Kill Hayate and the Lion General and recover the Curse Scroll!
strings.talk.62367.text: You are a traitor. Death is coming for you.
strings.talk.62368.text: Go get some more training! Ha ha!
strings.talk.62369.text: What?! How dare you! Hayate, you must be ashamed of your despicable conduct. This is called betrayal and it will bring you death!
strings.talk.62370.text: I just don't care. I won't continue living my life under someone else's control.
strings.talk.62371.text: You are delusional! Traitors cannot control their own lives.
strings.talk.62372.text: I recommend you focus on steering clear of the hunt for a traitor.
strings.talk.62373.text: Thank you for telling me this. I'm leaving now.
strings.talk.62374.text: You're leaving? Why not let me help you fight this evil?
strings.talk.62375.text: Thank you, but no. I must handle this myself.
strings.talk.62377.text: Why does every ninja have to be so proud?
strings.talk.62379.text: Why am I here? Aren't you the person I mistook for a thief? What are you doing here?
strings.talk.62380.text: (I can't let him know Hayate knocked him out in one punch trying to kill him.)
strings.talk.62381.text: I intended to pay a visit to Himiko and discovered you had fallen asleep here. So I woke you up.
strings.talk.62382.text: Oh, well thanks for waking me. It's disgraceful to fall asleep on the side of the road.
strings.talk.62383.text: Let me express my gratitude to you. Take this.
strings.talk.62384.text: Thank you very much, Lion General.
strings.talk.62385.text: I must continue my patrol. Please take care.
strings.talk.62390.text: Did you see blood under that tree?
strings.talk.62392.text: Is it Hayate? How did she fall from the tree? She's hurt badly. I have to help her!
strings.talk.62393.text: Who are you? What are you doing?!
strings.talk.62394.text: Hayate has left the Kurokawa ninjas.
strings.talk.62395.text: People who betray the organization must die!
strings.talk.62397.text: Then I will kill you first!
strings.talk.62398.text: #f2/#fI have to defeat the Kurokawa ninjas.
strings.talk.62399.text: We won't give up. Hayate will die sooner or later. Let's go!
strings.talk.62400.text: The Kurokawa ninjas won't give up so easily.
strings.talk.62401.text: Hayate is badly hurt. We need a #RRecovery Potion/#R to save her.
strings.talk.62402.text: Only a #RRecovery Potion/#R will save Hayate.
strings.talk.62404.text: Yes, you're badly hurt. We can't leave you by yourself.
strings.talk.62406.text: I was attacked by Kurokawa's minions and hid in the tree.
strings.talk.62407.text: Hayate, let's travel together so we can look after one another.
strings.talk.62408.text: But Kurokawa will chase you, too!
strings.talk.62409.text: #f1/#fIt doesn't matter. I saved you, so they're already my enemy.
strings.talk.62410.text: Let's team up to fight Kurokawa together!
strings.talk.62411.text: OK, but can I trust you?
strings.talk.62413.text: How can I be sure? Evil people would just lie.
strings.talk.62414.text: I guess I can't argue with that. Only time will tell.
strings.talk.62420.text: That's odd. Why are wolves chasing that cat instead of dogs?
strings.talk.62421.text: The cat and wolves entered #Rthe cave/#R. Let's go check it out.
strings.talk.62423.text: Ahroo! (I'm starving! Can I eat it now? )
strings.talk.62425.text: Ahroo! (I'm starving! Can I eat it now?)
strings.talk.62426.text: Ahroo! (Eat it, eat it, eat it!)
strings.talk.62428.text: (Do you want to save the cat or not?)
strings.talk.62431.text: I have to save the cat!
strings.talk.62432.text: Don't worry little cat, they're gone.
strings.talk.62436.text: Looks like you're OK. Try to be more careful!
strings.talk.62440.text: I didn't mean to, but the cat ...
strings.talk.62441.text: You just mentioned Shizune. Who is that?
strings.talk.62442.text: Shizune, can you show #n/#n your human shape?
strings.talk.62443.text: Sam, I'm surprised that you still recognize me.
strings.talk.62445.text: (Oh, she can change shapes like Sam. Are they members of the same race?)
strings.talk.62448.text: Why are you blushing? Aren't you feeling well?
strings.talk.62449.text: Well ... I missed you. I left the village to find you.
strings.talk.62450.text: Are you kidding me? Girls shouldn't leave the village alone! They're probably worried sick. You should go back!
strings.talk.62451.text: Why are you shouting? I really like you. I wasn't kidding ...
strings.talk.62453.text: Sam, you should be more caring. It's dangerous for her to travel alone.
strings.talk.62454.text: If she doesn't go back, everyone will worry!
strings.talk.62455.text: But if you go with her, she'll be safe.
strings.talk.62456.text: But I just made her mad ...
strings.talk.62457.text: She can't have gone too far. Let's find her!
strings.talk.62458.text: I shouldn't have said that Shizune. I'm sorry.
strings.talk.62459.text: Hmph! You know, it's all your fault. How are you going to fix it?
strings.talk.62460.text: Well, if you come with us, I can watch over you ...
strings.talk.62461.text: #f1/#fWhat Sam means is that he cares about you and wants to look after you.
strings.talk.62462.text: Really, Sam? I can go with you?!
strings.talk.62470.text: Shizune ... Sam ... it's so beautiful here!
strings.talk.62471.text: Yeah, the wind blows all my troubles away. Don't you agree Sam?
strings.talk.62476.text: It's nice to see them growing closer.
strings.talk.62477.text: It's nice to see them growing closer.
strings.talk.62479.text: Shizune, get behind me! I'll protect you!
strings.talk.62480.text: Ha ha! I'll eat ALL OF YOU!
strings.talk.62481.text: #F2/#FIt's awful! The guilt is too hard to deal with.
strings.talk.62482.text: You're not as weak as I thought, but I'll still get one of you!
strings.talk.62483.text: Let me go! Let me go! Sam, HELP ME!
strings.talk.62485.text: It's my fault for not protecting her.
strings.talk.62487.text: The hawk flew west. Let's follow him!
strings.talk.62489.text: The hawk flew to #Rthe west/#R. We have to catch it before it eats Shizune!
strings.talk.62490.text: Do you see that feather? This must be his nest!
strings.talk.62491.text: But we'll need a #Rladder/#R to climb up there.
strings.talk.62492.text: We need to find a #Rladder/#R to climb up there.
strings.talk.62496.text: Sam, Shizune passed out. Let's get her out of here.
strings.talk.62497.text: Hey, don't leave with my supper!
strings.talk.62499.text: #F2/#FIt's awful! The guilt is too hard to deal with.
strings.talk.62502.text: Shizune, you finally woke up! I was worried about you!
strings.talk.62503.text: Oh, how can you talk such nonsense?
strings.talk.62505.text: I was just worried that if you died your dad would kill me.
strings.talk.62508.text: Since Shizune is OK, we should get going now.
strings.talk.62522.text: My uncle is surrounded by poisonous flowers!
strings.talk.62527.text: Thank you for helping me, and thanks to your friend, too. What's his name?
strings.talk.62530.text: Anyone can become a marksman. It just takes practice!
strings.talk.62531.text: It's time I retired. Give this gun to Louis. Hopefully he'll take good care of it.
strings.talk.62532.text: Are you sure you want to do this?
strings.talk.62533.text: Don't worry about it. Just take it. I insist.
strings.talk.62535.text: Thank you, and you, too, Louis. It would've been a shame to be killed by such little flowers.
strings.talk.62536.text: Give this gun to Louis. He'll know how to use it.
strings.talk.62538.text: My uncle is strong. Don't worry.
strings.talk.62540.text: Who is wanted? Whoa, that's a big reward!
strings.talk.62541.text: The guy on the wanted poster looks familiar. Is that Fred? I need to be careful in Rome.
strings.talk.62542.text: The guy on the wanted poster looks familiar. Is that Fred?
strings.talk.62543.text: Fred, you are wanted for murder! They say you killed a priest.
strings.talk.62544.text: This is my first time here. How could I have killed him?
strings.talk.62545.text: I need to find out what happened.
strings.talk.62547.text: Let's begin our investigation at the hotel.
strings.talk.62548.text: Excuse me, do you know anything about the man on the wanted poster?
strings.talk.62549.text: Oh, several months ago some guy attacked the Holy Palace and killed the priest.
strings.talk.62550.text: Why did he kill the priest?
strings.talk.62551.text: I don't know, but I heard that the Priest was looking for the savior before he was killed.
strings.talk.62552.text: Did you just say the savior?
strings.talk.62553.text: Yeah, the priest asked everyone to let him know if they had any info on the savior.
strings.talk.62554.text: Really? I know something about the savior. Where can I find the priest?
strings.talk.62555.text: The priest is in the #RHoly Palace/#R.
strings.talk.62556.text: Thank you. I will go to the #RHoly Palace/#R to find the priest.
strings.talk.62557.text: (The guy with the blue hair looks the same as the guy on the wanted poster.)
strings.talk.62558.text: The priest is in the #RHoly Palace/#R.
strings.talk.62561.text: I'm Silvia, one of the evil ones. Archie! Neil! You two can come out now!
strings.talk.62562.text: It was revolting having to assume Frederico's appearance.
strings.talk.62563.text: But if I hadn't, the so-called "savior" wouldn't have come here.
strings.talk.62565.text: We need to take revenge for Berthaud and also help King Howert.
strings.talk.62566.text: If we kill him, King Howert will reward us!
strings.talk.62569.text: Today is the day you die.
strings.talk.62570.text: Today is the day you die.
strings.talk.62571.text: Today is the day you die.
strings.talk.62573.text: King Howert, please give me another chance. I will kill him next time.
strings.talk.62574.text: You are useless. I don't need you anymore.
strings.talk.62576.text: King Howert is so evil, he kills his own followers.
strings.talk.62577.text: They are just King Howert's toys. After killing the evil one, what should we do next?
strings.talk.62578.text: Let's go back and look at the wanted poster.
strings.talk.62580.text: Stop! This is the man we've been looking for! Are you friends?
strings.talk.62581.text: Wait! It was a mistake! One of King Howert's followers killed the priest, not Frederico!
strings.talk.62582.text: Archie took Frederico's appearance and killed the priest.
strings.talk.62584.text: Yeah! This was all a plot by King Howert!
strings.talk.62585.text: The last priest mentioned something about King Howert trying to destroy the world. It seems that he was telling the truth. I'll cancel the warrant.
strings.talk.62586.text: You should show respect to the general.
strings.talk.62587.text: Thank you for finding the real criminal. This is for you.
strings.talk.62589.text: Now you won't need to go to prison.
strings.talk.62600.text: You cannot enter the cave. A mysterious force prevents it.
strings.talk.62601.text: #n/#n, look! The cherry blossoms are falling down like a gentle rain.
strings.talk.62603.text: If someone saw this in their last moments of life, it would be a blessing.
strings.talk.62605.text: #n/#n, I've had a really good time being with you of late, but sometimes I forget my mission!
strings.talk.62607.text: I like traveling with you. I'd like to stick around after this mission to go adventuring some more.
strings.talk.62608.text: That would be great! We can go hiking, take a dip in a hot spring, or even get some good food together. Please stay, Angela!
strings.talk.62611.text: Why did Angela stop so suddenly?
strings.talk.62612.text: #n/#n, it seems an angel just paid us a visit. That scent is familiar.
strings.talk.62613.text: Really? Is it an angel you know? Let's find it!
strings.talk.62614.text: This door cannot be opened. Maybe there's a device that can open this door.
strings.talk.62620.text: How dare you enter the forbidden kingdom of King Howert?! Prepare to pay with your lives!
strings.talk.62622.text: Noo! I have been defeated! Curses!
strings.talk.62623.text: Whose armlet is this? We have to stay out of sight of King Howert's men. Perhaps #RAngela/#R can shed some light on all this.
strings.talk.62624.text: Angela and our savior! You finally made it!
strings.talk.62625.text: Oh! It's you, sister! I never thought I'd see you again!
strings.talk.62626.text: Angela, are you an heir of the Bright Shield, too?
strings.talk.62627.text: I just want to finish what's left, sister.
strings.talk.62628.text: Don't be silly! You're just a common angel.
strings.talk.62631.text: If the Messiah had descended during the final battle a hundred years ago, King Howert's dark power would not have grown so dangerous.
strings.talk.62632.text: We wouldn't have lost so many angels.
strings.talk.62633.text: #n/#n! Is there a chance you may be enchanted by King Howert and betray Angela?
strings.talk.62634.text: Absolutely not! I want to protect Angela and see her beautiful smile!
strings.talk.62635.text: #n/#n! Is there a chance you may be enchanted by King Howert and betray Angela?
strings.talk.62636.text: Hmmm ... I think you'll keep your promise. Very well. This is my Sunny Armlet. It will guide you to King Howert.
strings.talk.62637.text: Their destinies lie in your hands. Do not fail them.
strings.talk.62639.text: I have much more to discuss with you.
strings.talk.62640.text: Angela, Misia has taken us under his wing. The road to defeating King Howert is still long, but we'll do anything to see it through to the end!
strings.talk.62641.text: Hello there, if you have 70 wing fabrics, I'll beable to exchange them with you for a white wing suit.
strings.talk.62642.text: The redemption is successful, If you wish to redeem again, please find me.
strings.talk.62645.text: Sorry, you do not have enough inventory space to redeem.
strings.talk.62646.text: Sorry, you do not have enough materials to exchange.
strings.talk.62647.text: Exchange 70 Wing Fabric for a White Wing Suit.

strings.talk.63001.text: Hello! Do you want to re-challenge 20 Rounds?
